quest.name: Santiago's Dilemma
quest.desc: $npc:11000021$'s youngest grandson $npc:11000054$ threw a tantrum about being sent to the royal audience, then suddenly disappeared. Where could $npc:11000054$ be? Let's meet $npc:11000148$ at $map:63000001$ and ask about $npc:11000054$'s whereabouts.

quest.name: The Start of a Journey
quest.desc: I heard from $npc:11000062$ that the upcoming levee for the Empress will be open to the public. It's going to be a once in a lifetime opportunity you won't want to miss. Should I attend as well?
quest.manual: Talk to $npc:11000016$ in $map:63000002$ to board a ship headed towards Lith Harbor

quest.name: The Empress' Levee
quest.desc: It was nice seeing $npc:11000080$ the island boy again in $map:02000062$. You'll probably find even more familiar faces in $map:02000001$. The Royal Road that connects $map:02000062$ and $map:02000001$ should make the journey quick and easy. But first, find a path that connects $map:02000062$ to $map:02000114$.
quest.manual: Go to $map:02000001$, the location where the levee will be held

quest.name: I want to know that
quest.desc: $npc:11000003$ has traveled far over mountains and rivers to reach Tria, and seems very upset about the audience ceremony being canceled. Hearing $npc:11000003$'s story, the sudden cancellation feels suspicious. Could there be another reason? Maybe I should discreetly ask the armory guard at $map:02000001$ that $npc:11000003$ pointed out.
quest.complete: Find out the reason the audience was canceled in $map:02000001$

quest.name: Their Hidden Story
quest.desc: The royal steward $npc:11000492$ of $map:02000140$... As the person who oversaw all the preparations for the audience ceremony, they might know more about why it was canceled. Let's head to $map:02000140$ first.

quest.name: Those Who Leave
quest.desc: It seems $npc:11000179$'s high opinion of $npc:11000492$ goes beyond a simple business referral. Watching $npc:11000492$ smile for everyone even while repeating the same words dozens of times in the middle of a hectic day makes it easy to see why not just $npcName:11000179$, but most people, would remember him fondly. If I head to $map:02000033$ and handle the checkout $npcName:11000179$ asked me to do, could I be remembered as a good person too, just like $npc:11000492$?

quest.name: Porters in Danger
quest.desc: The porters that carried the goods in preparation for the levee came to $map:02000116$ despite the dangers that awaited. It seems that some particularly thorny vines may have trapped some of them. Try and save any porters you come across.
quest.manual: Rescue the porters stuck inside the vines in $map:02000116$

quest.name: Relaying the Message
quest.desc: $npc:11000129$ says that there is a group that went on ahead into $map:02000117$. I was asked to meet them to relay the tale of the porters that have fallen into trouble, and ask them to wait until everyone has arrived. Let's head on over to $map:02000117$ to look for another royal porter.

quest.name: A Recruit's Troubles
quest.desc: Guard trainee $npc:11000169$ is quietly troubled by weapons that have vanished without a trace from the armory he's been guarding. He's barely left his post, and the lock was still firmly in place — so who took them, and how? As $npc:11000169$ said, the stolen weapons could turn up on the black market, so I should visit equipment merchant $npc:11000004$ at $map:02000001$ to check if any stolen weapons have come through.

quest.name: Toward the Golden Tower
quest.desc: In the end, $npc:11000170$ confessed to having bought iron ore from $npc:11000173$. Even if the iron ore $npcName:11000170$ dealt in has nothing to do with the armory theft... the notorious fence $npcName:11000173$ might know something about the stolen weapons. Let's take the iron ore sales flyer $npc:11000170$ gave me and head to $map:02000083$, where the entrance to $map:02000141$ is said to be!

quest.name: The Origin of the Iron Ore
quest.desc: $npc:11000365$ found a transaction record among the $item:30000018$ I retrieved, showing that $npc:11000173$ purchased iron ore from $npcName:11000171$, and handed it to me. $npc:11000171$, who runs a junk shop at $map:02000084$ — where would a mere junk dealer get a large supply of iron ore? I should head to $map:02000084$ and meet $npc:11000171$ first.

quest.name: The Delivery Truck's Whereabouts
quest.desc: $npc:11000171$ said the Goldus delivery truck carrying the iron ore came from $map:02000001$. If that's true, $npc:11000012$ at $map:02000001$ might know where it was headed. Let's go to $map:02000001$ and meet $npc:11000012$.

quest.name: Suspicious Delivery
quest.desc: After rummaging through the shipping records for a while, $npc:11000012$ finally found the entry. The truck's destination: 125 Royal Road, $map:02000064$! Who received the iron ore delivery? Let's head to $map:02000064$!

quest.name: The Truth Behind the Armory Theft
quest.desc: A suspicious ledger found in $map:02000020$... It looks like records of transactions involving royal goods... For now, let's take the ledger and return to $map:02000001$ to meet $npc:11000169$.
quest.manual: Pick up the suspicious ledger on the desk in $map:02000020$

quest.name: To Nelf's Home!
quest.desc: The home address for $npc:11000492$ that $npc:11000012$ found in the address book was 674 Flower Park, $map:02000119$. Let's find the house with the red roof in the Flower Park district.

quest.name: A Mysterious Note
quest.desc: Will I really be able to find clues to track Nelf's whereabouts inside $map:02000122$? Let's thoroughly search every corner of $map:02000122$, located in $map:02000119$, and find a lead on Nelf's whereabouts.
quest.manual: Find clues in $map:02000119$ $map:02000122$ to track down Nelf's whereabouts

quest.name: What Nelf Left Behind
quest.desc: I came all the way to $map:52000037$ in $map:02000043$ marked on the crumpled memo, but... unfortunately, $npc:11000492$ was already dead. And a mysterious figure appeared at just the right moment, opened a secret door in the cave, and vanished. If I follow that person, maybe I can find a clue to unravel everything. Steady myself and follow the mysterious figure deeper into the cave.
quest.manual: Chase the mysterious stranger who disappeared through the secret door in $map:52000037$ and find clues

quest.name: A New Clue
quest.desc: After hearing about $npc:11000492$'s death and the mysterious notebook found nearby, $npc:11000169$ asked me to report everything I've investigated directly to $npc:11000119$. Let's go meet $npcName:11000119$ at $map:02000001$.
quest.manual: Retrieve the mysterious notebook from $npc:11000169$ in $map:02000001$

quest.name: Monkey Trouble
quest.desc: At $map:02000064$, it seems $npc:21000055$ that wander over from $map:02000017$ sometimes cause trouble by stealing residents' belongings and ransacking homes. $npc:11000172$'s $item:30000019$ was likely stolen by $npc:21000055$ from $map:02000017$ as well. Apparently they hide inedible objects in tree branches in the forest, so let's shake the trees in $map:02000017$ to find the $item:30000019$!

quest.name: A Secret Between Two
quest.desc: $npc:11000172$ of $map:02000064$ reluctantly agreed to open the door to $map:02000020$. I should quickly look around $map:02000020$ and come back out.

quest.name: The Last Letter
quest.desc: Hearing $npc:11000012$'s words, I faintly recall how $npc:11000492$ always looked after his mother so carefully. A final letter from a son to his mother... I'm not sure I can face $npc:11000492$'s mother, who will receive a letter from a son she can never meet again. But thinking of a mother still waiting for her child, I feel I should get there as soon as possible. Let's take the $item:30000025$ from $npc:11000012$ and head to $map:02000076$ to meet $npc:11000178$.

quest.name: A Boy's Curiosity
quest.desc: Although she nags every now and then, $npc:11000107$ is a kind sister that is simply worried for $npc:11000114$. But where could $npc:11000114$ have gone? Could he really have gone to Royal Road?

quest.name: Tires for Cash
quest.desc: $npc:11000395$ is a resident of the slums at $map:02000084$, living hand to mouth day by day. He barely has the strength to stand from hauling heavy scrap tires every day, and it would weigh on me to just walk past. Let's move the scrap tires piled around $npc:11000395$ at $map:02000084$ to the junk yard area where $npc:11000171$ and the helpers are working.
quest.manual: Move scrap tires to the junkyard in $map:02000084$

quest.name: A Stinging Revolt
quest.desc: The honey bees that have worked hard to gather all this honey are furious ever since $npc:22000022$ stole their honey. You should give $npc:22000022$'s honey pot to the honey bees that have lost their food. Look for a pot of honey below a stone roof in $map:02000117$, where $npc:22000022$ appears.
quest.manual: Recover the pot of honey in $map:02000117$

quest.name: A Family in Misfortune
quest.desc: It was odd enough to find frozen ground and ice chunks in the middle of a green meadow — but to think those ice chunks were actually people frozen solid... Among the frozen figures on the ice at the center of $map:02000085$, let's find $npc:11000186$'s older sister $npc:11000188$ and thaw her with the warmth of $item:30000028$. First, let's break a branch from the red maple tree next to $npc:11000186$ and head down toward the ice.
quest.manual: Pluck $item:30000028$ next to $npc:11000186$|Find $npc:11000188$ among the frozen victims in the center of $map:02000085$ and thaw them

quest.name: Big Sister is Back
quest.desc: Thinking about how long $npc:11000188$ was frozen, her coming back to life truly feels like a miracle. I should go meet $npc:11000188$ and warmly take her hand. Let's head inside $map:02000150$.

quest.name: 손녀를 위해서라면
quest.desc: $npc:11000188$$pp:를,을$ 향한 $npc:11000187$의 사랑과 관심이 그대로 전해진다. $npc:11000188$$pp:가,이$ 어서 몸을 회복할 수 있도록 나도 도와야겠다. $map:02000059$$pp2:로,으로$ 가자.

quest.name: A Grandmother's Love
quest.desc: $npcName:11000187$ is deeply worried for the health of her granddaughter $npcName:11000188$, and has asked you to get medicine from an herbalist in $map:02000059$.
$npc:11000187$'s love and concern for $npc:11000188$ comes through clearly. I should help so $npc:11000188$ can recover quickly. Go to $map:02000059$.

quest.name: 방랑 약초꾼
quest.desc: $npc:11000190$$pp:는,은$ 참 무심한 남편인 것 같다. 일단, $npc:11000192$$pp:를,을$ 찾아가서 $npcName:11000190$의 행방을 알아보자.
$npc:11000190$ seems like a very inattentive husband. First, find $npc:11000192$ and learn where $npcName:11000190$ is.

quest.name: That Man of Mine
quest.desc: It seems that $npcName:11000190$ wandered off days ago without any consideration for his wife and children, and hasn't been back since. You should talk see if $npcName:11000192$ the $npcTitle:11000192$ knows where $npcName:11000190$ went.

quest.name: 약초꾼에게 필요한 건?
quest.desc: 간단히 구할 수 있을 줄 알았는데… $npc:11000190$$pp:를,을$ 만나기가 이리 어려울 줄이야… $npc:11000187$에게 이미 약초를 구해다 주겠다고 약속을 했으니 이제 와서 포기할 수도 없다. 일단, $item:30000026$$pp:를,을$ 들고 $map:02000059$의 $npc:11000192$의 집 바로 아래에 있다고 하는 $map:02000082$$pp2:로,으로$ 가서 $npc:11000190$$pp:를,을$ 찾아보자.

You thought it would be easy to get... but who knew meeting $npc:11000190$ would be this difficult... You already promised $npc:11000187$ you would bring back the medicinal herbs, so you cannot give up now. For now, take $item:30000026$ and go to $map:02000082$, said to be right below $npc:11000192$'s house in $map:02000059$, and look for $npc:11000190$.

quest.name: O Husband, Where Art Thou?
quest.desc:
What started as a simple trip to pick up medicine has turned into a missing persons case, and now two families are counting on you to find $npcName:11000190$.
Take $npcName:11000190$'s $item:30000026$ and search for him in the $map:02000082$, which is located right below $npcName:11000192$'s house in $map:02000059$.

quest.name: 비법서를 찾아서
quest.desc: $npc:11000190$$pp:는,은$ 건망증이 심한 것 같다. 그가 부지런히 비법서를 만들어 놓은 것도 다 이 건망증 때문에 생긴 버릇이겠지…? 아무튼 $map:02000059$에 있는 $map:02000151$에서 약초 비법서를 찾아보자.
quest.complete: $map:02000059$에 있는 약초꾼의 집에서 약초 비법서 찾기

quest.name: A Recipe for Disasters
quest.desc:
Being a forgetful man, $npc:11000190$ carefully documents all his notes on herbs and plants in a guide book. If you can find the book, you should be able to discern how to help $npcName:11000188$.
Go to $map:02000151$ in $map:02000059$ and look for the herb guide.
quest.complete: Find the herb guide in the herbalist's house in $map:02000059$

quest.desc: $npc:11000190$ seems very forgetful. Maybe his habit of diligently making secret manuals came from that forgetfulness...? Anyway, look for the herbal secret manual in $map:02000151$ in $map:02000059$.
quest.complete: Find the herbalist's secret book in the herbalist's house in $map:02000059$
quest.name: Searching for the Secret Book
황금 사과의 비밀
quest.desc: $npc:11000190$의 비법서에는 $item:20000044$$pp:가,이$ 몸을 따뜻하게 해 주는 효능이 있다고 적혀 있다. $map:02000059$에서 황금 사과나무를 찾아보자.
$npc:11000190$'s secret manual says $item:20000044$ has the effect of warming the body. Look for a golden apple tree in $map:02000059$.

quest.name: Eat Fruits and Leaves
quest.desc:
According to $npc:11000190$'s herb guide, a $item:20000044$ just might help restore $npcName:11000188$'s health.
Go shake some $item:20000044$ trees in $map:02000059$!

quest.name: 나무장작 쟁탈전
quest.desc: $npc:11000203$$pp:는,은$ 몬스터들이 나무 장작을 훔쳐가는 바람에 화가 많이 난 것 같다. $map:02000059$에서 $map:02000054$$pp2:로,으로$ 가는 길에 움푹 패인 땅에 쌓여 있는 장작더미를 $npc:11000203$ 앞으로 옮겨주자.

quest.name: Get Your Hands Off My Wood
quest.desc:
$npcName:11000203$ the $npcTitle:11000203$ is furious about monsters making off with his firewood.
You should grab any firewood you find on the path to $map:02000054$ and bring it back to him.
quest.manual: Place $npcName:11000203$'s liberated firewood in front of him

quest.desc: $npc:11000203$ seems very angry because monsters stole the firewood. Move the pile of firewood stacked in the sunken ground on the road from $map:02000059$ to $map:02000054$ to the front of $npc:11000203$.

quest.name: 가장의 의무
quest.desc: $npc:11000190$$pp:는,은$ $map:02000082$에서 계속 버섯을 캐고 있을 모양이다. 때가 되면 그도 집으로 돌아가겠지… 나가는 길에 $npcName:11000190$$pp:를,을$ 위해 $map:02000082$의 불 꺼진 양초를 다시 켜주고, $map:02000059$에서 $npc:11000191$$pp:를,을$ 만나보자.

quest.name: A Father's Duty
quest.desc:
It looks like $npcName:11000190$ has decided to stay in $map:02000082$ and harvest more mushrooms.
He's asked you to deliver a bag-full to $npc:11000191$ in $map:02000059$, and re-light some candles on your way out.

$npc:11000190$ seems likely to keep gathering mushrooms in $map:02000082$. When the time comes, he will probably return home... On your way out, relight the extinguished candle in $map:02000082$ for $npcName:11000190$, then meet $npc:11000191$ in $map:02000059$.
quest.name: The Head of the Household's Duty
Pincerific Choice
quest.desc: It seems as though $npc:11000098$ really likes $npc:11000151$. You can get $item:30000011$ by catching $npc:21000059$ right? Well then, you better stretch and get warmed up! You don't want to pull a muscle! Go to $map:63000002$ and catch $npc:21000059$ to gather $item:30000011$.

quest.name: Everything for Her
quest.desc: Is $npc:11000151$ simply horrible at expressing her feelings, or is she just always this blunt? Is it possible that $npc:11000151$'s boyfriend had enough of her abrasive attitude and decided not to return from $map:63000002$?
quest.complete: Go to $map:63000002$ after checking the location by pressing the M key

quest.name: Unusual Circumstances
quest.desc: Poor $npc:11000118$… She needs some assistance after injuring her hand. Someone needs to help her harvest the clams that hold pearls in $map:63000002$! Start searching for $item:30000008$!

quest.name: O Turtle! My Turtle!
quest.desc: $npc:11000053$ made a request to bring $item:20000013$, which is located at Turtle Hill where $npc:22300149$ appears. It's not going to be easy...but nothing worthwhile ever is, right?

quest.name: Leaving Lith Harbor
quest.desc: Are there not enough ships because so many people are trying to go to $map:02000062$? If that's the case, it'll probably be best to go to $map:63000002$ port and speak with $npc:11000016$ personally to see if a ship is available.

quest.name: Garbage Is Money Too
quest.desc: The slum resident $npc:11000396$ at $map:02000084$ looks like they haven't eaten in days and can barely stand. Let's gather the scattered $item:30000120$ around $map:02000084$ and bring them over.

quest.name: Iron Transformation
quest.desc: $npc:11000181$ of $map:02000084$ mistakenly assigned you work, thinking you were a worker who had just recently started. The assignment was to heat up the blast furnace to make an iron mold... Having this kind of experience can only help, right? Go to $map:02000084$ and gather the $item:30000120$ needed to make the $item:30000121$ with the blast furnace.
quest.manual: Make $item:30000121$ at the blast furnace in $map:02000084$

quest.name: Who Owns the Notebook?
quest.desc: A notebook bearing the Barota Trading Company logo was found in a bag near the deceased $npc:11000492$... Can this help unravel the mysteries surrounding $npc:11000492$'s death? For now, let's head to $map:02000139$, where Barota Trading Company's headquarters is located.
quest.complete: Find the Barota Trade Company Headquarters in $map:02000139$

quest.name: The Notebook's Secret
quest.desc: $npc:11000097$, who was certain it was the notebook of Barota Trading Company leader Layman, checked the contents and dropped it in a panic. Just what was written in that notebook?

quest.name: Forbidden Trade
quest.desc: Could $item:20000046$ really be among the goods stored by Barota Trading Company? I should find the Barota Trading Company warehouse in $map:02000139$ and check the items stored there. The warehouse is at the end of the road just in front of $npc:11000208$.
quest.manual: Search for $item:20000046$ near the Barota Merchant Guild warehouse in $map:02000139$

quest.name: Request for Support
quest.desc: Layman has been missing for several days... What kind of relationship did he have with Nelf? Let's head to $map:02000152$ in $map:02000100$ and meet Dark Wind captain $npc:11000044$.

quest.name: Backbreaking Work
quest.desc: Moving $item:30000048$ off a ship is dangerous work, even for a seasoned dockworker who's been at $map:02000139$ for years — one moment of carelessness could mean a back injury. But I can't ignore the request of someone who's sick... I'll help move the red container $item:30000048$ to the dock. From the stacked containers at the dock, let's move the cargo box that $npc:11000207$ requested to where the red containers are!
quest.manual: Move $item:30000048$ from the ship docked at $map:02000139$ to the pier

quest.name: The Precarious Pipeline
quest.desc: Oil seems to be a crucial resource throughout daily life in Kerning City. Before the problem gets worse, I should hurry to $map:02000148$ and remove the rust from the corroded pipes and repair them.

quest.name: Where Did Raymond Go?
quest.desc: $npc:11000044$ has given me a mission to secretly infiltrate the Shadow Commission and find out if they know the whereabouts of $npc:11000526$. A covert mission that Dark Wind cannot officially be involved in... Will I be able to succeed? For now, let's head to $map:02000138$ and find out where the Shadow Commission's hideout is.
quest.complete: Ask around for the Black Star hideout in $map:02000138$

quest.name: Secret Club
quest.desc: $map:02000149$? So this is the secret arcade the Shadow Commission has been quietly running... Let's go find $map:02000149$.

quest.name: Everything You Know
quest.desc: To get $npc:11000212$ to talk — who keeps yelling that we're ruining his business — it seems the only option is to disrupt his arcade operations. Let's drive out all the customers inside the arcade until $npc:11000212$ confesses!

quest.name: Black Office
quest.desc: The manager of $map:02000149$, $npc:11000212$, told me how to get from $map:02000149$ to $map:02000156$, along with the Shadow Commission recruitment code: "Code Black 365." From $map:02000149$, move ten squares to the southeast, then eleven squares to the northeast — the small iron gate I'll encounter is the entrance to $map:02000156$... For now, let's look for $map:02000156$ from $map:02000138$.

quest.name: Nothing Is Free
quest.desc: What is $item:20000015$ anyway... If "an eye for an eye" is the rule of this alley, then I have no choice but to play along... Let's defeat the monsters in the alleys of $map:02000138$ and find $item:20000015$.
quest.manual: Defeat monsters in the alleys of $map:02000138$ and find $item:20000015$

quest.name: Resolution
quest.desc: $npc:11000044$ told me to relay orders to $npc:11000215$ to reinforce the wanted order for $npc:11000064$.

quest.name: The Hunt Begins
quest.desc: $npc:11000215$ from $map:02000153$ asked me to help post $npc:11000064$'s wanted posters on the bulletin boards in each district.

quest.name: Bounty Hunt, Part One
quest.desc: Let's post $npc:11000064$'s wanted poster on the bulletin board $npc:11000343$ in $map:02000138$. If $item:30000038$ has been lost, go back to $npc:11000215$ in $map:02000153$ and ask.
quest.manual: Prepare $npc:11000064$'s wanted poster|Post $npc:11000064$'s wanted poster on the bulletin board $npc:11000343$ in $map:02000138$

quest.name: Bounty Hunt, Part Two
quest.desc: Let's post $npc:11000064$'s wanted poster on the bulletin board $npc:11000343$ in $map:02000137$. If $item:30000038$ has been lost, go back to $npc:11000215$ in $map:02000153$ and ask.
quest.manual: Prepare $npc:11000064$'s wanted poster|Post $npc:11000064$'s wanted poster on the bulletin board $npc:11000343$ in $map:02000137$

quest.name: Bounty Hunt, Part Three
quest.desc: Let's post $npc:11000064$'s wanted poster on the bulletin board $npc:11000343$ in $map:02000135$. If $item:30000038$ has been lost, go back to $npc:11000215$ in $map:02000153$ and ask.
quest.manual: Prepare $npc:11000064$'s wanted poster|Post $npc:11000064$'s wanted poster on the bulletin board $npc:11000343$ in $map:02000135$

quest.name: Bounty Hunt, The Finale
quest.desc: Let's post $npc:11000064$'s wanted poster on the bulletin board $npc:11000343$ in $map:02000146$. If $item:30000038$ has been lost, go back to $npc:11000215$ in $map:02000153$ and ask.
quest.manual: Prepare $npc:11000064$'s wanted poster|Post $npc:11000064$'s wanted poster on the bulletin board $npc:11000343$ in $map:02000146$

quest.name: Quite a Quandary
quest.desc: $map:02000100$'s $npc:11000065$ seems to be stuck in a predicament regarding the conflict between Goldus Pharmaceutical and the residents. What a sticky situation... Try to find out some more information and meet with $npc:11000216$, who is participating in the demonstration in front of $map:02000154$.

quest.name: Transparency Is a Virtue
quest.desc: It seems the demonstration won't end until full transparency is achieved, and the whole truth is revealed. $npc:11000216$ begged you to gather any sort of evidence that could help expose the truth. Begin your investigation with aplomb by heading over to $map:02000134$.

quest.name: An Inconvenient Truth
quest.desc: $map:02000134$'s $npc:11000124$ told you how to procure the material that may serve as evidence of how products from Goldus Pharmaceutical brought upon negative side effects. Make your way to $map:02000159$ connected to $map:02000134$, and activate both the drug mixing and data collecting devices to find $item:30000049$ and $item:20000048$.

quest.name: Lifetime Duty
quest.desc: The new drug $npc:11000124$ risked life and limb to create... Providing some assistance could be the perfect opportunity to ask him to help uncover the truth behind the drug's side effects. Head on over to $map:02000134$ to defeat all the monsters that have invaded, and look for $npc:11000124$'s $item:20000050$.

quest.name: 사라진 고양이
quest.desc: $npc:11000217$의 주인님이 애지중지하는 고양이 $npc:11000049$$pp:가,이$ 낭떠러지 벽 틈에 갇혀서 빠져 나오지 못하고 있다. 벽타기나 풍선날기 스킬로 낭떠러지 벽 틈으로 들어가서 $npc:11000049$$pp:를,을$ 구하자.

quest.name: The Cat in the Cliff
quest.desc:
$npcName:11000217$'s boss's cat $npc:11000049$ is stuck on the side of a cliff and in need of rescue.
Defy the law of gravity by way of wall-climbing or flying mount, and rescue $npc:11000049$.
quest.manual: Rescue $npc:11000049$ from the side of the cliff in $map:02000137$

quest.desc: $npc:11000049$, the beloved cat of $npc:11000217$'s owner, is trapped in a gap in the cliff wall and cannot get out. Use wall climbing or balloon flight to enter the gap in the cliff wall and rescue $npc:11000049$.

quest.name: God of Business
quest.desc: $npc:11000311$ from $map:02000166$ says they will tell me everything they saw, if I go to $map:02000136$ and bring back a large order of materials needed for the construction of Rockefeller Tower from $npc:11000220$.

quest.name: Business Results
quest.desc: $npc:11000220$ in $map:02000136$ handed over an order form listing the construction materials needed to build the Rockefeller Tower. Head back to $npc:11000311$ in $map:02000166$!

quest.name: Indomitable Will
quest.desc: Construction blueprints are an essential item for building Rockefeller Tower, the largest skyscraper in Maple World. Let's defeat the monsters that attacked $map:02000136$ and retrieve $item:30000043$.

quest.name: Dutiful Daughter Monica
quest.desc: I can't just ignore the request of $npc:11000221$, a shy girl with round eyes. It's not a difficult favor, so let's find $npc:11000222$ in $map:02000136$ and deliver the lunchbox.

quest.name: 위험한 연구소
quest.desc: $map:02000145$$pp:는,은$ 갑자기 들이닥친 몬스터들의 행패로 아수라장이었다. 곳곳에 몬스터의 공격을 받고 쓰러진 연구원들 사이에서 겨우 정신을 차리고 있던 $npc:11000125$$pp:는,은$ 몬스터들이 실험 중이던 $item:20000049$$pp:를,을$ 가지고 갔다며, 연구 센터 밖으로 $item:20000049$$pp:가,이$ 유출되기 전에 몬스터들을 처치하고 이를 되찾아달라고 부탁했다. 연구소 밖으로 유출되면 생태계에 대 혼란을 야기할 수도 있는 $item:20000049$! $map:02000145$$pp:를,을$ 습격한 몬스터들을 처치하고 녀석들이 가지고 간 $item:20000049$$pp:를,을$ 되찾아 유출을 막도록 하자!

quest.name: Containment Breach
quest.desc:
$map:02000145$ was thrust into chaos by an invasion of monsters, resulting in the injury of numerous researchers. But worse, they escaped with highly experimental $itemPlural:20000049$ that could wreak havoc on the environment should they escape the lab.
$npc:11000125$ has tasked you with defeating the monsters and retrieving the samples before it's too late.

$map:02000145$ was in chaos after monsters suddenly stormed in and ran wild. Among the researchers collapsed from monster attacks, $npc:11000125$ was barely conscious and said the monsters had taken $item:20000049$, which was being used in experiments. They asked you to defeat the monsters and recover it before $item:20000049$ leaks outside the research center. $item:20000049$ could cause major chaos in the ecosystem if it leaks outside the laboratory! Defeat the monsters that attacked $map:02000145$, recover the $item:20000049$ they took, and prevent the leak!

quest.name: 사랑은 너무 어려워
quest.desc: 알 수 없는 이유로 갑자기 토라진 여자친구를 달래기 위해 $npc:11000223$$pp:는,은$ 여자친구가 풀밭에 던져버린 $item:30000046$$pp:를,을$ 찾고 있다. $npc:11000223$의 사랑을 위해 $map:02000135$ 풀밭을 뒤져서 $item:30000046$$pp:를,을$ 찾아주자.

To cheer up his girlfriend, who suddenly got upset for unknown reasons, $npc:11000223$ is looking for $item:30000046$, which she threw into the grass. For $npc:11000223$'s love, search the grass in $map:02000135$ and find $item:30000046$.

quest.name: Love Hurts
quest.desc:
$npc:11000223$'s girlfriend got upset and threw her $item:30000046$ away. Before he can patch things up with her, he needs your help to recover it.
Search $map:02000135$ for the missing $item:30000046$.
quest.manual: Search the field in $map:02000135$ for the $item:30000046$

quest.name: 여자의 언어
quest.desc: $npc:11000223$의 여자친구가 화가 난 진짜 이유가 뭘까? $map:02000135$ 케이블카를 타고 올라가서 레스토랑에 있는 $npc:11000224$$pp:를,을$ 만나서 물어보자.
What is the real reason $npc:11000223$'s girlfriend is angry? Take the cable car in $map:02000135$ up and meet $npc:11000224$ at the restaurant to ask.

quest.name: Reasonable Expectations
quest.desc: Why is $npc:11000223$'s girlfriend $npc:11000224$ upset? Ride the cable car up to the restaurant in $map:02000135$ and ask her.

quest.name: 요정의 신발
quest.desc: 선량한 요정을 괴롭히는 나쁜 놈들…! $map:02000041$의 몬스터들을 물리치고 $item:30000050$$pp:를,을$ 찾아주자.
Bad people tormenting a kind fairy...! Defeat the monsters in $map:02000041$ and find $item:30000050$.

quest.name: Twinkle Toes
quest.desc: How dare they cause such trouble for the good fairies! It would be a shame to let such nice gifts go to waste. Defeat the monsters in $map:02000041$ and find $item:30000050$.

quest.name: The Realest Estate
quest.desc: $npc:11000185$ seems to always be busy since so many people are trying to buy and sell houses. Let's go see $npc:11000246$ in $map:02000002$ and help her out.

quest.name: Now That's What I Call Labor
quest.desc: It's not that difficult a task, and the pay seems to be pretty generous to boot.... Why don't I try packing and moving by going to $map:02000160$? I can check the location of $map:02000160$ using the mini map of $map:02000002$.

quest.name: Prison Package
quest.desc: $npc:11000401$ was so busy getting the comic books that he didn't notice that I was already inside packing the comic books that have already been piled up high. Since I already agreed to help, I'll move the $item:30000124$ scattered around $npc:11000401$ to the yard.
quest.manual: Move the $item:30000124$ scattered around $npc:11000401$ to the yard

quest.name: The Fates That Bind Us
quest.desc: I met $npc:11000110$ again in Victoria Island and he made another request. I don't hesitate to help those who I've only met once, so there's no reason why I can't help someone I've known since Maple Island. Let's defeat the monsters in the grass underneath the $map:02000114$ bridge, and find item:30000054$ that $npc:11000110$ lost.
quest.manual: Defeat the monsters in $map:02000114$ and recover $item:30000054$

quest.name: An Unexpected Event
quest.desc: The Royal Guard are also confused by the sudden earthquake. They're quickly trying to find out what caused the earthquake... Maybe I can lend a hand? I'll carry the equipment box that lies near $npc:11000157$ and move it below the stairs.
quest.manual: Move the equipment box that lies near $npc:11000157$ down the stairs

quest.name: Strong Eats
quest.desc: $map:02000001$'s safety is at jeopardy if hunger also becomes a factor in these intense battles. Defeat the monsters in $map:02000118$ and bring back the $item:20000014$ that the monsters have taken.
quest.manual: Bring back the $item:20000014$ that the $map:02000118$ monsters have taken

quest.name: For a Comrade
quest.desc: $npc:11000260$ expressed resentment toward $npc:11000064$ and lamented the hardships of being a Shadow Gate guardian. Let's help the guardians by defeating the monsters that have crossed over from the Dark Land near the Shadow Gate in $map:02000146$.
quest.manual: Defeat monsters near the Shadow Gate

quest.name: Emergency
quest.desc: It's an emergency! Let's head to $map:02000026$ in $map:02000146$ and meet $npc:11000122$!

quest.name: The Trampled Mushroom Field
quest.desc: The mushroom fields near the laboratory have become completely tainted with shadow energy, as the power of the Dark Land grows ever stronger. Can I really find $item:20000045$ that's still good enough to use as medicine ingredients? While watching out for shadow poison that spreads from the shadow-tainted ground, let's search not only the mushroom fields near the laboratory but all throughout $map:02000146$ for $item:20000045$!

quest.name: Miracle Medicine
quest.desc: Insert $item:20000045$ into the mixer at $map:02000026$ in $map:02000146$ and activate it to craft $item:20000016$.
quest.manual: Use the mixing machine in $map:02000026$ to craft $item:20000016$

quest.name: The Trainer's Mission
quest.desc: $npc:11000121$ says that together with $npc:11000122$, they plan to breach the barrier sealing the shadow gate in $map:02000146$ and study the DNA of monsters that crossed over from the Dark Land, in order to uncover the source of the shadow energy. Defeat the monsters near the shadow gate in $map:02000146$, collect $item:20000047$, and bring them to $npc:11000121$!
quest.manual: Defeat monsters near the Shadow Gate in $map:02000146$ and collect $item:20000047$

quest.name: Find the Spy
quest.desc: So if I gather every last fragment of the shattered Blue Lapenta, it can be restored... Perhaps a way to bring peace back to this world hasn't completely vanished after all. Let's find the spy $npc:21000178$, disguised as a Dark Wind agent near the Shadow Gate in $map:02000146$, and recover $item:30000058$!
quest.manual: Find the spy disguised as a Dark Wind agent in $map:02000146$ and recover $item:30000058$

quest.name: Qualification for Audience
quest.desc: $npc:11000076$'s letter of recommendation! This is practically a certificate that grants access to $map:02000025$ and the right to have an audience with $npc:11000075$. Let's go to $map:02000001$ and show the letter of recommendation to $npc:11000119$ to receive permission to enter $map:02000025$.

quest.name: To the Royal Palace of Tria!
quest.desc: Am I finally going to meet $npc:11000075$? My heart is pounding. Let's quickly head into $map:02000025$!

quest.name: Light of Blue Hope
quest.desc:
The path I took, driven by the sole desire to meet $npc:11000075$, leaving $map:63000001$ and coming to Victoria Island... and the news of the canceled audience that made it all feel so futile... Now, standing face to face with $npc:11000075$, all those memories flash before my eyes, and I'm filled with deep emotion.
$npc:11000075$ said something I don't think I'll ever forget: "Please lend your strength to this world going forward. I ask this in the name of the Empress."

quest.name: The Call of the Minister
quest.desc: $npc:11000119$ said that $npc:11000074$ made an order to recommend a person that could be trusted with the utmost confidentiality. I was told to go to $map:02000065$ and meet $npc:11000074$.

quest.name: The Minister's Request
quest.desc: After hearing what $npc:11000074$ said, I remember finding $item:30000174$ among the wreckage of the stolen royal carriage while chasing the red cape in $map:02000238$. At that time, $npc:11000119$ and $npc:11000074$ didn't speak much and only provided some vague answers after seeing $item:30000174$... After all, what could these two know? Let's first go to $map:02000218$ in $map:02000001$ and look for the picture $npc:11000074$ asked for.

quest.name: The Vid-Bleim Mansion
quest.desc: What could have happened in the Vid-Bleim family? $npc:11000074$, $npc:11000119$, and even $npc:11000530$... The fact that everyone is giving off such a tense vibe is making me a bit suspicious. What kind of stories will I hear if I bring back the picture to $npc:11000074$? Let's go to $map:02000190$ in $map:02000119$.

quest.name: A Daughter's Face
quest.desc: $npc:11000058$ was left alone to watch over $map:02000190$. Observing $npc:11000058$'s mood, there seems to be a silent but profound pain between her and her father $npc:11000074$... Why did $npc:11000074$ order this portrait...? Take the $item:30000182$ you received from $npc:11000058$ and return to $map:02000065$.

quest.name: A Sad Truth
quest.desc: The mysterious red-cloaked figure threatening the world with the Devlin at the vanguard! Their true identity is Bella Vidblain... Daughter of Royal Prime Minister $npc:11000074$, and twin sister of $npc:11000058$... and now... she has returned as a servant of evil, under the dominion of shadow energy. This is the moment that a painful memory — one no one wished to see revived, as though it were taboo — has descended upon $map:02000001$!

quest.name: Comprehending the Situation
quest.desc: $npc:11000044$ asked for assistance in finding $npc:11000069$, who has gone missing. Typically level-headed $npc:11000044$ is exhibiting an impatience you've never seen before, as she does not want to lose $npc:11000069$ to $npc:11000522$, just like her father and previous leader Win Stilton had in the past. Could $npc:11000522$ really have kidnapped $npc:11000069$?

quest.name: Lips Sealed Shut
quest.desc: $npc:11000258$ says that $npc:11000531$, who resents the Dark Wind, is not divulging any details regarding the disappearance of $npc:11000069$, and told me to go talk to $npc:11000531$ if I want more details.

quest.name: Start of the Clue
quest.desc: It's going to be difficult gaining any more useful information from $npc:11000531$. However, carefully tracking $npc:11000069$'s movement before the disappearance may lead to more clues that could become invaluable for this search.
quest.complete: Look for any clues between $item:39000012$ and $item:39000013$, and enter investigative questioning

quest.name: Deadliest Part-Time Job
quest.desc: $npc:11000532$ says that he was paid from a person he never met to merely borrow and return books. Just exactly who paid $npc:11000532$ to do this job? Could that person be connected to $npc:11000069$ disappearance? I still don't see how all of the clues I have really fit together, but I have no choice but to follow each clue like a trail of bread crumbs and continue my search...

quest.name: A Surreptitious Pursuit
quest.desc: $npc:11000301$ didn't see anyone suspicious looking in the area, but did mention that there is an area below the moving bone bridge in $map:02000045$ that hasn't started construction and could be a perfect place for someone to hide. If this person went through such great lengths to stay hidden, what $npc:11000301$ said about dark and hidden places is likely to be true, and these locations could possibly unearth some vital clues.
quest.manual: Look for the hideout beneath the moving bone bridge in $map:02000045$

quest.name: Perion and Yamarcha
quest.desc: You found the words Yamarcha and $map:02000051$ written on the dusty walls of $map:02000223$. I'm pretty sure $map:02000051$ is the name of a location, but Yamarcha... What could that mean...? Would the people in $map:02000051$ know the meaning behind this?
quest.complete: Go to $map:02000051$ and find out what Yamarcha means

quest.name: The Pursuit of Meaning
quest.desc: $npc:11000018$ apologized for not knowing what Yamarcha means, but was still helpful enough to refer me to $npc:11000136$. $npcName:11000136$, a unique girl that can tame savage wolves as if they were mere puppies... Could she possibly know what Yamarcha means?

quest.name: Catch the Varaha
quest.desc: Let's defeat $npc:22000002$, who appears sporadically in $map:02000087$, and claim the bounty. He is just as ferocious as he is notorious, so it'd probably be a good idea team up with some other people to hunt it down.

quest.name: 칸토의 꿈
quest.desc: $npc:22000002$에게 $item:30000065$$pp:를,을$ 빼앗긴 $npc:11000292$$pp:를,을$ 위해 $map:02000087$에서 $npc:22000002$$pp:가,이$ 나타날 때까지 기다렸다가 처치하자. 홀로 상대하기 어렵다면 함께 싸울 동료들을 모아보자.

quest.name: Kanto's Dream
quest.desc:
The $item:30000065$ is $npc:11000292$'s last shot at love, but it was stolen by $npc:22000002$. Wait for $npc:22000002$ to appear in $map:02000087$ and recover the potion for $npc:11000292$.
This will be a dangerous fight, so be sure to bring some friends!

For $npc:11000292$, whose $item:30000065$ was stolen by $npc:22000002$, wait in $map:02000087$ until $npc:22000002$ appears, then defeat it. If it is difficult to fight alone, gather companions to fight with you.

quest.name: Holding Back Reinforcements
quest.desc: $npc:11000119$ suddenly held back the $map:02000146$ Defender reinforcements, even though $npc:11000044$ is leading the Dark Wind. Suspending the Defender reinforcements out of nowhere like this... Could there have been a more dangerous and urgent situation than the protection of $map:02000146$?

quest.name: 나의 운명은?
quest.desc: 장난삼아, 재미삼아 $map:02000088$의 $npc:11000283$에게 운세를 한번 볼까?

quest.name: An Uncertain Fate
quest.desc: It might be fun to get your fortune read by $npc:11000283$ at $map:02000088$.

quest.name: 운명을 극복하는 자
quest.desc: 사실인지 아닌지 증명할 수는 없지만 어쩐지 운세를 듣고 보니 찜찜한 기분이다. 차라리 $item:30000068$$pp:를,을$ 구해서 찜찜한 기분은 시원하게 날려버리는 게 더 나을 것 같다. $map:02000088$에서 $npc:23000020$$pp:를,을$ 만나면 뒷걸음질치지 말고 용감하게 달려들어서 처단하자.

You cannot prove whether the fortune is true or not, but hearing it somehow leaves you uneasy. It may be better to obtain $item:30000068$ and clear away that uneasy feeling. If you meet $npc:23000020$ in $map:02000088$, do not back away. Charge bravely and defeat it.

quest.name: Overcoming Destiny
quest.desc:
No one can see the future. Not really. And yet, something about this fortune gnaws at the back of your mind...
Maybe you should get $item:30000068$, after all. Just in case.

quest.name: 아르웬과 유리구두
quest.desc: $map:02000006$의 $npc:11000284$$pp:는,은$ 얼마 전 숲 속에서 몬스터의 습격을 받아 소중한 유리구두를 잃어버리고 말았다며 울고 있다. 요정들은 반짝이는 아름다운 물건에 대한 집착이 대단하기 때문에 꼭 되찾고 싶어하는데… 도와 주겠다고 나섰던 사람들이 모두 구두를 찾아주는 걸 포기할 정도로 찾기 어렵다는 $item:30000069$! 쉽게 포기하지 말고 $map:02000006$의 몬스터 중에서 $item:30000069$$pp:를,을$ 가지고 있는 녀석을 꼭 찾아내서 $npcName:11000284$$pp:가,이$ 환하게 웃을 수 있게 해 주자!

$npc:11000284$ in $map:02000006$ is crying, saying she recently lost her precious glass slipper after being attacked by monsters in the forest. Fairies are very attached to beautiful sparkling things, so she desperately wants it back... $item:30000069$ is so hard to find that everyone who offered to help gave up! Do not give up easily. Find the monster in $map:02000006$ that has $item:30000069$ and help $npcName:11000284$ smile brightly again!

quest.name: Arwen's Glass Slippers
quest.desc:
You found $npc:11000284$ in $map:02000006$ bawling her little eyes out. Apparently her prized glass slippers were stolen by monsters. As everyone knows, fairies are extremely possessive of shiny baubles and things of beauty. Sadly, none of the people who offered to help her were able to follow through on their promise.
And so it falls to you to dry the tears in her eyes. Go forth and rough up the monsters of $map:02000006$ until one coughs up $npc:11000284$'s prized slippers!

quest.name: A Turtley Pure Love
quest.desc: $npc:11000285$ planted the flowers in remembrance for his loved one, but is fed up with having monsters trample them to death. I was asked to help revive the flowers in $map:02000089$. Let's help him with his request so that $npc:11000285$ can be at peace once more.

quest.name: The Broken Binti Tree
quest.desc: $npcName:11000293$, the owner of the log cave, is about to leave because monsters have been gnawing on the bark and burrowing into the nest... but says leaving behind the $item:20000052$ would be too much of a waste. It's hard to say how sticky the spider webs that $npc:11000293$ absolutely despises are, but let's find the $item:20000052$ inside the wooden barrels and bring it to $npc:11000293$, who has lost their home and been driven out.
quest.manual: Collect $item:20000052$ from inside the wooden barrels at $map:02000024$

quest.name: 개구리 구출 대작전
quest.desc: 구리구리한 도마구리 녀석들이 $map:02000022$ 주변의 개구리들을 모두 잡아다가 싹쓸이를 하고 있다. <font color="#ffd200">$npc:21090175$</font>, <font color="#ffd200">$npc:21090176$</font>, <font color="#ffd200">$npc:21090177$</font>$pp:를,을$ 처치하고 잡혀간 <font color="#ffd200">$item:30000071$</font>들을 찾아서 물가 연잎 위에 풀어주면 $npc:11000294$의 울음소리도 그칠 것 같다.
quest.manual: $map:02000022$의 도마구리들이 잡아간 $item:30000071$$pp:를,을$ 강가 연잎 위에 풀어주기

quest.name: Operation Frog Rescue
quest.desc: The 'gogs at the $map:02000022$ are on a campaign to wipe out the local frog population. Defeat $npcPlural:21090175$, $npcPlural:21090176$, and $npcPlural:21090177$, find the captured $itemPlural:30000071$, and return them to their lily pads.
quest.manual: Free $itemPlural:30000071$ from 'gogs at the $map:02000022$ and put them on lily pads

quest.desc: Those nasty Domaguri are catching and sweeping up all the frogs around $map:02000022$. Defeat <font color="#ffd200">$npc:21090175$</font>, <font color="#ffd200">$npc:21090176$</font>, and <font color="#ffd200">$npc:21090177$</font>, then find the captured <font color="#ffd200">$item:30000071$</font> and release them onto the lotus leaves by the water. That should stop $npc:11000294$ from crying.
quest.manual: Release $item:30000071$, captured by the Domaguri in $map:02000022$, onto the lotus leaves by the river

quest.name: Steadfast and Unchanging
quest.desc: $npc:11000097$ appears to be fighting hard to protect the Barota Trading Company, left in ruins by its leader $npc:11000526$'s corruption. $npcName:11000097$ has asked for my help — the least I can do is lend a hand.

quest.name: Wolf Phobia
quest.desc: $npc:11000426$ refused to hand over $item:30000072$ without a trade — they've asked me to hunt down all the wolves in $map:02000085$ that have been terrorizing them.

quest.name: With the Golden Carp
quest.desc: $npc:11000426$ handed over $item:30000256$ as promised. Thinking of $npc:11000097$ anxiously waiting, I should head back to $map:02000139$ quickly.

quest.name: 날아라, 나비야
quest.desc: $npc:11000298$$pp:는,은$ $map:02000004$의 딱딱하게 굳어버린 장난감 나무 속에 나비들이 갇혀 있다며 발을 동동거린다. 날개가 있는 나비들이 훨훨 날 수 있도록 풀어주자.
quest.manual: 장난감 나무 속에 갇힌 나비 풀어주기

quest.name: Flight of the Butterflies
quest.desc:
$npc:11000298$ says that there are butterflies trapped inside the petrified toy trees in $map:02000004$.
Release the butterflies so that they can fly free once more.
quest.manual: Free the butterflies trapped inside toy trees

quest.desc: $npc:11000298$ is stomping anxiously, saying butterflies are trapped inside the hardened toy trees in $map:02000004$. Free the butterflies so they can flutter away with their wings.

quest.name: 농사꾼의 근심
quest.desc: 어느 날 $map:02000056$ 바닥에 의문의 균열이 생기면서부터 호수는 점점 루디브리엄 큐브로 변해가기 시작했다. 때문에 이곳에 사는 $npc:11000299$$pp:는,은$ 농작물에 물을 주지 못해 걱정이 이만저만이 아니다. 폭포 바닥에 조금씩 남아있는 물을 퍼서 양동이에 담아오자!
quest.manual: $map:02000056$의 폭포수 바닥에 남은 물을 양동이에 담기

quest.name: The Concerned Farmer
quest.desc:
The water of the basin in $map:02000056$'s ground has gradually begun to turn into ludibrium blocks, and $npc:11000299$ is worried about how he will water his crops.
Gather water from what remains of the basin below the waterfall.

One day, a mysterious crack appeared on the floor of $map:02000056$, and the lake slowly began turning into a Ludibrium Cube. Because of this, $npc:11000299$, who lives here, is very worried because they cannot water their crops. Scoop up the little water remaining at the bottom of the waterfall and bring it back in a bucket!

quest.name: 당근당근, 행운당근
quest.desc: 여러 모로 $npc:11000299$의 걱정이 큰 것 같다. 그를 도와 $map:02000056$에 있는 당근 새싹에 물을 주자!

quest.name: A Load of Crop
quest.desc: $npc:11000299$ finally has some water for his crops, but too much ground to cover. Help him out by watering carrot sprouts in $map:02000056$!
$npc:11000299$ seems worried about many things. Help them water the carrot sprouts in $map:02000056$!

quest.name: 당근을 지키는 기본적인 방법
quest.desc: $npc:11000299$$pp:를,을$ 도와주긴 했지만 $map:02000056$의 몬스터들때문에 당근이 안전하게 잘 자라나지 못할 것 같다. $map:02000056$의 몬스터들이 당근을 망치기 전에 먼저 녀석들을 처치하자!

quest.name: Champion of Carrots
quest.desc:
With a dash of water, $npc:11000299$'s crop will live another day—provided it's not eaten by monsters.
Reduce the monster population in $map:02000056$ and protect the budding plants.
You helped $npc:11000299$, but because of the monsters in $map:02000056$, the carrots may not grow safely. Defeat the monsters in $map:02000056$ before they ruin the carrots!

quest.name: All Sold Out
quest.desc: $npc:11000268$ is obsessed with money, wealth, and buying expensive things. She says that she needs $item:20000054$, but is unable to purchase it because it's constantly sold out in the shop. If I remember correctly, there are supposedly a lot of $npc:21000053$ in $map:02000173$ and $map:02000174$…
quest.manual: Gather $item:20000054$ around the Ant Tunnel area

quest.name: 소식 없는 보부상
quest.desc: $npc:11000268$에게 $item:20000075$$pp:를,을$ 구해오겠다고 호언장담하고 떠난 $npc:11000300$. 하지만 길을 떠난지 한참이 지났는데도 별다른 소식이 없다고 한다. $map:02000039$$pp2:로,으로$ 가서 $npc:11000300$$pp:를,을$ 찾아보자.

quest.name: The Missing Hawker
quest.desc: $npcName:11000300$ went missing while collecting a $item:20000075$ for $npcName:11000268$. Go to $map:02000039$ and find him.

$npc:11000300$ left after boldly declaring they would bring $item:20000075$ back for $npc:11000268$. But even though a long time has passed since they left, there has been no news. Go to $map:02000039$ and look for $npc:11000300$.

quest.name: 기운이 샘솟는 꼬리
quest.desc: 고소공포증 때문에 $map:02000039$에 있는 $npc:11000300$$pp:는,은$ 도저히 $map:02000052$$pp2:로,으로$ 뛰어내리지 못하겠다고 한다. $map:02000039$에서 가장 높이 솟은 봉우리 꼭대기에서 끝이 보이지도 않는 $map:02000052$$pp2:로,으로$ 뛰어 내려야 하니, 고소공포증이 있는 사람들에게는 꽤 어려운 일로 여겨질 것 같다. $npc:11000300$대신 $map:02000052$에서 $npc:22000005$$pp:를,을$ 처치하고 $item:20000075$$pp:를,을$ 구해오자! 홀로 상대하기 어렵다면 함께 싸울 동료들을 모아보자.

Because of their fear of heights, $npc:11000300$ in $map:02000039$ says they absolutely cannot jump down to $map:02000052$. Since they would have to jump from the top of the highest peak in $map:02000039$ down to $map:02000052$, whose bottom cannot even be seen, it seems like quite a difficult task for someone afraid of heights. Go to $map:02000052$ in place of $npc:11000300$, defeat $npc:22000005$, and bring back $item:20000075$! If it is difficult to fight alone, gather companions to fight with you.

quest.name: The Tail Trade
quest.desc:
$npcName:11000300$ climbed the mountain peak at $map:02000039$, but he's too frightened to enter the $map:02000052$ due to his fear of heights. It's time for you to do $npcName:11000300$'s job and get the $item:20000075$ from $npcName:22000005$!
You might want to get some help for this one.

quest.name: 설계도면을 찾아라!
quest.desc: $npc:11000134$의 부탁으로 $map:02000045$에 병참기지를 건설하고 있는 $npc:11000301$$pp:는,은$ 이곳 몬스터들에게 $item:30000077$$pp:를,을$ 도둑맞았다. $map:02000045$의 몬스터들을 처치해서 $item:30000077$$pp:를,을$ 찾아오자.

quest.name: Misplaced Plans
quest.desc: $npc:11000301$ is building an outpost for $npc:11000134$ at $map:02000045$, but his $itemPlural:30000077$ were stolen from monsters. Round the monsters up and get the plans back.

$npc:11000301$, who is building a logistics base in $map:02000045$ at $npc:11000134$'s request, had $item:30000077$ stolen by the monsters here. Defeat the monsters in $map:02000045$ and retrieve $item:30000077$.
quest.name: Find the Blueprint!
일석이조 공사판
quest.desc: $map:02000051$에 사는 $npc:11000271$$pp:는,은$ $item:30000015$$pp:를,을$ 찾고 있다고 한다. 흔하디 흔한 $item:30000015$$pp:를,을$ 모아서 어디에 쓰려고 하는 걸까? 일단, $map:02000045$ 곳곳 돌바위들을 파내고 그 아래에 있는 $item:30000015$$pp:를,을$ 모아서 $npc:11000271$에게 가져다 주자.

$npc:11000271$, who lives in $map:02000051$, is looking for $item:30000015$. What are they planning to do with such common $item:30000015$? For now, dig up the stone rocks throughout $map:02000045$, collect the $item:30000015$ underneath, and bring them to $npc:11000271$.

quest.name: Clumps for a Friend
quest.desc: $npcName:11000271$ in $map:02000051$ is looking for $itemPlural:30000015$. Why could he possibly want such a thing? And how much will he pay for them? Find out by searching the rocks at the $map:02000045$ and going to him.

quest.name: Cursed Love
quest.desc: Rumor has it that $npc:29000024$ will appear at the top of $map:02000046$ when all 4 of the altars are lighted. Let's defeat $npc:29000024$ and take the $item:30000080$ that holds cursed power.

quest.name: Search and Seek
quest.desc: $npc:11000272$ of $map:02000051$ asked me to look for $npc:11000302$ in $map:02000046$.

quest.name: 메이플 연대기
quest.desc: $npc:11000327$$pp:가,이$ $item:30000087$에서 확인하고 싶은 건 무엇이었을까? $map:02000031$ 입구 쪽에 있는 책 수레에서 $item:30000087$$pp:를,을$ 찾아서 $map:02000001$에 있는 $npc:11000327$$pp:를,을$ 만나보자.

quest.name: Legends of Perion
quest.desc: On the way out of the library, you were tasked with delivering a copy of $item:30000087$ to $npcName:11000327$ in $map:02000001$. Hop to it!
quest.manual: Find $item:30000087$ in the book cart at the entrance of $map:02000031$

quest.desc: What did $npc:11000327$ want to check in $item:30000087$? Find $item:30000087$ from the book cart near the entrance to $map:02000031$, then meet $npc:11000327$ in $map:02000001$.
quest.manual: Find $item:30000087$ in the book cart at the entrance to $map:02000031$

quest.name: More Than a Myth
quest.desc: It's time to unravel the mystery! Go to $map:02000076$ and meet with $npc:11000328$.
Go to $map:02000076$ and meet $npc:11000328$.

quest.name: 소몰이 기행
quest.desc: $npc:11000328$$pp:는,은$ 지난날 $npc:11000039$에게 들었었던 $npc:21000425$에 관한 전설을 들려주었다. $npc:21000225$$pp:를,을$ 잡다보면 아주 가끔 얻을 수 있다는 $item:30000088$부터 구해서 전설이 사실인지 확인해봐야겠다. $map:02000056$$pp2:로,으로$ 가서 이 근방에 자주 출몰하는 $npc:21000225$$pp:를,을$ 찾아보자.

quest.name: Unmasking the Past
quest.desc: $npc:11000328$ told you the legend of $npc:21000425$ as he heard it from $npc:11000039$. To find out whether it's true, you'll need to get your hands on a $item:30000088$ recently liberated from a tourist shop by the $npcPlural:21000225$ of $map:02000056$.

$npc:11000328$ told you the legend about $npc:21000425$ that they once heard from $npc:11000039$. First, you should obtain $item:30000088$, which can very rarely be obtained by hunting $npc:21000225$, and check whether the legend is true. Go to $map:02000056$ and look for $npc:21000225$, which often appears nearby.

quest.name: 전설은 살아있다
quest.desc: $map:02000060$ 서쪽 바위 언덕 어디쯤엔가 그 입구가 있다는 $map:02000047$!! $item:30000088$$pp:를,을$ 가지고 $map:02000047$$pp2:로,으로$ 가서 제단을 찾아 그 뒤쪽 벽에 $item:30000088$$pp:를,을$ 걸어보자. 고대 사원이니만큼 어떤 위험이 도사리고 있을지 모르니 주변을 잘 둘러보면서 이동하는 것이 좋겠다.

quest.name: The Legend Lives
quest.desc:
$map:02000047$'s entrance is somewhere near the rocky hills in the western side of $map:02000060$! If you go there and hang the $item:30000088$ on the altar, you should be able to once and all put this myth to rest.
Where you're going is a dangerous place. Tread carefully!

$map:02000047$ is said to have an entrance somewhere on the rocky hill west of $map:02000060$! Take $item:30000088$ to $map:02000047$, find the altar, and hang $item:30000088$ on the wall behind it. Since it is an ancient temple, you do not know what dangers may be lurking, so it would be best to look around carefully as you move.

quest.name: 최첨단 로봇 메이드
quest.desc: $map:02000163$에서 만난 $npc:11001031$$pp:는,은$ 연구소 로봇들이 갑자기 이상 작동을 하며 연구원들을 공격하기 시작했다고 말하며, 로봇들에게 붙잡혀 있는 $npc:11000335$$pp:를,을$ 구해주면 $item:30000084$$pp:를,을$ 꺼낼 수 있는 $item:30000083$$pp:를,을$ 얻을 수 있을 것이라고 했다. $map:02000163$에서 $npc:11000335$$pp:를,을$ 구해주고, $item:30000083$$pp:를,을$ 얻어 $npc:11000244$$pp:가,이$ 주문한 $item:30000084$$pp:를,을$ 찾아가자.

quest.name: Robots Running Amuck
quest.desc: $npc:11001031$ from the $map:02000163$ says that the robots in the lab are malfunctioning. To get the $item:30000084$, you'll first need to free $npc:11000335$ and obtain his $item:30000083$. Then you can retrieve the $item:30000084$ and for $npc:11000244$.
quest.manual: Free $npc:11000335$ at the $map:02000163$ to get the master key card|Retrieve the $item:30000084$ from the $map:02000163$

quest.desc: $npc:11001031$, whom you met in $map:02000163$, said the laboratory robots suddenly malfunctioned and began attacking researchers. They said that if you rescue $npc:11000335$, who is being held by the robots, you can obtain $item:30000083$, which can retrieve $item:30000084$. Rescue $npc:11000335$ in $map:02000163$, obtain $item:30000083$, and find the $item:30000084$ ordered by $npc:11000244$.
quest.manual: Rescue $npc:11000335$ in $map:02000163$ and obtain the Master Card|Find $item:30000084$ in $map:02000163$

quest.name: 특별한 하녀
quest.desc: $npc:11000335$에게 무슨 일이 생긴 것은 아닐까? $map:02000163$$pp2:로,으로$ 가서 상황을 알아보자.
Did something happen to $npc:11000335$? Go to $map:02000163$ and find out what is going on.

quest.name: A Match Maid in Heaven
quest.desc: What's holding up $npc:11000335$? Head to $map:02000163$ and see what you can find out.

quest.name: Praise the Pigming
quest.desc: $npc:11000136$ asked me to fill the $item:30000086$ in $map:02000077$, and take it to $npc:11000039$ in $map:02000049$. Would $npc:11000039$ know about Yamarcha?

quest.name: Enemy of the Pigming
quest.desc: $npc:11000039$ explained that the Yamarcha was one of the tribes that existed in ancient Perion, and asked me to stop the Inakimos that were prowling around the altar attempting to interrupt the Pigmings' tribal activities. Let's go to $map:02000049$ and defeat the strange $npc:21000332$ and $npc:21000333$, who were continuously flapping their wings, and return to $npc:11000039$ to learn more about the Yamarcha.

quest.name: Murpagoth's Eagle
quest.desc: $npc:11000039$ relays the story of the Yamarcha's insatiable lust for power, and their subsequent decline after falling for a demon's trap. Yamarcha...the only clue that was left in $map:02000223$... The answer is still shrouded in mystery. Will I be able to find $npc:11000069$ using only this clue? I wish Perion's chief $npc:11000069$ would return soon since he is the only person I feel is capable of unraveling this mystery, thanks to his vast knowledge about the Yamarcha... There are five Murpagoth's eagles in $map:02000049$. The eagles all sit along the edges of the cliffs on the east, west, south, and north sides. I think it'd be a good idea to send an eagle to the chief!

quest.name: 내겐 너무 높은 길
quest.desc: $npc:11000338$$pp:는,은$ 바퀴가 빠져 뒤집어져버린 수레에 담긴 빵 상자를 절벽 위 호텔 앞으로 옮겨 달라고 부탁해왔다. 얼핏 보기에도 $npc:11000338$의 몸으로는 빵 상자를 들고 가파르고 좁은 계단을 올라가기는 힘들 것 같다. 운동하는 셈 치고 그의 부탁을 들어주자. $map:02000178$$pp:는,은$ $npc:11000338$ 앞에 있는 가파른 계단을 따라 올라가면 그 꼭대기에 위치하고 있다.

$npc:11000338$ asks you to move the bread boxes from the overturned cart with a missing wheel to the front of the hotel on top of the cliff. At a glance, it seems difficult for $npc:11000338$ to carry the bread boxes up the steep, narrow stairs. Treat it as exercise and help him. $map:02000178$ is located at the top if you climb the steep stairs in front of $npc:11000338$.

quest.name: Up and Down, Up and Down
quest.desc: $npc:11000338$'s bread cart flipped over, and he needs you to carry his delicious bread to $map:02000178$ at the top of a steep set of stairs.

quest.name: 달콤한 유혹
quest.desc: $npc:11000339$$pp:가,이$ 피하려는 것을 보니 $npc:11000340$$pp:는,은$ 과하게 깐깐한 인물인 듯 하다. $map:02000178$ 구경도 할 겸 $npcName:11000339$$pp:가,이$ 건네 준 머핀을 들고 $npc:11000340$$pp:를,을$ 만나볼까?

Seeing $npc:11000339$ try to avoid them, $npc:11000340$ seems like an excessively strict person. Since you can look around $map:02000178$ too, why not take the muffin $npcName:11000339$ gave you and meet $npc:11000340$?

quest.name: The Heavenly Scent of Bread
quest.desc: $npc:11000339$ is trying to avoid $npc:11000340$'s wrath, so he sends you to deliver a Bread Sample in his stead.

quest.name: Her Promise
quest.desc: $npc:11000341$ says that for $map:02000178$ to establish a stable presence in $map:02000171$, winning over the Koropu tribe is essential. Let's fulfill $npc:11000341$'s request to eliminate the monsters terrorizing the Koropu tribe in $map:02000171$ to win their hearts!

quest.name: A Tragic Decision
quest.desc: When $npc:11000027$ tried to help a young child that was having his soul being slowly eaten away by an evil spirit, his friends also became corrupted by the dark aura. $npcName:11000027$ blames himself for exposing his friends to the darkness, and pleads that you free their souls. Let's go to $map:02000053$, where the $npc:21000109$ corrupted by dark aura are located, and release the souls of $npcName:11000027$'s friends.
quest.manual: Defeat $npc:21000109$ in $map:02000053$ to liberate the unicorns' souls

quest.name: 납골당의 비밀
quest.desc: $map:02000059$에 있는 $map:02000082$에서 $npc:22000011$$pp:가,이$ 나타났다는 신고를 받고 $npc:11000015$$pp:는,은$ 정예 정찰대를 꾸려 $npc:22000011$$pp:를,을$ 찾아 나섰지만 수차례 실패했다며 고심하고 있다. 오랫동안 사람의 발길이 끊겼던 $map:02000082$, 그 깊은 곳에서 나타난 $npc:22000011$$pp:는,은$ 그 모습을 감췄다가 나타나길 반복하고 있는 듯한데… $npcName:11000015$의 말대로 주민들의 안전과 메이플 월드를 위해서라도 $map:02000082$에서 $npc:22000011$$pp:를,을$ 만나면, 그 즉시 처치하고 위험한 도끼를 빼앗는 것이 좋겠다.

After receiving a report that $npc:22000011$ appeared in $map:02000082$ in $map:02000059$, $npc:11000015$ formed an elite scouting party and set out to find $npc:22000011$, but they are troubled after failing several times. In the depths of $map:02000082$, where people have not set foot for a long time, $npc:22000011$ seems to appear and disappear repeatedly... As $npcName:11000015$ said, for the safety of the residents and Maple World, if you meet $npc:22000011$ in $map:02000082$, it would be best to defeat it immediately and take away its dangerous axe.

quest.name: A Rotten Malcontent
quest.desc:
After reports of a $npc:22000011$ menacing the people of $map:02000059$, $npc:11000015$ has tasked you with tracking down the undead assailant.
$npc:22000011$ was last seen near the $map:02000082$. Defeat him and recover his axe, for the safety of the people!

quest.name: Let Me Axe You a Question
quest.desc: $npc:11000203$ living in $map:02000059$ is convinced that $npc:21000041$ stole their axe. According to them, the $npc:21000041$ steal woodcutters' axes and stick them into their own bodies, turning into $npc:21000045$ and wandering around... Why on earth would they harm themselves like this? First, let's check if $npc:21000045$ really did steal $npcName:11000203$'s axe. Let's head to $map:02000058$ where $npc:21000045$ frequently appear.

quest.name: Discovering the Truth
quest.desc: $npc:11000203$ wanted to know the reason why $npc:21000041$ stole the tree cutters' axes, and impaled it in their own bodies to become $npc:21000045$. I was asked to go to $npc:11000328$ in $map:02000076$ and discover the truth behind this strange phenomenon.

quest.name: Axe-amine the Stumps
quest.desc: Who is the little girl that persuaded $npc:11000134$ with tears in her eyes to save $npc:21000041$? I'll go to $map:02000076$ and ask $npc:11000001$ for more answers.

quest.name: The Kindhearted Girl
quest.desc: $npc:11000188$... Isn't she the older sister of $npc:11000186$, whom I thawed and rescued not long ago?! If what $npc:11000001$ says is true... could the $npc:21000041$ have been waiting for $npc:11000188$, who couldn't come because she was frozen with an axe stuck in her head? Let's go to $map:02000085$ and meet $npc:11000188$.

quest.name: The Girl's Request
quest.desc: $npc:11000188$ was deeply saddened and heartbroken after hearing the story about $npc:21000045$. Since $npc:11000188$ still hasn't recovered and can't move, let's relay her message to $npc:11000203$ in $map:02000059$ on her behalf.

quest.name: Harbor Scoundrel
quest.desc: $npc:11000207$ of $map:02000139$ has asked me to deal with the monsters rampaging through the harbor and destroying the cargo. It would be too heartless to abandon someone I've already helped once. Let's take care of $npcName:11000207$'s request!

quest.name: Risky Business
quest.desc: $npc:11000307$, who runs an interior shop in $map:02000119$, asks that I collect the Ludibrium meteoric fragments that fell on the back hill, claiming that the fragments can be used as a new materials when they are refined. Let's go to $map:02000014$ and collect those fragments.

quest.name: Suspicious Iron Ore
quest.desc: $npc:11000004$ said the reason for rushing to buy iron ore from $npc:11000170$ without thinking it through was that iron ore has been hard to come by lately. Where did $npcName:11000170$ get iron ore — something so hard to find — that they could sell it to a merchant so cheaply? Could it be iron ore smelted from manufactured weapons, as $npc:11000004$ suggested? If so, could the stolen weapons have also been melted down into raw iron ore? For now, let's go to $map:02000140$ and find out about $npc:11000170$'s whereabouts.

quest.name: Find Broker Ralph!
quest.desc: The hip-hop boys I encountered in $map:02000083$ warned me with a beat that $map:02000141$ lies to the northeast of $map:02000083$. Just how dangerous can this place be for them to make such a fuss? Let's find the entrance to $map:02000141$ at the far northeast end of $map:02000083$!
quest.complete: Find and enter the entrance to $map:02000141$ at the northeast end of $map:02000083$, then meet $npc:11000173$

quest.name: Ralph's Provocation
quest.desc: There's not much more to gain from pressing $npc:11000173$ further. In times like this, it may be best to boldly search every corner of $map:02000141$. Along the way, I might find a useful clue or even someone willing to help. Defeat $npc:11000173$'s subordinates while exploring $map:02000141$. $map:02000141$ is located in $map:02000083$.
quest.complete: Talk to the person hiding in the sewer of $map:02000141$

quest.name: Traces of Stolen Goods
quest.desc: Tired of living on the run from $npc:11000173$, $npc:11000365$ plans to steal $npc:11000173$'s stolen goods ledger and hand it over to the Royal Guard or the Dark Wind in exchange for safety. The full details are unclear, but among the $item:30000018$ that $npcName:11000365$ asked me to find, there should be transaction records revealing who sold the iron ore to whom. Open the safes on the walls of each room in $map:02000141$, find the $item:30000018$, and bring them to $npc:11000365$. $map:02000141$ is located in $map:02000083$.
quest.manual: Open Ralph's secret vault in $map:02000141$ and find $item:30000018$

quest.name: 푸딩은 사랑을 싣고
quest.desc: 친절한 $npc:11000002$ 아줌마는 $map:02000017$에서 집을 짓고 있다는 $npc:11000350$에게 갓 만든 푸딩을 전해 달라고 부탁했다. $map:02000001$에서 멀지 않은 곳이라고 했으니까 금방 찾아갈 수 있겠지? $map:02000017$$pp2:로,으로$ 가서 $npc:11000350$$pp:를,을$ 찾아보자.

quest.name: For the Love of Pudding
quest.desc:
$npc:11000002$ heard her friend $npcName:11000350$ was building a home in $map:02000017$ and asked you to deliver some pudding as a housewarming gift.
She said $map:02000001$ is close by, so it should be a quick trip. Find $npc:11000350$ at $map:02000017$.

The kind auntie $npc:11000002$ asked you to deliver freshly made pudding to $npc:11000350$, who is building a house in $map:02000017$. She said it is not far from $map:02000001$, so you should be able to find them quickly. Go to $map:02000017$ and look for $npc:11000350$.

quest.name: 숲을 살려라!
quest.desc: $map:02000017$$pp:를,을$ 지키는 $npc:11000368$$pp:는,은$ 인간들이 드나들면서 숲의 모습을 잃어버린 $map:02000041$$pp:가,이$ 예전으로 돌아가길 바라고 있다. 그래서 꼬깔나무 묘목들을 심었지만, 돌바위 아래 숨어 사는 꿈틀꿈틀 나무벌레 $npc:29000022$들이 나무뿌리를 갉아먹는 바람에 나무들이 모두 죽을 위기에 처했다며 $npc:29000022$들을 처치해달라고 부탁했다. $map:02000041$$pp2:로,으로$ 가서 꼬깔나무 주변의 돌바위를 걷어내고 나무벌레 $npc:29000022$$pp:를,을$ 찾아서 처치하자.

quest.name: Only You Can Preserve the Forest
quest.desc:
$npc:11000368$, the guardian of $map:02000017$, wishes for $map:02000041$ to return to its past glory... the way it was before the humans came. He planted lots of trees, but the pesky tree bugs known as $npcPlural:29000022$ keep eating them.
Help $npc:11000368$'s by searching under wrocks in $map:02000041$ and taking care of any $npcPlural:29000022$ you find.
quest.manual: Eliminate the $npcPlural:29000022$ hiding underneath the rocks in $map:02000041$

quest.desc: $npc:11000368$, who protects $map:02000017$, hopes $map:02000041$, which lost its forest appearance after humans began coming and going, will return to how it used to be. They planted cone tree saplings, but wiggly tree worms $npc:29000022$ living under stone rocks are gnawing at the roots, putting all the trees in danger of dying. They ask you to defeat the $npc:29000022$. Go to $map:02000041$, clear away the stone rocks around the cone trees, find the tree worms $npc:29000022$, and defeat them.

quest.name: The Quality of Wolf Hides
quest.desc: $npc:11000374$ at $map:02000117$ mentions a lucrative side job and suggests obtaining $item:30000112$ and bringing it to $npc:11000546$. Let's hunt $npc:21000062$ to gather $item:30000112$, then deliver it to $npc:11000546$.

quest.name: Secret of the Mushroom
quest.desc: $npc:11000375$, whom I met in $map:02000117$, told me that he would pay well for $item:20000058$, a rare herb found only in the most pristine of areas. The path may be narrow and the monsters tough...but I think it's worth a shot, since $npc:11000375$ will most likely pay very well. Let's go to $map:02000117$ and collect $item:20000058$.

quest.name: Water Tank Inspection Period
quest.desc: $npc:11000393$ in the $map:02000083$ district came to perform routine water tank maintenance but has been unable to move a single step due to the monsters' rampage — now on their 251st deep breath. In place of $npc:11000393$, inspect the water tanks on the rooftops of the buildings in $map:02000083$ and collect $item:30000117$.
quest.manual: Inspect the water tanks in $map:02000083$ and collect $item:30000117$

quest.name: The Mart Raid
quest.desc: The monsters roaming $map:02000083$ have turned to robbery and attacked $map:02000121$. The staff barely escaped with their lives, but if the register cash is completely cleaned out, they'll inevitably be suspected by the store owner of being in on it. Head to $map:02000121$ and recover all the cash stolen from the registers so the innocent employees don't suffer unjustly!

quest.name: 차우에게 맞서는 자
quest.desc: 한번 걸리면 뼈와 살이 분리될 정도의 아픔을 겪을 수 있다는 $npc:22300105$! $npc:11000150$$pp:는,은$ $npc:22300105$$pp:가,이$ 얼마나 강한지 알고 싶으면 직접 부딪혀보라고 말했다. $map:02000083$에서 $npc:22300105$$pp:가,이$ 나타나길 기다렸다가 그와 맞서 싸워보자. 홀로 상대하기 어려울 수 있으니 마음이 맞는 동료들과 함께 힘을 합하는 것이 좋을 것 같다.

$npc:22300105$ is said to cause pain so severe that your bones and flesh feel like they are separating if it catches you! $npc:11000150$ said that if you want to know how strong $npc:22300105$ is, you should face it yourself. Wait for $npc:22300105$ to appear in $map:02000083$, then fight it. It may be difficult to face alone, so it would be best to join forces with like-minded companions.

quest.name: Rise Against
quest.desc: They say $npc:22300105$ redefines the meaning of pain to everyone who has the misfortune to meet him. $npc:11000150$ has challenged you to face $npc:22300105$ one-on-one to see how strong he really is. It sounds like he hangs around $map:02000083$. He's definitely a challenge to face alone, so you should probably bring some allies with you.

quest.name: Source of the Stench
quest.desc: $npc:11000399$, who came to $map:02000092$ to investigate the cause of the petrifying water, is suffering from a piercing stench. The source of the odor appears to be the Large Vine Moss and $npc:21000387$ spawned by wastewater believed to have flowed in from $map:02000084$! Find and remove the Large Vine Moss growing near the wastewater inlet in $map:02000092$, and defeat $npc:21000387$!
quest.manual: Defeat $npc:21000387$ near the contaminated area in $map:02000092$|Remove the Large Vine Moss near the contaminated area in $map:02000092$

quest.name: Dad Is the Maintenance Chief
quest.desc: $npc:11000174$ is worried that her father, who manages $map:02000092$, hasn't come home for several days. Go find $npc:11000174$'s father, $npc:11000400$, and tell him that his daughter is worried and he should come home.

quest.name: Petrifying Water
quest.desc: There was a reason $npc:11000400$ hasn't been able to come home for days. The water upstream in $map:02000092$ has been gradually hardening from the center outward! A field investigation is needed to find the cause, but the constantly spawning monsters make it impossible to even get close. Eliminate the monsters rampaging on the hardened water upstream in $map:02000092$.
quest.manual: Defeat monsters on the frozen water upstream in $map:02000092$

quest.name: Power of Poison
quest.desc: $npc:11000402$ and $npc:11000403$ have been poisoned by toxins seeping out of $map:02000043$! They need $item:20000060$ from $npc:21000078$ to neutralize the poison. Defeat $npc:21000078$ that occasionally appear in the plains of $map:02000043$ and collect $item:20000060$.

quest.name: 반격의 힘
quest.desc: $map:02000181$의 $npc:11000404$$pp:는,은$ 블루 라펜타가 깨진 후 $map:02000181$에서 깨어난 $npc:23000024$$pp:가,이$ 자신의 아버지와 친구들을 모두 해쳤다며 복수를 해달라고 부탁했다. 블루 라펜타가 깨짐과 동시에 깨어나 온갖 횡포를 부리고 있는 $npc:23000024$!! $npc:11000404$의 개인적인 원한이 아니더라도 메이플 월드를 위협하는 위험한 존재이므로 처치하는 것이 좋겠다. $npc:11000404$의 충고대로 뜻을 같이하는 동료들을 모아 힘을 합해 함께 싸우도록 하자.

$npc:11000404$ in $map:02000181$ says $npc:23000024$, which awakened in $map:02000181$ after the Blue Lapenta shattered, harmed their father and all their friends, and asks you to avenge them. $npc:23000024$ awakened the moment the Blue Lapenta broke and has been running rampant! Even aside from $npc:11000404$'s personal grudge, it is a dangerous being that threatens Maple World, so it would be best to defeat it. As $npc:11000404$ advised, gather companions who share your goal and fight together.

quest.name: Free Gift with Vengeance
quest.desc: $npcName:11000404$ at $map:02000181$ says that $npc:23000024$, who awoke after the Blue Lapenta shattered, slew his papa. He wants vengeance! Defeat $npc:23000024$ for justice! And also for the free gift...

quest.name: Back Where They Belong
quest.desc: $npc:11000148$, who manages the village warehouse at $map:63000001$, was going to load the $item:30000130$ produced at $map:63000001$ onto a ship to send to the continent, but a sudden problem with departure means the $item:30000130$ must be moved back in front of $map:63000004$. Let's help move the $item:30000130$ to the front of $map:63000004$ at least until $npc:11000148$'s back feels better!
quest.manual: Move the $item:30000130$ near $npc:11000148$ to the front of the village warehouse at $map:63000001$

quest.name: 해변에 사는 내 친구
quest.desc: $map:02000086$에서 일하고 있는 $npc:11000360$$pp:는,은$ 친구 $npc:11000420$$pp:가,이$ $map:02000111$$pp:는,은$ 편안하고 안전해서 엄마와 함께 살기 참 좋은 곳이라며 이사를 권유했지만, 밀린 일거리가 많아서 쉽사리 자리를 비울 수가 없다고 한다. $npc:11000360$$pp:를,을$ 대신해 $map:02000111$$pp2:로,으로$ 가서, 그 곳이 정말 $npc:11000360$$pp:가,이$ 엄마와 함께 살기에 적합한 곳인지 살펴보자.

quest.name: By the Seaside
quest.desc: $npc:11000360$'s friend, $npc:11000420$, recommended that $npc:11000360$ and his mother move to $map:02000111$, since it's a beautiful, safe, and comfortable place to have a home. But $npc:11000360$ says that he's swamped with work and doesn't have time to check the place out right now. Go to $map:02000111$ and scope the place out.

$npc:11000360$, who works in $map:02000086$, says their friend $npc:11000420$ recommended moving to $map:02000111$, saying it is comfortable and safe and would be a good place to live with their mother, but they cannot easily leave because they have a lot of overdue work. Go to $map:02000111$ in place of $npc:11000360$ and check whether it is really a suitable place for $npc:11000360$ to live with their mother.

quest.name: 생존경쟁
quest.desc: 언젠가부터 $map:02000111$에 나타나 사람들을 괴롭히고 있다는 $npc:23000018$! $map:02000111$에서 한 번씩 출몰한다는 이 녀석 때문에 $npc:11000421$$pp:는,은$ 생계가 곤란할 정도로 장사에 어려움을 겪고 있다. 전략을 잘 세워서 $map:02000111$에 나타난 $npc:23000018$$pp:를,을$ 처치해 보자! 혼자서 녀석을 상대하기 힘들다면 주변의 동료들과 함께 힘을 합쳐서 싸우도록 하자.

quest.name: Struggling to Survive
quest.desc:
A $npc:23000018$ is wreaking havoc on the beaches of $map:02000111$, and $npc:11000421$'s business is struggling to stay afloat.
Dispatch the $npc:23000018$ at $map:02000111$! Be warned, it's best to bring friends when facing a foe this fierce!

$npc:23000018$ has apparently been appearing in $map:02000111$ and harassing people for some time! Because this creature appears in $map:02000111$ from time to time, $npc:11000421$ is having so much trouble with business that their livelihood is at risk. Make a good strategy and defeat $npc:23000018$ when it appears in $map:02000111$! If it is difficult to face alone, join forces with nearby companions.

quest.name: 불량 대출자
quest.desc: $npc:11000002$의 귀여운 아들 $npc:11000055$$pp:는,은$ $map:02000001$에서 $map:02000031$에 가장 많이 드나드는 꼬마다. 하지만 늘 대출기한을 어겨 $npc:11000005$의 머리를 아프게 하는 녀석이기도 하다. $map:02000001$에서 $npc:11000055$$pp:를,을$ 찾아서 빌려간 책의 대출기한이 지났다는 사실을 알려주자.

$npc:11000055$, the cute son of $npc:11000002$, is the child who visits $map:02000031$ from $map:02000001$ most often. But he is also always missing return deadlines and giving $npc:11000005$ headaches. Find $npc:11000055$ in $map:02000001$ and tell him the book he borrowed is overdue.

quest.name: Borrower's Remorse
quest.desc:
$npc:11000055$, $npc:11000002$'s lovely son, is a frequent visitor to $map:02000031$. However, he's a bit of a headache for $npc:11000005$, as he rarely returns his books.
Find $npc:11000055$ in $map:02000001$ and inform him that he should check out a book on manners once he returns the last book he borrowed.

quest.name: 숲의 전설
quest.desc: 그저 옛날 이야기책 속에서 전해오는 전설인 줄만 알았던 $npc:22000003$$pp:와,과$ $npc:22000004$… 그녀들이 이 세계 어딘가에 실제로 존재한다면 그 전설 같은 이야기도 사실인 것이 되는데… $map:02000001$의 $npc:11000327$$pp:를,을$ 찾아가서 정말 그녀들이 나타난 것인지, 어디에 나타난 것인지 물어보자.

$npc:22000003$ and $npc:22000004$ were thought to be only legends passed down in old storybooks... If they really exist somewhere in this world, then that legendary story may be true... Find $npc:11000327$ in $map:02000001$ and ask whether they really appeared, and where.

quest.name: Forest Legends and Folktales
quest.desc: $npc:22000003$ and $npc:22000004$ were supposed to be just a creepy campfire story... But if they're real, how many other legends could be true? You should find $npc:11000327$ in $map:02000001$ to ask if they really did reappear. And if so, where?

quest.name: 비극을 부른 사랑
quest.desc: $npc:11000327$$pp:는,은$ $map:02000041$에서 목격된 $npc:22000003$$pp:와,과$ $npc:22000004$$pp:가,이$ 진짜일 가능성을 염두에 두고, 그녀들이 정말 알베르토가 로안나에게 사랑의 증표로 선물한 루비 목걸이와 보석함을 가지고 있는지 확인해보고 싶다며 도움을 요청했다. $map:02000041$$pp2:로,으로$ 가서 $npc:22000003$$pp:와,과$ $npc:22000004$$pp:가,이$ 정말 나타나는지, 그녀들이 루비 목걸이와 보석함을 가지고 있는지 확인해보자. 그녀들의 악명은 근거없는 소문은 아닐테니 서로 힘을 합할 수 있는 동료들을 구해서 함께 싸우는 것이 좋겠다.

$npc:11000327$ considers the possibility that $npc:22000003$ and $npc:22000004$ witnessed in $map:02000041$ may be real, and asks for help checking whether they truly have the ruby necklace and jewel box Alberto gave Roanna as tokens of love. Go to $map:02000041$ and check whether $npc:22000003$ and $npc:22000004$ really appear, and whether they have the ruby necklace and jewel box. Their infamy is probably not baseless rumor, so it would be best to find companions who can join forces and fight together.

quest.name: A Tragic Love
quest.desc:
$npc:11000327$ has asked you to investigate whether $npc:22000003$ and $npc:22000004$, elves mentioned in an old folktale, have actually returned to $map:02000041$, and whether they possess the trinkets Alberto gave to Roanna to confess his love.
Travel to $map:02000041$ and find out! If the tales are true, you'll want to bring allies to aid you in battle.
quest.manual: (Elite) Defeat $npc:22000003$ and obtain $item:30000131$|(Elite) Defeat $npc:22000004$ and obtain $item:30000132$

quest.name: 슬픈 연인의 무덤
quest.desc: $map:02000001$의 $npc:11000327$$pp:는,은$ $map:02000017$ 북서쪽 큰 나무줄기 위 어딘가에 로안나의 무덤이 있다며, 그 앞에 $item:30000133$$pp:를,을$ 놓아 달라고 부탁했다. $map:02000017$에서 로안나의 무덤을 찾아보자.

quest.name: Bury Your Love
quest.desc: $npc:11000327$ of $map:02000001$ has asked that you leave $item:30000133$ at her grave, which is located somewhere in the treetops in the northwest of $map:02000017$.

$npc:11000327$ in $map:02000001$ says Roanna's grave is somewhere on the large tree trunk northwest of $map:02000017$, and asks you to place $item:30000133$ in front of it. Look for Roanna's grave in $map:02000017$.

quest.name: 하늘에서라도, 부디…
quest.desc: $map:02000017$ 깊은 곳에 자리잡고 있는 $npc:11000422$! 그 곁에는 알베르토의 것으로 추정되는 백골이 지키고 있었다. 로안나와 알베르토의 사랑이 하늘에서라도 행복하게 맺어질 수 있도록 기도하며, $npc:11000327$에게 받아 온 $item:30000133$$pp:를,을$ $npc:11000422$ 앞에 놓아두자.

$npc:11000422$ is located deep in $map:02000017$! Beside it stood a skeleton believed to be Alberto's. Pray that Roanna and Alberto's love can be happily fulfilled even in heaven, and place the $item:30000133$ you received from $npc:11000327$ in front of $npc:11000422$.

quest.name: Those We Leave Behind
quest.desc:
You found $npc:11000422$ located deep in the $map:02000017$. Alongside it was a nameless marker for a grave that could only belong to Alberto.
