You should leave $item:30000133$ in front of her grave, in hopes that it brings her some peace in the afterlife.
quest.manual: Place the jewel box in front of $npc:11000422$ in $map:02000017$

quest.name: Longing for a Granddaughter
quest.desc: $npc:11000419$, a doctor at the hospital in $map:02000100$, handed over a photo of $npc:11000424$'s granddaughter — who went missing shortly after leaving the hospital — and asked me to deliver it. For $npc:11000424$, who spends every day in tears missing the beloved granddaughter who vanished without a trace, this photo must be more precious than anything. Find $npc:11000424$ in $map:02000100$ and deliver the granddaughter's photo.

quest.name: The Monster Girl's Secret
quest.desc: $npc:11000424$ cautiously asked me to check whether the mysterious monster-girl who occasionally appears in $map:02000147$ might be their granddaughter's doll come to life. Apparently a single item from $npc:22090165$ would be enough to know for certain — let's retrieve something from $npc:22090165$ and show it to $npc:11000424$.

quest.name: 독수리를 붙잡고
quest.desc: $map:02000085$의 $npc:11000425$$pp:는,은$ 날아다니는 야생 독수리를 붙잡고 건너편에 있는 $npc:11000427$에게 $item:30000141$$pp:를,을$ 전해달라고 부탁했다. 야생 독수리 붙잡기라… 꽤 재미있을 것 같다. $npc:11000425$ 옆에서 야생 독수리가 올 때까지 기다렸다가 붙잡고 날아보자.

quest.name: Fly Like a Vulture
quest.desc:
Afraid of plummeting to his death, $npc:11000425$ asked you to deliver the $item:30000141$ to $npc:11000427$ in $map:02000085$. All you have to do is grab onto a vulture and let it fly you to your destination.
You should wait near $npc:11000425$ for a vulture to arrive, and grab on tight.
quest.complete: Grab hold of a vulture in $map:02000085$ and fly to $npc:11000427$

quest.desc: $npc:11000425$ in $map:02000085$ asks you to catch a flying wild eagle and deliver $item:30000141$ to $npc:11000427$ across the way. Catching a wild eagle... It sounds pretty fun. Wait beside $npc:11000425$ until a wild eagle comes, then catch it and fly.
quest.complete: Grab onto the eagle in $map:02000085$ and fly to $npc:11000427$

quest.name: 분노의 날갯짓
quest.desc: $npc:11000427$$pp:는,은$ $map:02000085$ 고지대 평원에 있는 독수리 알들이 무사히 부화할 수 있도록 $npc:23000019$$pp:가,이$ 나타나면 사람들과 함께 힘을 합해서 처치하는 데 힘을 보태달라고 부탁해왔다. $npc:23000019$의 거대한 날개도 붙잡고 날 수 있을까? $map:02000085$에 $npc:23000019$$pp:가,이$ 나타나면 주변 사람들과 힘을 합해 함께 처치해보자.

quest.name: Wings of Rage
quest.desc:
$npc:11000427$ wants to train the vulture hatchlings on the highland plains of $map:02000085$ as transportation for the local populace, but $npc:23000019$ keeps destroying all the eggs.
Work alongside other adventurers to defeat $npc:23000019$ in $map:02000085$ when it finally appears.

$npc:11000427$ asks you to help defeat $npc:23000019$ together with others when it appears, so the eagle eggs in the highland plain of $map:02000085$ can hatch safely. Can you grab $npc:23000019$'s huge wings and fly too? When $npc:23000019$ appears in $map:02000085$, join forces with the people nearby and defeat it.

quest.name: Prison Pen Pals
quest.desc: Unable to face $npc:11000526$, who has been connected to the death of $npc:11000492$, $npc:11000012$ of $map:02000001$ requested that a letter be delivered to $npc:11000526$, who is currently trapped in $map:02000310$.

quest.name: Nelph's Keepsake
quest.desc: $npc:11000526$, currently trapped in $map:02000310$, handed over $npc:11000492$'s keepsake, a tape containing an audio message from $npc:11000492$ for $npc:11000492$'s blind mother, and asked to have it delivered to $npc:11000178$ in $map:02000076$.

quest.name: Broken Promises
quest.desc: Being blind, $npc:11000178$ gave $item:30000342$ back and asked to have the audio message be played for her. Find the small audio player next to the bed in $map:02000198$ and play $item:30000342$.

quest.name: 난파선의 흔적
quest.desc: $map:02000062$의 $npc:11000025$$pp:는,은$ 그녀의 오빠 $npc:11000021$$pp:가,이$ $map:63000001$$pp:를,을$ 떠나 $map:02000062$$pp2:로,으로$ 오는 길에 폭풍우에 휩쓸려 배가 난파된 후로 실종되어 소식이 없다며 발을 동동 굴렀다. $map:02000183$$pp2:로,으로$ 가서 $npc:11000021$의 생사라도 알아봐 달라는 그녀의 간절한 부탁을 매몰차게 거절할 수는 없을 것 같다. $map:02000062$ 부둣가에서 잡다한 일을 도맡아 하는 $npc:11000994$에게 부탁하면 다소 위험하지만 $map:02000183$$pp2:로,으로$ 빠른 시간 안에 도착할 수 있는 배를 태워줄 수 있다고 하니 그를 찾아가 보는 것도 좋겠다.

$npc:11000025$ in $map:02000062$ is anxiously worried, saying her older brother $npc:11000021$ went missing after leaving $map:63000001$ for $map:02000062$ and being caught in a storm that wrecked his ship. It seems hard to coldly refuse her desperate request to go to $map:02000183$ and at least find out whether $npc:11000021$ is alive. If you ask $npc:11000994$, who handles odd jobs at the docks in $map:02000062$, he can take you by boat to $map:02000183$ quickly, though it may be somewhat dangerous.

quest.name: Searching the Wreckage
quest.desc: $npcName:11000025$ in $map:02000062$ is worried about her older brother, $npcName:11000021$, who disappeared during a typhoon on his way to visit her from $map:63000001$. She wants you to head to $map:02000183$, where the wreckage of his boat was found, to investigate. She says $npcName:11000994$ down by the docks might be able to get you to the island quickly.

quest.name: 바다의 유령선
quest.desc: $map:02000183$에서 우연히 만난 $npc:11000782$! 유령 해적단에게 붙잡혀 죽을 고비를 넘긴 모험담을 듣는 도중 $npc:11000021$의 소식을 알게 되었다. 다행히 살아있다는 $npc:11000021$! $npc:11000025$에게 기쁜 소식을 전해줄 수 있을 것 같다. $map:02000067$$pp2:로,으로$ 가서 $npc:11000021$$pp:를,을$ 만나보자.

quest.name: Undead Pirates
quest.desc: You found $npcName:11000782$ at $map:02000183$, who told you about a frightening experience with undead pirates, during which you found out that $npcName:11000021$ is alive! $npc:11000025$ will be so happy! Time to go find $npcName:11000021$ at $map:02000067$.

You happened to meet $npc:11000782$ in $map:02000183$! While listening to their adventure story about nearly dying after being captured by ghost pirates, you learned news about $npc:11000021$. Fortunately, $npc:11000021$ is alive! You should be able to bring good news to $npc:11000025$. Go to $map:02000067$ and meet $npc:11000021$.

quest.name: 산티아고가 겪은 일
quest.desc: $npc:11000021$$pp:는,은$ $map:63000001$$pp:를,을$ 떠나 유령 해적선에서 탈출해 나오기까지의 기적같은 일화를 들려주었다. 겨우 꼬리가 잡힌 유령 해적선! 과연 실종된 빅토리아호의 진실을 밝히는 불씨가 될 수 있을까?

$npc:11000021$ told you the miraculous story of leaving $map:63000001$ and escaping from the ghost pirate ship. The ghost pirate ship has finally been caught by the tail! Could this become the spark that reveals the truth behind the missing Victoria?
quest.name: What Santiago Experienced
Santiago's Story
quest.desc: $npcName:11000021$ shares a terrifying tale of undead pirates and a grand escape from a phantom pirate ship. Could this be the first major clue to finding the truth behind what happened to the Victoria?

quest.name: 합격 소식
quest.desc: $npc:11000476$$pp:는,은$ 골두스 택배 기사들의 파업으로 인턴 사원 서류 합격자들에게 직접 돌아다니면서 합격 소식을 전하다가 발을 다쳐서 걸을 수가 없는 상태라고 한다. 면접 일정이 시작되기 전에 마지막 합격자인 $map:02000166$의 $npc:11001054$에게 합격 소식과 면접 안내를 해야 하는데… $npc:11000476$$pp:를,을$ 대신해서 $map:02000166$의 $npc:11001054$에게 합격 소식을 전해주자.

$npc:11000476$ says that because Goldus delivery workers are on strike, they went around personally telling intern applicants who passed the document screening, but injured their foot and can no longer walk. Before the interview schedule begins, the last successful applicant, $npc:11001054$ in $map:02000166$, needs to be told the good news and given interview instructions... Go to $npc:11001054$ in $map:02000166$ in place of $npc:11000476$ and deliver the news.

quest.name: A Timely Interview
quest.desc:
$npc:11000476$ hurt her feet delivering interview requests to prospective interns, but she still has one left to deliver to $npc:11001054$ in $map:02000166$...
Lucky for her, you've agreed to go in her place.

quest.name: 합격 기원
quest.desc: 합격 소식을 들은 $npc:11001054$$pp:는,은$ 기쁨을 감추지 못했다. 하지만 그것도 잠시… 피자 배달 아르바이트 때문에 $npc:11001054$$pp:는,은$ 면접을 보지 못할 수도 있다고 한다. $npc:11001054$$pp:가,이$ 무사히 면접을 볼 수 있도록 그를 대신해서 $map:52000004$ 1층에 있는 피자를 꼭대기 층까지 배달하도록 하자.

quest.name: A Difficult Delivery
quest.desc:
$npc:11001054$ is ecstatic to be considered for the Goldus intrernship. But with his part-time pizza delivery job, there's no way he can make it to the interview...
Thankfully for him, that's where you come in! Deliver the pizzas sitting at the first floor of $map:52000004$ to the top floor in $npc:11001054$'s place.
quest.manual: Take the pizza from $map:52000004$ 1F and deliver it to the top floor
quest.complete: Find $npc:11001055$ at the top floor of $map:52000004$

quest.desc: $npc:11001054$ could not hide their joy after hearing the good news. But only for a moment... because of their pizza delivery part-time job, $npc:11001054$ may not be able to attend the interview. To help $npc:11001054$ attend safely, deliver the pizza on the first floor of $map:52000004$ to the top floor in their place.

quest.name: 꿈을 향해서
quest.desc: 다행히 $npc:11001054$$pp:는,은$ 1차 면접까지 무난하게 통과한 모양이다. 하지만 최종 관문인 "$npc:11000252$ 앞에서 골두스 찬양가 부르기"가 남아있는데, 노래 가사를 도통 외울 수가 없다며 울상이다. $npc:11001054$$pp:가,이$ 골두스 찬양가를 편한 마음으로 잘 외울 수 있도록 그를 대신해서 $map:52000004$ 1층에 있는 피자를 꼭대기 층까지 배달하도록 하자.

Fortunately, $npc:11001054$ seems to have passed the first interview without trouble. But the final hurdle remains: "singing the Goldus anthem in front of $npc:11000252$." They are upset because they cannot memorize the lyrics at all. To help $npc:11001054$ comfortably memorize the Goldus anthem, deliver the pizza on the first floor of $map:52000004$ to the top floor in their place.

quest.name: 30 Minutes or Less
quest.desc:
$npc:11001054$ seems to have made it through the first round of interviews, but there's no time to prepare for the second one while fulfilling his delivery obligations.
Lucky for him, you've agreed to take the pizzas from the first floor of $map:52000004$ and deliver them to the roof so that $npc:11001054$ can prepare with peace of mind.
quest.manual: Take the pizza from $map:52000004$ 1F and deliver it to the top floor
quest.complete: Find $npc:11001055$ at the top floor of $map:52000004$

quest.name: Unidentified Thieving Assailant
quest.desc: $npc:11001028$ of $map:02000309$ said that the results from the study regarding the principles of time, $item:30000320$, $item:30000321$, and $item:30000322$ all disappeared after an invasion by an unknown assailant. $map:02000298$ in $map:02000259$ is the place where the Chaos Time Key is the most useful! By using the $npc:11001056$ located behind $npc:11001028$, teleport to $map:02000259$ and assess the situation at $map:02000298$!

quest.name: Dungeon: Hacker’s Ambush
quest.desc:
$dungeonTitle:21008001$ (Entrance: $map:2000259$) Party Size (4 players)
$npc:11001057$ of $map:02000259$ said that this hacker group appeared out of nowhere and overtook $map:02000298$. Stop this army of hackers and investigate the perilous situation at $map:02000299$.
quest.manual: Stop the hacker group Funny Fingers in $map:02000298$ | Investigate $map:02000299$

quest.name: Dungeon: Protect the Time Hole!
quest.desc:
$dungeonTitle:2000298$ (Entrance: $map:2000259$) Party Size (4 players)
$npc:11001057$ in $map:02000259$ said that the unidentified assailant who took the Chaos Time Key must be stopped from seizing the universe's center of time. $npc:11001057$ said that this unknown attacker will be found at $map:02000298$ as a result of the unstable time traveling process, and must be stopped in order to protect $map:02000304$'s safety.
quest.manual: Find $map:02000304$ in $map:02000298$ | (Elite) Find and stop the unidentified assailant with the Chaos Time Key

quest.name: 설렘만 남기고…
quest.desc: $map:02000001$의 잡화상인 $npc:11000010$$pp:는,은$ 그녀의 마음 속에 설렘만 남겨두고 사라져버린 갈색 삿갓을 쓴 남자를 찾고 있다. 떠돌이 보부상으로부터 개미굴 쪽에서 그와 비슷한 모습의 사람을 보았다는 이야기를 듣고 $npc:11000010$$pp:는,은$ 개미굴에서 그를 찾아봐 달라는 부탁을 했다. 항상 도도하고 시크한 $npc:11000010$$pp:를,을$ 이렇게 풋풋하고 여린 여자로 바꿔버린 갈색 삿갓을 쓴 사나이의 정체가 뭘까? $map:02000173$에서부터 그의 행적을 찾아보자.
quest.complete: $map:02000173$에서 갈색 삿갓을 쓴 남자 행적 추적하기

quest.desc: $npc:11000010$, the general merchant in $map:02000001$, is looking for the man in the brown satgat who disappeared after leaving only butterflies in her heart. After hearing from a wandering peddler that someone who looked like him was seen near the Ant Tunnel, $npc:11000010$ asks you to look for him there. Who is this man in the brown satgat who transformed the always proud and chic $npc:11000010$ into such a fresh and delicate woman? Start tracing his path from $map:02000173$.

quest.name: Utterly Charmed
quest.desc:
$npcName:11000010$ of $map:02000001$ has fallen head-over-heels for a man with a bamboo hat. Unfortunately, he vanished without warning. She's heard rumors that a man matching his description was spotted near the Ant Tunnel.
Head to the $map:02000173$ and get some answers.
quest.complete: Search for the man in the bamboo hat at the $map:02000173$

quest.name: 추억으로 살다
quest.desc: $map:02000173$에서 갈색 삿갓을 쓴 남자 대신 요상한 플라스틱을 눈에 달고 있는 $npc:11000145$라는 자를 만났다. 그의 말에 따르면 $npc:22000322$에게 죽을 뻔한 자기를 밀쳐내고 싸운 사람이 $item:11300119$$pp:를,을$ 쓰고 있었다는데… $npc:11000010$에게 종이꽃만을 남긴 채 떠난 그 남자는 어떻게 된 것일까…? $map:02000173$에서 $npc:22000322$$pp:를,을$ 찾아다니다 보면 그의 행적을 알 수 있지 않을까?

In $map:02000173$, instead of the man in the brown satgat, you met someone named $npc:11000145$ with strange plastic over their eyes. According to them, the person who pushed them aside and fought when $npc:22000322$ nearly killed them was wearing $item:11300119$... What happened to the man who left only paper flowers for $npc:11000010$ before leaving...? If you search for $npc:22000322$ in $map:02000173$, perhaps you can learn his whereabouts.

quest.name: Memory of the Man
quest.desc:
Instead of finding the man in the bamboo hat, you found a strange fellow wearing a high-tech monocle: $npc:11000145$. He claims that the man who saved his life from a $npcName:22000322$ was wearing a $item:11300119$ and left an origami flower behind. It must be the same man that $npcName:11000010$ told you about!
Maybe you'll find another clue if you find the $npcName:22000322$ in the $map:02000173$.

quest.name: The Only Clue
quest.desc: $npc:11000492$ recalled an address written in $npc:11000170$'s peddler's notebook and told me to head to $map:02000092$ to search for $npc:11000170$. Nothing to lose by trying. For now, let's head to $map:02000092$ and look for $npc:11000170$!

quest.name: Delivery Rider
quest.desc: While $npc:11000012$ reviews the shipping logbook, they asked me to deliver some mail to $npc:11000492$ at $map:02000140$. If it helps me find the missing delivery truck any sooner, a small errand is nothing. Let's head to $map:02000140$ with the mail from $npc:11000012$.

quest.name: A Word of Thanks
quest.desc: $npc:11000492$ didn't forget to thank $npc:11000012$ as well. Being grateful for small things and showing consideration for others — that kind of attitude has a way of moving people's hearts. Let's head to $npc:11000012$ at $map:02000001$ and pass along $npc:11000492$'s regards.

quest.name: Broken Trust
quest.desc: $npc:11000169$ asked me to keep an eye on $npc:11000492$ to prevent him from fleeing while they report to $npc:11000119$ about the weapons depot theft and $npc:11000492$'s corruption. Head to $map:02000140$ and keep watch on $npc:11000492$'s movements.

quest.name: Growing Suspicions
quest.desc: The door of $map:02000140$, where $npc:11000492$ always greeted visitors with a bright smile, was firmly shut. Where could $npc:11000492$ have gone...? $npc:11000373$, a part-timer who's always handing out flyers at the taxi stop right in front of $map:02000140$, might have seen something.

quest.name: The Missing Nelph
quest.desc: $npc:11000373$ says they saw $npc:11000492$, who rarely leaves $map:02000140$, heading home for some business. Ask $npc:11000012$ for $npc:11000492$'s home address.

quest.name: The First Step of the Search
quest.desc: While $npc:11000044$ gathers Dark Wind members to form a search team to find evidence of $npc:11000526$'s corruption, they've asked me to head to $map:02000157$ and obtain a search warrant for the Barota Trading Company from $npc:11000065$. Every great task starts with the first step! Report everything to $npc:11000065$ and secure the Barota Trading Company search warrant.

quest.name: Search Permit
quest.desc: $npc:11000065$ issued $item:30000165$, asking that this matter be concluded by exposing $npc:11000526$'s personal corruption alone, so the entire Barota Trading Company doesn't come crumbling down. Head back to $map:02000152$ and meet with $npc:11000044$.

quest.name: Contraband Crackdown
quest.desc: $npc:11000044$ received a tip that $item:20000015$, a banned food product, is being sold alongside $item:20000046$ at $map:02000209$, and ordered me to trace the distribution route. If $npc:11000526$ is involved in distributing $item:20000015$ as $npc:11000044$ suspects, we might uncover an unexpected lead on his whereabouts. Find $item:20000015$ at $map:02000209$ in $map:02000147$, then meet with $npc:11000491$.
quest.manual: Check the display shelves in $map:02000209$ of $map:02000147$|Obtain $item:20000015$

quest.name: A New Lead
quest.desc: As promised, $npc:11000491$ revealed the distribution route for $item:20000015$ and mentioned the possibility that the Black Star Society was involved in helping $npc:11000526$ disappear. It's just speculation from $npc:11000491$ with no evidence yet, but it could turn out to be the decisive clue to finding $npc:11000526$. For now, head back to $map:02000152$ and meet with $npc:11000044$.

quest.name: Business Rights Competition
quest.desc: $npc:11000491$ says that securing $npc:11000245$'s support is necessary to win the oil development rights in $map:02000148$. $npc:11000245$ is not the type to open up easily... How do we get a recommender's signature on $item:30000166$? For now, head to $map:02000148$ and meet with $npc:11000245$.

quest.name: The Art of Persuasion
quest.desc: $npc:11000245$ of $map:02000148$ advised that to earn a recommendation for the business rights, I should first win over the workers at $map:02000148$. Help out $npc:11000353$, $npc:11000533$, and $npc:11000543$—the workers of $map:02000148$ who toil under the blazing sun all day—and build a rapport with them.
quest.manual: Help $npc:11000543$ with [Hazardous Oil Pipe]|Help $npc:11000353$ with [The Cobras Are Furious]|Help $npc:11000533$ with [The Wretched Arsonist]

quest.name: True Fruition
quest.desc: $npc:11000245$ signed the recommender field and returned $item:30000167$. Deliver $item:30000167$ to $npc:11000491$ at $map:02000209$.

quest.name: The Wretched Arsonist
quest.desc: $npc:11000533$ of $map:02000148$ is at their wit's end because of monsters that pierce through oil pipes and set them ablaze. Even a slight reduction in their numbers would make things much easier for $npc:11000533$ and the workers here, so let's take down the troublemaking monsters of $map:02000148$.

quest.name: Find the Gold Bars!
quest.desc: The Black Star Society boss $npc:11000251$ said that if I retrieve all the gold bars that a traitor stole from the organization, they will accept me as a member. I must quickly find the hidden gold bar bags scattered throughout $map:02000138$, or defeat the monsters that made off with the gold and seize $item:30000168$ from them. To find $npc:11000526$, I must earn the trust and recognition of the Black Star Society. Let's move quickly.

quest.name: Investigating the Case
quest.desc: $npc:11000251$ ordered me to find out what happened at $map:02000144$. Head to $map:02000144$.

quest.name: Working the Field
quest.desc: $npc:11000213$, met at the entrance of $map:02000144$, kept repeating that it was "horrible" and told me to ask $npc:11000534$ for the details of the incident. Meet with $npc:11000534$, who is conducting an on-site investigation at $map:02000144$.

quest.name: Incident Report
quest.desc: $npc:11000534$ said that the ID found near the body bore the name $npc:11000526$. $npc:11000526$...? Did I hear that right...? Does that mean $npc:11000526$ died here at $map:02000144$...? It's hard to believe, but I should report what I've learned at $map:02000144$ to $npc:11000251$. Head back to $map:02000156$.

quest.name: The Death of Raymon
quest.desc: I ran into $npc:11000524$ again at $map:02000144$—the same person I'd met in $map:02000139$. It seems they had been privately tracking $npc:11000526$'s whereabouts after the Barota Trading Company search concluded, hoping to boost their record as a Dark Wind member. They happened to stumble upon the scene at $map:02000144$ by chance... Whether fortune truly favors them as they say, I can't be sure, but what matters now is that all evidence strongly points to the person who died alone in this secluded alley being $npc:11000526$. Take $item:30000036$ received from $npc:11000524$ and deliver it to $npc:11000044$ at $map:02000153$.

quest.name: A Dead End
quest.desc: After much deliberation, $npc:11000044$ declared that with $npc:11000526$'s death, they would close the investigation—from the weapons depot theft to the cases surrounding $npc:11000492$'s corruption and death. Head back to $map:02000001$ and report the conclusion of the investigation to $npc:11000119$.

quest.name: Vigilante Support Mission
quest.desc: $npc:11000119$ said that an urgent support request came in from the $map:02000076$ vigilante corps, and asked me to depart ahead of the royal guard reinforcements to assess the situation and assist $npc:11000015$. Head out to $map:02000076$.

quest.name: Save the Northeast Outpost!
quest.desc: $npc:11000015$ says the vigilante corps' northeast outpost at $map:02000054$ was ambushed by mysterious monsters, and asks me to defend the outpost alongside the vigilantes. Head to $map:02000054$, defeat the demon-winged bats that attacked the northeast outpost, and help the vigilante corps!
quest.manual: Wake up the fainted vigilantes near the northeast outpost in $map:02000054$|Defeat $npc:21000191$ near the northeast outpost in $map:02000054$

quest.name: An Unfamiliar Object
quest.desc: $npc:11000547$ at the northeast outpost of $map:02000054$ asks me to deliver $item:30000172$, seized after a fierce battle against the ringleader who led the $npc:21000191$ attack, to $npc:11000015$. Head back to $map:02000076$!

quest.name: Nermann the Blacksmith
quest.desc: $npc:11000015$ asked me to deliver $item:30000172$, passed along by $npc:11000547$, to the blacksmith $npc:11000508$ at $map:02000203$. Head to $map:02000203$.

quest.name: A Special Order
quest.desc: $npc:11000508$ at $map:02000203$ asked me to deliver $item:30000173$ to $npc:11000015$.
quest.manual: Find $item:30000173$ at the workbench behind $npc:11000508$ in $map:02000203$

quest.name: The Captain's Heart
quest.desc: $npc:11000015$ asked me to deliver $item:30000173$, given by $npc:11000508$, to $npc:11000119$ at $map:02000001$. Head back to $map:02000001$.

quest.name: From the Front Lines
quest.desc: $npc:11000119$ brought both welcome news—that the vigilante corps stationed at $map:02000115$ outpost, cut off after an earthquake split the land, have finally made contact—and grim news that the fearsome $npc:23000001$ has appeared there. While it's wonderful that the members $npc:11000015$ has been worried about are safe, the emergence of a terrifying presence threatening $map:02000001$'s safety is far from welcome. Deliver $item:30000173$ to the vigilantes at $map:02000115$ outpost. Find the narrowest gap in the broken terrain of $map:02000115$ and fly across.
quest.complete: Meet a vigilante at the broken land in $map:02000115$

quest.name: For Victory
quest.desc: $npc:11000548$ at $map:02000115$ outpost asked me to use $item:30000173$ to repair the broken crossbows.
quest.manual: Obtain $item:30000173$ from $npc:11000548$|Repair the Broken Crossbow in the Severed Land of $map:02000115$

quest.name: Red Dead Witness
quest.desc: $map:02000001$'s $npc:11000119$ said that the red caped man was found at $map:02000117$, counterattacking with $npc:23000008$ when $npc:23000001$ fell in combat. The search began quickly after the report came in, but there has been no news from the guards themselves... Did something happen to them? No time to waste! Go find out what happened at $map:02000117$!

quest.name: Traversing the Cliff Cave
quest.desc: $map:02000117$'s $npc:11000549$ saw the guards locked in fierce combat at $map:02000238$ below the cliff. $map:02000238$ is now unusually still and quiet... Just exactly happened there? Return to $map:02000117$'s $map:02000238$.

quest.name: Battle of Cliff Cave
quest.desc: $npc:11000551$, who fell in $map:02000238$, could no longer continue speaking due to the immense pain. $map:02000238$ seems to be a trap set for the red cape's pursuers. I can lend a hand to the guards who are currently engaged in an intense battle with the monsters from $map:02000238$.
quest.manual: Take care of the monsters at $map:02000117$'s $map:02000238$

quest.name: The Color Green
quest.desc: You managed to discover $item:30000174$ from a broken wagon deep inside $map:02000238$. Ask $npc:11000551$ to find out more information about it.
quest.manual: Pick up $item:30000174$ from the $npc:11000550$ wreck at $map:02000117$'s $map:02000238$

quest.name: Emergency Report
quest.desc: $npc:11000551$ at $map:02000238$ asked me to return to $map:02000001$ and deliver $item:30000174$ to $npc:11000119$, along with a request for reinforcements.

quest.name: A New Phase
quest.desc: $npc:11000119$ received word from $npc:11000044$ that they have found evidence linking $npc:11000529$ of $map:02000100$ to the theft of items from the royal audience ceremony, and asked me to assist with the investigation.

quest.name: Heard It Through the Grapevine
quest.desc: $npc:11000044$ told me to question the residents of $map:02000100$ and look for anyone who has seen the Humples or knows something about them, in order to find their hideout.

quest.name: Eyewitness Testimony
quest.desc: $npc:11000232$, a resident of $map:02000100$, shares what they've heard about the Humples and mentions that $npc:11000233$ would know more.

quest.name: Humples the Outlaw
quest.desc: $npc:11000233$, a resident of $map:02000100$, says their twin sister who works as a maid in $map:02000137$ personally witnessed Humples bullying students in school uniforms. Head to $map:02000137$ and continue investigating Humples.

quest.name: Hidden Truth
quest.desc: I met students in $map:02000137$ who had been victimized by Humples. Seeing how scared and intimidated they were, Humples seem far worse than expected. Since they said they'd come back to see $npc:11000219$, they might still be around here somewhere. Search $map:02000137$ and track down Humples.

quest.name: Humples' Hideout
quest.desc: While searching for Humples in $map:02000137$, I came across $npc:11000218$, who told me a completely different story. It turns out the students being punished at the railroad tracks were actually delinquents who had been bullying $npc:11000218$, and Humples were in fact champions of justice who came to $npc:11000218$'s defense...!! Luckily, a slip by $npc:11000218$ revealed that $map:02000208$ is somewhere in an abandoned building in $map:02000166$. Head to $map:02000166$ and find the condemned building.

quest.name: Clearly Innocent
quest.desc: $npc:11000529$, whom I met at $map:02000208$, shared the story behind why they left the Dark Wind and recounted past memories involving $npc:11000044$. $npc:11000064$, whom $npc:11000529$ firmly believes in... What is the truth about them? Head to $map:02000152$ and report the findings to $npc:11000044$.

quest.name: Traceless Assault
quest.desc: $npc:11000529$, whom I met at $map:02000208$, advises that if I truly want to uncover the truth, it would be better to first trace the origin of the box rather than heading straight to $npc:11000044$. Before acting hastily, it might be wise to look into whether anyone suspicious was seen recently in $map:02000166$.

quest.name: The Trap
quest.desc: Could $npc:11000529$ have been right — that everything was a conspiracy and a trap? $npc:11000311$, a merchant in $map:02000166$, passed along a story about suspicious figures whispering near an abandoned building shrouded in darkness. Head to $map:02000208$ in $map:02000166$ and inform $npc:11000529$ of this.

quest.name: Between Surveillance and Protection
quest.desc: $npc:11000044$ says they are afraid of losing $npc:11000069$, the only daughter of Wren Stilton, at the hands of $npc:11000064$. The terrible memory they once witnessed seems to have left an indelible trauma. Head to $map:02000147$ and find the Dark Wind member guarding $map:02000205$ to check that $npc:11000069$'s daily life is undisturbed.

quest.name: Her Daily Life
quest.desc: $npc:11000258$ asked me to check whether $npc:11000069$, who hasn't been going outside, is doing alright.

quest.name: The Invisible Truth
quest.desc: $npc:11000069$ seemed wary of strangers visiting and appeared to want to live quietly.

quest.name: Harbinger of Doom
quest.desc: When the Royal Guard came to check her safety, $npc:11000058$'s intuition told her that something had happened to $npc:11000074$. Was she right in thinking that something bad had happened...? Let's go to $map:02000001$'s $npc:11000119$ and learn what exactly transpired.

quest.name: Chasing Footprints
quest.desc: $npc:11000119$ seems to place great priority on the value of justice. As $npc:11000119$ said, the world is full of disagreements, and everyone has their own personal reasons for their own perspective. I suppose then it does make sense that some people would see merit in the concept of sacrificing the few for the good of the many... $npc:11000075$ must also have carefully considered the options after $npc:11000057$ returned as a servant of evil... Let's trust $npc:11000075$ for now and join the Royal Guard Chasers following $npc:11000057$ as $npc:11000119$ says.
quest.complete: Find the Royal Guard Chasers at $map:02000053$

quest.name: Endless Pursuit
quest.desc: I saw $npc:11000602$ collapsed in the alleyway in $map:02000053$, which leads to $map:02000090$. He seemed to be more concerned about the other members who were hot on the tail of the red-caped figure. Let's head to $map:02000090$ before anything else.
quest.complete: Find the Royal Guard Chasers at $map:02000090$

quest.name: Inside the Forest of Chaos
quest.desc: Deep inside $map:02000090$, the Royal Guard Chasers were found collapsed and severely injured near the entrance of $map:02000206$. $npc:11000603$ was still somewhat conscious, and said that $npc:23000025$ emerged from the deep, dark $map:02000206$ to protect the red cape from the Royal Guard Chasers. Let's not take any chances and head to $map:02000001$ to report to $npc:11000119$ and request for backup.

quest.name: The Fog Sets In
quest.desc: As $npc:23000025$'s punishment is prepared, $npc:11000119$ requested that the $npc:11000057$'s news be delivered to $npc:11000075$.

quest.name: Conflicting Hearts
quest.desc: $npc:11000075$'s resolve to return to $npc:11000057$ seems to be unshaken. Despite the difficult decision, even for $npcTitle:11000075$, who is essentially the guardian of Maple World, her firm determination is a testament to her unbreakable will. How will $npc:11000074$ respond to $npcTitle:11000075$'s resolve...?

quest.name: Know Thy Enemy
quest.desc: In order to defeat $npc:23000025$, the Royal Guards have been collecting all sorts of information. $npcName:11000169$ wants to make up for not having been able to properly protect the armory, but his timid personality that makes him shy and fidgety in front of women is worrisome. Let's go to $map:02000031$ in $npc:11000169$'s place and retrieve the Book of Shadow Healing from $npc:11000005$.

quest.name: The Book of Legends
quest.desc: $map:02000031$'s $npc:11000005$ said that more can be learned about the Book of Shadow Healing from $map:02000023$'s $npc:11000033$.

quest.name: Apollo the Genius
quest.desc: $npc:11000033$ said that the last person who read the Book of Shadow Healing, $npc:11000604$, might remember the contents of the tome. Let's look for $npc:11000604$ at $map:02000023$'s $map:02000109$.

quest.name: A Fastidious Demand
quest.desc: $npc:11000604$ will share the information related to $npc:23000025$ from Book of Shadow Healing...if I bring $item:30000179$. Let's defeat $npc:22090107$, often found in $map:02000112$ near $map:02000023$, and bring back $item:30000179$.

quest.name: The Brothers Grim
quest.desc:
Here are the passages in the Book of Shadow Healing pertaining to the Baphomet Brothers...
"The Baphomet Brothers were immensely powerful demons who were able to open their eyes and see through the darkness of the Demon King. The eldest, $npc:23000026$ was filled with unspeakable evil, the second, $npc:23000025$ was overflowing with wickedness, and the third, $npc:23000024$ was consumed with pure insanity, annihilating everything in its wake. $npc:23000025$ was the one responsible for engulfing $map:02000023$ with darkness and chaos...which is why it is now called $map:02000206$. As the source of chaos overwhelming the forest stems $item:30000190$, once $npc:23000025$ loses control of it, only then will the Shadow of Chaos be diminished."
There appears to be even more information, but much of the text has withered away...

quest.name: Wisdom of a Sage
quest.desc: $npc:11000075$ said that $map:02000023$'s $npc:11000031$ might be able to find a way to rescue $npc:11000057$, and asked me to deliver a letter.

quest.name: Library of the Forest
quest.desc: $npc:11000031$ told me to find $map:02000019$ in $map:02000019$ and bring back $item:30000191$ from $npc:11000282$.
quest.complete: Find and enter $map:02000019$ in $map:02000215$ to meet with $npc:11000282$

quest.name: Curse of Akabonari
quest.desc: $npc:11000282$ was finicky for a long time. Looking for the hidden $map:02000219$ in a library this large... Guess I don't have much of a choice. Since it's been said that $map:02000219$ is hidden behind a bookcase, let's first find the bookcases that can be moved in $map:02000019$ and try pushing them.
quest.manual: Find $map:02000219$ hidden behind a bookcase in $map:02000019$ | Find $item:30000191$ in $map:02000219$

quest.name: Confirming the Legend
quest.desc: $map:02000019$'s $npc:11000282$ said that in order to obtain $item:30000191$, I must find Hephaestus's travel log, figure out where he hid $item:30000184$, and bring $item:30000184$ back. As it is somewhat of a convoluted request, there is no time to waste, especially considering the urgency at which $npc:11000031$ wants $item:30000191$ back. Let's first search the bookshelves in $map:02000019$ for Hephaestus's travel log!
quest.manual: Search $map:02000019$'s bookshelves to find $item:39000008$ | Go to the marked location on $item:39000008$ and find $item:30000184$

quest.name: Witchin' Treasure
quest.desc: Considering all the difficulty $npc:11000282$ went through in order to obtain $item:30000191$, I guess it shouldn't be a surprise that analyzing the contents have also taken an excruciatingly long time. Fortunately, the everything that's been learned thus far made it clear that $item:30000187$ is necessary. $item:30000187$, the treasure of the witches that is passed from one generation to the next... Can it be obtained?

quest.name: Orb of Souls
quest.desc: $npc:11000304$ divulged the hidden location of $item:30000187$, and imparted some particularly deep and profound messages. Although I can't seem to get $npcName:11000304$'s messages out of my mind, let's try to push that to the side and find $item:30000187$ first before returning. Let's also find the fairy $npcName:11000284$ in the center of $map:02000006$'s large lake and look around the pink-leafed tree for the hidden passageway that goes under the lake. The jar hidden in the bottom of the lake contains $item:30000187$.
quest.manual: Find $item:30000187$ at the bottom of $map:02000006$'s lake

quest.name: You Can Never Be Too Careful
quest.desc: Although $npc:11000031$ finished decoding $item:30000191$'s records and secured $item:30000187$, there seems to be a bigger issue at hand. Using the witches' Soul Curse spell to save $npc:11000057$ runs the risk of throwing off balance one of the powers that drives this world, the balance of life itself. What will $npcTitle:11000075$ decide to do...? Let's return to $map:02000025$ and meet $npc:11000075$.

quest.name: What a Witch Wants
quest.desc: As expected, $npc:11000304$ was not willing to lend out $item:30000187$ so easily. Considering the circumstances, I guess I can't say I'm all that surprised. Let's go to $map:02000113$ and bring $npc:21000266$'s prey, $item:30000072$.

quest.name: The Power of the Wind
quest.desc: $npc:11000304$ wants the power to control the wind! She needs $npc:22000007$'s $item:30000186$. Let's take $item:30000186$ when $map:02000180$'s $npc:22000007$ appears.

quest.name: Specialized Order
quest.desc: After careful deliberation, $npc:11000075$ ordered me to enter $map:02000220$. It's possible that a live being entering $map:02000220$ can disturb the order of life... But if this is necessary to ensure the current world does not fall into confusion and chaos, then such an act should not be solely viewed as transgression against the very nature of life itself. It's time to go to $map:02000023$ and meet $npc:11000031$.

quest.name: The Chief of Perion
quest.desc: Perion Chief $npc:11000134$ has returned! I should go meet with him and hear more about Yamarcha.

quest.name: Muphaza the Wolf King
quest.desc: I'll meet with $npc:11000078$ at $map:02000170$ as $npc:11000134$ said.

quest.name: Unexpected Discovery
quest.desc: I found a suspicious bag in $map:02000229$... My first instinct was that this was $npc:11000069$'s bag.
quest.manual: Find clues from the bag behind $map:02000229$'s altar

quest.name: A Heartwarming Reunion
quest.desc: To meet $npc:11000407$ here, who regaled me with so many stories during the Maple Island days... The nostalgia warms my heart. $npc:11000407$ shared everything, all the way from the first encounter with $npc:11000064$, to how $npc:11000064$ left for the Land of Darkness to save $npc:11000069$. $npc:11000064$ left a letter for $npc:11000529$ before leaving! I wonder what kind of message he left to one of his most dependable friends? Let's go to $map:02000166$'s $map:02000208$ and deliver $item:30000340$ to $npc:11000529$.

quest.name: Unyielding Friendship
quest.desc:
$item:30000340$ contained a request for $npc:11000529$'s help, as $npc:11000069$ left alone for Katramus, the slave's tower. Overjoyed at the news that $npc:11000064$ is still alive, $npc:11000529$ began preparing to leave for Katramus without a moment's hesitation. He left one piece of advice before he left...
"Remember, you still have time to listen to the entire story from $npc:11000064$ first before relaying the news of $npc:11000064$ to $npc:11000044$."
It is now up to me to decide how much should be reported to $npc:11000044$. Let's first go to $map:02000100$'s $map:02000152$ and meet $npc:11000044$.

quest.name: The Final Gift
quest.desc: After sharing $map:02000229$'s location, $npc:11000078$ asked me to help free the trapped soul of his fallen friend, the Red Wolf King Machar. Let's carefully take $item:30000076$ from $npc:11000078$ and travel to the entrance of $map:02000229$ in the red lands below the center of $map:02000170$.
quest.manual: Defeat the monsters at $map:02000229$ | Free Machar's soul with the embers of purification at $map:02000229$

quest.name: Witness Protection
quest.desc: $npc:11000529$ could not help but show unbridled joy while meeting with $npc:11000064$ at Katramus. Although it isn't completely credible, $npc:11000529$ said that there has been an anonymous informant who can reveal $npc:11000044$'s true identity, and that he must be found before the Dark Wind finds him.

quest.name: No Corner Left Behind
quest.desc: $npc:11001021$ at $map:02000279$ requested that I conduct a thorough investigation of $map:02000307$. I'll head to $map:02000307$'s entrance, which is right behind $npc:11001021$.
quest.manual: Enter through $map:02000307$'s entrance behind $npc:11001021$ and defeat the monsters

quest.name: Everybody Loves Raymon
quest.desc: The anonymous informant from $map:02000279$... He was $npc:11000526$, thought to have been dead for a long time now. $npc:11000526$ said that both the robbery of the armory and the death of $npc:11000492$ are $npc:11000044$'s doings, and that the proof can be found behind $map:02000226$'s wall clock.

quest.name: Decisive Evidence
quest.desc: $npc:11001021$ told me to go to $map:02000139$ and look behind $map:02000226$'s wall clock. $map:02000226$ can be reached by going up through $map:02000225$.
quest.manual: Find the evidence behind $map:02000226$'s wall clock at $map:02000139$

quest.name: The Unusual Suspect
quest.desc: $npc:11000529$ said that $npc:11000044$ can be proven to be guilty with testimony from $npc:11000526$ and $item:30000075$ as evidence. I was told to go to $map:02000152$ and make sure $npc:11000044$ cannot run away.

quest.name: Into Thin Air
quest.desc: $npc:11000044$ has already left $map:02000153$ and vanished. It's apparent that $npc:11000044$ already figured out what was going on and hid. I should return to $map:02000208$ and tell $npc:11000529$ the news.

quest.name: Flip Flopped
quest.desc: $npc:11000529$ told me to show $item:30000075$ to $map:02000001$'s $npc:11000119$ and say that a bounty must be set for $npc:11000044$.

quest.name: Reporting Facts
quest.desc: $npc:11000119$ told me to report everything to $npcName:11000075$.

quest.name: The Great Rescue
quest.desc: The doppelganger of $npc:11000685$, the absolute good...$npc:11000068$, the absolute evil! Until $npc:11000068$ is sealed away back into the Shadow World, not even Green Lapenta's safety is guaranteed... This is a crisis that only the Defenders, the guardians of the world, must resolve. It's vital that $npc:11000057$'s rescue plan first be executed. Let's find the door to $map:02000227$ near the Green Lapenta's apparition at the lowest part of $map:02000023$.
quest.manual: Receive $item:30000107$ from $npc:11000031$ at $map:02000023$'s $map:02000035$ | Find and enter $map:02000227$'s entrance near Lapenta's apparition

quest.name: Soul Dimension
quest.desc: $npc:11000685$ in $map:02000227$ said that in order to diminish the impact of the fissure from both life and soul, the Spirit Lantern must be absorbed. Let's enter $map:02000220$ after absorbing the Spirit Lantern behind $npc:11000685$.
quest.manual: Receive $item:30000107$ from $npc:11000685$ at $map:02000227$ | Enter $map:02000220$ after absorbing the Spirit Lantern

quest.name: No Turning Back
quest.desc: Bella was found hardened like a rock at $map:02000220$, and was unresponsive to $item:30000107$. Just what in the world happened to Bella's soul...?

quest.name: A Lost Hope
quest.desc: It seems like the only hope of saving $npc:11000057$ has been extinguished.

quest.name: Back to Square One
quest.desc: The memories of all the work I did for $npc:11000282$ and $npc:11000304$ with the hopes of saving $npc:11000057$ from the Demon King flashed before my eyes. But now... Everything's back to square one... Is it time to give up trying to save $npc:11000057$...?

quest.name: A Hole That Cannot Be Filled
quest.desc: Unable to see $npc:11000074$ face to face, $npc:11000075$ asked me to deliver the news along with some words of consolation to $npc:11000057$.

quest.name: A Word A Day
quest.desc: $npc:11000074$ asked me to deliver the news that $npc:11000057$ will not be returning, so that $npc:11000057$ will not have to suffer more from any pretense of false hope.

quest.name: Incoming Storm
quest.desc: $npc:11000076$ said that $npc:11000057$ and his minions stormed $map:02000146$ and attempted to overtake it. I was asked to join the reinforcements $npc:11000119$ and $npc:11000057$ brought in order to track $npc:11000057$ down. Let's find an entrance to a tunnel near the path to $map:02000145$!
quest.complete: Find $map:02000237$ in $map:02000146$ and join the reinforcements

quest.name: Light at the End of the Tunnel
quest.desc: The reinforcements $npc:11000119$ and $npc:11000015$ brought from $map:02000237$ have already been almost completely obliterated. $npcName:11000015$ told me to leave the injured $npcName:11000119$ with him and to continue pursuing $npc:11000057$.

quest.name: The One That Got Away
quest.desc: $npc:11000703$, who was injured while pursuing $npc:11000057$, told me to return to the Defender's Alliance HQ and request for reinforcements to continue chasing $npc:11000057$.

quest.name: Beings of Darkness
quest.desc: I received word that somewhere in $map:02000146$, there is likely an entrance to $map:02000213$ — a kind of summoning ground where $npc:23000007$ endlessly calls forth Shadow Legion members and strengthens them with the power of darkness.

quest.name: The True Nature of Darkness
quest.desc: $npc:11000076$ believes the mysterious door discovered by a Guardian scouting party is the entrance to $map:02000213$, and tells me to go ahead and observe the situation while the elite troops prepare.
quest.manual: Explore the Shadow Legion's summoning site found in $map:02000146$

quest.name: The Hunt for Comrades
quest.desc: $npc:11000842$ asked me to go to $map:03000143$ and deliver a message to a companion.

quest.name: Preparation Before Perspiration
quest.desc: $npc:11000841$ was injured and was treated by a doctor at an emergency shelter. However, the wounds unfortunately became worse, and as a result, $npc:11000841$ is now immobile. The Lumina Liberation Army's Katramus operation to rescue citizens must be executed without any issues... I'll go to $map:03000057$ in $npc:11000841$'s place to remove the poisoned traps near Katramus and defeat $npc:29000049$!
quest.manual: Remove the poisoned traps near $map:03000057$ Katramus | Defeat $map:03000057$'s $npc:29000049$

quest.name: Dungeon: The Mining Captives
quest.desc:
$dungeonTitle:21009001$ (Entrance: $map:3000057$) Party Size (4 players)
After sharing an entrance to infiltrate $map:02000292$, $npc:11000839$ said that it would be best to rescue the citizens trapped in $map:02000292$ before the Lumina Liberation Army's plan rolls into action. It would be a big help if I could free at least a few more people from the suffering as soon as possible. Time to gather companions to help free the captured citizens in $map:02000292$!

quest.name: Dungeon: The Taskmaster
quest.desc:
$dungeonTitle:21009001$ (Entrance: $map:3000057$) Party Size (4 players)
$npc:11000839$ shared the stories of the rescued people of $map:02000292$ and said that the plans of the Lumina Liberation Army will be expedited. It's time to assist the Lumina Liberation Army in conquering Katramus, rescuing all the citizens, then finally defeating the evil taskmaster $npc:24000516$!

quest.name: Dungeon: A Mother's Trace
quest.desc:
$dungeonTitle:21009001$ (Entrance: $map:3000057$) Party Size (4 players)
$npc:11000186$, whom I previously met at $map:02000085$, told me with tears in his eyes that his older sister has been suffering with nightmares ever since they heard about Katramus from the Land of Darkness. Are the rumors about $npc:11000186$'s parents being held as slaves at Katramus really true? Keeping in mind that $npc:11000186$ and $npc:11000188$'s mother is wearing a silver bracelet with her initials on it, I can attempt to pinpoint her location at Katramus!
quest.manual: (Elite) Find the silver bracelet of $npc:11000188$'s mother at Katramus

quest.name: Dungeon: More Than a Feeling
quest.desc:
$dungeonTitle:21002001$ (Entrance: $map:2000172$) Party Size (4 players)
While observing the forest with a telescope, $map:02000172$'s $npc:11000873$ spotted a green tornado beyond a rather peculiar door, and asked me to find out what exactly is happening beyond said door.

quest.name: Longing for Mother
quest.desc: $npc:11000221$ of $map:02000136$ asked me to go find $npc:11000242$ of $map:02000135$ and get more details, as $npc:11000242$ had mentioned that $npc:11000221$'s mother might still be alive in the Land of Darkness.

quest.name: Shadow World Research
quest.desc: $npc:11000242$ of $map:02000135$ mentioned that a regular customer, $npc:11000384$, had come across $item:39000010$ by chance, and suggested I go meet them.

quest.name: In Search of the Shadow Gate
quest.desc: $npc:11000384$ of $map:02000135$ said they sold $item:39000010$ to $npc:11000609$ and told me to head to $map:02000146$.

quest.name: Eagle Eye News
quest.desc: $map:02000146$'s $npc:11000009$ said that Murpagoth's eagle from $map:02000051$ flew over to deliver $npc:11000064$'s news.

quest.name: Onward to Perion
quest.desc: $map:02000153$'s $npc:11000215$ told me to go to $map:02000051$ first and find out what happened.
quest.complete: Go to $map:02000051$ and discover what happened

quest.name: Trivial Treasure
quest.desc: $map:02000051$'s $npc:11000136$ told me that more detailed information could be learned from $npc:11000078$ at $map:02000170$.

quest.name: Kaka Tribe's Ruin
quest.desc: $npc:11000078$ at $map:02000170$ says $npc:11000064$ may be after the ancients' treasure, and that they need to verify whether it actually exists. $npc:11000078$ tells you to defeat $npc:21000087$ at $map:02000236$ and $map:02000235$, where the entrance to $map:02000207$ opens, collect $item:30000001$, and bring them to $npc:11000039$.

quest.name: Eye of Fire
quest.desc: $map:02000049$'s $npc:11000039$ told me to place 50 $item:30000001$ into the jar on the altar behind him and chant the incantation "Yaramachata charamayata."
quest.manual: Make $item:30000201$ by chanting the incantation to the jar on the altar

quest.name: Lennon the Defender
quest.desc: $map:02000146$'s $npc:11000076$ said that $npc:11000064$ has joined the Defenders, and asked that I go see him at $map:02000228$.

quest.name: A Tunnel Within a Tunnel
quest.desc: $npc:11000064$ anticipates that $npc:11000044$ will slip into the Land of Darkness through a hidden passage in $map:02000146$, and asks me to search $map:02000308$.

quest.name: Facing the Darkness
quest.desc: $npc:11000069$ said that $npc:11000064$ went after $npc:11000044$ into $map:52000003$ and asked me to help $npc:11000064$ stay safe.

quest.name: Duty of the Survivor
quest.desc: $npc:11000064$ anticipates that $npc:11000044$ will return someday, stronger than before, and tells me to inform the Guardian troops that $npc:11000044$ has completely vanished into the Land of Darkness.

quest.name: An End That Isn't the End
quest.desc: $npc:11000076$ tells me to report to $npc:11000075$ that $npc:11000044$ has completely vanished into the Land of Darkness.

quest.name: 예전의 내가 아니야!
quest.desc: 건달 세계에서 발을 빼겠다며 남은 인생에서 절대 주먹을 휘두르지 않겠다고 다짐한 $map:02000110$의 $npc:11000358$$pp:는,은$ 자신을 대신해서 위험한 폭탄을 닥치는대로 던지고 다니는 $npc:21000281$들을 혼내 달라는 부탁을 했다.

quest.name: Reinvented
quest.desc: Having sworn to leave the thug life behind and never use his fists again, $npc:11000358$'s upset that he can't do anything about the $npcPlural:21000281$. They're throwing dangerous bombs everywhere, and he's asked you to put a stop to it.

$npc:11000358$ in $map:02000110$ swore to leave the gangster world and never throw another punch for the rest of his life, and asks you to punish the $npc:21000281$ who are throwing dangerous bombs everywhere in his place.
quest.name: I'm Not Who I Used to Be!
Secret Orders
quest.desc: $npc:11000076$ revealed that special agents of the Secret Order are carrying out covert missions in the Land of Darkness, and invited me to join. A dangerous but meaningful life suits me far better than a safe but purposeless one — especially for someone who wants to become a hero. The Land of Darkness, where a great evil threatening this world lies dormant...! However dangerous it may be, there's no point in being afraid before I've even set foot there!

quest.name: Welcome to Hell
quest.desc: $npc:11000804$ challenged me, on my honor, to step outside $map:03009001$ and defeat $npc:40000024$. I'm not sure why I need to prove myself like this... but if I walk away now, I'll be branded a coward. Let's defeat $npc:40000024$ with dignity and hold my head high!

quest.name: Shadow Report
quest.desc: I went through all that trouble defeating $npc:40000024$ and came back, only to hear them grumbling about skill levels...? I don't know how talented $npc:11000804$ really is, but I'm determined to one day make them apologize for looking down on me. Business is business! For now, let's just take care of the mission at hand.
quest.manual: Receive $item:30000218$ from $npc:11000804$ in the Dark Land $map:03009001$

quest.name: Secretly, Greatly
quest.desc: $npc:11000076$ of $map:02000146$ says a new mission in the Land of Darkness has come up, and tells me to head to $map:03009001$ to meet $npc:11000804$.

quest.name: The Investigation Resumes
quest.desc: $npc:11000804$ of $map:03009001$ says we need to use $npc:11000070$ to find out where and how $item:20000046$ is being produced and distributed. They give me a mission to approach $npc:11000070$ under the pretense of buying $item:20000046$ and determine its source and distribution route.

quest.name: A Dangerous Deal
quest.desc: $npc:11000070$ demanded $item:30000194$ in exchange for $item:20000046$. Unlike Karma, $item:30000194$ is nothing but worthless stone fragments — what could they possibly want them for...? For now, let's hunt monsters roaming the Land of Darkness, as they are known to occasionally drop $item:30000194$.
quest.manual: Defeat monsters in the Dark Land and obtain $item:30000194$

quest.name: Undercover Investigation
quest.desc: $npc:11000070$ introduced me to $npc:11000610$, who supplies $item:20000046$, and said they'd take $item:30000194$ as a referral fee. I feel like I've been had, but I'll have to swallow my pride just this once to gather more information. Let's head outside the shelter and meet $npc:11000610$.

quest.name: Finding the Scene!
quest.desc: $npc:11000610$ said that if I want to obtain $item:20000046$, I should go to $map:03000134$ and meet $npc:11000806$, who first developed $item:20000046$.

quest.name: Lepen's Scheme
quest.desc: $npc:11000806$, stressed by the $npc:40000023$s' tyranny, gave what seemed like a reluctant agreement to deal with them. Their thoroughness in always having an escape plan, even when things go wrong, seems to be the source of strength that allows them to adapt and survive here.

quest.name: Investigation Report
quest.desc: $npc:11000806$ in $map:03000134$ seems to take great pride in having been the first to develop $item:20000046$. However... for the safety and peace of the Maple World, it would have been far better if he had stayed in the corner of the Goldus Pharmaceutical Factory making antacids. Drastic measures must be taken to ensure that $npc:11000806$'s grand and wicked dream of using his own drugs to control and manipulate people never becomes reality.

quest.name: Papagaru Manufacturing Site
quest.desc: $npc:11000804$ said the illegal distribution of $item:20000046$ must be stamped out at its root, and gave me a mission to clear out $map:03009021$ and return. Let's find $map:03009021$ underground in $map:03000134$, defeat the guards protecting it, and collect all of $item:30000216$, the raw material used to produce $item:20000046$.

quest.name: Trust Beyond Repair
quest.desc: $npc:11000805$, whom I met in $map:03009021$, acted as though they wanted nothing to do with anyone outside the Lumina Liberation Army. Who are the Lumina Liberation Army...? Why is $npc:11000805$ acting this way...? For now, let's return to $map:03009001$ and give $npc:11000804$ a detailed report on what happened in $map:03009021$.

quest.name: Lumina Liberation Army
quest.desc: $npc:11000804$ told me that $npc:11000564$ of $map:03009001$ is known as the Dark Land's information broker, and asked me to find out if they know anything about the Lumina Liberation Army.

quest.name: Find the Password
quest.desc: $npc:11000564$ shared that the Lumina Liberation Army's last gathering point was the Solar Energy Research Center in $map:03000134$. The Solar Energy Research Center... that would be the building with solar panels on its roof, along the road from $map:03000134$ toward $map:03000092$. Let's head there and look for any clues or traces we can use to track down the Lumina Liberation Army.
quest.manual: Find clues to track the Lumina Liberation Army in $map:03000134$

quest.name: Their Own Rules
quest.desc: $npc:11000613$ in the Dark Land of $map:03009022$ offers me a chance to aid the Liberation Army's activities, and asks me to go meet $npc:11000615$.

quest.name: A Heartbreaking Farewell
quest.desc: $npc:11000615$ of $map:03009022$ in the Dark Land asks me to go find $npc:11000614$, who is reportedly searching day and night for their separated younger sister, and lend them some help.

quest.name: The Rabbit's Temptation
quest.desc: $npc:11000614$ of $map:03000135$ in the Dark Land says that obtaining and examining $item:30000211$ held by the clock rabbit $npc:40000022$s — who lured them and their younger sister into the Dark Land and kidnapped them — might yield clues to finding their sister. Let's defeat the $npc:40000022$s and get our hands on $item:30000211$!

quest.name: An Unexpected Connection
quest.desc: $npc:11000614$ of $map:03000135$ in the Dark Land told me about what happened in the Tower of Slaves and shared how they first came to meet $npc:11000064$. $npc:11000064$ was trapped in the Tower of Slaves... what could have happened to them? Let's go to $map:03009001$ and report to $npc:11000804$.

quest.name: The True Mission
quest.desc: $npc:11000804$ of $map:03009001$ in the Dark Land tells me to return to Maple World and report everything to $npc:11000076$ of $map:02000146$, including news about the Lumina Liberation Army and $npc:11000064$.

quest.name: The Operation Begins
quest.desc: $npc:11000613$ says they used $item:30000211$ recovered from the $npc:40000022$s to discover that $npc:11000614$'s younger sister is imprisoned in $map:03009023$, and has devised what they call the '$map:03009023$ Rescue Operation'.

quest.name: Quietly, Quickly
quest.desc: $npc:11000614$ confirms the orders given, and asks me to deliver $item:30000213$ to $npc:11000616$ in $map:03000136$.

quest.name: Real Situation
quest.desc: $npc:11000616$ in $map:03000136$ asks me to obtain $item:30000214$ and $item:30000215$ needed to prepare the rescue operation for $map:03009023$. $item:30000214$ can be taken from $npc:40000020$s roaming around $map:03000136$, and $item:30000215$ can be found in the yellow drums scattered throughout $map:03000136$.
quest.manual: Defeat $npc:40000020$ and obtain $item:30000214$|Find Buatan Oil in the yellow drums of $map:03000136$

quest.name: If We Could Block That Path
quest.desc: $npc:11000616$ of $map:03000136$ asks me, as part of the $map:03009023$ Rescue Operation, to take $item:30000214$ and install it at the junction in $map:03000146$ that connects to other regions.
quest.manual: Place $item:30000214$ on the path connecting to $map:03000136$ in $map:03000146$|Place $item:30000214$ on the path connecting to $map:03000145$ in $map:03000146$

quest.name: Preparations Complete
quest.desc: $npc:11000616$ of $map:03000136$ tells me to return to $map:03009022$ and inform $npc:11000613$ that the operation preparations are complete.

quest.name: Shadow Rescue Operation!
quest.desc: $npc:11000613$ tells me to go to $map:03009023$ and, together with the Lumina Liberation Army, rescue the people unjustly imprisoned there.
quest.manual: Find $item:30000251$ in $map:03009023$ and free the imprisoned people|Rescue $npc:11000807$ in $map:03009023$|Eliminate monsters in $map:03009023$

quest.name: My Little Sibling Has Returned
quest.desc: $npc:11000614$ of $map:03000135$ is overjoyed, saying they safely rescued their long-awaited younger sister $npc:11000807$. Let's meet $npc:11000807$ before she returns to Maple World.

quest.name: In That Place...
quest.desc: $npc:11000807$ told me about the terrible things she endured in the Tower of Slaves before being rescued. The yellow hair lingering in her memory... worn goggles... a tattered red cloak... The description brings $npc:11000064$ to mind — the one said to have been dragged to $map:02000213$.

quest.name: Yet Another Connection
quest.desc: $npc:11000613$ says that as long as it is for the benefit of the good, ordinary citizens of Maple World and does not require anyone's sacrifice, the Lumina Liberation Army will assist the Guardians.

quest.name: Joining Hands
quest.desc: $npcName:11000804$ tells me to return to $map:02000146$ and request that $npc:11000076$ have the Guardian Corps support the survivors rescued in the $map:03009023$ Rescue Operation so they can return to their normal lives.

quest.name: The End of That Road
quest.desc: $npc:11000872$ says that investigating the toxic liquid flowing through the Dark Land will reveal many things, and plans to thoroughly explore the Poison Cave found in $map:03000014$. $npc:11000872$ said we can't predict what we'll encounter inside Poison Cave, so let's explore it to the end without letting our guard down for a moment. Don't forget to prepare $item:20000060$ in case of emergencies.
quest.manual: Explore Poison Cave to the very end

quest.name: Another Secret Agent
quest.desc: $npc:11000804$ is worried, saying that $npc:11000872$, who has been carrying out a secret mission in the Dark Land alongside them, set out long ago and has yet to return. Let's look for $npc:11000872$ in $map:03000014$.

quest.name: Losing Hope
quest.desc: $npc:11000058$ told me to find $npc:11000869$, a researcher who has been assigned to investigate the Lidibrium area by the Chaos Time Center, and inquire if time travel is possible with the Red Lapenta's powers.
quest.complete: Find the Chaos Time Center's researcher at $map:02000008$

quest.name: Grasping at the Straws of Time
quest.desc: Left alone in $map:02000008$, $npc:11000868$ said that $npc:11000869$ can be found at $map:02000142$.

quest.name: Come on Feel the Noise
quest.desc: $npc:11000869$ asked me to defeat the monsters of $map:02000142$, who are disrupting the research with an abundance of noise.

quest.name: Unauthorized
quest.desc: $npc:11000869$ warns that while returning to the past is not impossible, doing so could disrupt the order of time and open a world even more terrifying than the Dark Land.

quest.name: Unreadable Intentions
quest.desc: $npc:11000058$ seems curious about what would happen if the order of time collapsed. What thoughts might be lurking behind that question?

quest.name: 시계탑 속으로
quest.desc: $npc:11000870$$pp:는,은$ 시계탑의 시계가 멈춘 원인을 파악하기 위해 $map:02000161$$pp:로,으로$ 들어간 $npc:11000871$$pp:가,이$ 감감 무소식이라며 상황을 파악해 달라고 부탁한다.

quest.name: Tick Tock Clock Tower
quest.desc: $npc:11000870$ has asked you to help solve the mystery of the stopped Clock Tower. Head into the $map:02000161$ to find $npc:11000871$.
$npc:11000870$ asks you to find out what happened, saying $npc:11000871$, who entered $map:02000161$ to determine why the clock tower stopped, has not been heard from.

quest.name: 아수라장 놀이터
quest.desc: $npc:11000871$$pp:는,은$ 시계를 굴리는 거대한 토끼가 낚아채 간 $item:39000026$$pp:를,을$ 찾아 달라고 한다. $map:02000161$를 가득 채운 몬스터들을 처치하며 거대한 토끼를 찾아서 $item:39000026$$pp:를,을$ 되찾자!
quest.manual: $map:02000161$의 몬스터 처치하기|$map:02000161$ 깊숙이 사라진 토끼를 처치하고 $item:39000026$ 찾기

quest.desc: $npc:11000871$ asks you to find $item:39000026$, which was snatched by the giant rabbit that runs the clock. Defeat the monsters filling $map:02000161$, find the giant rabbit, and recover $item:39000026$!
quest.manual: Defeat monsters in $map:02000161$|Defeat the rabbit that disappeared deep into $map:02000161$ and find $item:39000026$

quest.name: Clock Tower Pandemonium
quest.desc: $npc:11000871$ asked you to retrieve the $item:39000026$, which was stolen by a giant rabbit. Defeat the monsters in the $map:02000161$ while you hunt down that rabbit.
quest.manual: Defeat monsters in the $map:02000161$|Defeat the rabbit deep within $map:02000161$ and retrieve the $item:39000026$

quest.name: 혼돈의 시간
quest.desc: $npc:11000871$$pp:는,은$ 설계도에 나와 있는 시계탑 지하의 중추부를 찾아 가겠다며 $npc:11000870$에게 이 소식을 전해 달라고 한다.

quest.name: Dazed and Confused
quest.desc: $npc:11000871$ headed for the control room in the basement. Relay the news to $npc:11000870$.
$npc:11000871$ says they will go find the central area beneath the clock tower shown in the blueprint, and asks you to tell $npc:11000870$ this news.

quest.name: Cries of the Forest
quest.desc: $map:02000017$'s $npc:11000350$ said that there have been cries coming from the cherry blossom forest and asked me to look into it. Let's go to $map:02000017$'s eastern cherry blossom forest to investigate.
quest.complete: Investigate the cries coming from $map:02000017$'s eastern cherry blossom regions

quest.name: Dungeon: Broken Peace
quest.desc:
$dungeonTitle:21001001$ (Entrance: $map:2000017$) Party Size (4 players)
$npc:11000499$ at $map:02000017$'s eastern cherry blossom forest asked me to save the Boroboro trapped inside the thorny vines. I'm still unsure as to what kinds of dangerous threats await inside, so let's tread with caution. It's time to gather up some companions to go to $map:02000290$, and save $npc:11000499$'s friends.
quest.manual: Save the Boroboro from the thorny vines in $map:02000290$

quest.name: Dungeon: Wicked Old Tree
quest.desc:
$dungeonTitle:21001001$ (Entrance: $map:2000017$) Party Size (4 players)
$npc:11000499$ heard from friends at $map:02000017$'s pink Cherry Blossom Forest that $npc:11000751$, who was under the protection of the Boroboro, was taken by $npc:24000409$ and imprisoned in giant thorny vines. He'd been tasked with rescuing the princess... Return to $map:02000290$ and defeat $npc:24000409$ so $npc:11000751$ may come back safely.

quest.name: Dungeon: All the King's Treasure
quest.desc:
$dungeonTitle:21005001$ (Entrance: $map:2000083$) Party Size (4 players)
$map:02000083$'s $npc:11000101$ has asked to join forces to avenge $npc:11000503$, and has talked at great length of the king's treasure chest located in the deepest parts of $map:02000251$. Since it doesn't inspire confidence to see one believe that words are all the strength one needs, it seems going to $map:02000251$ with more skilled friends than $npc:11000101$ is the better option.
quest.manual: Open the king's treasure chest in $map:02000251$

quest.name: Dungeon: Unacquainted with Death
quest.desc:
$dungeonTitle:21003001$ (Entrance: $map:3000014$) Party Size (4 players)
In $map:03009001$, the Land of Darkness, resides a secret Defender named $npc:11000804$. The Defender has heard of $npc:22000047$ living deep within the Poison Cave, and has issued orders to confirm the rumor and defeat $npc:22000047$.
quest.manual: Find and defeat $npc:22000047$ in the Poison Cave

quest.name: A Welcome Guest
quest.desc: $npc:11000002$ from $map:02000001$ is distraught, as $npc:11000607$ left a present just before heading off into the wild. Go find $npc:11000607$ near the $map:02000001$ palace and tell him to stop by and see $map:02000120$ before leaving $map:02000001$.

quest.name: Dungeon: Secrets in the Basement
quest.desc:
$dungeonTitle:21004001$ (Entrance: $map:2000001$) Party Size (4 players)
$npc:11000607$ at the basement entrance of the $map:02000001$ palace is anxious about the unusual atmosphere around the area. Go into $map:02000252$ and see if $npc:11000607$ has anything to fear.

quest.name: Dungeon: Protect the Palace!
quest.desc:
$dungeonTitle:21004001$ (Entrance: $map:2000001$) Party Size (4 players)
$npc:11000607$, hearing of the $map:02000252$ ambush and looking absolutely perplexed, alerted the royal guards and pleaded for help to stop the enemy's push at $map:02000252$ until support troops arrive. Return to $map:02000252$ and defeat those who invaded the palace!

quest.name: Dungeon: With Anos
quest.desc:
$dungeonTitle:21002001$ (Entrance: $map:2000172$) Party Size (4 players)
The kind and slender Fairy $npc:11000693$ from $map:02000172$ has asked for help protecting the Green Lapenta by assisting $npc:11000032$, who is currently fighting the assailants trying to destroy it. It seems it will be difficult to overlook $npc:11000693$'s request due to the Fairy's special and precious relationship with $npc:11000032$. I have no choice but to grab some comrades and go into $map:02000066$ to assist $npc:11000032$ in protecting the Green Lapenta!

quest.name: Maintaining Composure
quest.desc: $npc:11000119$ of $map:02000001$ has asked me to remember that the strength of the darkness threatening the world has increased along with my own. He said to stay humble... There are still many places in the world where Defenders and unsung heroes are battling the Demon King's darkness. I will find and assist them.

quest.name: The Qualifications of a Hero
quest.desc: $npc:11000076$ of $map:02000146$ has accepted me as a hero and informed me of my duty to stand up for this world. As $npc:11000076$ has requested I take on more difficult work, I've decided to meet $npc:11000266$ and $npc:11000009$ at $map:02000146$ and help them.
quest.manual: Help $npc:11000266$ and complete the story [City Threat]|Help $npc:11000009$ and complete the story [Curse of the Vayar Mountains]

quest.name: The Weight of a Hero
quest.desc: $map:02000146$'s $npc:11000076$ commanded me to meet $npc:11000007$ at $map:02000146$ and assist the Henesys Green Hood Vigilantes' guard activity.
quest.manual: Help $npc:11000007$ and complete the story [Demon's Servant ]

quest.name: 파괴의 법칙
quest.desc: $map:02000146$의 $npc:11000266$$pp:는,은$ $map:02000100$ $npc:11000065$$pp:가,이$ 수시로 나타나 도시를 파괴하고 주민들을 위협하는 거대 괴수 로봇을 일망타진하고 그 정체를 밝힐 수 있게 도와 달라는 협조 요청 공문을 보냈다고 말한다. $map:02000145$에 자주 출몰하는 $npc:23000054$$pp:를,을$ 처치하고 $item:30000280$$pp:를,을$ $npc:11000065$에게 가지고 가자.

quest.name: The Outlaws of Robotics
quest.desc:
$npc:11000266$ of $map:02000146$ sent an urgent request for help to $npc:11000065$. Apparently a giant robot is attacking the city.
Defeat $npcName:23000054$ at the $map:02000145$ and bring its $item:30000280$ to $npc:11000065$.

$npc:11000266$ in $map:02000146$ says $npc:11000065$ from $map:02000100$ sent an official request for cooperation to help wipe out the giant monster robot that keeps appearing, destroying the city and threatening residents, and to reveal its identity. Defeat $npc:23000054$, which often appears in $map:02000145$, and bring $item:30000280$ to $npc:11000065$.

quest.name: 던전 : 빛을 잃은 도시
quest.desc:
$dungeonTitle:20009001$ (입구 맵 : $map:02000164$) 파티권장 (4명) 노멀 모드에서만 퀘스트 수행이 가능합니다.
$map:02000100$의 $npc:11000065$$pp:는,은$ 시민들이 거주하고 있는 $map:02000164$ 주변 $map:02000099$에 $npc:23100055$$pp:가,이$ 나타나서 날뛰는 바람에 $map:02000100$까지 전기가 끊어지게 생겼다며 걱정한다. $map:02000164$에서 $map:02000314$$pp2:로,으로$ 들어가서 $npc:23100055$$pp:를,을$ 처치하고 송전탑 전원을 연결하도록 하자.

quest.name: City of Lost Lights
quest.desc:
$dungeonTitle:20009001$ Entrance: $map:02000164$ Party Size: 4 players This quest is only available on normal difficulty.
$npc:11000065$ is worried about the $npc:23100055$ that has taken position on the $map:02000099$, where it can cut power to the city. Defeat the robot and restore power to the utility tower.

$dungeonTitle:20009001$ (Entrance Map: $map:02000164$) Party Recommended (4 players) This quest can only be completed in Normal Mode.
$npc:11000065$ in $map:02000100$ is worried because $npc:23100055$ appeared and went on a rampage in $map:02000099$ around $map:02000164$, where citizens live, and now even $map:02000100$ may lose power. Enter $map:02000314$ from $map:02000164$, defeat $npc:23100055$, and connect the power to the transmission tower.

quest.name: 방심은 금물
quest.desc: $map:02000100$$pp:와,과$ $map:02000270$ 지역 간 갈등이 심각한 것 같다. $map:02000146$$pp2:로,으로$ 돌아가서 $npc:11000266$에게 $npc:11000065$의 당부를 전해주자.
The conflict between $map:02000100$ and $map:02000270$ seems serious. Return to $map:02000146$ and deliver $npc:11000065$'s request to $npc:11000266$.

quest.name: Tightening Security
quest.desc: It seems the divide between $map:02000100$ and $map:02000270$ is quite severe. Return to the $map:02000146$ and deliver $npc:11000065$'s request to $npc:11000266$.

quest.name: The Sacred Feather
quest.desc: $map:02000146$'s $npc:11000009$ has stated that assistance is required to unravel the curse and grief at the Vayar Mountains, and that I should help $npc:11000039$ prepare the offerings for the service. I should be able to acquire $item:30000281$ from either $npc:23000019$ or $npc:23000020$.

quest.name: Dungeon: The Sacred Rock
quest.desc:
$dungeonTitle:20002001$ (Entrance: $map:02000148$) Party Size (4 players) Quest possible only on Normal Mode.
$npc:11000009$ of $map:02000146$ has asked me to defeat the $npc:23100100$ and anything protecting $map:02000313$. I'm also to retrieve the $item:30000282$ and bring it to $npc:11000302$. With reliable comrades, I should have no problem retrieving the $item:30000282$ in $map:02000313$.

quest.name: Noble Beginnings
quest.desc: Expressing great trust and faith in $npc:11000009$, the son of $npc:11000134$, the chief of the Murpagos tribe, $npc:11000302$, has requested a relay of gratitude for retrieving the required offerings.

quest.name: Origins of Evil
quest.desc: $npc:11000007$ of $map:02000146$ believes that the powerful dark energy of the Devilyns in $map:02000115$ comes from the giant horns on their heads. I've been tasked with defeating them and retrieving $item:30000283$.

quest.name: Dungeon: Souls Awoken from Darkness
quest.desc:
$dungeonTitle:20006001$ (Entrance: $map:02000146$) Party Size (4 players) Quest possible only on Normal Mode.
$npc:11000007$ of $map:02000146$ has expressed that the source of the darkness within $item:30000283$ was created by $npc:23100007$ by waking up spirits sleeping in darkness. Let's get to $map:02000356$, defeat $npc:23100007$, destroy the spirit stone used to wake the sleeping spirits and report the situation to $npc:11000015$ of $map:02000076$.
quest.manual: (Boss) Defeat $npc:23100007$ at $map:02000356$|Destroy the Spirit Stone at $map:02000213$

quest.name: This Is Just the Beginning
quest.desc: The Devilyns are merely the tail end of the Shadow Forces, or so says $npc:11000015$. It is of vital importance to remove the head from the Shadow Force's body. In order to accomplish this, it is primal that all of Maple World's Defenders and heroes trust and rely on one another. Let's return to $map:02000146$ and deliver the message of $npc:11000015$ to $npc:11000007$.

quest.name: 책 벌레, 아폴로
quest.desc: $npc:11000033$$pp:는,은$ [$item:39000011$] 책이 없어졌다고 말하며 $npc:11000604$$pp:가,이가$ 가지고 갔을 거라고 짐작하며 책을 돌려받아 가지고 오라고 말한다. $map:02000023$의 $map:02000109$에서 $npc:11000604$$pp:를,을$ 찾아보자.
$npc:11000033$ says the book [$item:39000011$] has disappeared, guesses that $npc:11000604$ took it, and tells you to get it back. Look for $npc:11000604$ in $map:02000109$ in $map:02000023$.

quest.name: Apollo the Bookworm
quest.desc:
$npc:11000033$ believes that $npc:11000604$ has taken his book, [$item:39000011$], and requested that you retrieve it.
Search for $npc:11000604$ at $map:02000023$'s $map:02000109$.

quest.name: 독이 든 발톱
quest.desc: $npc:11000604$$pp:는,은$ $item:39000011$에 나와있는 내용 중 $npc:22000038$에 대한 내용이 진짜인지 확인해 보고 싶다며, $map:02000089$$pp2:로,으로$ 가서 $item:30000189$$pp:를,을$ 구해 오라고 한다.
$npc:11000604$ says they want to check whether the part about $npc:22000038$ in $item:39000011$ is true, and tells you to go to $map:02000089$ and bring back $item:30000189$.

quest.name: Claws-on Research
quest.desc:
$npc:11000604$ is willing to return $item:39000011$'s in exchange for some help with some hands-on-research.
All you need to do is harvest a $item:30000189$ from a $npc:22000038$ in $map:02000089$.

quest.name: 엘리니아의 괴수
quest.desc: $npc:11000604$$pp:는,은$ 책을 마저 다 읽을 시간을 벌기 위해 일부러 $item:30000189$$pp:를,을$ 구해 오라고 한 것이었다며 약을 올렸다. $npc:11000604$$pp:가,이$ 얄밉기는 하지만 $item:39000011$$pp:를,을$ 기다리고 있을 $npc:11000033$$pp:를,을$ 생각하면 잘잘못을 따질 시간이 없다. $npc:11000604$에게서 $item:30000189$$pp:를,을$ 받아서 $map:02000023$$pp2:로,으로$ 돌아가자.

quest.name: Ellinia's Monster
quest.desc: It turns out that $npc:11000604$ only sent you off to find the $item:30000189$ to buy time to read his book. Well, there's no sense getting upset now. $npc:11000033$ waiting in $map:02000023$ for you to return his copy of $item:39000011$.

$npc:11000604$ teases you, saying they deliberately asked you to bring $item:30000189$ to buy time to finish reading the book. $npc:11000604$ is annoying, but when you think of $npc:11000033$ waiting for $item:39000011$, there is no time to argue over right and wrong. Receive $item:30000189$ from $npc:11000604$ and return to $map:02000023$.

quest.name: 던전 : 마지막 기록
quest.desc:
$dungeonTitle:20010001$ (입구 맵 : $map:02000067$) 파티권장 (4명) 노멀 모드에서만 퀘스트 수행이 가능합니다.
$npc:11000995$에게 실종된 빅토리아호의 선장은 아버지나 다름없는 분이라고 한다. 깊은 바다 한 가운데에서 흔적도 없이 사라져 버린 가족을 찾는 심정으로 $npc:11000995$$pp:는,은$ 빅토리아호 실종 사건의 진상을 밝히고 싶어하는 것 같다. 실종된 빅토리아호 선장과 똑같은 이름으로 스스로를 지칭하는 $npc:23100015$!! 과연 그 실체는 무엇일지, 그 녀석이 정말 $item:39000032$$pp:를,을$ 가지고 있는지 확인해 보자.

$dungeonTitle:20010001$ (Entrance Map: $map:02000067$) Party Recommended (4 players) This quest can only be completed in Normal Mode.
To $npc:11000995$, the missing captain of the Victoria is like a father. As someone searching for family who vanished without a trace in the middle of the deep sea, $npc:11000995$ seems to want to uncover the truth behind the Victoria's disappearance. $npc:23100015$ calls itself by the same name as the missing captain of the Victoria! What is its true identity? Check whether it really has $item:39000032$.

quest.name: Dungeon: Captain's Log
quest.desc:
$dungeonTitle:20010001$ Entrance: $map:02000067$ Party Size: 4 players This quest is only available on normal difficulty.
$npcName:11000995$ wants to unravel the truth of what happened to the Victoria. His investigation has revealed that the leader of the undead pirates goes by the same name as the captain of the lost ship! He wants you to find out the truth about this so-called $npc:23100015$ as well as to retrieve $item:39000032$.

quest.name: Emergency Summons
quest.desc: $npc:11000012$ of $map:02000001$, without saying hello, informed me that $npc:11000119$ is looking for me and that I should hurry. What could be happening? Let's go see $npc:11000119$.

quest.name: Forest Protection
quest.desc: $npc:11000119$ ordered me to $map:02000023$ to help $npc:11000031$. So, let's meet $npc:11000031$ in $map:02000023$.
quest.manual: Help $npc:11000031$ and complete the story [Light of the Forest]

quest.name: Life-Bearing Earth
quest.desc: $npc:11000119$ ordered me to $map:02000076$ to help $npc:11000001$. So, let's meet $npc:11000001$ in $map:02000076$.
quest.manual: Help $npc:11000001$ and complete the story [Earth's Strength]

quest.name: An Ocean that Swallowed the Darkness
quest.desc: $npc:11000119$ ordered me to $map:02000062$ to help $npc:11000019$. So, let's meet $npc:11000019$ in $map:02000062$.
quest.manual: Help $npc:11000019$ and complete the story [Shadow of the Ocean]

quest.name: Lost Time
quest.desc: $npc:11000119$ ordered me to $map:02000142$ to help $npc:11000869$. So, let's meet $npc:11000869$ in $map:02000142$.
quest.manual: Help $npc:11000869$ and complete the story [Shadow of Time]

quest.name: Find the Forest Spirit!
quest.desc: $npc:11000031$ says to defeat $npc:23000035$, $npc:23000017$, and $npc:23000047$, for they are absorbing all the $item:30000314$ which purifies the darkness and protects the forest. I must reclaim $item:30000314$.
quest.manual: (Boss) Defeat the giant monster at $map:02000023$ forest and reclaim $item:30000314$

quest.name: Dungeon: Forest of Lost Light
quest.desc:
