quest.name: Without a Choice
quest.desc: $npcName:11000050$ strongly disagrees in assisting other troops who offer no help of their own. However, the Thief troop leader, Jonathan Button, has commanded that they go support the expedition. And so it appears they've no choice but to join the Starlight Expedition. Let's go to $map:02000023$ $map:02000035$ and deliver the news to $npcName:11000031$.

quest.name: Outside of Interest
quest.desc: $npcName:11000051$ says there is an emergency at the palace and to get to $map:52000026$ immediately. $npc:11000051$ seems irritated and hopes it's not all a waste of time... The entrance to $map:52000026$ can be found by the $map:02000119$ entrance, northwest of $map:02000001$, toward the top part of the palace walls.
quest.manual: Enter $map:52000026$ through the $map:02000119$ palace wall, northwest of $map:02000001$, and observe the situation

quest.name: Interest Is Poison
quest.desc: It wasn't something the assassin was part of, says $npcName:11000051$. Nevertheless, $npcName:11000006$ asked what the emergency was about. $npcName:11000051$ requested I go to $map:02000208$ in $map:02000166$ and relay what happened at the banquet hall to $npcName:11000006$.
quest.complete: Speak with $npcName:11000006$ at $map:02000208$ located somewhere in $map:02000166$

quest.name: Individual Duty
quest.desc: $npcName:11000529$ shook his head nonchalantly at $npcName:11000051$'s words, and said an assassin just needs to do an assassin's job. $npc:11000529$ says I should help $npcName:11000051$, who was going to $map:52000027$ alone. A Humples member went undercover into Darkstar in order to reveal the link between $npc:11000065$ and $npcName:11000251$, but was caught and isolated in $map:52000027$. We must rescue him as well as acquire the evidence. Let's go to $map:52000027$ to help $npcName:11000051$ rescue the isolated Humples member.
quest.manual: Help $npcName:11000051$ at $map:52000027$ and secure the evidence

quest.name: A Courageous Act
quest.desc: $npcName:11000006$ says that $npcName:11000051$ took the Humples member and the Runeblader to the hospital. $npcName:11000006$ also says that the Humples member was able to stay alive before $npcName:11000051e$ got there because of the Runeblader. Touched by the courageous act of the Runeblader protecting one of his men, $npcName:11000006$ revealed that he will join the Starlight Expedition. $npcName:11000006$ says since $npcName:11000051$ left with the first group to $map:02000023$, I should hurry and go to $map:02000035$ of $map:02000023$ and meet with $npcName:11000031$.

quest.name: Rumors Spreading Through the Back Alleys
quest.desc: $npcName:11000515$ sensed something suspicious about the recent unrest in the back alleys. Upon investigating, they discovered that a secret gathering of faction leaders had taken place in $map:02000001$ by order of the Empress. Let's meet $npc:11000050$ at $map:02000188$ in $map:02000001$ to learn why the secret gathering was held.

quest.name: The Legendary Holy Temple
quest.desc: $npc:11000050$ tells me the story of how everyone joined forces to form the Starlight Expedition to stop the Rune Blader traitor $npcName:11001231$. The place they'll pursue $npcName:11001231$ is the Rune Sanctuary, where the ancient $npc:23000078$ is said to slumber! Let's go to $map:02000112$ and find the entrance to the Rune Sanctuary.
quest.complete: Find the entrance to the Rune Temple in $map:02000112$

quest.name: A Legend Washed In by the Rough Waves
quest.desc: $npcName:11000003$ says there are rumors of a secret gathering of faction leaders in $map:02000001$. Let's meet $npc:11000119$ in $map:02000001$ to find out why the secret gathering was held.

quest.name: The Veiled Sanctuary
quest.desc: $npc:11000119$ tells me the story of how everyone joined forces to form the Starlight Expedition to stop the Rune Blader traitor $npcName:11001231$. The place they'll pursue $npcName:11001231$ is the Rune Sanctuary, where the ancient $npc:23000078$ is said to slumber! Let's go to $map:02000112$ and find the entrance to the Rune Sanctuary.
quest.complete: Find the entrance to the Rune Temple in $map:02000112$

quest.desc: Blackstar Society members burst in while you are talking with $npcName:11001733$ in $map:52000044$! Can you shake them off and reach the garage safely?

After shaking off the organization members who chased you all the way to $map:52000044$, $npcName:11000779$ told you that the back-alley people are trapped in $map:52000045$. Take the vehicle parked at $map:52000044$ in $map:02000100$ and head to $map:52000045$!
quest.name: Searching for Them
quest.manual: Ride the vehicle parked in $map:52000044$ of $map:02000100$ and move to $map:52000045$

quest.desc: With a worried look, $npcName:11000779$ tells you about a secret passage that leads straight into $map:52000047$. Look around the entrance to $map:02000156$ from $map:02000138$ and find the door connected to the secret passage!
quest.manual: Find and enter $map:52000047$ from $map:02000138$ through the secret passage near the entrance to $map:02000156$

quest.desc: You entered $map:52000047$ through the secret passage near the entrance to $map:02000156$ in $map:02000138$ and met $npcName:11000251$! With a shameless face and not the slightest trace of guilt, he provokes you by saying the lives of the back-alley people do not matter. His brazenness makes your anger boil over.

A note that seems to have been sent by the mysterious friend who saved your life in $map:52000045$... Inside was a clue to the whereabouts of the back-alley people you had been searching for so desperately. Go to $map:02000275$ and investigate further.
$npcName:11000003$ greets you warmly, which feels unlike him. Does he know what is going on with me...?

$npcName:11000003$'s sharp advice seems to snap you back to your senses. Nothing will be solved if you only avoid things because they hurt or scare you. Return to $map:52000039$ in $map:03000145$ and face the real truth.
quest.manual: Return to $map:52000039$ in $map:03000145$ and confirm the truth

quest.desc: Whenever you lose consciousness, that mysterious person you met in a place you cannot tell is dream or reality seems to have pushed you out of Beyond Link. But you cannot give up now. You have to find out who that person is, and who you are. Go back to $map:52000039$ in $map:03000145$.
quest.manual: Return to $map:03000145$ and investigate the Beyond Link again

quest.desc: You caught a fleeting glimpse of $npc:11001556$ in $map:52000040$... Follow those traces and enter the Beyond Link capsule.
quest.manual: Follow the truth through the Beyond Capsule in $map:52000040$

quest.desc: When you met $npcName:11001557$ again in $map:52000049$, they said they would accept you back as a member of the Guidance. Go with $npcName:11001557$ to the Guidance's new hideout, $map:52000050$.
quest.name: Returning Once More

quest.desc: You met $npcName:11001558$ again at the Guidance's newly prepared temporary hideout, $map:52000050$, in $map:02000101$! Quite some time has passed, but they have not changed.

Through the birds that flew into $map:52000050$, you learned that the entrance to the final destination of the Munakra pilgrimage is located in $map:02000192$. This is a chance to find the sacred relic and repay at least a little of the debt you owe the Guidance. Follow $npcName:11001557$ and $npcName:11001558$ to $map:02000192$.
quest.name: Searching for the Sanctuary
quest.complete: Find the entrance to the Guide's Sanctuary in $map:02000192$

quest.desc: It looks like you found the entrance to the Guide's Sanctuary in $map:02000192$. You think you can hear the voices of $npcName:11001558$ and $npcName:11001557$ from inside... Go in!
quest.complete: Talk to $npcName:11001556$ in $map:52000053$, located in the deepest part of the Guide's Sanctuary
quest.manual: Explore the Guide's Sanctuary and find the divine artifact
Find and examine the glowing stone in $map:52000050$ in $map:02000101$
quest.complete: Examine the Animar energy in $map:52000050$ in $map:02000101$
quest.desc: When you reunited with $npc:11001556$ in $map:52000053$, they told you to recover your strength in $map:52000050$ and moved you there together with $npcName:11001557$ and $npcName:11001558$. They said examining the glowing stone here would reveal what to do next...

Before leaving for $map:02000275$ according to destiny's revelation, you should tell the mysterious stranger you met in $map:52000045$ what happened to the people taken away by $npcName:11001559$'s subordinates. Ask the birds chirping in $map:52000050$ for help.

quest.name: Boroboro Rescue Diary
quest.desc: $npcName:11000424$ from $map:02000100$ says she keeps hearing what might be a hallucination — a young child crying from somewhere far away. Could it be because of her grief-stricken heart after losing her granddaughter?... Who is the one whose cries are reaching the old woman's ears? Let's follow wherever the sound of crying leads.

quest.name: Returning to Nature
quest.desc: $npcName:11000233$ in $map:02000100$ grimaces at the foul smell emanating from $dungeonTitle:25001001$ in $map:02000167$. What on earth has happened to the once-beautiful garden?

quest.name: A Deal in the Dark
quest.desc: $npc:11000623$, who runs a shop in $map:02000203$, says rampant stolen goods trading is disrupting the market. They ask me to go to $dungeonTitle:21005001$, a known hotspot for such trade, and find out if the rumors are true.
quest.manual: Enter and clear up to floor 5 of the $dungeonTitle:21005001$ dungeon

quest.name: Wings of Freedom
quest.desc: $npc:11000007$, supporting the Guardian Force in $map:02000146$, looks troubled and explains that all the chickens at $npcName:11001835$'s poultry farm have gone missing. Unable to leave their post, they ask me to go to $map:02000087$ and help $npcName:11001835$ in their place.

quest.name: The Ferocious Guard
quest.desc: $npcName:11000009$, a Guardian operative in $map:02000146$, shares disturbing rumors coming from $map:02000023$ and urges you to defeat the brutal guard $npc:23000039$ terrorizing the fairies of $map:02000023$.

quest.name: Dangerous Hide and Seek
quest.desc: $npc:11000007$, supporting the Guardian Force in $map:02000146$, tells me that children who were playing in the $map:02000023$ forest haven't come home for over half a day. They ask me to go to $dungeonTitle:25004001$ and find the children to safely send them home.
quest.complete: Speak with $npc:11001887$ at the end of the $dungeonTitle:25004001$ dungeon

quest.name: Revealed Identity
quest.desc: A member of the Red Cape has infiltrated $map:02000025$ and kidnapped $npc:11000074$. There is no time to wait for the Royal Guard to be summoned, for $npc:11000074$'s life may be in danger. Let's hurry to $dungeonTitle:21004001$ and rescue the minister.

quest.name: Protect the Barrier of Life
quest.desc: $npc:11000031$ at $map:02000023$ $map:02000035$ intuits that the barrier of life is in danger from the dark energy coming from the east part of the forest. Let's go to $dungeonTitle:21002001$, located deep in the $map:02000023$ eastern forest, and cleanse the darkness!
quest.complete: Follow the open road at $map:02000066$, go inside $map:02000179$, and speak with $npcName:11000032$

quest.name: Honest Logs
quest.desc: $npc:11000136$ of $map:02000051$, having shared that an eagle from distant seas came and delivered news of ghost pirates, expressed curiosity in regards to the secret logs that could potentially reveal the identity of the pirate captain.
quest.manual: Defeat $npc:23000015$ in the $dungeonTitle:20010001$ dungeon and acquire $item:39000032$

quest.name: The Secret of the Clocktower
quest.desc: $npc:11000039$, having a memorial service in $map:02000049$, said that an ominous energy was felt from the northwest skies, and that I should observe it before something bad occurs.

quest.name: Real Friendship
quest.desc: $npcName:11000044$ says to go find Katramus, whom $npcName:11000006$$ mentioned, and bring back every clue that could help find Lennon or Eve.

quest.name: End of a Long Parting
quest.desc: Join $npcName:11000006$ in the $dungeonTitle:21017001$ slave rescue.

quest.name: Turn Back Time!
quest.desc: $npc:11000003$ of $map:02000001$, sharing the story of the $map:02000309$ robbery incident, said with confidence that the culprit who stole the time key had to have gone to $dungeonTitle:21008001$. Could $npc:11000003$'s assumption be right? Let's go to $dungeonTitle:21008001$ and check it out.

quest.name: To the Highlands
quest.desc:
The forces of darkness have set their sights on the Seven Heroes. The only two who remain in the public eye are $npc:11000134$ and $npcName:11000601$. It's up to you and Allon to keep them safe from the so-called "ragged wraith."
Head to $map:02000051$ and protect $npcName:11000134$.

quest.name: The Warrior's Test
quest.desc: $npcName:11003421$ refuses to let you into $map:02000051$ without passing his test. Go to $map:02000010$ and vanquish the $npcNamePlural:21090102$ and $npcNamePlural:21000088$.

quest.name: After the Attack
quest.desc:
$npcName:11000134$ joined the war party that's tracking down the mysterious figure in rags who attacked town. Meet with the town shaman, $npcName:11000039$, and warn her of the danger.
If you leave by mistake, talk to $npcName:11000289$ in $map:02000051$ to return to $map:52010033$.

quest.name: Wolf Girl
quest.desc: $npcName:11000039$ is off looking for medicine to treat all the wounded. She's left $npcName:11000136$ behind to watch the hospital in the meantime, but it seems like she has something to ask you…

quest.name: Shells of Wellness
quest.desc:
The shell of $npcName:21000267$ can be used as a medicine to treat the injured. These critters like to live near the lava flows in places like $map:02000010$.
Gather some for $npcName:11000136$. It's not like you have more pressing business.

quest.name: Honorary Doctor
quest.desc: $npcName:11000136$ wants you to use her medicine to treat the injured. You're not a doctor, but what have you got to lose?

quest.name: Perion Persistence
quest.desc: You've finally found a responsible adult. Tell $npcName:11000039$ about your business in $map:02000051$.

quest.name: The Missing Warriors
quest.desc: $npcName:11003422$ says that the war party was ambushed. You should look for more survivors.

quest.name: The Casualty
quest.desc: You found $npcName:11003423$ from the war party, but she's badly hurt. Find something nearby that you can use to treat her wounds.

quest.name: Path of War
quest.desc: In spite of your best efforts, $npcName:11003423$ was too wounded to save. Before she passed away, she said that the war party was headed for the $map:02000048$.

quest.name: The Interlopers
quest.desc: You met $npcName:11000541$ at the $map:02000048$. She seems to know something about the war party, but she refuses to say anything until someone does something about the $npcNamePlural:21000065$, $npcNamePlural:21090082$, and $npcNamePlural:21091082$.

quest.name: End of the Chase
quest.desc: The war party should still be at $map:02000046$. But they were ambushed, and now monsters are closing in on the area. You need to find $npcName:11000134$ before something happens to him.
quest.complete: Search for $npcName:11000134$ at the top of $map:02000046$

quest.name: Burning Clue
quest.desc: $npcName:11000134$'s trail ends at the top of $map:02000046$. Where did $npcName:11000134$ and $npcName:11000009$ vanish to? It seems the nearby torches have been lit recently. Perhaps you should see what happens when you relight them.
quest.manual: Light the first torch |Light the second torch |Light the third torch |Light the fourth torch
quest.complete: Search the hidden temple at the top of $map:02000046$

quest.name: Inside the Hourglass
quest.desc:
You found the entrance to a hidden temple at the top of $map:02000046$. There's a good chance that $npcName:11000134$ and $npcName:11000009$ are inside.
If you leave by mistake, examine the $npc:11003430$ in $map:02000046$ to return.

quest.name: Son of the Chief
quest.desc: $npcName:11000134$ attacked his own son, $npcName:11000009$. What could have caused him to do so? Since both father and son are unconscious, talk to $npcName:11000009$ in $map:52010033$.

quest.name: The Mysterious Woman
quest.desc:
$npcName:11000009$ isn't sure what happened to $npcName:11000134$. The so-called ragged wraith seems to be involved, along with a mysterious woman.
If $npcName:11000134$'s mind is being controlled, who is doing it... and how?

quest.name: Returned from Darkness
quest.desc: $npcName:11000039$ seems especially distressed after hearing what $npcName:11000009$ had to say. She's asked you to meet her in $map:52010034$.

quest.name: A Secret Treatment
quest.desc: $npcName:11000039$ is convinced that the attack on Perion was led by the Inakimo, a tribe that vanished into the Land of Darkness a generation ago. She's seen their magic before, and she thinks she knows how to treat $npcName:11000134$'s illness. Gather $item:30000864$ from $map:02000095$.

quest.name: The Sleepy Witch
quest.desc: $npcName:11000039$'s medicine will stop $npcName:11000134$ from getting any worse, but it's not a true cure. $npcName:11000746$, the witch of the $map:02000103$ in Ellinia, knows many rituals to purify dark magic. Seek her out.

quest.name: A Divine Being
quest.desc: The ritual to cure the war chief requires pure, divine energy—and, as a witch, $npcName:11000746$ doesn't have access to that kind of energy. However, the unicorns of $map:02000053$ may be able to help.

quest.name: Unicorn Rescue Party
quest.desc: $npcName:11000027$, the unicorn you met in $map:02000053$, is in dire need of your help. All of his unicorn friends have been transformed by dark magic. You'll need those unicorns' help if you're going to save $npcName:11000134$…
quest.manual: Purify the $npcNamePlural:21000109$ by beating them up

quest.name: Aura of Light
quest.desc: $npcName:11000027$ and his friends have granted you the aura of light you need to save $npcName:11000134$. Return to $npc:11000039$ in $map:52010032$.

quest.name: The Light of Hope
quest.desc: The ritual successfully purified $npcName:11000134$ of darkness, but…

quest.name: The Guardian of Perion
quest.desc:
Even though the purification ritual was successful, the curse on $npcName:11000134$ returned moments later. $npc:11000039$ suspects that the Inakimo have found a way to corrupt $npcName:11003392$, a guardian golem who shares a magical bond with the war chiefs of $map:02000051$.
$npcName:11003391$ was sent to scout out $map:52010029$ and never returned. Go there and save both him and $npcName:11003392$ from the Inakimo's clutches!
quest.manual: Go to the $map:52010029$ via $map:52010031$, then save $npcName:11003392$ and $npcName:11003391$

quest.name: Perion's Coldest Heart
quest.desc: You had a... falling out with $npcName:11003391$ in $map:52010029$. How are you going to win him back over to your side?

quest.name: A Quick Apology
quest.desc:
Nothing says "I'm sorry" like a gift that you obtained for free. Give some incense to $npcName:11003391$ so that he forgives you for your earlier disagreement.
$npcName:11000289$ should be able to get you to $npc:11003391$'s house.

quest.name: House Visit
quest.desc:
$npcName:11000289$ says that $npcName:11003391$ looks depressed. Go to $npcName:11003391$'s house in $map:52010027$ and leave your gift.
If you leave by mistake, talk to $npcName:11000289$ in $map:02000051$ to return.

quest.name: A Gift Left Behind
quest.desc: You just missed $npcName:11003391$. Break into his house and leave your apology gift for him to find later.

quest.name: A Bad Turn
quest.desc: There's something happening outside. You're certain you hear screaming. Go outside to $map:52010027$ and see what's happening.

quest.name: Suspect Victory
quest.desc:
You encountered $npcName:11003431$, chief of the Inakimo, in $map:52010027$. But where has he vanished to? And who is this viper he mentioned?
For now, hurry back to $map:02000051$.

quest.name: An Unexpected Raid
quest.desc:
You've returned to $map:02000051$ to find it under attack by the Inakimo. It seems that $npcName:11003431$ was a diversion...
$npcName:11000289$ will get the civilians to safety. You need to get to $map:52010031$ to join forces with $npcName:11000078$ and $npcName:11000009$.

quest.name: Save the Guardian
quest.desc:
$map:02000051$ won't be able to survive another attack if the Inakimo manage to take control of $npcName:11003392$'s golems. While $npcName:11000078$ and $npcName:11000009$ fight off the main Inakimo force, you need to sneak off to $map:02000313$ and save $npcName:11003392$ from its captivity.
Use the secret passage to get there.

quest.name: The War Chief's Mission
quest.desc: Go to $map:02000313$ through the $npcName:11003468$ in $map:52010031$ and rescue $npcName:11003392$ from the Inakimo.

quest.name: Looking Forward
quest.desc: After a long battle, $npcName:11000134$, $npcName:11000078$, and $npcName:11003392$ fell to protect $map:02000051$. $npcName:11000039$ blames herself for not doing enough to save them.

quest.name: A New Chief for a New Age
quest.desc: The new war chief of $map:02000051$, $npcName:11003457$, has pledged to support the battle against the darkness.

$npcName:11004577$ says you can finally explore beyond $map:02020036$.
What lies beyond $map:02020036$?
Hurry to $map:02020036$ and find out.

You felt awkward after everyone pointed to you as the ideal expedition member, but you decided to move beyond $map:02020036$ to meet their expectations.
$npcName:11004582$ asks you to investigate $map:02020066$, discovered during the first expedition...
Head out to investigate $map:02020066$ and defeat the obstructing Kerbes forces.

$npcName:11004571$ is surprised to hear that you crossed $map:02020036$. They are surprised again when you say you defeated Kerbes on the way.
When you ask about this place, $npcName:11004571$ tells you to find the leader, $npcName:11004574$. But they warn you not to mention Georg to $npcName:11004574$. Why would that be?
For now, meet $npcTitle:11004574$.

You tried to meet the refugee leader and explain the situation, but after hearing the word Georg, $npcName:11004574$ shows strong hostility.
$npcName:11004574$ asks what Georg ever did for them while the Black Legion appeared and trapped them. You argue that Georg also had difficulty fighting on two fronts, but $npcName:11004574$ will not listen.
This will not do. You need to help the refugees to change $npcName:11004574$'s mind.

$npcName:11004574$ finally opens up.
When you say you want to know more about this place, they say there is someone better suited than them and tell you that $npcTitle:11004576$, who knows all the rumors around here, exists. They even write you a recommendation letter, perhaps feeling sorry about everything so far.
Take the recommendation letter and go see $npcTitle:11004576$.

As expected, $npcTitle:11004576$ knows everything!
After a brief conversation, $npcTitle:11004576$ realizes that you are looking for $npcName:11004430$ and demands payment.
When you look at them pitifully, $npc:11004576$ says they will accept an item instead of an information fee.
Bring the $item:30001349$ they want.
quest.name: How to Pay the Price

quest.desc:
$npc:11004576$ says many materials have recently been transported to $map:02020067$.
They say their intuition tells them something is being built in $map:02020067$.
Trust their instinct and go to $map:02020067$ to check whether anything suspicious is there.

The facility looks very suspicious, but you still do not know what it really is, so it is hard to respond.
If only you had more information...
For now, return to $npcTitle:11004576$ and ask if they know anything else.
quest.name: A New Place, a Welcome Encounter

quest.desc:
$npcName:11004576$ says the facility is connected to the Tyren Kingdom's latest weapon, Archeon. $npcName:11004576$ says Archeon is extremely powerful and would be dangerous if it fell into $npcName:11004430$'s hands.
When you try to rush there immediately, they say facing it bare-handed would be impossible and suggest another way.
$npcName:11004576$ says that if you go to $map:02020035$ and secure the blueprint, you should be able to learn how to control Archeon.
Go secure the blueprint right now.

To secure the blueprint, you need to enter the factory, but the entrance seems to be hidden.
$npcName:11004580$ and $npcName:11004579$ said hacking is the answer at times like this... Should you try it?

The guide robot inside the factory tells you that Archeon's blueprint can be found in the innermost area.
However, it says that to move deeper inside, the security facility must be shut down...
There is no other obvious method for now, so head inside.
quest.name: Security System Activated

quest.desc:
You met $npcName:11004584$ and handed over the blueprint, but they stubbornly insisted they did not need it.
Before leaving to defeat Archeon, you suggested going together, but $npcName:11004584$ flatly refused. When you persuaded them again by saying they still do not know this place well, they finally changed their mind and promised to come along.
All that remains now is to defeat Archeon.

$npc:11004577$ says they discovered that $npcName:11004430$ is commanding the Black Legion from $map:02020071$, beyond $map:02020070$. However, an unidentified energy source was found at the gateway leading to $map:02020071$, making them hesitate to advance.
For everyone's sake, you need to see what that energy source is with your own eyes.
$npcName:11004584$ wanted to come with you, but since they still do not seem to know much about Kritias, you asked $npcName:11004582$ to guide you.
$npcName:11004582$ seemed very grateful, but why? You are curious, but first you need to check the energy source and defeat the monsters in your way.

While you were defeating the obstructing monsters, you suddenly felt a huge tremor.
What could this shaking be?

After seeing the photo taken in $map:02020070$, $npcName:11004582$ says the unidentified energy source is $npcName:11004684$, a weapon that once protected the Tyren Kingdom.
$npcName:11004582$ explains that it was an excellent weapon guarding the front of the kingdom, but after repeated learning it developed a sense of self and was abandoned by $npcName:11004575$.
Listen to more of her story.

$npcName:11004582$ says you may need to consider retreating, but after coming this far, you cannot back down.
You must stop $npcName:11004684$ and enter $map:02020071$.

$npcName:11004684$ always surrounds itself with a barrier for protection, but the barrier is said to disappear before royalty.
$npcName:11004582$ says she will help you defeat $npcName:11004684$. But $npcName:11004583$ strongly objects.
Instead, $npcName:11004583$ suggests making an Ener disruption device to deceive $npcName:11004684$. The problem is that there is no way to obtain $item:30001350$, the material needed to make the Ener disruption device...
$npcName:11004583$ says refugees who were driven out of the Tyren Kingdom not long ago might have $item:30001350$. For now, go see $npcName:11004574$.

$npcName:11004574$ says the refugees do not have the material, but the Tyren Kingdom soldiers in $map:02020066$ should have $item:30001350$.
Teach the Tyren soldiers watching the refugees a lesson, and get the material while you are at it.

All right, everything is ready now.
Go defeat $npcName:11004684$!

You finally arrived at $map:02020071$.
The moment you decided to charge inside, you felt an ominous energy.
What is this energy?

$npcName:11004577$ says $npcName:11004430$'s sudden appearance is confusing, but you should focus on what matters first. That means capturing $npcName:11004430$.
$npcName:11004577$ suggests splitting the assault route in two.
With an important battle ahead, you should prepare thoroughly.

At last, all preparations are complete.
Now it is time to end your long, ill-fated bond with $npcName:11004430$.

There is nothing to fear when everyone is together.
The time has come to defeat $npcName:11004430$.

The shocking truth that $npcName:11004430$ was a robot, and the Tyren Kingdom forces that suddenly stormed in.
It was a crisis, but thanks to $npcName:11004603$'s dramatic appearance, everyone survived.
What has $npcName:11004603$ been doing since parting ways with us?
Listen to the full explanation.

$npcName:11004430$ was a clone created by $npcName:11004575$ to break the seal on Kritias.
Everyone was left speechless by the shocking truth that $npcName:11004430$, one of $npcName:11004613$'s Seven Captains who had tormented Maple World for so long, was a robot born in Kritias.
But you cannot just stand there stunned. Even in this situation, there must be something you can do.

$npcName:11004609$ says they prepared a small gift to thank you for helping drive the Black Legion from this land.
What could the gift be?
You should ask right away.

$npcName:11004609$'s gift was a letter declaring a friendly alliance between Georg and the Maple Alliance.
$npcName:11004604$ says the letter should be delivered to Empress $npcName:11004390$.
At last, it is time to return to Maple World.

Life in Kritias was very difficult, but it was also precious time that let you meet $npcName:11004609$ and $npcName:11004603$.
$npcName:11004390$ says she is proud of everyone who endured it.
Now it is time to run toward a new goal.

How much does $npcName:11004613$ really know about what happened in Kritias?
Did he know that $npcName:11004430$ was a robot? How will he react to $npcName:11004430$'s death?
You wonder what $npcName:11004613$ is thinking right now.

$npcName:11004520$ is the pilot in charge of the airship to $map:02020041$...
What could be going on? If this is about what happened in Kritias, how much can you tell them?
Ever since you began adventuring in Maple World, nothing good has happened when someone called for you. Could this time be an exception?

Fortunately, it does not seem to be anything serious. $npcName:11000169$ is a Royal Guard member standing watch in $map:02000001$, so what could possibly be so serious?
As $npcName:11004520$ said, you can just tell them not to worry and to go for it.

A dark blue light...? Whatever the case may be elsewhere, $map:02000001$ is home to the palace and the Royal Guard. That means it is not a place an outside threat could infiltrate.
If the guard told you instead of reporting to a superior, it may be because they saw something incorrectly... But what is this ominous feeling?

You looked through the telescope, but could not find anything. There was no dark blue light like $npcName:11000169$ mentioned, only $map:02000001$, peaceful as always.
$npcName:11000318$ may be right. If something had happened here, the people's rumors might already know about it.

Every banner hanging in $map:02000001$ bears these words: All light comes from the Empress.
Rumors about a dark blue light in $map:02000001$ could easily become an insult to the Empress. You need to determine the truth behind the rumors.

Something appeared? What could possibly appear in $map:02000001$? Too many people are talking about it to simply say $npc:11000607$ has lost their mind.
This time, you must see what it really is.

You encountered dark matter. The thing everyone was talking about truly existed in $map:02000001$.
All light comes from the Empress. So what does this darkness appearing here, in the palace of the Empress of Light, mean?
quest.manual: Go to the front of the armory in $map:02000001$ where $npcName:11000169$ is
quest.complete: Go to the front of the armory in $map:02000001$ where $npcName:11000169$ is

quest.desc:
The time is coming...? $npc:11004778$'s reaction only heightens your unease.
$npc:11004778$'s office is not a place for idle chatter. Being told to go there surely means there is a serious matter in the palace.

Meanwhile, at the same time in $map:52000193$, $npc:11000075$ was also anxiously worrying about the dark blue light. As the symbol of light and light itself, $npc:11000075$ could not help but feel uneasy about the strange being that appeared in $map:02000001$.
Even if no one said it openly, the people of the royal court must at least have sensed that the strange form appearing in $map:02000001$ was connected to the safety of $npcName:11000075$ $npcTitle:11000075$, or perhaps the safety of Maple World.

Everyone in the palace is trembling with anxiety because of $npc:11004727$, which appeared in $map:02000001$. In particular, $npc:11004782$ was reassuring the Empress, but seemed more worried about the situation than anyone else.
What does $npc:11004778$ think about this?

$npc:11004778$ spoke of one who was once one of the Seven Heroes, but is now stained by darkness.
$npc:11004744$, a companion of the great hero $npc:11001812$ and one of the Seven Heroes. They said he is imprisoned in $map:52000189$.
Why is he imprisoned in a place meant to hold criminals and traitors?

You were asked to execute $npcName:11004744$. $npc:11004778$ calls $npcName:11004744$ a traitor.
But it is hard to imagine executing a hero who was once called the Mage of Light and helped the Empress. Even if $npc:11004778$ asked you to…

You answered $npc:11004778$'s request by saying you would try for the sake of $map:02000001$, but you are still confused. Is it really right for you to execute $npcName:11004744$?
Set your confusion aside, find the key, and go to $map:52000189$ in $map:02000001$. If you meet $npc:11004744$, perhaps you can find a clue like a ray of light in this confusion. Or maybe it would be right to kill him according to $npc:11004778$'s order.
quest.complete: Find $npc:11004792$ on the lowest floor of $map:52000189$ in $map:02000001$

quest.desc:
$npcName:11004744$ is already radiating powerful energy here. $npc:11004778$ told you to kill him... Perhaps he overestimated you.
Can you face him?
quest.complete: Calmly talk with $npc:11004793$, who is trapped in $map:52000191$ on the lowest floor of $map:52000189$ in $map:02000001$

quest.desc:
Inside the powerful magical barrier, $npcName:11004744$ seems to have a lot to say. Even after long years of confinement, his eyes long for the truth.
If you must kill this person, bound and unable to do anything, it does not have to be right now. Somehow, you find yourself listening to his story.
quest.manual: Calmly talk with $npc:11004793$, who is trapped in $map:52000191$ on the lowest floor of $map:52000189$ in $map:02000001$
quest.complete: Calmly talk with $npc:11004793$, who is trapped in $map:52000191$ on the lowest floor of $map:52000189$ in $map:02000001$

quest.desc:
A traitor who became intoxicated by darkness and tried to harm the Empress, and who is creating dark matter in $map:52000189$ to frame her. That is the truth about $npcName:11004744$ that you heard from $npc:11004778$. But $npcName:11004744$ tells a different story.
A loyal servant who gave himself to end the war against darkness and went to the land of darkness to seal Lapenta. Or a traitor... What is the truth?
quest.manual: Calmly talk with $npc:11004793$, who is trapped in $map:52000191$ on the lowest floor of $map:52000189$ in $map:02000001$
quest.complete: Calmly talk with $npc:11004793$, who is trapped in $map:52000191$ on the lowest floor of $map:52000189$ in $map:02000001$

quest.desc:
$npcName:11004744$: traitor, or loyal servant. Since you do not know the truth, you need to find any clue you can.
His instruction to go to the Gate of Light tells you that his truth lies in the past. The truth may remain in the place he went to seal the darkness. Go to the former Gate of Light... the place now called $map:02000146$.
quest.manual: Look closely at $npc:11004803$ in the center of $map:02000146$|Listen closely to $npc:11004803$ in the center of $map:02000146$|Touch $npc:11004803$ in the center of $map:02000146$
quest.complete: Talk to $npcName:11004795$, who appeared in the center of $map:02000146$

quest.desc:
The reason you need to know the truth is not simple curiosity. You cannot execute $npcName:11004744$ just because $npc:11004778$ ordered it.
Taking someone's life carries that much weight. You must know the truth and choose. That is respect for death.
You must uncover the truth.
(If you leave the map, you can re-enter through $npcName:11004795$ in $map:02000146$)

You can sense that you are nearing the truth. The truth you heard from $npc:11004778$, or the truth you heard from $npcName:11004744$.
And here is another person speaking about the truth.
(If you leave the map, you can re-enter through $npcName:11004795$ in $map:02000146$)
quest.manual: Listen to $npcName:11004798$'s story to the end in $map:52000199$ <font color="#909090">If you leave the map, you can re-enter through $npcName:11004795$ in $map:02000146$</font>

quest.desc:
This confusion, which began with dark matter, traces back to the distant past.
$npc:11001812$ and $npcName:11003894$, who said they tried to seal Lapenta together with $npcName:11004744$, even at the cost of their lives. $npc:11004778$ says they are traitors who threaten the Empress's safety and are creating dark matter in $map:02000001$. But the stories told by $npc:11001812$ and $npcName:11004744$ had a certain consistency, and their eyes showed a solemn determination that seemed to speak the truth. $npc:11004778$ is a loyal prime minister who has protected Empress Ereve's safety in the palace for many years.
You should tell $npc:11004778$ about the two truths.
(If you leave the map, you can re-enter through $npcName:11004826$ in $map:52000189$ in $map:02000001$)

You should have considered that when faced with two truths that cannot coexist, you may become buried beneath the shadow of lies.
If the stories of the two people whose claims about the past differed from $npc:11004778$, namely $npc:11004778$ and $npcName:11004744$, were true, then you should have suspected $npc:11004778$, who tried to have $npcName:11004744$ killed.
When you told $npc:11004778$ what you had learned, fear flashed in his eyes.
Then he trapped you here. You have to escape.
(If you leave the map, you can re-enter through $npcName:11004826$ in $map:52000189$)

Many things you have believed until now are being shaken. As $npcName:11003894$ said, you must choose truth or lies.
And you gained a major clue. It was $npc:11004778$'s true face: the fear you saw in the eyes of someone hiding a lie.
Was the reason $npc:11004778$ tried to kill $npcName:11004744$ to hide the truth? You have to escape from here, but you cannot think of a way.
(If you leave the map, you can re-enter through $npcName:11004826$ in $map:52000189$)

While you were trapped alone in $map:52000190$, you saw the faint silhouette of someone wearing a hood. As the faint silhouette drew closer and removed the hood in front of you, you realized it was $npc:11000075$.
$npc:11000074$ was reporting a distorted truth to $npc:11000075$.
$npc:11000075$ had received a report that you were influenced by $npcName:11004788$, who had been consumed by the power of darkness, but she did not seem to fully believe it. She may have come personally to $map:52000198$ because she found $npcName:11004778$'s report suspicious.
While you were talking about what you had learned, smoke seemed to rise from somewhere, and soon flames began to surge.
(If you leave the map, you can re-enter through $npcName:11004826$ in $map:52000189$)

The flames are taking over the underground prison in an instant. You have to escape!
But if you escape like this, $npcName:11004744$... You cannot leave him behind.

When the flames had spread everywhere and you thought there was no longer any hope, $npc:11000075$ led you to $map:52000192$, said to be known only to the royal family. It would not be an exaggeration to say that royals have lived under threats to their safety since ancient times. You had heard that $map:52000192$ passages for escaping the palace had been built in various places, but to actually see one...

You barely escaped alive from the flames. Then $npc:11000075$ began questioning the conflicting truths. But everyone wants the truth as much as the Empress does.
The Empress called together everyone connected to this matter. Soon, everyone who can speak about the truth of the past will gather in $map:52000193$.
quest.manual: Search for clues $npc:11000074$ may have left behind in $map:02000190$ of $map:02000119$
quest.name: Searching for Clues

quest.desc:
A battle over the truth began among $npcName:11004780$, $npcName:11004787$, and $npcName:11000075$, who gathered in $map:52000193$. $npcName:11004780$ is definitely hiding something. Claiming the current situation is due to his indecision and that he should have executed $npcName:11004787$ sooner does not add up. Did he not order him killed in the first place?
Then the Empress said she knew $npc:11001812$ had completed Lapenta's seal at the cost of his life. She also knew that $npcName:11004744$, who was stained by darkness during the process, tried to harm the Empress. This is completely different from $npcName:11004787$'s claim. It all seems to have come from $npcName:11004780$.
$npcName:11004780$ clearly does not know that you have a clue: $item:30001480$, found in his house.
The Empress said she had not doubted $npcName:11004780$'s loyalty, but she seemed to be questioning him. Yet $npcName:11004780$ only spoke about his loyalty, and did not seem able to speak about the truth.

Between $npcName:11004780$, who insists on his loyalty, and $npcName:11004787$, who tells a different story, the truth seemed to fall into a maze.
The Empress may have wanted to give $npcName:11004780$ a chance to confess. But that chance ended, and $npcName:11004780$ was driven into danger. To think the words of the one who should have been more loyal to the royal family than anyone, and who should have protected it, were lies... With what heart does $npcName:11004780$ intend to bear the many incidents and truths caused by those lies?

The truth surrounding Lapenta's seal was revealed. $npcName:11004787$'s claim was true. $npcName:11004780$ may truly have made that choice to protect the Empress. But protecting someone should not mean letting them seek safety while deceived by lies.
Empress $npcName:11004825$ felt extreme anger. It was not simply anger toward $npcName:11004780$, but deep, dark anger toward herself for being deceived by lies and betraying the heroes who had waited for her help with Lapenta's seal... and toward her own helplessness for failing to save the countless people who suffered because of the being born from it.
That anger was extraordinary. The power within the Empress exploded, and she lost consciousness. And then... $npcName:11004801$ appeared.

At first, this all began with a small rift. $npc:11004727$ appeared throughout $map:02000001$ and made people uneasy... The astonishing theory that they began from $npc:11000075$, the symbol of light. And now, $npc:11004801$ has appeared before your eyes. Does this mean you must now fear destruction caused by the Empress, who was the light of this world?

$npcName:11004787$ and $npcName:11004783$ worried about $npc:11004801$, which appeared the moment the Empress lost consciousness.
Beyond it lies a clue that could protect the peace of Maple World. But if you head there carelessly, it may be difficult to return. You could become lost inside $npc:11004801$, unable to find the way back forever.
quest.name: Searching for a Way

quest.desc:
$npcName:11004783$ and $npcName:11004789$ are gathering energy toward the rift in space-time. They are creating a way for you to return. Trust them, go beyond $npc:11004801$, and do whatever you can for Maple World's peace.
Somehow, you feel strong faith in them.

You crossed beyond $npc:11004801$. The things you meet here are definitely things you have seen before. But something is different. Just their presence makes the air feel heavy. You need to find out what this energy is.
(If you leave the map, you can re-enter through the central portal in $map:52000201$)

After battling the beings you encountered beyond $npc:11004801$ and returning to report to $npcName:11004787$ and $npcName:11004783$, they said strange fragments were attached to your body.
You had not noticed during the battle. Unknown crystal-like fragments were attached all over your armor.
What are these fragments from beyond the rift? $npcName:11004783$ said a chaotic wave of light was dancing within them. They seem to be a substance with considerable energy.

$npcName:11004783$ and $npcName:11004787$ seem to be continuing to guard $map:52000194$ so the unstable rift can remain stable.
They say the new substance you brought back from beyond the rift needs to be investigated in detail. Go to $map:02000487$ and hear more about this substance.
You met $npcName:11003883$ in $map:02000487$. Does she know about this substance? For now, this substance is the only clue that might save the fallen Empress.

$npcName:11003883$ told you to bring this substance to $map:52000196$, a space established separately to research it. It seems the substance from beyond $npcName:11004801$ is anything but ordinary.
That was expected. What secret is hidden within this substance?

$npcName:11004816$ in $map:52000196$ showed great interest in the substance brought back from $npcName:11004801$. They saw it as the perfect chance to prove the hypothesis they had developed.
To confirm the true nature of $item:40100055$'s power and the range it can influence, you must go beyond the rift again. To cover your whole body in that place's energy, soak yourself in the water at the center of $npcName:11004801$ and return.
quest.manual: Soak yourself in the mysterious water of $map:02000554$ and absorb plenty of its energy

quest.desc:
$npc:11004802$ says you can use the power of $item:40100055$ to perform Limit Breakthrough, and explains it.
By using $item:40100055$, you can break through the limits of a material and draw out power stronger than ordinary enchantment.
The only equipment that can undergo Limit Breakthrough is a weapon called Fire Prism, which can be collected from the Illusory Dungeons, and it must be enchanted to stage 15 or higher.
The monsters that appear in the Illusory Dungeons connected to $npcName:11004801$ are illusions of monsters you have met before, but since they have grown stronger beyond your own growth, you must keep challenging them.
$item:40100055$ and $item:40100056$ can be collected by dismantling Fire Prism equipment, so you must steadily challenge the Illusory Dungeons for Limit Breakthrough.
This is all that can be known for now, but it would be best to keep challenging yourself, build your strength, and prepare for whatever else may come. To prepare for another crisis that will come someday...

$npcName:11004793$ calls you, saying the power of the rift has grown even stronger. What on earth happened?
You should meet $npcName:11004782$ in $map:52000201$.

You rushed to $map:52000201$ after $npcName:11004793$ called you. The energy pouring out of $map:52000202$ at the center was clearly different from before. And sometimes, orbs are said to be flung out from there...
According to $npcName:11004828$, when they broke an orb, they found something surprising... New equipment!

$npcName:11004828$ says that if it is scattering things like this outside, it must be trying to lure you in. They say you should enter the rift once more and confirm the truth.
After entering the rift and checking near the center, something unexpected happens...!

The black mass you met inside the rift vanished after saying it would give you something good if you played with it. It just said what it wanted and disappeared...?
When you return to the bedroom and explain what happened in the rift to $npcName:11004828$, they look as if they understand something and tell you to spend time with that thing regularly...

If it means getting stronger, there is nothing you will not do! Whether it is a black mass, a blue mass, or anyone else, you will play with them from now on.
Meanwhile, $npcName:11001812$…

quest.name: Happy Little Trees
quest.desc: Hurum would be so much happier with friends. You should find some red trees south of $npc:11000386$ and replant them in $map:02000041$.
quest.manual: Find the red trees located south of $npc:11000386$ and replant them

quest.desc: For $npc:11000386$ in $map:02000041$, transplant the red trees south of $npc:11000386$.
quest.name: Even Trees Need Friends
몰카 촬영?
quest.desc: $map:02000137$에서 만난 사생팬 $npc:11000387$$pp:를,을$ 위해 $npc:11000406$의 사진을 촬영하자. 공연장 왼쪽 구조물에 올라가 촬영하면 된다.
quest.manual: $npc:11000387$에게 $item:30000109$ 받기|공연장 왼쪽 구조물에 올라가서 $npc:11000406$ 사진 다각도 촬영하기

quest.name: Clandestine Photo Shoot
quest.desc:
$npc:11000387$ is desperate for photos of $npcName:11000406$, the celebrity currently visiting $map:02000137$.
Sure, it may seem odd, but it's a victim-less crime. Help a lovesick girl out and take some photos with her totally inconspicuous $item:30000109$.
quest.manual: Get the $item:30000109$ from $npc:11000387$|Take photos of $npc:11000406$ from the structure near the stage

quest.desc: For the obsessed fan $npc:11000387$ you met in $map:02000137$, take a photo of $npc:11000406$. Climb the structure to the left of the performance hall and take the photo.
quest.manual: Receive $item:30000109$ from $npc:11000387$|Climb onto the structure on the left side of the performance hall and take photos of $npc:11000406$ from multiple angles

quest.name: Balloon Grabber
quest.desc: Let's retrieve the balloon over the tree above the portal to get to $map:02000116$. $npc:11000389$, who sells balloons in $map:02000115$, wants it.
quest.manual: Use rock climbing skills to retrieve the balloon from the tree above the $map:02000116$ portal

quest.name: Apple Commotion
quest.desc: Let's go pick the apples from the apple tree located on the road to $map:02000116$ from $map:02000115$.
quest.manual: Bring back $item:30000128$ from the apple tree in $map:02000115$

quest.name: Into the Woods
quest.desc: Let's deliver the packed lunch to $npc:11000128$ in $map:02000116$.

quest.name: 아티스트 vs 아티스트
quest.desc: $map:02000110$ 곳곳에 있는 버섯이 그려진 그래피티를 지우자.

quest.name: Artist vs. Artiste
quest.desc: Time to erase the ugly mushroom graffiti all over $map:02000110$. It's pretty unsightly, really. Who'd want to stare at a fungus all day?
Erase the mushroom graffiti found throughout $map:02000110$.

quest.name: 예술적 복수
quest.desc: $map:02000086$에 있는 $npc:11000412$의 아지트 주변에 그래피티를 바꿔치기 하자.
Swap the graffiti around $npc:11000412$'s hideout in $map:02000086$.

quest.name: Artistic Vengeance
quest.desc: The best way to get rid of that terrible mushroom 'art' is to cover it over with something worth looking at. It'll be a piece of cake to replace the graffiti around $npc:11000412$'s hideout in $map:02000086$.
quest.manual: Replace the graffiti around $npc:11000412$'s house in $map:02000086$

quest.name: 뜨거운 꽃
quest.desc: $map:02000086$의 용암에서 자라는 $item:20000061$$pp:를,을$ 뽑아보자. 불타는 용암이 뜨거워도 무서워 말자!
Try pulling out $item:20000061$, which grows in the lava of $map:02000086$. Do not be afraid, even if the burning lava is hot!

quest.name: Petals of Fire
quest.desc: If you're going to prove you're an adventurer worthy of respect, you'll have to uproot the $item:20000061$ growing in the lava of $map:02000086$. A little lava's nothing you can't handle. After all, it's just a bit of blazing, liquid fire of doom.

quest.name: 뜨거운 전투
quest.desc: $map:02000086$에 있는 용광로를 두드려 $npc:21000086$들을 깨운 후 $item:30000142$$pp:를,을$ 빼앗아 오자. 용광로의 위치는 미니맵에서 확인하자.
Strike the furnaces in $map:02000086$ to wake the $npc:21000086$, then take $item:30000142$ from them. Check the minimap for the furnace locations.
quest.manual: Find and strike the furnace in $map:02000086$, then take $item:30000142$

quest.name: Fiery Combat
quest.desc: Another opportunity to prove you're a real adventurer. Banging on the smelting furnace in $map:02000086$ is sure to annoy the $npc:21000086$. Wait for them to come find you and grab that $item:30000142$ fast! You can double-check the location of the furnace on the mini map.
quest.manual: Bang on the smelting furnace in $map:02000086$ and steal $itemPlural:30000142$

quest.name: 업무 방해
quest.desc: $map:02000111$에서 튜브를 옮겨 $npc:11000362$의 $npc:29000033$ 함정을 막아버리자.
Move tubes in $map:02000111$ and block $npc:11000362$'s $npc:29000033$ trap.
quest.manual: Use tubes to fill the beachside $npc:29000033$ traps

quest.name: Crabby Sabotage
quest.desc: The economy in the area has been totally disrupted by $npc:11000362[gender:0]$'s new venture. Sabotage may not be very nice, but that $npc:11000420$ is definitely someone you don't want to cross. Use tubes to block $npc:11000362$'s $npc:29000033$ traps in $map:02000111$ before she gets mad at you.
quest.manual: Use tubes to block $npc:29000033$ traps on the beach

quest.name: 생선 도둑?
quest.desc: $npc:11000420$$pp:는,은$ $map:02000111$ 도심에 있는 $npc:21000101$들이 엄마의 가게에서 팔아야 하는 생선들을 훔쳐갔다고 의심하고 있다. $npc:21000101$들이 정말 생선 도둑이 맞는지 놈들을 처치해보자.

quest.name: Sticky Fish Fingers
quest.desc: $npc:11000420$ suspects that the $npcPlural:21000101$ in $map:02000111$ city center have stolen the fish her mother was trying to sell. You should help her confront them to find out if they really are the culprits.
$npc:11000420$ suspects that the $npc:21000101$ in downtown $map:02000111$ stole the fish meant to be sold at their mother's shop. Defeat the $npc:21000101$ to see if they really are fish thieves.

quest.name: 숏다리의 꿈
quest.desc: $npc:11000471$$pp:는,은$ 작은 키가 불만이다. $map:02000136$$pp:를,을$ 돌아다니는 $npc:21099049$들 사이에 있는 영양제 상자에서 $item:20000064$$pp:를,을$ 훔쳐오자!

quest.name: Making it Big
quest.desc: $npc:11000471$ is tired of coming up short, and wants to make a change. Help him recover $itemPlural:20000064$ from the crates belonging to the $npcPlural:21099049$ in $map:02000136$!
quest.manual: Retrieve $itemPlural:20000064$ from the crates near the $npcPlural:21099049$

quest.desc: $npc:11000471$ is unhappy about being short. Steal $item:20000064$ from the supplement box among the $npc:21099049$ roaming $map:02000136$!
quest.manual: Take $item:20000064$ from the nutrition supplement box among the $npc:21099049$

quest.name: 거미 박멸!
quest.desc: $npc:11000472$ 뒤에 있는 건물 틈으로 들어가 $npc:29000025$들을 잡아주자.

quest.name: The Itsy-Bitsy Spiders
quest.desc:
$npc:11000472$, who is not the slightest bit afraid of spiders, was about to go and squish all of the $npcPlural:29000025$ infesting the crawl space behind him—that is, until you volunteered.
Well, get to stomping!
quest.manual: Enter the crawl space behind $npc:11000472$ and squish $npcPlural:29000025$

quest.desc: Enter the gap between the buildings behind $npc:11000472$ and catch the $npc:29000025$.

quest.name: Below His Station
quest.desc: $npc:11000065$ is complaining of a bad stench coming from lower $map:02000100$, where his least favorite constituents live. Help clean up that part of town.
According to $npc:11000065$, a foul smell is coming from the polluted water in the lower part of $map:02000100$. Install a septic tank in the polluted water.

quest.name: Below His Station
quest.desc: $npc:11000065$ is complaining of a bad stench coming from lower $map:02000100$, where his least favorite constituents live. Help clean up that part of town.

quest.name: Interview of a Lifetime
quest.desc: To thank you for your service, $npc:11000065$ has sent a letter of recommendation on your behalf to Goldus Group. Go to $map:02000189$ for your interview.

quest.name: Interview of a Lifetime
quest.desc: To thank you for your service, $npc:11000065$ has sent a letter of recommendation on your behalf to Goldus Group. Go to $map:02000189$ for your interview.
Thanking you for installing the septic tank, $npc:11000065$ says they sent a recommendation letter to Goldus for you. Go to $map:02000189$ for the interview.

quest.name: Praise Goldus
quest.desc: As Goldus Group's newest employee, it's time for you to meet $npc:11000252$ and sing the company song to him. The lyrics to the song, "$npc:11000477$," are hanging on the wall next to him.

quest.name: Praise Goldus
quest.desc: As Goldus Group's newest employee, it's time for you to meet $npc:11000252$ and sing the company song to him. The lyrics to the song, "$npc:11000477$," are hanging on the wall next to him.
After passing the interview, the next thing to do is meet $npc:11000252$ in person and sing the Goldus anthem. If you cannot remember the lyrics, check $npc:11000477$ hanging next to $npc:11000252$.

quest.name: Demonic Roots
quest.desc: $npc:11000169$ requested that I go to $map:02000315$ and steal the $item:30000190$ from $npc:23100025$. Although I am bothered by his attitude (he seems to ask others for help in every difficult situation), I will aid him this one time, like $npc:11000169$ said to.

quest.name: Secret of the Dance
quest.desc:
$npc:11000542$ loves to dance, so he decided to raise some $npcPlural:21000069$ to dance with. However, his $npcPlural:21000069$ look pretty sad compared to the ones you see dancing in the wild.
Hunt some wild $npc:21000069$ around the $map:02000049$ and learn their secret.

$npc:11000542$ loves dancing so much that they personally raise $npc:21000069$, famous for their cute dance moves. But $npc:11000542$'s $npc:21000069$ seem a bit gloomy compared to wild $npc:21000069$. Try hunting the $npc:21000069$ around $map:02000049$ first!

quest.name: Secret of the Dance
quest.desc:
$npc:11000542$ loves to dance, so he decided to raise some $npcPlural:21000069$ to dance with. However, his $npcPlural:21000069$ look pretty sad compared to the ones you see dancing in the wild.
Hunt some wild $npc:21000069$ around the $map:02000049$ and learn their secret.

quest.name: Dance of the Cacti
quest.desc: You found $itemPlural:30000029$ while hunting $npcPlural:21000069$. Is this what Tanz needs to get his own $itemPlural:30000029$ to dance?

quest.name: Dancing Cactus
quest.desc: You found $itemPlural:30000029$ while hunting $npcPlural:21000069$. Is this what Tanz needs to get his own $itemPlural:30000029$ to dance?

quest.name: Rain, Rain, Come Again
quest.desc: Worried about the lack of rain in the Perion region, $npc:11000039$ set up totems in the lower area of $map:02000049$. Let's hold a rain ritual in front of all the totems in $map:02000049$.
quest.manual: Hold a rain ritual in front of all the totems in $map:02000049$

quest.name: Exciting Teleportation
quest.desc: TELI is a strange teleportation machine discovered in $map:02000163$. Why is this machine installed here in the midst of the chaos of other machines and robots?

quest.name: Back to Home
quest.desc: The teleportation device operates as normal. Now it's time to turn it on and get home.

quest.name: Melting Lava
quest.desc: The lava that needs to flow into $map:02000162$'s lava generator has hardened, and therefore the generator is not working. I should follow the path of the lava, locate the problem, and fix it.
quest.manual: Follow the lava, locate the blockage, and fix it

quest.name: 바위 틈을 비집고
quest.desc: $npc:11000599$$pp:는,은$ $map:02000045$의 동굴속에서 신발을 잃어버렸다. $npc:11000599$ 뒤에 보이는 막혀있는 동굴 입구 속으로 들어가, $item:30000180$$pp:를,을$ 구해주자.
$npc:11000599$ lost their shoes inside a cave in $map:02000045$. Enter the blocked cave entrance visible behind $npc:11000599$ and retrieve $item:30000180$.

quest.name: The Smooshed Shoe
quest.desc: $npcName:11000599$ lost his shoe while spelunking at the $map:02000045$. Enter the cave system behind him and retrieve $item:30000180$.

quest.name: 강하게 키우자!
quest.desc: $npc:11000629$$pp:는,은$ $npc:11000630$$pp:가,이$ 아이들에게 날기 교육을 시키는 방식에 불만이 많다. $npc:11000628$들이 전부 무사히 건넜을리 없으니 $map:02000046$의 하단부에서 날기에 실패한 $npc:11000628$들을 도와주자.

$npc:11000629$ is very unhappy with the way $npc:11000630$ teaches the children to fly. Not all $npc:11000628$ could have crossed safely, so help the $npc:11000628$ who failed to fly in the lower part of $map:02000046$.

quest.name: Flying Lessons
quest.desc: $npcName:11000629$ is unhappy with how her husband, $npcName:11000630$, is teaching their children how to fly. She may have a point—$npcNamePlural:11000628$ who failed to make it across the $map:02000046$ are littering the canyon floor. Give them a helping hand.

quest.name: 인형의 비밀
quest.desc: $npc:11000372$의 연구 욕심은 끝이 없다. $map:02000145$에서 찾을 수 있는 $map:02000240$에서 소리의 정체를 파악한 후 증거물을 가져가자. $map:02000240$$pp:는,은$ $npc:11000372$ 아래에 위치해 있다.

quest.name: Things Best Left Buried
quest.desc:
$npc:11000372$ speaks cryptically of a failed experiment, and an abomination that must be destroyed. Travel to $map:02000240$ in the $map:02000145$, destroy the failed experiment, and bring back proof of your deed.
The entrance to the $map:02000240$ is located below $npc:11000372$.
quest.manual: (Elite) Defeat $npc:22090166$ in the $map:02000240$ under the $map:02000145$ and obtain proof of your deed

quest.desc: $npc:11000372$'s desire for research is endless. Identify the source of the sound in $map:02000240$, found in $map:02000145$, then bring back evidence. $map:02000240$ is located below $npc:11000372$.
quest.manual: Defeat $npc:22090166$ in $map:02000240$ of (Elite) $map:02000145$, then obtain the evidence

quest.name: 불의 재료
quest.desc: $npc:11000541$$pp:는,은$ 툼바족들이 주민들의 집을 빼앗는 것에 진절머리가 난 것 같다. $map:02000048$ 곳곳에서 $item:30000198$$pp:를,을$ 획득하자.

quest.name: All Fired Up
quest.desc: $npcName:11000541$ is furious at the Tumbai who have stolen her peoples' homes. She wants you to gather $itemPlural:30000198$s from the $map:02000048$.
$npc:11000541$ seems fed up with the Toomba tribe taking residents' homes. Obtain $item:30000198$ throughout $map:02000048$.

quest.name: 활활 타올라라
quest.desc: $npc:11000541$$pp:는,은$ 놀랍게도 빼앗긴 집들을 모두 불태우자고 제안했다. $npc:11000541$에게 $item:30000198$$pp:를,을$ 받아서 $map:02000048$ 곳곳의 움막집들을 불태우자.

quest.name: Burn, Burn, Burn!
quest.desc: In a twist that nobody could have predicted, $npc:11000541$ has decided to burn down her whole village rather than let the T'oomba kick them out. Use the $item:30000198$ you gathered to burn down homes at the $map:02000048$.
quest.manual: Use $item:30000198$ to burn homes at the $map:02000048$

quest.desc: Surprisingly, $npc:11000541$ suggests burning down all the stolen homes. Receive $item:30000198$ from $npc:11000541$ and burn the huts throughout $map:02000048$.

quest.name: No Contact
quest.desc: $npc:11000664$ wants to hack $map:02000162$'s antenna in order to see his girlfriend's text message log. Let's hunt the monsters in $map:02000162$ and acquire $item:30000035$ for $npc:11000664$.

quest.name: To Hack, or Not to Hack
quest.desc: Using $item:30000035$, $npc:11000594$ produced $item:30000040$. Let's go to $npc:11000666$ at the upper region of $map:02000162$ and attempt to hack.
quest.complete: Hack $npc:11000666$, located in the upper region of $map:02000162$

quest.name: 울부짖는 석상
quest.desc: 보름달이 뜨는 날의 밤이면, $map:02000051$ 서쪽 꼭대기에 위치한 늑대 석상이 울부짖는다는 소문이 있다. 소문의 주인공인 석상을 살펴보자.
quest.manual: $map:02000051$ 서쪽 꼭대기에 위치한 늑대 석상 조사하기

quest.desc: There is a rumor that on nights when the full moon rises, the wolf statue at the western peak of $map:02000051$ howls. Examine the statue from the rumor.

quest.name: The Howling Stone
quest.desc: Rumor has it that, on a full moon, the wolf statue in northwestern $map:02000051$ howls like a real wolf. You need to see this for yourself.
quest.manual: Watch the wolf statue in northwestern $map:02000051$

quest.name: 울음소리의 정체
quest.desc: $map:02000081$ 다락방에서 숨어있을 곳을 찾아, $npc:11000694$$pp:가,이$ 나타나길 기다리자.
Find a place to hide in the attic of $map:02000081$ and wait for $npc:11000694$ to appear.

quest.name: The Voice of the Statue
quest.desc: Find a place to hide within the $map:02000081$ attic and wait for $npcName:11000694$ to appear.
quest.manual: Hide in the $map:02000081$ attic and learn $npcName:11000694$'s secret

quest.name: A Habit of Three…
quest.desc: $npc:11000001$ has been so worried he hasn't been able to sleep ever since a man in black came by looking for $npc:11000502$, his son. Let's go ask $npc:11000101$ in $map:02000083$ about $npc:11000502$'s whereabouts.

quest.name: Big Dreams, Bigger Punishments
quest.desc: $npc:11000502$ is being chased...for it has been revealed that he stole the $item:30000016$ from the Darkstar. I'm going to look for those who robbed $npc:11000502$ at $map:02000141$ and see if I can't find the stolen $item:30000016$.
quest.complete: Find the culprit who stole the $item:30000016$ from $map:02000141$

quest.name: Dungeon: Black Market Den
quest.desc:
$dungeonTitle:21005001$ (Entrance: $map:2000083$) Party Size (4 players)
$item:30000016$ can only be found in $map:02000241$. If I go down the stairs by the Golden Tower in $map:02000083$, there will be a emergency door that is connected to $map:02000241$! I must keep in mind $npc:11000365$'s advice on gathering comrades and advancing in a group of 4 within $map:02000241$...
quest.manual: Go downstairs from $map:02000241$ and look for $item:30000016$

quest.name: 멈춰버린 멜로디
quest.desc: $npc:11000890$$pp:는,은$ 최근 $map:02000095$에 아름답게 울려퍼지던 멜로디 소리가 들리지 않아 원인을 찾던 중 의심스러운 토템을 발견했다고 한다. 수상한 토템을 제거하여, 정적이 흐르는 $map:02000095$에 아름다운 멜로디를 되찾아주자.

$npc:11000890$ says the beautiful melody that recently echoed through $map:02000095$ can no longer be heard. While searching for the cause, they found suspicious totems. Remove the suspicious totems and restore the beautiful melody to the silent $map:02000095$.

quest.name: Broken Melody
quest.desc: The beautiful music of $map:02000095$ has been silenced, and $npcName:11000890$ thinks that some strange totems are behind it. Remove the totems and restore music to $map:02000095$.
quest.manual: Remove the strange totems in the $map:02000095$

quest.name: 치치의 걱정거리
quest.desc: 수상한 토템은 모두 제거 되었다. $npc:11000890$$pp:는,은$ 이 사실을 $map:02000095$ 꼭대기에 있는 $npc:11000891$에게 전해달라고 부탁한다.
All suspicious totems have been removed. $npc:11000890$ asks you to tell $npc:11000891$ at the top of $map:02000095$ about this.

quest.name: Chechy's Plan
quest.desc: Now that the totems are gone, $npc:11000890$ wants you to tell her brother, $npc:11000891$. He can be found near the highest point at $map:02000095$.
quest.complete: Talk to $npc:11000891$ at the top of $map:02000095$

quest.name: 도난당한 풀피리
quest.desc: $npc:11000891$$pp:는,은$ 잠들어 버린 요정들을 깨우기 위해 필요한 $item:30000261$$pp:를,을$ 도난 당했다고 한다. $npc:21000065$$pp:를,을$ 사냥하여, 도난당한 $item:30000261$$pp:를,을$ 찾아주자.

quest.name: Flute Felony
quest.desc: $npc:11000891$ says that he needs his $item:30000261$ to awaken the guardians of the fountain. Unfortunately, it was stolen by a $npc:21000065$. Get the $item:30000261$ back.
quest.complete: Talk to $npc:11000891$ at the top of $map:02000095$

quest.desc: $npc:11000891$ says $item:30000261$, needed to wake the sleeping fairies, was stolen. Hunt $npc:21000065$ and find the stolen $item:30000261$.

quest.name: 음악은 사랑을 싣고
quest.desc: $npc:11000891$$pp:는,은$ 되찾아온 $item:30000261$$pp:를,을$ 연주하면, 멜로디 분수를 깨울 수 있는 세 명의 요정을 불러낼 수 있다고 한다. $item:30000261$$pp:를,을$ 연주하여, 잠들어 있는 세 명의 수호 요정을 깨워보자.

quest.name: An Uplifting Tune
quest.desc: $npc:11000891$ has asked you to awaken the fairfolk guardians of the fountain by playing his $item:30000261$. You might as well give it a try.
quest.manual: Play the $item:30000261$ to summon the guardians
quest.complete: Talk to $npc:11000891$ at the top of $map:02000095$

quest.desc: $npc:11000891$ says that if you play the recovered $item:30000261$, you can summon the three fairies who can awaken the Melody Fountain. Play $item:30000261$ and wake the three sleeping guardian fairies.
quest.manual: Play $item:30000261$ to wake the guardian fairy

quest.name: 진정한 파이터라면!
quest.desc: 여행자들을 위한 쉼터이자, 피추피추족의 문화적 특색이 살아있는 $map:02000095$에 위기가 찾아왔다. $map:02000095$$pp:를,을$ 위협하는 몬스터들을 사냥하자!
A crisis has come to $map:02000095$, a resting place for travelers and a place alive with the cultural character of the Pichu Pichu tribe. Hunt the monsters threatening $map:02000095$!

quest.name: A Call to Action
quest.desc: You found a notice calling for heroes to defend the $map:02000095$ from monsters. Fight for the future of the Picchu Picchu people!
quest.complete: Check the bulletin board in the $map:02000095$

quest.name: A Secret Rendezvous
quest.desc: A mysterious letter of instructions found by chance. Checking the contents, it contains records of events occurring in $map:03000145$. Let's find $npc:11000910$ in $map:03000145$ to learn more about the incident.

quest.name: Dr. Rokel's Conspiracy
quest.desc: $npc:11000910$ tells me about a conspiracy unfolding inside $map:03000145$. To stop Dr. Rokel's dangerous research, let's go to $npc:11000911$ in $map:03000145$ and ask for help.

quest.name: Fail to Survive!
quest.desc: $npc:11000911$ says we must shut down the incubators producing Shadow Cells. Let's hurry and shut down the Shadow Cell incubators before Dr. Rokel can collect the cultivated cells.
quest.manual: Stop the incubators producing Shadow Cells

quest.name: Never Let Your Guard Down
quest.desc: $npc:11000911$ says the cell incubators were barely shut down, but we can't relax yet. Let's hunt the mutant monsters in $map:03000145$ that have already been exposed to the Shadow Cell virus.
quest.manual: Hunt mutant monsters infected with the virus

quest.name: Dangerous People
quest.desc: $npc:11000912$ says the health of the slaves captured and brainwashed in $map:03000145$ is deteriorating. Searching the $npc:40000019$s guarding the cage will yield $item:30000264$, so let's obtain $item:30000264$ and rescue the slaves trapped in the iron cages.
quest.manual: Obtain $item:30000264$, open the iron cage door, and rescue the trapped slaves

quest.name: Memory Trace
quest.desc: Once upon a time, $npc:11000929$ wrote a great book. But after spending a thousand years in Perion, $npc:11000929$ can't remember the location of the original manuscript. After tracing the ancient memory back, $npc:11000929$ found out the book is inside of an egg. The nest, decorated with multi-colored feathers, is located on the peak of the $map:02000267$. The eggshell has hardened and solidified as time passed, so I'll need to hunt the $npc:21000255$ around the area and use its $item:30000268$ to hatch the egg. Let's go to the $map:02000267$ to find the original manuscript of the book written by $npc:11000929$.
quest.manual: Use the $item:30000268$ to hatch the egg and find the $item:30000265$|Use the $item:30000268$ to hatch the egg and find the $item:30000266$|Use the $item:30000268$ to hatch the egg and find the $item:30000267$

quest.name: Sharing Is Caring
quest.desc: $npc:11000929$ was practically leaping for joy after I managed to locate the original manuscript. $npc:11000929$ claims the book will be a big hit as long as it gets published. If that's the case, I might be able to make a lot of money if I show the manuscript to $npc:11000327$ in $map:02000001$. I should go speak with $npc:11000327$.

quest.name: I'm a Survivor
quest.desc: $npc:11000930$ was deeply hurt and disappointed by the humans when she lost her husband to the poachers. She has been raising her babies by herself in $map:02000267$. It's been difficult for $npc:11000930$ to hunt, as dangerous lava fountains have formed around the area recently. Let's help and bring $item:30000269$ so that she can feed her baby birds.
quest.manual: Hunt the $npc:29000041$ in the bushes and bring it to $npc:11000930$

quest.name: 구슬픈 울음소리
quest.desc: 앞을 볼 수 없지만, 대신 앞 날을 예측하고 바라볼 수 있는 $npc:11000931$. 얼마 전부터 사냥을 떠난 아내 앙카가 계속 꿈에서 나타난다고 한다. 꿈 속에서 본 $map:02000267$의 용암지대로 가서 $item:30000270$$pp:를,을$ 찾은 후에, 양지바른 곳에 있는 제단에서 제사를 올려주자.

quest.name: Mournful Vision
quest.desc:
Although $npc:11000931$ is blind, he has the ability to see visions. He's been having recurring dreams about his mate, Anka, who never returned from her last hunt.
Go to the lava flows of $map:02000267$ and find $item:30000270$, then find a sunny place to lay her to rest.
quest.manual: Find $item:30000270$ in $map:02000267$ and lay her to rest at the altar

quest.desc: $npc:11000931$ cannot see, but can instead predict and look toward the future. They say their wife Anka, who left to hunt some time ago, keeps appearing in their dreams. Go to the lava area of $map:02000267$ seen in the dream, find $item:30000270$, then perform a ritual at the altar in a sunny place.
quest.manual: Find $item:30000270$ in $map:02000267$, then hold a spirit ceremony at the altar

quest.name: 내겐 너무 골치 아픈 너
quest.desc: 오염된 산업폐수가 고여 있는 물길을 커닝시티 발전소의 강한 스파크가 관통하면서 도심 한 복판에 거대한 괴물이 돌아다니는 일이 발생했다. 오염된 거대 돌연변이 $npc:23000013$$pp:는,은$ $map:02000100$ 전체를 병들게 할 지도 모른다. 도심 속에 나타난 $npc:23000013$$pp:를,을$ 처치하자.

quest.name: Life Finds a Way
quest.desc:
A huge monster wanders the city wreaking chaos after industrial waste enters the ecosystem and turns an unsuspecting frog into a thumping freak.
Defeat $npc:23000013$ in $map:02000084$ and put an end to the clomping croaker. It really won't change much in the grand scheme of things, but it sure will make one more day in this city a little more tolerable!

Polluted industrial wastewater gathered in a waterway, and when a strong spark from the Kerning City power plant pierced through it, a giant monster began roaming the middle of the city. The polluted giant mutant $npc:23000013$ may make all of $map:02000100$ sick. Defeat $npc:23000013$, which appeared in the city.

quest.name: Dungeon: Catastrophic Jealousy
quest.desc:
$dungeonTitle:20012001$ (Entrance: $map:02000024$) Party Size (4 players) The quest is only available in Normal mode.
As the fallen angel Ariel spread the seeds of darkness, $npc:23100039$, the violent guard of the underground, became awakened. $npc:23100039$ must be stopped, with it becoming increasingly more violent as it continues to absorb dark spirits. It's time to defeat $npc:23100039$ captured in $map:02000312$.

quest.name: 무소식의 이유
quest.desc: $npc:11000961$$pp:는,은$ $map:02000013$로 파견나간 대원들이 돌아올 때가 한참이 지났는데 아무런 소식도 없이 행방이 묘연해졌다고 말하며 걱정을 하고 있다. $map:02000013$$pp2:로,으로$ 가서 파견나간 자경단원들이 무사한지 행방을 조사해보자.

quest.name: The Long Silence
quest.desc: $npc:11000961$ hasn't heard back from the Green Hoods who were deployed to the $map:02000013$. Head out there and find out what happened to them.
quest.manual: Search for missing Green Hoods at the $map:02000013$

quest.desc: $npc:11000961$ is worried, saying the members dispatched to $map:02000013$ should have returned long ago, but vanished without any news. Go to $map:02000013$ and investigate whether the dispatched vigilantes are safe.
quest.manual: Go to $map:02000013$ and investigate the whereabouts of the dispatched vigilante member

quest.name: 간절했던 손길
quest.desc: 나무 숲 사이로 몸을 숨기고 있는 $npc:11000962$. $npc:11000961$$pp:가,이$ 말한 자경대원 중 한 명인듯 하다. $npc:11000962$$pp:는,은$ 갑작스럽게 무리를 지어 몰려온 몬스터들의 공격에 대응하지 못해 많은 사람들이 부상당했고, 파견 나올때 준비해왔던 구호물품도 모두 바닥이 나서 상황이 매우 좋지 않다고 한다. 가장 시급한 것은 부상당한 사람들을 치료해 주는 것! 홀로 부상자들을 돌보고 있는 $npc:11000832$$pp:를,을$ 찾아가보자.

quest.name: Uphill Battle
quest.desc: You found one of the missing Green Hoods, $npc:11000962$. Her squad was ambushed by monsters and they don't have enough supplies to take care of the wounded. Find $npc:11000832$ and help take care of the injured Green Hoods.

$npc:11000962$ is hiding among the trees. They seem to be one of the vigilantes $npc:11000961$ mentioned. $npc:11000962$ says many people were injured because they could not respond to the sudden attack by monsters that rushed in as a group, and all the relief supplies they prepared before being dispatched have run out, so the situation is very bad. The most urgent thing is treating the injured! Find $npc:11000832$, who is caring for the injured alone.

quest.name: 임시 처방
quest.desc: $npc:11000832$$pp:는,은$ 홀로 부상자들을 돌보느라, 눈코 뜰 새 없이 바쁘다. 갈수록 부상자들은 늘어가는데 이들을 치료 해줄 약이 바닥이 나 버리는 바람에 상황은 더 안 좋기만 하다. 부상당한 환자를 위한 비상약 제조법을 알고 있는 $npc:11000832$$pp:는,은$ 약 제조에 필요한 재료들을 구해달라고 부탁한다. 근처에 있는 $npc:21000353$, $npc:21000003$$pp:를,을$ 사냥하여, $item:30000285$, $item:30000286$$pp:를,을$ 구해오자.

$npc:11000832$ is extremely busy caring for the injured alone. The number of injured people keeps growing, and the medicine to treat them has run out, making the situation even worse. $npc:11000832$, who knows how to make emergency medicine for injured patients, asks you to gather the materials needed to make it. Hunt nearby $npc:21000353$ and $npc:21000003$, and bring back $item:30000285$ and $item:30000286$.

quest.name: Triage
quest.desc: $npcName:11000832$ is swamped taking care of wounded Green Hoods. She needs to make more medicine, and it falls on you to gather the materials. Hunt $npcNamePlural:21000353$ and $npcNamePlural:21000003$ to acquire $itemPlural:30000285$ and $itemPlural:30000286$.

quest.name: 치료가 필요해
quest.desc: $npc:11000963$에 의하면 부상당한 사람들이 치료도 받지 못한 채 거리에 쓰러져 있다고 한다. 안 그래도 치료제가 바닥이 나서 $npc:11000832$$pp:를,을$ 찾아가려고 했지만, 부상자들만 두고 갈 수는 없었다는 $npc:11000963$. $npc:11000963$에게 받은 응급치료제를 가지고, 부상당한 사람들을 치료해주자.

According to $npc:11000963$, injured people are collapsed in the streets without receiving treatment. $npc:11000963$ was already going to find $npc:11000832$ because the medicine had run out, but could not leave the injured behind. Use the emergency medicine you received from $npc:11000963$ to treat the injured people.
quest.name: Needs Treatment
Rubbing It In
quest.desc: $npcName:11000963$ gave you some medicine for the injured people below.

quest.name: 사수하라!
quest.desc: $npc:11000972$$pp:는,은$ 급격하게 늘어나버린 몬스터의 공격을 홀로 힘겹게 막아내고 있다. 함께 파견나왔던 자경단원 대부분은 부상을 입었고, 비상 구호물품도 모두 바닥이 나버려서 버틸 수 있는 시간도 얼마 남지 않았다고 한다. 극한 상황에 처해 있음에도 불구하고 포기하지 않겠다고 당차게 말하는 $npc:11000972$. $npc:11000972$$pp:를,을$ 도와 성채를 점령하고 있는 $npc:21000003$, $npc:21000353$, $npc:21000306$$pp:를,을$ 사냥하자.

$npc:11000972$ is struggling alone to hold back the sharply increased monster attacks. Most of the vigilantes dispatched with them were injured, and all emergency relief supplies have run out, so there is not much time left to hold out. Even in this extreme situation, $npc:11000972$ boldly says they will not give up. Help $npc:11000972$ by hunting $npc:21000003$, $npc:21000353$, and $npc:21000306$, which are occupying the fortress.

quest.name: Holding the Fort
quest.desc: $npcName:11000972$ is making a desperate stand against an army of monsters after the rest of her squad was injured and scattered. Alone and without supplies, she refuses to give up—help her by fighting off the hordes of $npcNamePlural:21000003$, $npcNamePlural:21000353$, and $npcNamePlural:21000306$ that are attacking the fortress.
quest.manual: Defeat $npcNamePlural:21000003$ at the $map:02000013$|Defeat $npcNamePlural:21000353$ at the $map:02000013$|Defeat $npcNamePlural:21000306$ at the $map:02000013$

quest.name: 아름답지 않은 소리
quest.desc: $npc:11000741$$pp:는,은$ 새로운 음악 작곡에 한창 몰입 중이다. 밝은 장조의 음악을 만들어야 하는 까닭에 달콤한 향이 가득한 $map:02000186$으로 작업실까지 옮겼지만, 거리의 엉터리 악사들의 소음 때문에 폭발 직전의 상태가 되어버렸다. 창작의 고통으로 예민해질대로 예민해진 $npc:11000741$$pp:를,을$ 위해 $npc:21000278$, $npc:21000173$$pp:를,을$ 사냥하자.

quest.name: Cacophony
quest.desc: $npc:11000741$ has moved to a new studio in the remote $map:02000186$ in order to compose his magnum opus. Unfortunately, the locals are too noisy for him to concentrate. Beat up the $npcPlural:21000278$ and $npcPlural:21000173$ so that $npc:11000741$ can focus on writing real music.

$npc:11000741$ is deeply absorbed in composing new music. Because they need to create bright major-key music, they even moved their studio to $map:02000186$, which is filled with sweet scents, but the noise from the terrible street musicians has brought them to the verge of exploding. For $npc:11000741$, who has become extremely sensitive from the pain of creation, hunt $npc:21000278$ and $npc:21000173$.

quest.name: 살이 빠지지 않는 이유
