quest.desc: $npc:11000875$ says the monsters would not be carrying valuable items directly, and must have hidden them somewhere. They say a dirt mound they saw somewhere in $map:02000006$ looks suspicious, and demand that you dig it up. What could be inside the dirt mound?

quest.name: 숲을 적시는 물
quest.desc: $map:02000024$ 나무 꼭대기의 물은 숲 전체로 흐르며 숲의 생명을 책임지고 있다고 한다. 그런데, 지진으로 물길이 끊기는 바람에 숲의 일부인 요정 숲이 말라가고 있다는데…… $npc:11000876$에게 빈 물병을 받아서 요정 숲을 살릴 수 있는 나무 꼭대기의 물을 담아서 가져다주자.

quest.name: Water Distribution Logistics
quest.desc:
The magical water that falls from the treetops of $map:02000024$ once flowed across the entire forest, giving life to all in its path. However, an earthquake has subverted the stream's flow to this part of the forest, causing it to wither and die.
Take $npc:11000876$'s bottle and collect water from the treetops so that it can be used to restore life to the dying forest.
quest.manual: Gather water from the $map:02000024$'s treetops using $item:30000259$

quest.desc: The water at the top of the tree in $map:02000024$ flows through the entire forest and sustains its life. But because an earthquake cut off the waterway, the fairy forest, part of the forest, is drying up... Receive an empty bottle from $npc:11000876$, fill it with water from the top of the tree that can save the fairy forest, and bring it back.

quest.name: 훼방꾼 처치하기
quest.desc: 몬스터들을 피해 $item:30000260$$pp:를,을$ 무사히 운반할 자신이 없다는 $npc:11000876$. 자칫 물을 쏟기라도 할까 걱정하고 있는 $npc:11000876$$pp:를,을$ 위해 몬스터들을 처치하고 길을 터주자.

quest.name: The Water Must Flow
quest.desc:
$npc:11000876$ needs to sprinkle the stream's life-giving waters around the forest, but there are too many monsters about.
Defeat monsters indiscriminately to clear a path for $npc:11000876$.

$npc:11000876$ says they are not confident they can safely carry $item:30000260$ while avoiding monsters. For $npc:11000876$, who worries they might spill the water, defeat the monsters and clear the path.

quest.name: The Noisy Alarm
quest.desc: At dawn, it's $npc:21000159$'s job to wake the sleeping. For a long time, they've announced the morning with an elegant and refreshing voice. But at some point, an annoying ring-ring sound started blaring every morning. The ring-ring is so loud that $npc:21000159$'s cock-a-doodle-doo can't even be heard. $npc:11000996$'s pride is wounded! Declaring that $npc:21000159$ is the only alarm clock in this area, they ask you to take $npc:21000280$'s winding key.

quest.name: Retrieving the Winding Key
quest.desc: $npc:11000997$ says someone took $npc:21000280$'s clock winding key and asks you to get it back. It seems we can't take sides between $npc:21000159$ and $npc:21000280$. For now, it's best to restore things to normal. Let's find $item:30000308$ on the ground and return it to $npc:11000997$.
quest.manual: Pick up $item:30000308$ from the grass at $map:02000180$

quest.name: The Alarm Sounds Again
quest.desc: $npc:11000996$ is puzzled that $npc:21000280$'s alarm sound is being heard again. After hesitating a moment and then explaining what happened, $npc:11000996$ is furious, saying you betrayed their trust. They say if you punish $npc:21000280$, they'll forgive the act of betrayal…

quest.name: Throwing Away the Winding Key
quest.desc: $npc:11000996$ says they don't even want to have the $item:30000307$ and asks you to throw it far away. They say to climb the tree next to them and throw it…
quest.manual: Climb the tree next to $npc:11000996$ and throw $item:30000330$ far away

quest.name: Wanting to Fit In
quest.desc: $npc:11000979$ has been excluded by friends because of their different color. Wanting to have the same black appearance as their friends, they decide to try eating $item:30000309$. Let's pick some $item:30000309$ for $npc:11000979$.
quest.manual: Gather $item:30000309$ from the mushroom clusters at $map:02000042$

quest.name: A Reckless Attempt
quest.desc: $npc:11000979$ immediately eats the $item:30000309$. They start retching, saying they feel nauseous, then can't endure the stomach pain and seeks an antidote. Let's get $item:30000310$ and give the fairy water to $npc:11000979$.
quest.manual: Find $item:30000310$ in the pond beneath the waterfall at $map:02000042$

quest.name: Live as You Are
quest.desc: $npc:11000979$ drank the fairy water and found peace. Will Grimond's challenge to change their appearance color continue?

quest.name: The Peddler Hates Rain
quest.desc: $npc:11000980$ hid under a roof to escape the rain. There's an umbrella at $map:02000239$, but they can't move—bringing the bundle would get it wet, and leaving it behind risks losing it. On top of that, they've lost their $item:30000311$ too, making things worse. Let's find the $item:30000311$ and bring the $item:30000312$ from $map:02000239$ for $npc:11000980$.

quest.name: 마녀의 놀이
quest.desc: 시종들과 함께 성 밖으로 산책을 나왔다가 $npc:11000745$와의 내기에 져 옷도 잃고 시종들도 잃은 $npc:11000857$. $npc:11000745$와의 가위바위보 승부에 이겨 $npc:11000857$의 옷을 되찾아주자.

$npc:11000857$ went for a walk outside the castle with attendants, lost a bet with $npc:11000745$, and lost both their clothes and attendants. Win a rock-paper-scissors match against $npc:11000745$ and recover $npc:11000857$'s clothes.

quest.name: Witch's Wager
quest.desc:
While on his daily stroll, $npcName:11000857$ encountered a witch named $npcName:11000745$. After a little wager, she won the shirt off his back—literally.
Help the naked nobleman by defeating $npcName:11000745$ in the most dangerous game: rock-paper-scissors.

quest.name: 영혼 구출하기
quest.desc: $map:02000278$에 있는 이들과의 승부에 흥미를 잃은 $npc:11000745$. 모든 걸 원상태로 돌려놓고, 새로운 놀잇감을 찾아 이곳을 떠나겠다고 말한다. 그러기 위해 몬스터 안에 가둬둔 왕궁 사람들의 영혼을 가져다달라는 $npc:11000745$. 몬스터를 처치해 $item:30000324$$pp:를,을$ 구해내자.

quest.name: Saving Souls
quest.desc:
$npcName:11000745$ has grown bored of winning. She's ready to restore the people of $map:02000278$, but first you'll have to get their souls back.
By fighting monsters, of course.

$npc:11000745$ has lost interest in competing with the people in $map:02000278$. They say they will return everything to normal and leave this place to find a new toy. To do that, $npc:11000745$ asks you to bring the souls of the palace people trapped inside monsters. Defeat monsters and recover $item:30000324$.

quest.name: Corn Thieves
quest.desc: $npc:11001006$ grows corn in a small garden plot. Though not a large amount, it was enough for $npc:11001006$ and her daughter $npc:11001007$. But recently, monsters have been stealing the corn, causing quite a headache. Let's retrieve the $item:30000325$ the monsters stole and bring it to $npc:11001006$.

quest.name: World Beyond the Rainbow
quest.desc: What lies beyond the rainbow? $npc:11001007$ is curious about the world beyond the rainbow. But $npc:11001007$'s mother warned them not to even loiter near the entrance to that place. The more they're told not to, the stronger the curiosity grows. Let's visit $map:02000305$ and come back to tell $npc:11001007$ about it.

quest.name: Can't Go Back Empty-Handed
quest.desc: $npc:11001009$ came all the way here after hearing rumors that climbing the beanstalk leads to a place overflowing with treasure. But the place the beanstalk led to is far from any treasure. $npc:11001009$ says they'll be laughed at if they go back empty-handed. Determined to bring something back, they've set their eyes on $item:30000326$.

quest.name: Intern Employee Summon
quest.desc: CashiMart $npc:11001010$ came to $map:02000063$ to do business with the pirates. But all the merchandise was stolen by the pirates. Returning empty-handed would obviously mean getting fired. Let's help poor $npc:11001010$ retrieve the stolen goods from the pirates.

quest.name: Noisy Neighbors
quest.desc: $npc:11001011$ moved to $map:02000182$ after being told it was a quiet beach house with a great view. But all they can see are cliffs, and all they can hear isn't the sound of waves but the raucous noise of pirates and exploding bombs! After belatedly realizing the contract can't be canceled, they've been living in resignation. But they can't just endure it forever! Let's at least make the noise stop.

quest.name: A New Dwelling
quest.desc: $npc:11001012$ came here after hearing that time has stopped in the Ludibrium region. Since time has stopped, they'll no longer age or grow old, so they want to settle down and live here. But they're worried about personal safety due to the threat of monsters…

quest.name: I Am a Magical Girl
quest.desc: Self-proclaimed magical girl $npc:11001015$ says she came to $map:02000214$ to save people who were cursed and turned into monsters! She asks for help rescuing the souls dwelling within the monsters, since fighting them alone is too much.

quest.name: The Witch's Loyal Hound
quest.desc: The witch $npc:21400746$, who had been living in darkness after being driven out by the fairies for practicing dark magic, awakened the beast $npc:23000047$ that was sealed by three Sages and made it her loyal hound. But contrary to the fairies' concerns, $npc:21400746$ and $npc:23000047$ never showed themselves. Self-proclaimed magical girl $npc:11001015$ says she tracked their traces all the way to $map:02000214$, burning with determination to defeat the dark mage and the legendary beast, seal their souls, and contribute to the peace of Maple World.

quest.name: Not Easy to Quit
quest.desc: $npc:11001063$ says that after actually experiencing the pirate life they'd always admired, it's hard to adapt to the rough and harsh daily routine. They want to leave the pirate crew to put the pirate life behind them, but the crew won't let them go easily, so they attempted a secret escape. But they can't move freely because fellow pirates are scattered throughout $map:02000067$…

quest.name: A Mysterious Test
quest.desc: $npc:11001064$, who says they came here from $map:02000068$ on assignment. They're on a secret mission but say it's too difficult alone and ask for help. Not sure what exactly they're trying to do, but since they're asking for help, let's help them.

quest.name: The Real Mission
quest.desc: $npc:11001064$ says they're collecting planks that washed up and are scattered across the beach. They won't properly answer what the planks will be used for, but it seems important. They insist that even planks in hard-to-spot locations must not be overlooked.
quest.manual: Pick up the planks scattered around $map:02000183$

quest.name: Petty Desires
quest.desc: $npc:11001065$ says they've been living only inside the castle because they're afraid of the monsters outside. One day, an old woman visiting the castle proposed a bet, and after winning, she cursed everyone in the castle, turning them into monsters. As she left, the old woman revealed the method to break the curse: gather fresh roses from the garden, make a wreath, and place it on the monsters…
quest.manual: Defeat monsters in the garden at $map:02000132$

quest.name: Source of Summoning
quest.desc: $npc:11000304$ covets the $item:30000366$ that $npc:22090007$ possesses in order to freely wield summoning magic. When $npc:22090007$ appears at $map:02000132$, let's take the $item:30000366$ and bring it to $npc:11000304$.

quest.name: What Matters Is Human Lives
quest.desc: $map:02000038$ is lush with trees and frequently visited by woodcutters, but it's also a place with many accidents due to the threat of monsters, especially $npc:22000024$. According to $npc:11000001$, the woodcutters have often demanded that the militia be deployed to deal with $npc:22000024$. However, there are also opinions that logging should be banned at $map:02000038$ to protect the forest, so it hasn't been easy to fulfill the woodcutters' requests…

quest.name: Their Performance Is Just Noise
quest.desc: $npc:11000869$ says they can't concentrate on research because of the noise made by $npc:21000169$, $npc:21000172$, and $npc:21000174$ at $map:02000142$. Beautiful music helps with concentration, but the sounds they make are nothing but noise... Let's take the instruments from the monsters and help $npc:11000869$'s research.

quest.name: Tracks Without a Train
quest.desc: $npc:11001066$ stands blankly, as if waiting for something. They say that once upon a time, a $map:02000184$ tour train full of laughing, chattering children used to run on these tracks. But now there are no children visiting $map:02000184$, and the train has been scrapped... $npc:11001066$ believes the cause is the monsters that occupied $map:02000184$. They say if only the monsters were gone, $map:02000184$ could be revived.

quest.name: Suspicious Gift Boxes
quest.desc: $npc:11001067$ welcomes you to $map:02000184$. They say they've prepared gifts for all visitors and placed gift boxes throughout $map:02000184$ for you to find. What could be inside the gift boxes?

quest.name: Mixed-Up Time
quest.desc: $npc:11000847$ compares $map:02000184$ and $map:02000255$, suspecting that space-time is jumbled throughout the Ludibrium region. To turn suspicion into certainty, they want to confirm whether the robots at $map:02000255$ are indeed produced in the future, and ask you to obtain memory chips that can determine the robots' production date.

quest.name: For a Safe Performance
quest.desc: $npc:11001068$ is worried because the rock band 'Oil & Water's concert is just around the corner, but the venue still hasn't been prepared. Concerned about safety accidents from unruly audience members, they ask you to retrieve the $item:30000372$ that monsters stole and install them in front of the venue.
quest.manual: Retrieve $item:30000372$ from monsters at $map:02000231$ and install them in front of the venue

quest.name: A Glutton's Dream
quest.desc: $npc:11000053$ is thrilled, saying they've finally discovered the greatest paradise on earth. They look ready to devour all of $map:02000257$. They want to taste the candy-like trees and soak in the sweet-smelling pond, but the monsters keep getting in the way...

quest.name: Completing My Dream
quest.desc: $npc:11000784$ is amazed, saying $map:02000018$ is the place they saw in their dreams. Suspecting they might still be asleep and stuck in a dream, $npc:11000784$ says that regardless of the truth, they can't stand having monsters swarming in their dream. They ask you to clear the monsters from their pretty, lovely space.

quest.name: Dangerous Uninvited Guests
quest.desc: $npc:11000849$ claims to be from a different time period. They attempted time travel and ended up here, but accidentally brought along monsters from where they came. Not wanting this place to fall into chaos because of them, they ask you to defeat the monsters…

quest.name: Driving Out the Jawbreaker Gang
quest.desc: A construction site has been set up in the $map:02000051$ region, where nature is still well preserved. Despite strong opposition from Perion residents, those leading the construction deployed the Jawbreaker Gang to suppress the residents. $npc:11001072$ asks you to drive the Jawbreaker Gang, who harmed their parents and the residents, out of the village…

quest.name: How to Honor a Hero
quest.desc: In the era when the Demon King was sealed, one of the 4 heroes who fought alongside $npc:11000075$ was 'Ten' of the Kaka Tribe. $npc:11000887$, a descendant of the Kaka Tribe, is deeply dissatisfied that while the other 3 living heroes are treated as guardians of Lapenta, 'Ten,' who gave their life, has received no such recognition. To restore honor to Ten and the Kaka Tribe, they decided to petition for a memorial park and gathered signatures, but the signatures left on the ground were blown away by the wind and ended up in the hands of monsters. Let's retrieve the signatures and return them to $npc:11000887$.

quest.name: The Hero's Resting Place
quest.desc: They say the warrior 'Ten' used to sit on a rock to cool off after battles. $npc:11000500$ is proud of the fact that they helped the hero of both the Kaka Tribe and all of Maple World. They say they will remain a resting place exclusively for heroes, and cannot allow others to sit on the rock. Especially the monsters that kick the rock—those are unforgivable…

quest.name: Side Effects of the Yakayama Fruit
quest.desc: $npc:11000790$ tells the story of the Foremagashi Tribe, which was cursed by the Mountain Hag and wiped out. Claiming to be the tribe's sole survivor, they say they ate the Yakayama Fruit to accelerate their aging in order to hide their identity. As a side effect, their body frequently itches. They say rubbing with $npc:21000111$'s mane makes the itching go away…

quest.name: The Martial Artist's Qualifications
quest.desc: $npc:11001073$ says $map:02000097$, being closest to the sky, is the ideal place for training. They declare that only a martial artist of equal caliber may converse with them, and will agree to talk if you defeat the monsters at $map:02000097$.

quest.name: The Displayed Paintings
quest.desc: $npc:11001074$ is picking up fallen paintings from the floor. They say children's drawings are being displayed here in frames or on easels. But mischievous monsters keep hanging the frames crooked and knocking over the easels. They can't just leave them like that, so they keep straightening the frames and standing the easels back up, but it's quite a nuisance. Let's teach the monsters a lesson so they can't cause any more mischief.

quest.name: Memory Chips for the Black Market
quest.desc: Dr. Katronic developed affordable maid robots to commercialize robot products. However, a virus planted by someone gave some robots aggressive tendencies, and their attacks led to the lab being shut down. Afterward, some became interested in the maid robots' aggressive behavior, and memory chips containing these robots' AI are being illegally traded at high prices. Let's help $npc:11001075$ who came to $map:02000265$ to obtain $item:30000375$.

quest.name: Finding the Lost Wallet
quest.desc: $npc:11000244$ suddenly screams. They say they lost a wallet full of cash. They insist the robots that were circling around them must have pickpocketed it…

quest.name: (Dungeon) A Reason to Train
quest.desc:
$dungeonTitle:20015001$ Entrance: $map:02000175$ Party Size: 4 This quest is only available on normal difficulty.
$npcName:11001073$ is determined to become skilled enough to win an 18-on-1 battle. If you want to follow in his footsteps, then you need to start by facing two worthy opponents at once. He demands that you defeat $npcName:23100033$.

quest.name: (Dungeon) A Reason to Train
quest.desc:
$dungeonTitle:20015001$ Entrance: $map:02000175$ Party Size: 4 This quest is only available on normal difficulty.
$npcName:11001073$ is determined to become skilled enough to win an 18-on-1 battle. If you want to follow in his footsteps, then you need to start by facing two worthy opponents at once. He demands that you defeat $npcName:23100033$.

$dungeonTitle:20015001$ (Entrance Map: $map:02000175$) Party Recommended (4 players) This quest can only be completed in Normal Mode.
$npc:11001073$ says the reason they train is to fight 18-to-1. Since every evil group in the world is made up of 18 people, they must train until they can handle that many opponents. They add that they have already fought countless 2-to-1 battles, and that anyone who wants to speak with them must have at least that level of skill. They demand that you knock down $npc:23100033$.

quest.name: (Dungeon) Upping the Ante
quest.desc:
$dungeonTitle:20015001$ Entrance: $map:02000175$ Party Size: 4 This quest is only available on normal difficulty.
$npcName:11001073$ is stunned that you not only defeated $npcName:23100033$, but that you did it dozens of times. Now he's bragging that he regularly wins 4-on-1 fights, and that you'll have to do better to reach his level.

$dungeonTitle:20015001$ (Entrance Map: $map:02000175$) Party Recommended (4 players) This quest can only be completed in Normal Mode.
When you say you knocked down $npc:23100033$ dozens of times as requested, $npc:11001073$ flinches. They say they have fought 4-to-1 countless times too, and that to reach the same level as them, you must knock down $npc:23100033$ dozens more times.

quest.name: (Dungeon) Upping the Ante
quest.desc:
$dungeonTitle:20015001$ Entrance: $map:02000175$ Party Size: 4 This quest is only available on normal difficulty.
$npcName:11001073$ is stunned that you not only defeated $npcName:23100033$, but that you did it dozens of times. Now he's bragging that he regularly wins 4-on-1 fights, and that you'll have to do better to reach his level.

quest.name: Dungeon: The Hens in Danger
quest.desc:
$dungeonTitle:25002001$ (Entrance Map: $map:02000087$)
The Monkey Gang, awestruck by the giant snail $npc:24001006$, worship it like a god. The Monkey Gang is preparing a chicken dish to offer $npc:24001006$ to gain its favor. Let's help $npc:11001141$, who is distressed because all their hens have disappeared, by defeating the Monkey Gang and rescuing the hens trapped in cages.
quest.manual: Open the chicken coop doors and rescue all the hens

quest.name: Dungeon: The Hens Have Vanished Again
quest.desc:
$dungeonTitle:25002001$ (Entrance Map: $map:02000087$)
$npc:11001141$'s hens have disappeared again. $npc:24001006$ doesn't seem particularly interested in the chicken dish, but the Monkey Gang is still trying to cook and offer chickens. Let's rescue the kidnapped hens once more and return them to $npc:11001141$.
quest.manual: Open the chicken coop doors and rescue all the hens

quest.name: 작별 인사
quest.desc: $npc:11000293$$pp:는,은$ $map:02000024$$pp:를,을$ 떠나기에 앞서, 평소 친구라 여기던 $npc:11001142$에게 작별 인사를 하고 싶어한다. 하지만, 직접 얼굴을 보고 얘기하면 눈물이 날 것 같다며 대신 인사를 부탁한다.

Before leaving $map:02000024$, $npc:11000293$ wants to say farewell to $npc:11001142$, whom they usually considered a friend. But they say they might cry if they speak face to face, and ask you to say goodbye in their place.

quest.name: The Hardest Thing to Say
quest.desc: $npc:11000293$ is leaving $map:02000024$, but can't bear to say goodbye to his friend $npc:11001142$. He's asked you to deliver the message in his stead.

quest.name: 작별 선물
quest.desc: 겉으로는 퉁명스럽기만 한 $npc:11001142$. $npc:11000293$$pp:가,이$ $map:02000024$$pp:를,을$ 떠나기로 했다는 말에 내심 충격을 받은 것 같다. 어쩔 줄 몰라하던 $npc:11001142$$pp:는,은$ 조심스럽게 $item:30000389$$pp:를,을$ 건넨다. $npc:11000293$에게 작별 선물로 전해 달라는 말과 함께…

$npc:11001142$ is blunt on the outside. When told that $npc:11000293$ decided to leave $map:02000024$, they seem secretly shocked. Not knowing what to do, $npc:11001142$ carefully hands over $item:30000389$. They ask you to deliver it to $npc:11000293$ as a farewell gift…

quest.name: A Parting Gift
quest.desc: $npc:11001142$ acts like a jerk, but he seems shocked to learn $npc:11000293$ is leaving $map:02000024$. He's asked you to deliver a $item:30000389$ to $npc:11000293$ as a parting gift.

quest.name: 변해가는 친구들
quest.desc: 한때 친하게 지냈던 $npc:21091166$의 변한 모습이 안타깝기만 한 $npc:11000298$. 사악한 영혼의 지배를 받게 되자, 몸 색깔이 짙고 어둡게 변했다고 한다. 몸 색깔이 변하자, 성격 또한 포악해졌다는데…… 친구였던 $npc:21091166$$pp:가,이$ 사악한 영혼으로부터 해방되길 바라는 $npc:11000298$. 그의 소원을 들어주자.

quest.name: Friendship's Burden
quest.desc:
$npc:11000298$'s friends, the $npcPlural:21091166$, have been corrupted by some dark force, rendering them violent.
Set the $npcPlural:21091166$ free from their torment, so that they can once again know peace.

$npc:11000298$ feels sorry about how $npc:21091166$, once a close friend, has changed. After coming under the control of an evil spirit, their body color reportedly became dark and deep. When their body color changed, their personality also became violent... $npc:11000298$ hopes their former friend $npc:21091166$ can be freed from the evil spirit. Grant their wish.
quest.name: Changing Friends
굳어가는 숲
quest.desc: 숲의 모든 것들이 딱딱하게 굳어가기 시작한 건 장난감들이 숲에 들어오고 나서부터라고 한다. 숲의 생명체들 모두 처음 보는 장난감들을 마냥 신기해하고 가까이 두고 싶어 했지만, 금세 전염병 퍼지듯 장난감과 같이 딱딱해지고 감정을 잃어가게 됐다고 한다. 숲을 되살리기 위해 장난감들을 없애달라고 부탁하는 $npc:11000298$. 그의 부탁을 들어주자.

quest.name: The Plastic Plague
quest.desc:
After the toys arrived, the forest began to change. The forest-folk, initially intrigued by the toys too were warped into toys themselves.
$npc:11000298$ begs you to get rid of the toys in the hopes that this will allow the forest to recover.

Everything in the forest began hardening after toys entered the forest. All the forest creatures found the unfamiliar toys fascinating and wanted to keep them nearby, but soon, like a spreading disease, they began hardening like toys and losing their emotions. $npc:11000298$ asks you to remove the toys to revive the forest. Grant their request.
quest.name: The Forest Turning Hard
The Start of Ruins Preservation
quest.desc: $map:02000130$—though heavily damaged, the towering walls and village layout remain intact. $npc:11001143$, captivated by the grandeur of $map:02000130$, decides to dedicate themselves to preserving the ruins. Determining that the first priority is to eliminate the monsters destroying the ruins, $npc:11001143$ asks for help. Let's assist and contribute to preserving the ruins.

quest.name: 오늘의 운세
quest.desc: 바닥에 주저 앉아 손 내밀고 있는 폼이 영낙없는 거렁뱅이인 $npc:11001144$. 지나가는 사람을 볼 때마다 점을 봐주겠다며 능청스레 말을 건넨다. 복채도 안 받고, 재미삼아 봐 준다는데 한번 점이나 봐 볼까?

quest.name: Daily Fortune
quest.desc: $npcName:11001144$ looks like a beggar. He smells like a beggar. But he insists that he's really a fortune teller, and he'll tell your fortune for free!

$npc:11001144$ sits on the ground with a hand outstretched, looking exactly like a beggar. Whenever someone passes by, they casually offer to tell their fortune. They say they will not even take a fee and are only doing it for fun. Why not have your fortune told?

quest.name: Ownerless Weapons
quest.desc: $npc:11001148$, a greedy collector who will search every corner of Maple World for exceptional weapons. They covet the various weapons stored in an abandoned, ownerless fortress. Curious whether the weapons that went unmaintained for so long still work, $npc:11001148$ asks you to test-fire the cannons at $map:02000021$.

quest.name: Strong Grip
quest.desc: Traveling with the Allicari, $npcName:11001181$ has experienced and seen a lot of crazy stuff for his young age. One time, he visited an island full of people who climbed everywhere to get around. Maybe you should give it a try.
quest.manual: Use the $skill:20000011$ skill to move 100 m

quest.name: Abyssal Courage
quest.desc: Traveling with the Allicari, $npcName:11001181$ has experienced and seen a lot of crazy stuff for his young age. One time, he visited a village where the warriors entered tiger dens to test their courage. You know of a place scarier than a tiger den...

quest.name: A Soaring Conversation
quest.desc: Traveling with the Allicari, $npcName:11001181$ has experienced and seen a lot of crazy stuff for his young age. One time, he had a chat with a bird while it flew him across a valley. What kind of conversation did he have, anyway...?

quest.name: Greater Heights
quest.desc: Traveling with the Allicari, $npcName:11001181$ has experienced and seen a lot of crazy stuff for his young age. One time, he visited an island where people jumped everywhere to get taller. Would that even work?

quest.name: Hanging Around
quest.desc: Traveling with the Allicari, $npcName:11001181$ has experienced and seen a lot of crazy stuff for his young age. According to him, the strongest man he ever met got that way simply by hanging off a ladder for hours. This could be an easy way to work on your beach bod...
quest.manual: Hang on a ladder for 300 seconds

quest.name: To Catch a Mate
quest.desc: Traveling with the Allicari, $npcName:11001181$ has experienced and seen a lot of crazy stuff for his young age. One time, he visited an island where all the $male:men,female:women$ hung from ropes to attract a mate. Could such an intriguing ritual work in modern society...?
quest.manual: Hang from a rope for 120 seconds

quest.name: Take a Dip
quest.desc: Traveling with the Allicari, $npcName:11001181$ has experienced and seen a lot of crazy stuff for his young age. One time, he visited an island full of people who practically lived in the water. You could probably use a quick bath, yourself.

quest.name: Growth through Adversity
quest.desc: Traveling with the Allicari, $npcName:11001181$ has experienced and seen a lot of crazy stuff for his young age. One time, he learned a secret technique for helping grass grow: stomping the heck out of it. This sounds legit.

quest.name: To Survive a Shipwreck
quest.desc: Traveling with the Allicari, $npcName:11001181$ has experienced and seen a lot of crazy stuff for his young age. According to him, all Allicari are strong swimmers so that they're ready if they ever shipwreck. That's not a bad idea...

quest.name: Keep Low
quest.desc: Traveling with the Allicari, $npcName:11001181$ has experienced and seen a lot of crazy stuff for his young age. One time, he visited an island where the hunters all crawled when they were hunting their prey. Sounds stealthy.

quest.name: Wayfarer's Blues
quest.desc: Traveling with the Allicari, $npcName:11001181$ has experienced and seen a lot of crazy stuff for his young age. He loves to travel, but he feels bad leaving all of his old friends behind. If only there was another way to see far-off places...

quest.name: Finders Keepers
quest.desc: Traveling with the Allicari, $npcName:11001181$ has experienced and seen a lot of crazy stuff for his young age. He's heard there are golden treasure chests hidden all over the place. It won't do for these precious treasures to distract future customers from precious Allicari merchandise! You should help round these treasures up.

quest.name: World in a Hat
quest.desc: Traveling with the Allicari, $npcName:11001181$ has experienced and seen a lot of crazy stuff for his young age. He's heard there are magical hats that will take you to pocket realms, where you can find many fantastical things. You like fantastical things, don't you?

quest.name: $npcName:11000273$
quest.desc: Traveling with the Allicari, $npcName:11001181$ has experienced and seen a lot of crazy stuff for his young age. One time, he lost a fight against a monster and needed to see a doctor to get fixed up. You should get to know $npcName:11000273$ in case you ever need treatment after a bad fight.

quest.name: $npcName:11000274$
quest.desc: Traveling with the Allicari, $npcName:11001181$ has experienced and seen a lot of crazy stuff for his young age. One time, he lost a fight against a monster and needed to see a doctor to get fixed up. You should get to know $npcName:11000274$ in case you ever need treatment after a bad fight.

quest.name: The Safest Bank
quest.desc: Traveling with the Allicari, $npcName:11001181$ has experienced and seen a lot of crazy stuff for his young age. He often has to run errands at the bank, and has been using $map:02000034$ since coming to Tria. It seems he's interested in $map:02000155$…

quest.name: A Blessed Day
quest.desc: Traveling with the Allicari, $npcName:11001181$ has experienced and seen a lot of crazy stuff for his young age. One of his favorite hobbies is clapping, and he hears there's a place nearby that's just great for it. You might as well indulge in his weird hobby and check it out.

quest.name: These City Streets
quest.desc: Traveling with the Allicari, $npcName:11001181$ has experienced and seen a lot of crazy stuff for his young age. He says that losing yourself in a city can wipe away your frustration and sadness. Imagine how effective it would be to lose yourself in <i>six</font> cities!

quest.name: The Best Policy
quest.desc: Traveling with the Allicari, $npcName:11001181$ has experienced and seen a lot of crazy stuff for his young age. One time, he made a stop at a prison colony and it made him devoted to a life of honesty. Maybe you need a reminder of the high price of crime.

quest.name: Fashion in Chains
quest.desc: Traveling with the Allicari, $npcName:11001181$ has experienced and seen a lot of crazy stuff for his young age. According to him, you can probably find a prison jumpsuit if you dig through the trash cans in jail. This strikes you as a sensible course of action.

quest.name: Nothing Is Useless
quest.desc: Traveling with the Allicari, $npcName:11001181$ has experienced and seen a lot of crazy stuff for his young age. According to him, sometimes you'll find something of value in plain wooden chests. You have been known to covet things of value...

quest.name: The Secret to Health
quest.desc: Traveling with the Allicari, $npcName:11001181$ has experienced and seen a lot of crazy stuff for his young age. One time, he visited an island where everybody runs all day. He doesn't know why they did it, but they were probably in great shape.

quest.name: Quick and Convenient
quest.desc: Traveling with the Allicari, $npcName:11001181$ has experienced and seen a lot of crazy stuff for his young age. One time, he visited an island where everybody used taxis to get around. Wait a second! Doesn't this island have taxis?

quest.name: Rest Your Feet
quest.desc: Traveling with the Allicari, $npcName:11001181$ has experienced and seen a lot of crazy stuff for his young age. One time, he visited an island where everybody rode mounts instead of walking. When you really think about it, mounts rule and walking drools.

quest.name: Nature's View
quest.desc: Traveling with the Allicari, $npcName:11001181$ has experienced and seen a lot of crazy stuff for his young age. According to him, the best way to see nature is with your naked eye looking through the lens of a telescope.
quest.manual: Use the binoculars at $map:02000090$ |Use the binoculars at $map:02000172$ |Use the binoculars at $map:02000103$ |Use the binoculars at $map:02000024$

quest.name: See the Sea
quest.desc: Traveling with the Allicari, $npcName:11001181$ has experienced and seen a lot of crazy stuff for his young age. According to him, nothing soothes the furious heart like a nice, long glare at the sea.
quest.manual: Use the binoculars at $map:02000062$ |Use the binoculars at $map:02000067$

quest.name: Cityscapes
quest.desc: Traveling with the Allicari, $npcName:11001181$ has experienced and seen a lot of crazy stuff for his young age. He says that every city has a dark side. Like most things, the best way to see it is with a telescope.
quest.manual: Use the binoculars at $map:02000100$ |Use the binoculars at $map:02000164$ |Use the binoculars at $map:02000273$

quest.name: $item:20000102$ for Your Wounds
quest.desc: Traveling with the Allicari, $npcName:11001181$ has experienced and seen a lot of crazy stuff for his young age. One time, he visited an island that used $item:20000102$ to cure itchy bug bites. You can probably find some in the Land of Darkness.

quest.name: Going for the Gold
quest.desc: Traveling with the Allicari, $npcName:11001181$ has experienced and seen a lot of crazy stuff for his young age. He says that finding a golden treasure chest is no big deal, and that he can do it in his sleep. You've resolved to find one, too—and you'll do it without even being half asleep!

quest.name: The Worst
quest.desc: Traveling with the Allicari, $npcName:11001181$ has experienced and seen a lot of crazy stuff for his young age. According to him, Victoria Island is probably the worst place he's ever been thanks to all the monster. Vanquish monsters and save the local tourism industry!

quest.name: Introduction to Fishing
quest.desc: According to $npc:11000003$, $npc:11000781$ at $map:02000002$ is giving away fishing rods for free. Since who knows when $npc:11000781$ might change their mind, let's hurry and go get one.

quest.name: First Time Feeling the Bite
quest.desc: $npc:11000781$ gives more detailed instructions on how to catch fish. They say it's especially important to keep the bobber at the right height when catching a new type of fish for the first time. Let's remember $npc:11000781$'s advice and try fishing.

quest.name: Fish from Different Waters
quest.desc: $npc:11000781$ says the types of fish you can catch differ depending on the habitat. Let's follow $npc:11000781$'s suggestion and try fishing in the poison pool.
quest.manual: Catch fish in the poison pool at $map:02000002$

quest.name: Dungeon: Why the Water Never Dries
quest.desc:
$dungeonTitle:21010001$ (Entrance Map: $map:02010084$) Party Recommended (4 players)
The villagers regularly offer sacrifices to the ruler of the underground cave to keep the waterway running through their village from drying up. No one has ever seen him or truly knows anything about him, but they obey without question out of fear that the underground water source might be cut off. But now they have no more livestock to offer as sacrifices, and are at a loss... They say catching monsters to offer could avert the crisis, so let's go hunting on their behalf.

quest.name: Dungeon: Why They Can't Sit Still
quest.desc:
$dungeonTitle:21010001$ (Entrance Map: $map:02010084$) Party Recommended (4 players)
$npc:24001309$ thinks the villagers deliberately sent a hero to teach them a lesson. Furious, they demanded even more sacrifices from the villagers. $npc:11001437$ and the villagers ask you to give $npc:24001309$ a proper beating so they won't threaten them anymore. Seeing them trembling in fear is pitiful, so let's help them once again.

quest.name: Dungeon: The Bugs' Lair
quest.desc:
$dungeonTitle:20017001$ (Entrance Map: $map:02010019$) Party Recommended (4 players)
$map:02010019$ acquired the villagers' small swimming pool. They abandoned the existing pool and built a state-of-the-art water park next to it. As time passed, the stagnant water in the neglected pool rotted and created a terrible stench. Eventually the smell even drifted into the new water park... $map:02010019$ finally decided to clean $map:02010050$. But the place is already a haven for bugs. Cleaning is impossible without eliminating the bugs first.

quest.name: Dungeon: The Bugs' Unity
quest.desc:
$dungeonTitle:20017001$ (Entrance Map: $map:02010019$) Party Recommended (4 players)
They expected that defeating $npc:23190066$ would cause the followers to lose morale and leave, but instead they've banded together even tighter, and it seems bugs from other areas have flocked here as well. It's doubtful whether fighting the bugs is the only answer, but let's honor $npc:11001444$'s request.

quest.name: Scary Cute
quest.desc: Most adults know to avoid the snakes in $map:02010022$, but it usually takes a snakebite or two for the local children to learn their lesson. If only the $npcNamePlural:21000392$ and $npcNamePlural:21000400$ weren't so dang cute!

quest.name: $npcName:11001456$'s Message
quest.desc: $npcName:11001456$ asked me to find her husband, who's looking for $itemPlural:30000505$ in $map:02010022$. Since you already gathered the petals, there's no need for him to wrestle with any more snakes.

quest.name: Rock Formations of $map:02010022$
quest.desc: $npcName:11001457$ spotted a telescope in $map:02010022$, but he can't reach it. With your $skill:20000021$, you should be able to get to it and take a look at the island's landscape.

quest.name: A Big Name in Begging
quest.desc: $map:02010012$ may still be under construction, but $npcName:11001466$ has already claimed his begging spot. Unfortunately, the robots keep giving him a hard time. Punish them for hurting $npcName:11001466$.

quest.name: Construction Unending
quest.desc: $npcName:11001466$ says that the work around $map:02010012$ is going too slowly. The sooner construction finishes, the sooner he can get to the good begging!

quest.name: Construction Check-up
quest.desc: If you really want to know how the construction is going, you need to talk to $npcName:11001468$. Apparently he's late sending his status report to $npcName:11001467$.

quest.name: Scattered Plan
quest.desc: $npcName:11001468$ would just love to give you a report on the construction status, but he misplaced his $item:30000506$. Get his copy back from one of the robot workers. You may need to use force…

quest.name: Get Rich Quick
quest.desc: $npcName:11001470$ was kicked out of his family home for trying to cheat his own brother. While he's just barely getting by, it seems he has big plans—and he wants you to be part of them.
quest.manual: Jump from $map:02010039$ |Defeat the robot workers in $map:02010039$

quest.name: Perpetual Repairs
quest.desc: The bridge is new, but it's already in need of constant repair. One of the bridge supports is even leaning to the side. Maybe $npcName:11001470$ knows why.

quest.name: Mile-high Fog
quest.desc:
You can clearly from one end of the bridge in $map:02010039$ to the other, but the middle is hidden in thick fog. There's a local rumor that an evil dragon lives in the fog, damaging the bridge and scaring the local children. Others say that the bridge is haunted by the ghosts of workers who died.
$npcName:11001469$ came out here to check it out. Maybe he knows the true story.
quest.manual: Climb the arch above $map:02010039$ and look around

quest.name: The Brave Friend
quest.desc:
There's a lot of money pouring in from $map:02010002$ to develop $map:02010063$. Many locals of the surrounding areas have come to work high-paying construction jobs, but since the robots all went insane, most of the workers are now trying to escape with their lives.
$npcName:11001401$ climbed up the bridge in a desperate attempt to evade the bots, but got stuck halfway. His friend $npcName:11001400$ is trying to get him some food to calm his nerves.
quest.manual: Get $itemPlural:30000507$ from the supply packages in $map:02010038$

quest.name: Part-time Trap
quest.desc: $npcName:11001401$ seems to have calmed down a bit. He wants you to clear a path through the crazed robots so he can escape. When you're done, ask $npcName:11001400$ if he's given any thought to $npcName:11001401$'s idea.

quest.name: The Best Business Plan
quest.desc: $npcName:11001381$ has great plans for the future of $map:02010063$, but first he needs to win over the locals. A picture of the desolate, unexploited mountain peaks would be just the thing—but the rampaging robots make taking pictures a bit challenging. This job is right up your alley.

quest.name: It's Just Business
quest.desc: $npcName:11001381$ has finished his $item:30000509$, and it's time to share it with to $npcName:11001386$ of $map:02010063$. The villagers may not respond well to being asked to relocate while the development is going on...

quest.name: The Elder Approves
quest.desc: $npcName:11001386$ is satisfied with the $item:30000509$. He believes that this development can bring the region into the modern world. Take his $item:30000510$ to $npcName:11001382$.

quest.name: The Noisy Pioneer Merchant
quest.desc: $npc:11001310$ came to $map:02010002$ on a mission. The noisy $npc:11001369$ who keeps bothering them seems to be getting on their nerves. Let's talk to $npc:11001369$ and find out what they want.

quest.name: Feet on the Wall
quest.desc: $npcName:11001369$ feels bad for the city folk, who live hurried and serious lives. He suggests you do something extraordinary so you don't get too serious, yourself. You can start by climbing a wall with the $skill:20000011$ skill.
quest.manual: Use the $skill:20000011$ skill to move 100 m

quest.name: Flight of Fancy
quest.desc: $npcName:11001369$ feels bad for the city folk, who live hurried and serious lives. He suggests you do something extraordinary so you don't get too serious, yourself. You can start by flying the friendly skies.

$npcName:11001369$ feels bad for the city folk, who live hurried and serious lives. He suggests you do something extraordinary to spice things up. Start by challenging $npcName:24001507$ in $map:02000337$.
