quest.name: Desert Outlaws
quest.desc: $npcName:11001369$ feels bad for the city folk, who live hurried and serious lives. He suggests you do something extraordinary to spice things up. Start by teaching the monsters of Karkar Island a lesson in manners.
quest.manual: Defeat the monsters of Karkar Island

quest.name: Celebratory Gathering
quest.desc: $npcName:11001292$, $npcName:11001297$, and $npcName:11001294$ are celebrating having safely completed their missions as dragon knights. Let's join the gathering.

quest.name: By Neccessity, Not Chance
quest.desc: The Huntis Federation and the dragon knights, two groups destined to unite, completed the missions together. $npcName:11001297$ is happy to have met $npcName:11001292$ and $npcName:11001294$ through this event. I've heard that $npcName:11001292$ has a similar story of how he met $npcName:11001294$...

quest.name: Grand Opening
quest.desc: $npcName:11001292$ recalled the grand opening of $map:02010053$ and $npcName:11001294$ described the circumstances of that day.
quest.manual: Speak with $npcName:11001493$ and go to the past|Speak with $npcName:11001499$ of the past

quest.name: The Customer Is Right
quest.desc: $npcName:11001294$ continued to explain that because he was the only customer, he was able to eat without stopping. However, after he appeared, $npcName:11001292$ couldn't handle cooking alone... $npcName:11001292$ finished the story for $npcName:11001294$ of that nightmarish day...
quest.manual: Speak with $npcName:11001498$ and go to the past|Observe the situation of that day

quest.name: Origins of Fate
quest.desc: From the mark on his wrist, $npcName:11001292$ recognized that $npcName:11001294$ was a dragon knight just like him. $npcName:11001297$ also brought up the first day she met $npcName:11001292$.

quest.name: Second Fate
quest.desc: $npcName:11001297$ suffered from an unknown source of pain until $npcName:11001292$ recognized that she was a dragon knight after hearing about her symptoms.

quest.name: You Too Shall Become Light
quest.desc: $npcName:11001292$ is curious about the other contents written in $item:30000515$. Let's go to $map:52010022$ and bring back $item:30000515$.

quest.name: 몸을 숨긴 이유
quest.desc: 무심결에 $npc:21000262$$pp:와,과$ $npc:21000264$ 앞에서 내뱉은 한마디 때문에 위험에 처한 $npcName:11001537$. 양파를 튀겨 먹으면 맛있다고 말했다는데… 숨어있는 $npcName:11001537$$pp:가,이$ 밖으로 나올 수 있게 $npc:21000262$$pp:와,과$ $npc:21000264$$pp:를,을$ 쫓아내자.

quest.name: $npcName:11001537$ the Indelicate
quest.desc:
$npcName:11001537$'s unsavory word-choice has proven offensive to onionkind, and landed him in something of a pickle.
Drive off the outraged $npcPlural:21000262$ and $npcPlural:21000264$ so that he can escape.

$npcName:11001537$ is in danger because of a careless remark made in front of $npc:21000262$ and $npc:21000264$. They apparently said fried onions taste good... Drive away $npc:21000262$ and $npc:21000264$ so the hidden $npcName:11001537$ can come outside.

quest.name: 토르하라의 눈물
quest.desc: 요리대회 출전을 눈앞에 둔 상태에서 요리 재료를 구하기 위해 이곳에 왔다는 $npcName:11001537$. $npcName:11000285$의 눈물이 모여 고인 샘물에서 물을 길어다 음식을 만들면, 먹은 사람 모두 음식에 반하게 된다고 한다. $npcName:11001537$$pp:를,을$ 위해 샘물을 길어다 주자.
quest.manual: $npcName:11000285$$pp:가,이$ 몸 담그고 있는 샘물을 물병에 담은 후 물병 챙기기

quest.name: Tasty Tasty Tears
quest.desc:
$npcName:11001537$ wouldn't leave even if he could—not until he collects some spring water made from $npcName:11000285$'s tears.
Allegedly, any who consume food cooked in the tears will instantly fall in love with the dish. You should go collect spring water for $npcName:11001537$ so that he stops riling up the local onion populace.
quest.manual: Fill the bottle with water from $npcName:11000285$'s spring

quest.desc: $npcName:11001537$ came here to gather cooking ingredients with a cooking contest just ahead. They say if you draw water from the spring formed by $npcName:11000285$'s tears and cook with it, everyone who eats the food will fall in love with it. Draw spring water for $npcName:11001537$.
quest.manual: Fill a bottle with the spring water $npcName:11000285$ is soaking in, then take the bottle

quest.name: 토르하라여, 사랑을 이뤄주오
quest.desc: 이룰 수 없는 사랑도 $npcName:11000285$에게 말하면 모두 이루어진다는 소문을 듣고 이곳을 찾았다는 $npcName:11001538$. 하지만 $npcName:11000285$$pp:는,은$ 소원을 이뤄줄 능력이 없다며 $npcName:11001538$$pp:를,을$ 돌려보냈다고 한다. 힘들게 이곳까지 온 만큼 얻는 것 없이 돌아가기가 아쉬운 $npcName:11001538$. 그녀를 위해 $npcName:11000285$$pp:를,을$ 만나보자.

$npcName:11001538$ came here after hearing a rumor that if you tell $npcName:11000285$ about even an impossible love, it will come true. But $npcName:11000285$ apparently sent $npcName:11001538$ away, saying they had no power to grant wishes. After coming all this way, $npcName:11001538$ feels disappointed to leave with nothing. Meet $npcName:11000285$ for her.

quest.name: The Hopeless Romantic
quest.desc:
$npcName:11001538$ traveled long and far to find $npcName:11000285$, after hearing he held the power to transform unrequited love into the requited kind.
Sadly for her, $npcName:11000285$ refused to help her. Perhaps you can talk to $npcName:11000285$ on her behalf and change the old turtle's mind.

quest.name: 마음 속 응원만
quest.desc: 자신의 사랑도 지키지 못했는데 다른 이의 사랑에 무슨 힘이 돼 줄 수 있겠느냐며, 자신을 둘러싼 소문은 헛소문이라고 말하는 $npcName:11000285$. 이제 더는 소문에 휘둘려 자신을 귀찮게 하는 이가 없길 바라는 듯하다.

$npcName:11000285$ says that since they could not even protect their own love, how could they help anyone else's, and that the rumors surrounding them are nonsense. They seem to hope no one will bother them anymore after being swayed by rumors.

quest.name: A Self-Help Story
quest.desc: $npcName:11000285$ says that the rumors about his powers over love are false. He is merely a sad old turtle, tired of others coming to remind him what he has lost.

quest.name: Looking for a Helping Hand
quest.desc: $npcName:11000221$ is looking for someone to help them. Let's meet $npcName:11000221$ and ask what kind of help they need.

quest.name: Without Anyone Knowing
quest.desc: A message has arrived to check a secret directive left on a rundown desk in $map:03000135$. Who sent it, and what does it say?

quest.name: The Mission Continues
quest.desc: $npcName:11000614$ is said to be waiting in $map:03000135$. What mission awaits…

quest.name: Wei Hong's Ulterior Motives
quest.desc: While everyone lamented the cancellation of the royal audience, one person was smiling — $npcName:11000251$. According to $npcName:11001690$, $npcName:11000251$ had bribed the royal officials to embezzle or purchase cheaply the items rendered useless by the cancellation.

quest.name: The Two-Faced Nelph
quest.desc: Now that it's known $npcName:11000492$ was involved in the armory theft, embezzling royal audience items has become much harder. How should we appease $npcName:11000251$, who will be furious that the plan has fallen apart…

quest.name: Nelph's Whereabouts
quest.desc: Because of the armory theft caused by $npcName:11000492$, the Black Star's plan to embezzle the royal audience items has fallen through. Unless we capture $npcName:11000492$ and make them kneel before $npcName:11000251$, there's no telling where $npcName:11000251$'s wrath will turn. Let's quickly track down $npcName:11000492$.

quest.name: Black House
quest.desc: $npcName:11001677$ says it was very noisy during the construction of $map:52000034$, making guard duty difficult. For whatever reason, they say it's a relief that the construction has stopped. Let's head to the place $npcName:11001677$ told us about.

quest.name: What Nelf Left Behind
quest.desc: We followed the crumpled note to $map:52000037$ in $map:02000043$… but unfortunately, $npc:11000492$ was dead. Why would $npc:11000492$ be dead in a place like this? What could have happened to him? Might there be a clue nearby to unravel the mysteries surrounding his corruption and death? Let's collect ourselves and carefully search the area around $npc:11000492$.

quest.name: A New Clue
quest.desc: After hearing about $npc:11000492$'s death and the mysterious notebook found nearby, $npc:11000169$ asked you to report your findings directly to $npc:11000119$. Let's go meet $npcName:11000119$ in $map:02000001$.
quest.manual: Get the mysterious notebook back from $npc:11000169$ in $map:02000001$

quest.name: Jabez's Summons
quest.desc: $npc:11001682$ was waiting for the Gray Wolf in $map:52000034$. Was there something urgent to say?

quest.name: A Thorn in the Eye
quest.desc: It's no secret in $map:02000100$ that the Black Star is distributing $item:20000046$ and $item:20000015$. Moreover, no one seems to be raising any objections. Only the Dark Wind finds it objectionable and keeps picking fights over it…

quest.name: Black Star's Secret Member
quest.desc: $npcName:11001674$ relays the boss's orders to the Gray Wolf. If any unusual activity is detected while frequenting Darkwind, report it to Black Star immediately.

quest.name: Surveillance Target
quest.desc: $npcName:11000251$ hands a notebook to the Gray Wolf. It seems to be a notebook carried by a Darkwind member. What could be written in it?
quest.manual: Double-click $item:39000050$ in your inventory to check its contents

quest.name: Darkwind Orders
quest.desc: I've been told Dark Wind Captain $npcName:11000044$ is looking for me. Let's head to $map:02000152$ in $map:02000100$.

quest.name: A Routine Summons
quest.desc: $npc:11001682$ summons the Gray Wolf to $map:52000034$ just when you'd almost forgotten. It doesn't seem like there's anything specific to say, though…

quest.name: Jacy's Summons
quest.desc: $npcName:11000515$ welcomes the Gray Wolf visiting $map:02000216$. What did they want to talk about?

quest.name: What She Wants to Say
quest.desc: $npcName:11000515$ expresses doubt about Humples being named as the culprit in the theft of the royal audience items.

quest.name: A Lonely Secret
quest.desc: I've been told Dark Wind Captain $npcName:11000044$ is looking for me. Let's head to $map:02000152$ in $map:02000100$.

quest.name: New Orders
quest.desc: A building managed by Beyond Link has been discovered in the Dark Land. Join $npcName:11001678$ and $npcName:11001686$'s group to investigate the building.
quest.manual: Go to $map:52000038$ in $map:03000134$ and eliminate the threats

quest.name: Suspicious Warehouse
quest.desc: $npcName:11001678$ finds it suspicious that an apparently abandoned warehouse has a well-equipped security system. What information can we obtain here? And what information is $npcName:11000251$ after?

quest.name: A Meaningless Clue
quest.desc: While examining the security robot parts in the warehouse, $npcName:11001678$ notices a familiar place name written on one of the components. Will going there yield what we're looking for?

quest.name: In My Absence
quest.desc: It's said that orders have come down from the Black Star to investigate $map:52000039$. $npcName:11001679$ and $npcName:11001687$ have already left, so let's hurry to $map:52000039$.
quest.manual: Go to $map:52000039$ in $map:03000145$ and eliminate the threats

quest.name: Shining Camaraderie in a Moment of Crisis
quest.desc: $npcName:11001679$ is said to be in danger. $npcName:11001687$ urges with a desperate voice to go rescue $npcName:11001679$…

quest.name: A Thorough Investigation
quest.desc: All threats in $map:52000039$ seem to have been eliminated. Let's investigate the interior in earnest.

quest.name: Not My Place to Intervene
quest.desc: $npcName:11000515$ says $npcName:11000251$ is looking for you and to head to $map:02000156$.
You arrived at $map:63000038$, the place where the back-alley people were supposedly taken. You are worried whether they are alive, so hurry and rescue them.
quest.name: The One Blocking the Way

quest.desc: According to $npcName:11001782$, the back-alley people are trapped in $map:63000039$. Hurry there and free them.
quest.name: Searching for the Back Alley People

quest.desc: To keep the Guidance out of danger, and to learn who you are, you can no longer turn away from Beyond Link and Kandura. Do not hesitate. Enter $map:63000038$.
Leave the injured $npcName:11001789$, who was hurt in your place, and face $npcName:11001780$.
$npcName:11001791$ says there is something they want to show you. Follow them to $map:63000040$.
quest.name: A New Family
Popularity
quest.desc: $npcName:11000076$ needs your attention urgently. What a burden it is to be so popular!

quest.name: Settling the Ranks
quest.desc: Though $npcName:11000044$ has left Dark Wind, his agents remain in Dark Wind and the army. You must track down his allies and remove them from the ranks. Meet with $npc:11000119$ and come up with a plan.

quest.name: Scene of the Crime
quest.desc: It's time to root out $npcName:11000044$'s spies. Search $map:52000073$ for clues.

quest.name: A Careful Search
quest.desc: Search the $map:52000073$ carefully to see if $npcName:11000044$ left any evidence behind. Start with the desk.

quest.name: A Hidden Place
quest.desc: Everything is not always what it seems. As $npcName:11000044$ had a hidden side, the $map:52000073$ may also be hiding something.

quest.name: Accomplice
quest.desc: Someone is covering $npcName:11000044$'s tracks. Ask $npcName:11000215$ if there have been any other visitors to the office.

quest.name: Cold Sweat
quest.desc: $npcName:11000215$ denies being a follower of $npcName:11000044$. You'll have to keep looking for suspects...

quest.name: The List
quest.desc: The charred documents that you found contain a list of people who have crossed $npcName:11000044$ and their location. Much of it is illegible, but you can just make out the words "$map:52000075$."

quest.name: Criminal Protection
quest.desc: $npcName:11000526$ may be a criminal, but he still deserves a fair trial. Make sure that he's safe and secure in the $map:02000134$.

quest.name: The Next Target
quest.desc: You weren't able to save $npcName:11000526$, but $npcName:11000064$ is also on $npcName:11000044$'s list. Make sure that he's safe.

quest.name: Increased Guard
quest.desc: You've let the guard know that $npcName:11000064$ may be in danger. That should be enough... right?

quest.name: A Difficult Rumor
quest.desc: It seems that $npcName:11000266$ has something to say.

quest.name: Reassuring the Ranks
quest.desc: To help bolster morale, $npcName:11000076$ suggests making $npcName:11000064$ the leader of Dark Wind. However, $npcName:11000266$ isn't sure if the other members would agree with this idea…

quest.name: The Leader of Dark Wind
quest.desc: I must first find out if $npcName:11000064$ is even interested in becoming the leader of Dark Wind.

quest.name: A Worthy Proposition
quest.desc: $npcName:11000064$ suggests that you ask $npcName:11000006$ to be the new leader of Dark Wind, instead.

quest.name: The Bait
quest.desc: Humblis has been investigating $npcName:11000044$'s activities on their own, and they think they've found the members of Dark Wind who are loyal to him. They have a plan…

quest.name: Misdirection
quest.desc: Set the trap by feeding false information to $npcName:11000215$, who happens to be a terrible gossip.

quest.name: Cleaning House
quest.desc: It's time to spring the trap on $npcName:11000044$'s spies. Defeat $npcNamePlural:29000146$ in the $map:52000070$.

quest.name: Elated Victory
quest.desc:
Now that $npcName:11000044$'s spies have been captured, the members of Humblis are going to rejoin Dark Wind.
Deliver this news to the guard.

quest.name: Too Soon to Celebrate
quest.desc: $npcName:11000064$ is curious about the news of $npcName:11000006$ and $npcName:11000044$'s spies. Bring him up to date.

quest.name: Strange Disappearance
quest.desc: There's urgency in $npc:11000076$'s voice. What does he have to say?

quest.name: Taken Away
quest.desc: $npcName:11000076$ believes that $npcName:11000523$ was kidnapped. It seems like a trap for $npcName:11000064$—one that he willingly jumped into. Make sure he isn't jumping into the trap alone.
quest.manual: Enter the $map:52000072$ at the $map:02000146$ and find $npcName:11001915$

quest.name: Her Reasons
quest.desc: It seems that $npcName:11000523$ left with $npcName:11000044$ of her own free will. $npcName:11000064$ is sure she must have had a reason, but the guard would never understand. Why don't you just tell them that she's gone on a... a trip?

quest.name: Getting Lennon
quest.desc: $npcName:11000064$ has yet to return. $npcName:11000266$ wants to discuss the matter of Dark Wind's new leader with him. Go find him.

quest.name: Losing Lennon
quest.desc: $npcName:11000064$ is nowhere to be found. Wouldn't $npcName:11000006$ know where he went?

quest.name: Low Profile
quest.desc: $npcName:11000006$ has an idea about how to find $npcName:11000064$ more quickly.

quest.name: A Kind of Lead
quest.desc: Since $npcName:11000006$ can't afford to make any waves in the search for $npcName:11000064$, he wants you to reach out to one of his less conventional sources. Meet the informant at the $map:03000103$.

quest.name: Searching Sight
quest.desc: $npcName:11001238$ will show you the way to $npcName:11000064$. Of course, she needs you to fetch ingredients for her first.
quest.manual: Get $item:30000614$ from $npcName:40000145$ in $map:03000060$ |Get $item:30000615$ from $npcName:40000128$ in $map:03000024$ |Get $item:30000616$ from $npcName:40000126$ in $map:03000101$

quest.name: An Unseen Threat
quest.desc:
It seems that $npcName:11000064$ is in trouble. Perhaps $npcName:11001238$ will send you to his side.
If you don't want to speak to $npcName:11001238$, you can take the temporary portal to the $map:52000076$, instead.
quest.complete: Go to $map:52000068$ from $map:02000349$ and speak with $npcName:11001917$

quest.name: Guard Captain's Lament
quest.desc: $npcName:11000119$ thanks you for saving $map:02000001$. He looks like he's aged ten years...

quest.name: Rob from the Rich
quest.desc: Empty out the safe before the coppers arrive.
quest.manual: Move $item:30000776$ from the safe to the exit

quest.name: Give to the Poor
quest.desc: Share the money you took from $map:52000128$ with the poor of $map:52000129$.
quest.manual: Give money to $npcName:11003277$ |Give money to $npcName:11003278$ |Give money to $npcName:11003279$

quest.name: Holy Mission
quest.desc: The soldiers who went out with $npcName:11003328$ all returned from the mission with grave injuries. Fulfill your duties as a Priest and heal them.

quest.name: Picking Up
quest.desc: Clean up the trash in $map:52000145$ for $npcName:11003189$.

quest.name: Quiver Basket Cleanup
quest.desc: While $npcName:11003189$ gets some "well deserved" sleep, move the quiver baskets into position for today's practice.

quest.name: The Fallen Squire
quest.desc: Carry $npcName:11003398$'s unconscious body to $npcName:11003400$.

quest.name: A Friend in Need
quest.desc: If you don't hurry, $npcName:11003399$ will die of terminal nausea! Get help from the priest, $npcName:11003402$.

quest.name: Homebound
quest.desc: Jonathan Button reached out to say that he'd found something interesting he wants you to see. It's been a while since you've been back home, why not go see what he has to say? Meet with Jonathan in $map:52000156$.

quest.name: An Unexpected Reunion
quest.desc: Jonathan called you into the $map:52000155$—a former Dark Wind hideout. Thankfully, they've abandoned the place. Apparently he's been living there with some associates. Well, might as well go inside and see what he wants to show you.

quest.name: Fresh-Squeezed Joy
quest.desc: $npcName:11003272$... $npcName:11003273$... You thought they were dead. But here they are waiting for you at the Jazz Club. They said $npcName:11001927$ tried to kill them, too, but failed to finish the job. All that matters now is you've been reunited with your old crew!

quest.name: An Important Discussion
quest.desc: With $npcName:11003272$ and $npcName:11003273$ in a sugar coma after your juice party, Jonathan becomes very serious. He wants to talk to you about something. Meet him in the basement.

quest.name: An Old Grudge
quest.desc: You followed Jonathan to the basement, where he shows you a photograph that opens some old wounds, and causes you to adjust your priorities. See what else Jonathan has to say.

quest.name: The Call of Vengeance
quest.desc: Jonathan showed you a picture of $npcName:11001927$, the man who betrayed you and attempted to kill you and your friends. It seems he's been illegally dealing in lapenshards. With this information in hand, you begin to form a plan to take your revenge.

quest.name: The Appointed Time
quest.desc: Your training is complete and the power of the lapenshard is yours. The question remains: are you ready to take down $npcName:11001927$? Talk to Jonathan and see what he thinks.

quest.name: Nothing Comes Free
quest.desc: With your newfound power, Jonathan believes you just might be up to the challenge of defeating $npcName:11001927$. But if you're going to have your revenge, you'll need to actually find the guy. Lucky for you, Jonathan has a plan! Listen to what he has to say.

quest.name: The Debt Comes Due
quest.desc: Jonathan says that his help was not free, but rather comes at a steep cost... Though you are initially filled with dread, it turns out his terms are actually quite reasonable. In a way, they've already been paid. Speak with Jonathan.

quest.name: Such Sweet Sorrow
quest.desc: The cost of Jonathan's help was to be his friend? Little did he realize, you were friends from the start. Now, a new mission awaits you at the Frontier Foundation. It's time to say goodbye to your friends once again—the old, and the "new."

quest.name: Recovering Lost Memories
quest.desc: In pursuit of your lost memories, you close your eyes and think of $map:52000156$. There in your mindscape, you recall a conversation you had with $npcName:11000006$.

quest.name: Memories of the Past
quest.desc: The lapenshard $npcName:11000006$ gave you was being studied by Dark Wind. Owing to its connection to the red lapenta which controls time, he's optimistic the crystal can help you recover your lost memories.

quest.name: Mystery Man
quest.desc: $npcName:11000006$ gave you something called a lapenshard and a report on what Dark Wind had learned about them. His hope was that you might be able to use it to recover your lost memories, and it seems to be working! You find yourself whirled away to a different place in the midst of calamity.

quest.name: Distorted Memories
quest.desc: You found yourself in a burning, but when you approached the flames you couldn't feel their heat. It was a memory, and in it you witnessed $npcName:11003185$ speaking with a $npcName:11004044$. You were not prepared for what came next.

quest.name: The Forgotten Truth
quest.desc: After witnessing the $npcName:11004044$'s death at the hands of $npcName:11003185$, your head begins to reel. That child next to the $npcName:11003915$... Is that you? A murderous rage overtakes you.

quest.name: An Origin Remembered
quest.desc: As the $npcName:11003915$ breathed his last, a murderous rage washed over you. $npcName:11003185$ said something about seeing if you have what it takes. What did he mean by that? You awaken from your memory to a startling realization.

quest.name: Muscle Memory
quest.desc: Awakening from your memory, you come to the startling realization that your whole life has been spent in service of the man who murdered your father—the monster known as $npcName:11003185$. There was more to the memory, though. Something that may help you quell your burning desire for vengeance.

quest.name: A Lethal Technique
quest.desc: After reliving one of your lost memories, a thought strikes you. The technique $npcName:11003185$ used is one that he never taught you. $npcName:11003185$ may have taught you everything you know, but apparently not everything he knows. If you can master this skill, perhaps you can use it when you give $npcName:11003185$ his just desserts.

quest.name: Exacting Vengeance
quest.desc: The skill $npcName:11003185$ used in your memory seems to have been intentionally hidden from you. Perhaps he feared you would use it against him. Now that you've memorized it, it's time to resume your journey.

quest.name: Cruelty and Justice
quest.desc: Now that you have mastered $npcName:11003185$'s secret technique, it's time to figure out where to go from here. Since he provided you with the lapenshard in the first place, you decide to speak with $npcName:11000006$ and bring him up to speed on what happened.

quest.name: As the Crow Flies
quest.desc: After emerging from your memory and mastering a new technique, you returned to $npcName:11000006$. It seems that $npcName:11000006$ was also familiar with the technique, but resolved never to use it because it was too cruel. He also filled you in on the latest intel regarding $npcName:11003185$.

quest.name: Renewed Pursuit
quest.desc: $npcName:11000006$ says that Dark Wind has received word of $npcName:11003185$'s recent movements. As much as you want to track down $npcName:11003185$ and end his life, you can't do that without finding him first. Talk to $npcName:11000006$.

quest.name: Introspection
quest.desc: On a visit to Lith Harbor, you stumbled over some crystals sitting on the ground and just about blew your top. Maybe if you take a moment to reflect on your thoughts, you can calm down a little.

quest.name: A Familiar Face
quest.desc: After a conversation with your $npcName:11003918$ that sounded suspiciously like $npcName:11003920$, who should you encounter but your adoptive sister herself! But what is she doing here? Speak with $npcName:11003920$.

quest.name: A Not-So-Stupid Stone
quest.desc: Wait a second! How did $npcName:11003920$ know you were in Lith?! Is she stalking you? $npcName:11003920$ said she paid some information broker to find you... Was she that worried about you? Maybe it's time you told $npcName:11003920$ about what's going on with you.

quest.name: Awakened Rage
quest.desc: $npcName:11003920$ seemed unsurprised to hear what you had to say. In fact, she seems to know more about that dumb rock than you do! Even though sisters are annoying and should be ignored as a general rule, maybe you should listen to what $npcName:11003920$ has to say.

quest.name: Anger Management
quest.desc: $npcName:11003920$ says that stone you've been kicking around is something called a lapenshard. Apparently they've been making people stronger and giving them new abilities. Wow! It's a good thing it hasn't exploded or anything. Anyway, she says maybe that lapenwhatever's started to wake up the god of rage's power which has been slumbering within you. Welp, now what? Speak with your smarty-pants sister.

quest.name: Whack-An-Island
quest.desc: While you were away from $map:52000161$, $npcName:11003920$ thumbed through your old man's books on the god of rage. She has this crazy theory that if you can master the abilities the god of rage used, maybe you can control your rage too. That would be awesome! And at the very least, it's an excuse to break things. So you hopped on a boat with $npcName:11003920$, and off you go!

quest.name: Mastery of Rage
quest.desc: Hoping to learn to control your anger and unlock the power of the god of rage without unleashing untold destruction, $npcName:11003920$ develops a training regimen for you. After destroying the many—thankfully unoccupied—outlying islands around Rien, your training is complete. Now what? Talk to $npcName:11003920$.

quest.name: An Upscale Affair
quest.desc: With your training complete and your rage under slightly better control, it's time to figure out what comes next. Thankfully, $npcName:11003920$ has a plan!

quest.name: The Real Agenda
quest.desc: Though your training is over, your work has just begun. Apparently all this was to help get your anger under control so you can go somewhere fancy. When all's said and done, maybe you'll find the old man. Talk to $npcName:11003920$ to learn more.

quest.name: We'll Meet Again
quest.desc:
$npcName:11003920$ told you about the "Frontier Foundation," an organization responsible for regulating the lapenshards. She says you have a responsibility to use your power to help the world, but it sure seems like her main goal is tracking down the old man. Still, that's fine by you. You'll go to the Frontier Foundation, learn about the lapenshards, and get any help they can offer toward finding the geezer.
Before you go, you should probably say goodbye to $npcName:11003920$.

quest.name: A Barbecue Among Friends
quest.desc:
After a long journey, a letter from an old friend brings you back to Ellinel. What could be better than a barbecue with your best bud Kate?!
You and $npcName:11003925$ should catch up!

quest.name: Stoking the Flames of Friendship
quest.desc: You're having a lovely visit with your old friend $npcName:11003925$, but for some reason your dinner isn't roasting properly! $npcName:11003925$ seems really worked up about something. She must be hungry.

quest.name: One-Track Mind
quest.desc: $npcName:11003925$ has been talking to herself for quite some time... Something about Professor Einos? Why isn't this stupid meat cooking faster?!

quest.name: Crunchy Crystal Candy
quest.desc: Kate's been nagging you about something again, but it was hard to pay attention with your stomach grumbling like that. But what's that shiny thing over there, a bit of tasty rock candy?!

quest.name: Power Overwhelming
quest.desc: You found a tasty-looking piece of rock candy on the ground, and your hunger got the better of you. Forget the five second rule, a wizard's gotta eat!

quest.name: Mana Overload
quest.desc: You feel a little funny after munching on your ground-candy. Perhaps something to do with that explosion? $npcName:11003925$ seems worried, but what ever for? Sure eating off the floor was kinda gross, but you were starving!

quest.name: A Wizard Reborn
quest.desc: So eating the floor-candy might not have been a such a good idea... It was a GREAT one. Sure it was weird that the mana overflowing from your body created an explosion that rocked the whole forest, but you feel AMAZING! Still, Kate seems really worried. You should talk to her.

quest.name: What Do You Mean it Wasn't Candy?
quest.desc: Contrary to you, who feels totally awesome, $npcName:11003925$ is worried. She took you back to Ellinel for a checkup, but you don't know what the big deal is. See what she has to say.

quest.name: Word of Mouth
quest.desc: According to Kate, what you thought was carelessly misplaced rock candy was actually a powerful magical object called a lapenshard. Apparently they make people stronger? Given your strange new situation, Kate proposes an idea.

quest.name: What's a Wizard to Do?
quest.desc:
Now that you're a lapenshard-enhanced wizard, $npcName:11003925$ suggests you join the Frontier Foundation to learn more about the lapenshards. Apparently the Frontier Foundation is an organization responsible for researching the lapenshards.
It could be worth considering. See what else Kate has to say!

quest.name: Professor Kate
quest.desc:
Inspired by your battles against the forces of darkness, $npcName:11003925$ wonders aloud if she has a bigger part to play. After all, with the power of the lapenshards, any wizard could become strong enough to join the fight!
Wait... Kate's still talking?

quest.name: If You Say So
quest.desc: Kate says you should join the Frontier Foundation, and who are you to disagree? She's a pretty smart girl. That means it's time to say bye bye $npcName:11003925$ for now!

quest.name: A Much-Needed Break
quest.desc: After a long and difficult journey, you decide to pay a visit to your old home on Halo Mountain in the hopes of encountering your friends. Much to your delight, there you encountered $npcName:11003952$ and $npcName:11001709$. It's about time you three caught up.

quest.name: Drifting Off
quest.desc: After you told them of your adventures since parting, your friends suggested that you get some well-deserved rest. That was when $npcName:11001709$ let something slip about events going in Maple World. $npcName:11003952$ said that was a discussion best left for later. Just what is going on?

quest.name: A Power Sealed Within
quest.desc: You were about to ask $npcName:11003952$ what was going on when your head got a little foggy. Next thing you knew, you found yourself somewhere else and were met by a familiar face.

quest.name: The Will to Power
quest.desc:
It seems you were called into this inner space by $npcName:11003951$. There you learned that gems called "lapenshards" had appeared throughout Maple World.
Somehow related to the lapentas, these shards had awakened the power of the Munakra sealed within you. As this power grows, it threatens to break the shackles that bind it—the force of which could end your life.
If you are to survive, you must free this power immediately. For that however, you need determination, and clarity of purpose. Speak with $npcName:11003951$ to learn more.

quest.name: Clarity of Purpose
quest.desc: I can't tell you whether you're worthy of the power of the Munakra or not but... Your intentions are true. Well then, let's begin.

quest.name: The Power of the Munakra
quest.desc:
With $npcName:11001560$'s aid, you succeeded in freeing the power of the Munakra sealed within you, saving your own life and unleashing new power.
You awakened to find $npcName:11001558$ and $npcName:11003949$ worrying over you. Speak with $npcName:11003949$.

quest.name: Unshackled and Empowered
quest.desc:
When you came to your senses, you were lying in Guidance's lodgings on Halo Mountain. It seems you were out for some time. And according to your friends, the chi flowing through your body moves more powerfully than ever.
Out of the corner of your eye you spot a familiar face... one you never expected to see here.

quest.name: A Time for All Things
quest.desc: Who's that over there? ...$npcName:11001560$?! Apparently as a bonus from unleashing the power of the Munakra, $npcName:11001560$ can come into the real world to chat. See what else $npcName:11001560$ has to say!

quest.name: Inside Information
quest.desc: You're a little worried about what it means to have $npcName:11001560$ walking about the real world unseen, but $npcName:11001560$ says not to worry about that right now. Your friends are probably worried about you. Why not talk with $npcName:11003952$?

quest.name: Walk Your Own Path
quest.desc:
$npcName:11003952$ said he and Tinchai were getting ready to go help the "Frontier Foundation" with their investigation into the lapenshards. $npcName:11001558$ was taken aback by your knowledge of the lapenshards, but answered your questions about the Foundation anyway.
With that matter settled, it seems that $npcName:11003952$ has an unusual request for you.

quest.name: The Constant Companion
quest.desc:
$npcName:11001558$ and $npcName:11003949$ have set off for the Frontier Foundation. Before you follow suit, you have unfinished business with $npcName:11003951$.
Speak with $npcName:11003951$.

quest.name: The Strange Swordsman
quest.desc: Upon arriving at the Frontier Foundation, you discovered a group of powerful-looking adventurers. As you take in the scenery, a long-haired swordsman strikes up a conversation with you. Speak with the $npcName:11003963$.

quest.name: A Different Manner of Bladecraft
quest.desc: Upon arriving at the Frontier Foundation, you discovered a group of powerful-looking adventurers. Say, is that person over there a swordsman like you? What's up with her shield? Go speak with the $npcName:11003955$.

quest.name: Little Miss Fancypants
quest.desc: You arrive at the Frontier Foundation and discover a group of tough-looking adventurers. They'd probably make a decent challenge. You asked if anyone wanted to spar, but some self-important little jerk started cramping on your style. Does this $npcName:11003956$ think she's better than you?

quest.name: Accosted By a Brute
quest.desc: You finally arrived at the Frontier Foundation, a place of true splendor. As you admire your surroundings, you can't help but be distracted by a loud and uncivilized individual shouting in your ear. What is such a person doing in a place like this?

quest.name: A Matter of Methods
quest.desc: As you arrived at the Frontier Foundation, finding $npcName:11003932$ was still the first thing on your mind. Where did he go? Perhaps someone here can help you track him down?

quest.name: Magical Superiority
quest.desc:
Wow the Frontier Foundation has so much free food, and it's all delicious! You decided to take a break from eating to explore the premise when you bumped into a real jerkwad.
All you wanted to do was help out a stranger and the guy decided to bite your head off.

quest.name: Technical Superiority
quest.desc: You arrived at the Frontier Foundation and bumped into a hapless fellow with a dilemma only you could solve! You suggested the perfect solution, but naturally, an air-headed wizard couldn't help butting in.

quest.name: The Wolf's New Fan
quest.desc: So you've arrived at the Frontier Foundation. There are a few people here who look really tough. Maybe they'd be up for a fight? But first maybe you should introduce yourself and let them know that you are in fact the famous Gray Wolf. It's only polite.

quest.name: An Unusual Introduction
quest.desc: You finally arrived at the Frontier Foundation and marveled at its decadence. It's filled with strong-looking adventurers. But who is that strange man, and why is he approaching you?

quest.name: Opportunity and Motive
quest.desc: You arrived at the Frontier Foundation and found it packed to the gills with priceless junk. You could easily sneak off with a small fortune's worth of goodies, if it weren't for that nosy lady staring at you.

quest.name: A Crime of Opportunity
quest.desc: You arrived at the Frontier Foundation only to discover a loud and obnoxious individual clearly casing the establishment. You can't help but feel angry about his blatant intent. You should keep an eye on him.

quest.name: First Order of Business
quest.desc: You've arrived in the new land, and already $npcName:11004341$ needs to see you. Check in with her and make sure everything is okay.

quest.name: A Thorough Investigation
quest.desc: $npcName:11004341$ has detected a source of lapenta energy on Kritias. How could it have come to be here? Speak with her to learn more.

quest.name: Epiphany
quest.desc: Sky Fortress doesn't have the manpower to investigate $npcName:11004341$'s unexpected readings. Go to the coordinates she provided and see if you can find the source of this lapenta energy.

quest.name: Unknown yet Familiar
quest.desc: There was a cave at the coordinates $npcName:11004341$ gave you. This place is stunning! Examine the strange light.

quest.name: Instinct for Power
quest.desc: The energy in the cave is strangely familiar. Examine the $npcName:11004339$.

quest.name: An Inner Change
quest.desc: The light of the lapenta energy is captivating. Without thinking, you reached out to touch it, and then...

quest.name: A Powerful Resonance
quest.desc: A change occurred within you after coming into contact with the lapenta energy. For now, go back to $npcName:11004341$ and give her your report.

quest.name: Your New Self
quest.desc: You're resonating with lapenta energy. With this new power, you feel ready to take on anything Kritias throws at you!

$npc:11004574$ says the only way to secure food for the refugees is to hunt nearby animals.
However, mechanical lifeforms are attacking residents who go out hunting, making hunting extremely difficult. $npc:11004574$ worries that if this continues, refugees will begin collapsing from hunger.
Defeat $npcName:25022203$ in $map:02020066$, $npcName:25022305$ in $map:02020067$, and $npcName:25022408$ in $map:02020068$.

$npc:11004620$ is saddened, saying boiling-hot Poings are harming the Morang.
They must be the Poings exposed to Ener that $npcName:11004614$ mentioned.
When you face the first Poing, the second and third appear to help it, and after struggling against all three, they combine into the 'Three Poing Brothers.'
$npcName:11004620$ says the combined 'Three Poing Brothers' are so powerful that the Morang cannot stand against them.
You must stop them before the Morang suffer further.
Defeat $npcName:25022805$ in $map:02020068$ and $npcName:25022815$ in $map:02020069$.

Tyren Kingdom forces are said to be attacking the residents of $map:02020066$. $npcName:11004574$ says that if Georg had not come in the first place, the Tyren Kingdom would not have attacked them.
To build greater trust with the refugees, you must repel the Tyren forces.
Defeat $npcName:25022200$, $npcName:25022201$, and $npcName:25022204$ in $map:02020066$.

$npc:11004574$ says that of the five residents who went hunting, only one returned. The other one had also been kidnapped, but Kerbes released them to tell the refugees how terrifying Kerbes is.
You can no longer tolerate Kerbes's cruel actions.
Defeat $npcName:25022300$, $npcName:25022306$, $npcName:25022303$, $npcName:25022301$, and $npcName:25022307$ in $map:02020067$.

$npc:11004620$ says $map:02020068$ is being stained black by the Black Legion.
The forest and the creatures within it are being consumed by black energy.
$npcName:11004620$ says creatures consumed by black energy come under the Black Legion's control. They say the Black Legion is corrupting them to steal the Morang's 'mysterious power'...
Defeat $npcName:25022406$, $npcName:25022409$, and $npcName:25022402$ in $map:02020068$.

$npcName:11004620$ says the Black Legion is staining the creatures of $map:02020069$ black.
Creatures consumed by black energy are under the Black Legion's control.
The Black Legion must have corrupted them to steal the Morang's 'mysterious power.'
Defeat $npcName:25022500$, $npcName:25022503$, and $npcName:25022502$ in $map:02020069$.

$npc:11004574$ says it is only a matter of time before $map:02020066$ collapses.
That is because new Kerbes commanders are appearing everywhere and kidnapping refugees indiscriminately.
If this continues, Galan may be gripped by fear and collapse from within.
Defeat $npcName:25022801$ in $map:02020066$ and $npcName:25022811$ in $map:02020067$.

$npc:11004574$ says no one is going out hunting because of the beasts Kerbes released.
The beasts attack residents who go out hunting, and more than a few people have been injured.
To free the refugees from hunger, you must suppress Kerbes's beasts.
Defeat $npcName:25022208$ in $map:02020066$ and $npcName:25022307$ in $map:02020067$.
quest.name: Monsters Created by Kerbes

quest.desc:
$npcName:11004620$ says Morang who insist on driving out outsiders are trying to break the peace of the forest.
On the surface they attack outsiders, but in truth they are thugs committing all kinds of bad deeds.
You must suppress the Morang thugs before their power grows further.
Defeat $npcName:25022409$ in $map:02020068$ and $npcName:25022503$ in $map:02020069$.

$npc:11004574$ says they had no choice but to reduce the number of active surveillance drones because of a parts shortage.
That is because Kerbes frequently attacks and shoots down the drones.
If you use $item:30001353$ from $npcName:25022206$ flying around $map:02020066$, you should be able to activate the drones.
Go to $map:02020066$, defeat $npcName:25022206$, and secure $item:30001353$.
quest.name: Why the Number of Drones Decreased

quest.desc:
$npc:11004574$ says $map:02020066$ suffers from constant Ener shortages because it has only one Ener fusion device.
If you remove $item:30001354$ from the magic staff of $npcName:25022204$ stationed nearby, the Ener shortage should be resolved.
Go to $map:02020066$, suppress $npcName:25022204$, and secure $item:30001354$.

$npc:11004574$ says Kerbes's kidnapping season has returned.
When the kidnapped people become too weak to be useful, Kerbes begins another large-scale kidnapping.
$npc:11004574$ is saddened that three refugees who went hunting today did not return.
You cannot stand by and let there be more victims.
Go to $map:02020067$ and repel $npcName:25022300$, who kidnaps refugees.

$npc:11004574$ says $npcName:25022306$ are injuring refugees for fun.
They are monsters who torment people like children killing bugs for amusement.
You cannot just watch such creatures.
Go to $map:02020067$ and suppress $npcName:25022306$, who throws knives at refugees.

$npc:11004620$ refuses to let Georg forces be stationed in $map:02020069$.
They also refuse Georg's offer to provide modern weapons to protect the mysterious power.
Now the only option is to improve the Morang's crude clubs into powerful weapons.
If $item:30001355$ is embedded into a Morang club, it should become a powerful weapon.
Go to $map:02020068$, defeat $npcName:25022403$, and secure $item:30001355$.

$npc:11004620$ says they already know about the creatures surrounding $map:02020069$.
Those creatures were beings consumed by the Black Legion.
$npc:11004620$ says the Black Legion is clearly controlling the creatures to steal the mysterious power.
You cannot let the mysterious power fall into the Black Legion's hands.
Suppress $npcName:25022502$, which threatens $map:02020069$.

$npc:11004620$ says Morang thugs are moving in groups and committing all kinds of bad deeds.
They are said to harass good Morang and steal their belongings.
They are the reason the atmosphere in $map:02020069$ became ominous.
If left alone, <font color="#ffd200">$map:02020069$</font> may spiral out of control.
Teach $npcName:25022503$, which roams $map:02020069$, a lesson.

$npc:11004574$ says Kerbes forces began throwing grenades after their attack on $map:02020066$ was thwarted.
Their plan is simply to destroy $map:02020066$ out of hatred.
If this continues, $map:02020066$'s infrastructure will be damaged.
Repel $npcName:25022205$, which is throwing grenades at $map:02020066$.

$npc:11004574$ says the Black Legion seems to have reinforced its forces to stain $map:02020067$ black.
They normally do not attack the refugees, but they attack without mercy if people who went hunting approach nearby.
For now, it would be best to go there yourself and learn what the Black Legion is plotting.
Go to $map:02020067$ and suppress $npcName:25022304$.

$npc:11004574$ says the kidnapped refugees must have been taken to a Kerbes base and forced into labor, and that it is already too late to rescue them.
$npc:11004574$ says the food shortage is severe because refugees who went hunting were kidnapped.
Go to $map:02020067$, defeat $npcName:25022307$, and bring back $item:30001360$.

$npc:11004620$ says $npcName:25022402$ is attacking the Morang. They say $npcName:25022402$ sprays venom everywhere, and many Morang have been injured.
$npc:11004620$ says $npcName:25022402$'s mind collapsed after being consumed by black energy.
Before the damage grows worse, go to $map:02020068$ and suppress $npcName:25022402$.

$npc:11004620$ asks for help repairing the temple.
They say $item:30001361$ is needed to repair the walls.
Go to $map:02020068$, defeat $npcName:25022405$, and bring back $item:30001361$.

$npc:11004620$ says the ecosystem disruption near $map:02020069$ is caused by $npcName:25022504$'s pollen.
When $npcName:25022504$'s powder gets into animals' eyes, they hallucinate and lose their sense of direction.
$npc:11004620$ says there are too many $npcName:25022504$, and the animals are suffering greatly.
Go to $map:02020069$ and reduce the number of $npcName:25022504$ to restore the ecosystem.

$npc:11004620$ says Morang thugs captured $npcName:25022505$ and released them in $map:02020069$.
They are stealing while the Morang run away from $npcName:25022505$.
If this continues, $map:02020069$ will fall into chaos.
Destroy $npcName:25022505$, which is tearing through $map:02020069$.

$npc:11004574$ says $npcName:25022207$ carved all kinds of threatening messages around Galan with a dagger.
The threats said that if Galan did not surrender voluntarily within a week, it would be devastated.
$npc:11004574$ says the confused refugees are no longer following rules and are acting as they please.
If this continues, Galan may collapse from within.
Repel $npcName:25022207$, which is spreading fear around $map:02020066$.

$npc:11004574$ says residents who went hunting near Galan were attacked by mechanical lifeforms.
They are said to attack refugees without warning with terrifying pincers.
If this continues, Galan may collapse from injuries and hunger.
Destroy $npcName:25022203$, which roams $map:02020066$.

$npc:11004574$ says $map:02020066$ is boiling in the heat.
She says it would help if you brought back the wings of $npcName:25022305$ flying around $map:02020067$.
That is because $item:30001363$ from $npcName:25022305$ blocks hot light and is useful as shade.
Go to $map:02020067$, defeat $npcName:25022305$, and bring back $item:30001363$.

You suggested providing modern weapons and military training to guard $map:02020069$, but $npc:11004620$ refuses.
Kanturang says the Morang will fight with Morang weapons.
Now the only option is to improve the Morang's crude clubs into powerful weapons.
If $item:30001365$ from $npcName:25022507$ is inserted into a Morang club, it will surely become a powerful weapon.
Defeat $npcName:25022507$ living around $map:02020069$ and secure $item:30001365$.

$npc:11004620$ says the Morang are working together to repair the temple that enshrines the 'mysterious power.'
They ask you to obtain $item:30001366$ to repair the temple mural.
Defeat $npcName:25022501$ living near $map:02020069$ and bring back $item:30001366$.

$npc:11004620$ says Black Legion forces were reinforced in $map:02020068$ not long ago.
They say the Black Legion seems to have reinforced its forces to contaminate all of $map:02020068$.
The reinforced force is said to be $npcName:25022400$.
If Kanturang's prediction is correct, soon all of $map:02020068$ will be consumed by black energy.
Go to $map:02020068$ and defeat $npcName:25022400$ to stop the forest's contamination.

$npc:11004620$ says they are suffering from food shortages because of beasts released by the Black Legion.
$npcName:25022401$ is devouring the fruit in $map:02020068$, leaving the Morang short on food.
You cannot stand by and watch even the Morang children go hungry.
Go to $map:02020068$ and drive off $npcName:25022401$.

Merin Has Disappeared
quest.desc: $npc:11001167$ is wandering all over $map:02000101$ searching for their younger sibling $npc:11001166$. $npc:11001166$, who loves hanging out with friends, apparently entered the dangerous $map:02000331$... Let's find $npc:11001166$ and bring them somewhere safe.

quest.name: Dungeon: Help the Children
quest.desc:
$dungeonTitle:25004001$ (Entrance Map: $map:2000101$)
Just as $npcName:11001167$ predicted, $npcName:11001166$ had snuck into $map:2000331$ with friends. They sensed the presence of the prickly mage who attacks anyone entering the forest, ran away, and had been hiding and trembling in the south of $map:2000101$. Let's enter $map:2000331$ with $npcName:11001166$, who is worried because their friends are still inside, and help them.
quest.manual: Defeat monsters hiding in $map:02000331$|Help all the children in danger at $map:02000331$

quest.name: Dungeon: Escape Helper
quest.desc:
$dungeonTitle:25004001$ (Entrance Map: $map:2000101$)
$npc:11001166$ and friends snuck into $map:02000331$ to play hide and seek, and got caught by the mage again. Once more, let's help these reckless but adorable little ones safely escape from $map:2000331$.
quest.manual: Help all the children in danger at $map:02000331$

quest.name: Eve of the Deadline
quest.desc: Maple TV $npc:11001191$ is filming a documentary covering ecological anomalies across Maple World. They've selected $map:2000045$, $map:2000003$, $map:2000010$, $map:2000255$, and $map:2000007$ as filming locations and finished installing cameras, but the team members sent to retrieve the footage have all failed to return. In particular, $npc:11001195$, who went to the site first, hasn't come back for days... Let's go to $map:2000045$ to find them.

quest.name: Dungeon: The End of Baseless Confidence
quest.desc:
(Entrance Map: $map:2000045$)
$npc:11001195$ fell in love with $npc:11001191$ at first sight and came to the field to retrieve the filming tape for her. But an unexpected situation awaited at the site... Unable to go back and tell $npcName:11001191$ that they failed to retrieve the tape, they've been standing here helplessly for days. Let's retrieve the $item:30000414$ for them.
quest.manual: Investigate the camera installed at $map:2000347$ and retrieve $item:30000414$

quest.name: Dungeon: A Groom-to-Be's Dream
quest.desc:
(Entrance Map: $map:2000003$)
$npc:11001194$ is about to get married. With work piling up and every day feeling like a war, they can't go home due to a crisis at the filming site, sinking into sadness. Let's lend a hand to $npcName:11001194$, who just wants to keep their promise with their fiancée today.
quest.manual: Investigate the camera installed at $map:2000346$ and retrieve $item:30000415$

quest.name: Dungeon: In This Complex World, Let's Live Easy
quest.desc:
(Entrance Map: $map:2000010$)
$npc:11001196$ is at the filming site with an expression full of discontent. They say it's too heartless to send a sick middle-aged employee out on fieldwork, even if they're short-staffed. Let's find and bring back the $item:30000416$ for $npc:11001196$, who says they don't even have the energy to stand.
quest.manual: Investigate the camera installed at $map:2000348$ and retrieve $item:30000416$

quest.name: Dungeon: The Depressed Junior Writer
quest.desc:
(Entrance Map: $map:2000255$) Party Recommended (4 players)
Maple TV was once a dream job for $npc:11001192$, but now it's so exhausting they're afraid it'll haunt their actual dreams. Let's help $npcName:11001192$, who is heartbroken saying they can't return to the station having failed to retrieve the filming tape.
quest.manual: Investigate the camera installed at $map:2000344$ and retrieve $item:30000417$

quest.name: Dungeon: For a Colleague
quest.desc:
(Entrance Map: $map:2000007$) Party Recommended (4 players)
$npc:11001193$ is actively helping with the documentary filming because they feel sorry seeing their colleague $npcName:11001191$ struggling. They thought retrieving the filming tape would be a simple task they could quickly finish before moving on to other work, but their plans fell apart and now they're in trouble. Let's retrieve the filming tape for $npcName:11001193$, who seems to be muttering to themselves nonstop from the shock.
quest.manual: Investigate the camera installed at $map:2000345$ and retrieve $item:30000418$

quest.desc: $npc:11001211$ says the black marketeer who handled $item:30000421$ seemed interested in it, and suggests you visit them because they may know something. Go find the black marketeer $npcName:11001212$ in $map:03000014$.

The black marketeer $npcName:11001212$ presses you, asking whether you bought $item:30000421$ to control its power. They seem to already know everything, and say it may help if you tell them what happened after defeating $npcName:23090005$. They introduce the eccentric scientist $npcName:11001242$. Go find $npcName:11001242$ in $map:03000024$.

quest.name: Dungeon: A Frozen Heart
quest.desc:
$dungeonTitle:25010001$ (Entrance Map: $map:2010026$)
$npc:11001433$ at $map:02010033$ says they're searching for the girl $npcName:24001807$ they met on a day when sandstorms were blowing. They felt a familiar presence from a door inside $map:02010026$ from which cold wind was seeping, but couldn't enter due to a monster attack. Let's search for traces of the girl in the place called $map:02010052$ on behalf of $npcName:11001433$.
quest.manual: Search for traces of $npc:24001807$ in $map:02010052$ inside $map:02010026$

quest.name: Dungeon: The Secret of the Snow Leopard Tribe
quest.desc:
$dungeonTitle:25010001$ (Entrance Map: $map:2010026$)
$npc:11001434$ at $map:02010026$ is researching the mysterious Snow Leopard Tribe, a race that loses its human form and memories as it awakens its divine power. Let's fulfill $npcName:11001434$'s request to find $item:30000478$, which is valuable research material for studying the Snow Leopard Tribe, from $map:02010052$.

quest.name: Operation: Convince the Captain
quest.desc: Meerkat Scout $npcName:11001084$, operating independently at $map:02010047$. Together with Captain $npcName:11001080$ and partner $npcName:11001355$, they've been investigating the secret of the black shadow that occasionally appears here. They seem to have worked hard and identified it, but Captain $npcName:11001080$ keeps forming alternative hypotheses, saying they need to be cautious. $npcName:11001084$ is curious about what $npcName:11001080$ is thinking and asks you to find out.
quest.complete: Relay the opinions of $npc:11001084$ and $npcName:11001355$ to $npc:11001080$

quest.name: Dungeon: Return of the Moon Shadow
quest.desc:
$dungeonTitle:21014001$ (Entrance Map: $map:2010047$) Party Recommended (4 players)
$npc:11001080$ believes the shadow that appears on new moon nights and during solar or lunar eclipses is the shaman $npcName:24002005$, recorded in ancient texts. But the reason they're hiding this from $npcName:11001084$ and $npcName:11001355$ is that they fear those two, with their strong curiosity, would want to rush to the scene themselves... Let's go deep into $map:02010054$ on behalf of the fearful $npc:11001080$ and investigate the shadow's true identity.

quest.name: Dungeon: Stop the Moon Shadow
quest.desc:
$dungeonTitle:21014001$ (Entrance Map: $map:2010047$) Party Recommended (4 players)
$npc:11001080$ warns that if $npc:24002005$ resumes activity, it could pose a great danger to this world. The shaman who once disrupted the world with dark magic and tried to steal the power of dragons must be continually attacked and weakened before growing stronger. Let's defeat $npcName:24002005$, who dreams of resurrection, at $map:02010054$.

quest.name: It's a Secret
quest.desc: $npc:11001406$ is looking for $npcName:11001412$ who went missing in $map:02010033$. Look for clues that could lead you to $npcName:11001412$ in $map:02010026$.

quest.name: Meerkat Matters
quest.desc: $npc:11001406$ is certain that $npcName:11001412$ made it back to $map:02010006$ safe and sound. He made a big deal about it... but maybe you should check to be sure. Go to $map:02010006$ and ask $npc:11001408$ about $npcName:11001412$.

quest.name: Meerkats Care
quest.desc: The Meerkat Patrol is not just a gaggle of small, weak critters. $npcName:11001408$ said they were able to build an organization that keeps tabs on all of Karkar Island through bonds of trust. Their tireless vigilance is what helped them save $npcName:11001412$, in fact. Go have a word with $npcName:11001412$.

quest.name: Walk with Light
quest.desc: $npcName:11001430$ is a mysterious boy in $map:02010047$. He's from another dimension and is looking for a way to return home. Meet with $npcName:11001431$ who was there when the boy arrived. He might have some clues to share.

quest.name: A Light in the Night
quest.desc: $npcName:11001431$ said that on that fateful day, there was a shooting star and a small earthquake but that was it. Still, you're pretty sure he knows more about $npcName:11001430$ than he's letting on. Tell $npcName:11001430$ what you've learned.

quest.name: The Smallest Clue
quest.desc: $npcName:11001430$ said you might turn something up if you examine the monsters in the area. Battle $npcName:21000645$ and $npcName:21000424$ and search their bodies for clues.

quest.name: Studies in Light
quest.desc: $npcName:11001430$ has been studying the history of the ruins intently, searching for a way to return to his home. He finally came across something of note, and asks you to review the research journal he hid. Look for $item:30000497$ in $map:02010007$, $npcName:11001430$'s hideout.
quest.manual: Find the research journal that $npcName:11001430$ hid in $map:02010007$

quest.name: A Friend's Request
quest.desc: $item:30000497$ was filled with information about a relic of light that can pierce the barriers between dimensions. $npcName:11001430$ wants to find $npcName:11000735$ because he thinks she knows more about the relic. Since you decided to be friends with $npcName:11001430$, listen to $npcName:11001431$'s request in his place.

quest.name: Raising Starlight
quest.desc: $npcName:11001431$ said you'll need materials first before watering the starflower. He said to get $item:30000498$ and $item:30000499$. Find what you need in $map:02010047$.

quest.name: Blooming Starflowers
quest.desc: $npcName:11001431$ produced $item:30000500$ from the materials you gathered. He said the lonely starflowers will love the water from this tool. Find the starflowers all over $map:02010047$ and water them.

quest.name: Patience Training
quest.desc: $npcName:11001409$ is in charge of training the top meerkat patrols. He suggests that you take part in the Meerkat Patrol's patience training to shape up as their members have. Try the Meerkat Patrol's beginner course.
quest.manual: Climb 200m |Hang on the ladder for 180 sec |Hang on the rope for 180 sec

quest.name: Combat Training
quest.desc: $npcName:11001409$ is in charge of training the top meerkat patrols. He explains that although the meerkats mostly patrol from high places, in critical situations they have to fight. Try the Meerkat Patrol's combat training.

quest.name: Conversation Training
quest.desc: $npcName:11001409$ is in charge of training the top meerkat patrols. He said one of their key talents is getting information through conversation. He tells you to find $npcName:11001407$ somewhere in $map:02010033$ and have a full conversation.

$npc:11001211$ says they heard from a shaman who came to $map:02000203$ that the way to break a powerful demon's curse is to enter the demon's consciousness. Meet $npc:11001485$, who left for $map:02000200$ in search of $npc:23090005$.

quest.name: A Desperate Heart
quest.desc: $npc:11001396$ tried to help $npc:11001392$ but failed. When she went to confront $npc:11001397$ who made the elixir, she was scolded for recklessly using medicine on a child. Reflecting on her hasty actions, $npcName:11001396$ wants to verify whether the newly made medicine is safe first. As she requested, let's go meet $npc:11001443$ in $map:02010063$.

quest.name: The Doctor's Diagnosis
quest.desc: $npc:11001443$ carefully examines $item:30000520$ and concludes it should be safe for children. However, since $npc:11001392$ and her brother $npcName:11001391$ are weak and would likely resist medicine, it would be best to mix it into food. Let's go meet $npc:11001388$, said to be the best cook in $map:02010063$.

quest.name: With the Heart of Family
quest.desc: After hearing the story, $npc:11001388$ gladly prepares food for the siblings. With the wish to become family for the siblings who are hurting in body and soul, deliver the $item:30000521$ that $npcName:11001388$ lovingly prepared to $npcName:11001391$, $npcName:11001392$'s brother.

quest.name: Faith Rewarded
quest.desc: $npc:11001392$ says she feels much better after eating $item:30000521$ and asks you to thank $npcName:11001396$ for keeping the promise. $npc:11001396$ may seem strong and smart but is actually soft-hearted. Let's deliver $npcName:11001392$'s condition and her gratitude.
quest.manual: Speak with $npc:11001392$ to check on her condition

quest.name: The Chatty Lady
quest.desc: $npc:11001536$ is loitering around $map:02000006$. She's the older sister of merchant $npc:11000167$ from $map:02000285$, and says she's in a bind because of a request she received from $npc:11000270$ while visiting the merchant gathering at $map:02000036$. Let's fulfill $npc:11001536$'s request to persuade the always-frowning $npc:11000270$ to forget about the whole thing.

quest.name: No More Sleep Deprivation
quest.desc: The reason $npc:11000270$ is always frowning is because of their timid daughter who can't sleep deeply at night and has scary dreams, leaving them sleep-deprived. $npc:11000270$ says they asked $npc:11001536$ to get rid of the noisy monsters at $map:02000006$ so their daughter could sleep soundly, but after hearing $npc:11001536$'s situation, they feel awkward... Let's clear the monsters at $map:02000006$ so she and her daughter can sleep peacefully tonight.

quest.name: Rumors of a Mysterious Herb
quest.desc: Young $npc:11000230$ working hard at $map:02000288$ in $map:02000036$. Despite appearing cheerful, they're actually searching for medicine to cure their terminally ill sibling. $npc:11000230$ recently heard from customers that a place called $map:02000074$ somewhere in $map:02000006$ is an herbalist's secret space where herbs effective against all ailments grow. They ask you to check if there really are herbs at $map:02000074$.
$npc:11000119$ says $npc:11000075$ is looking for you and tells you to come to $map:52000033$ upstairs in $map:02000025$.
quest.complete: Talk to $npc:11000075$ in $map:52000033$ above the palace entrance, north of $map:02000001$

quest.desc: When you meet $npc:11000075$ in $map:52000033$, they tell you about a suspicious tremor recently detected west of Victoria Island, revealing that the power of darkness has drawn closer. $npc:11000075$ says they will grant you a new power to deal with greater darkness and enables you to use "Attributes."
quest.complete: Talk to $npc:11000075$ in $map:52000033$ and unlock a new power, "Traits"

quest.desc: $npc:11000119$ says that now that your new power, "Attributes," has been unlocked, you will be able to grow in more varied ways. They advise you to try different activities to train yourself, and tell you that checking the "Maple Guide" will show things worth doing at your current level. They also say upgrading skills will let you use stronger power, and give you $item:40100022$ as a gift.
quest.complete: Talk to $npc:11000119$ in $map:52000033$ and receive a gift

quest.desc: $npc:11000601$ says that if you want to learn how to become stronger through those who gather mysterious power, you should visit them, and that they will be waiting in $map:02000025$.

Those who collect rare star fragments with mysterious power call themselves Star Keepers, and they say they will exchange $item:30000447$ or $item:30000448$ for various useful adventure items... Ask $npcFunction:11001271$ $npc:11001271$ in $map:02010063$ directly about how to obtain $item:30000447$.

quest.name: Mission from the Empress
quest.desc: $npc:11000075$ needs to see you. Meet her in $map:02000025$.

quest.name: The Royal Lowdown
quest.desc: $npc:11000075$ has received disturbing reports from the Land of Darkness. Followers of the ancient Demon King have appeared. She wants you to venture into the Land of Darkness and discover the origin of these monsters.

quest.name: A Potent Light
quest.desc: $npcName:11000601$ has decided to tell you about gemstones, a kind of material that holds extraordinary power. Meet her in $map:02000025$ to learn how you can make their power your own.

quest.name: Darkness Within Darkness
quest.desc:
$npcName:11001242$ is very interested in the $item:30000560$. He has a hypothesis on how to remove the weapon's curse, and asks you to obtain a crystal formed from condensed darkness to test it.
Find the $item:30000437$ in $map:2000350$ and bring it to $npcName:11001242$.

quest.name: Darkness Within Darkness
quest.desc:
$npcName:11001242$ is very interested in the $item:30000561$. He has a hypothesis on how to remove the weapon's curse, and asks you to obtain a crystal formed from condensed darkness to test it.
Find the $item:30000437$ in $map:2000350$ and bring it to $npcName:11001242$.

quest.name: Power Struggle
quest.desc: $npcName:11001242$ succeeded in breaking the ominous curse on $npcName:23090005$'s weapon. But he also said that wasn't enough, and you need to head to $map:02000203$ and reforge the weapon. Take $item:15500064$ to $npcName:11001211$ in $map:02000203$.

quest.name: Power Struggle
quest.desc: $npcName:11001242$ succeeded in breaking the ominous curse on $npcName:23090005$'s weapon. But he also said that wasn't enough, and you need to head to $map:02000203$ and reforge the weapon. Take $item:15600064$ to $npcName:11001211$ in $map:02000203$.

quest.name: An Unexpected Clue
quest.desc: A shaman from $map:02000203$ told $npcName:11001211$ that the way to remove the powerful curse of a demon is to enter the demon's consciousness. Find $npcName:23090005$ and meet $npcName:11001485$ who left for $map:02000200$.

quest.name: An Unexpected Clue
quest.desc: A shaman from $map:02000203$ told $npcName:11001211$ that the way to remove the powerful curse of a demon is to enter the demon's consciousness. Find $npcName:23090005$ and meet $npcName:11001485$ who left for $map:02000200$.

quest.name: Eternal Flame
quest.desc: $npcName:11001485$ tells you that if you want to break the curse of a powerful demon like $npcName:23090005$, you must enter their consciousness while they are weakened. There's a device in $map:02000200$ which can allow you to do just that, so once you defeat $npcName:23090005$ you need only find the path which opens nearby. Defeat $npcName:23090005$ and enter $map:52000014$ to find a way to break the curse.
quest.manual: After defeating $npcName:23090005$, enter $map:52000014$ and break the curse on $item:15500064$

quest.name: Eternal Flame
quest.desc: $npcName:11001485$ tells you that if you want to break the curse of a powerful demon like $npcName:23090005$, you must enter their consciousness while they are weakened. There's a device in $map:02000200$ which can allow you to do just that, so once you defeat $npcName:23090005$ you need only find the path which opens nearby. Defeat $npcName:23090005$ and enter $map:52000014$ to find a way to break the curse.
quest.manual: After defeating $npcName:23090005$, enter $map:52000014$ and break the curse on $item:15600064$

quest.desc: $npc:11000119$ says they have something to tell you and are looking for you. Meet them in $map:02000001$.

$npc:11000119$ tells you that a suspicious dark gate has appeared on the broken ground in $map:02000118$. Beyond the gate is a twisted dark space that could lead anywhere, and according to the royal guard members lucky enough to return alive after investigating it, the inside was filled with pitch-black darkness like another world and contained monsters with tremendous strength. The Royal Guard has decided to ask capable adventurers to explore the place and learn what is inside under the name "Shadow Expedition."

$npc:11001700$, dispatched to the broken ground in $map:02000118$, says that to survive in the deep darkness, it is important to understand and use the rules and expedition-only attributes that apply only inside. With the real challenge now before you, they encourage you to do your best exploring the place.

quest.name: The Disciples Reunited
quest.desc: $npc:11001677$ says the senior disciples went into a cute tree house following the path to the right. Let's head to $map:52000041$ to meet $npcName:11001715$ and $npcName:11001707$.
quest.complete: Meet the senior disciples in $map:52000041$ east of $map:02000001$

quest.name: Beginning the Inquiry
quest.desc: $npc:11001707$ suggests searching for information about the divine artifact in $map:02000001$ first. Since she can't move due to caring for $npc:11001716$, let's search for information in her place. $npc:11001707$ says she once saw a guide in front of the palace, so let's go to $npc:11000160$ first to gather information.

quest.name: The Flustered Guide
quest.desc: $npc:11000160$ says relics would mostly be stored in the $map:02000001$ palace, but all the royal officials are in disarray over the canceled audience and no one could properly answer. However, if it's a relic related to beast-kin, the beast-kin $npc:11000003$, who knows much about $map:02000001$, might have information... As $npc:11000160$ suggested, let's go meet $npc:11000003$.

quest.name: Tinchai's Message
quest.desc: $npc:11000012$ relays a message from $npc:11001707$. $npc:11001707$ says she has something to tell you, so let's go meet her in $map:52000041$.

quest.name: Guidance's Former Disciple
quest.desc: It turns out $map:52000041$ was arranged by Taig Furian, a tiger beast-kin who once trained at Guidance alongside $npc:11001716$ and $npc:11001707$. $npc:11001707$ says we should meet Taig Furian and ask him to help gather information about the divine artifact. To find this sturdy, nimble tiger beast-kin with a hearty personality, wouldn't it be fastest to ask a fellow tiger beast-kin? Let's go ask $npc:11000003$ about Taig Furian.
quest.complete: Ask $npc:11000003$ in $map:02000001$ if they know Taig Furian

quest.name: Taig Furian
quest.desc: $npc:11000003$ says that the Taig Furian who once trained at Guidance is none other than himself. No matter how you look at it, he seems far from the description $npc:11001707$ gave... Surprised to hear that $npc:11001716$ and $npc:11001707$ are in $map:02000001$, $npc:11000003$ offers to help after hearing about the incident at the mountain. He says he'd like to meet $npc:11001707$ first... Let's join their reunion in $map:52000041$.
quest.manual: Join the reunion of Taig Furian and the senior disciples in $map:02000001$ $map:52000041$

quest.name: Find the Clue
quest.desc: $npc:11001003$ stormed out. Because of that, $npc:11001707$ wasn't able to ask $npc:11000003$ to help collect information related to Guidance's divine artifact. Let's go find $npc:11000003$ in $npc:11001707$'s place and ask for help with the information gathering.
quest.complete: Meet $npc:11000003$ in $map:02000001$ and inquire for information

quest.name: What Nelph Left Behind
quest.desc: $npc:11000492$, who could have told us about Guidance's divine artifact and the armory theft incident, lies collapsed. Unfortunately, it seems we can no longer hear anything from $npc:11000492$. Let's search around $npc:11000492$ for any clues.

quest.name: A New Clue
quest.desc: Let's go to $npc:11000119$, show the notebook found in $npc:11000492$'s bag, report the investigation results so far, and request help gathering information about the divine artifact.

quest.name: The Chief Disciple's Summons
quest.desc: $npc:11000012$ relays a message from $npc:11001707$. $npc:11001707$ says to hurry over unless you want to face $npc:11001716$'s wrath... Let's go meet the senior disciples in $map:52000041$.

quest.name: Interim Report
quest.desc: $npc:11001716$ asks about the investigation so far. Telling about all the complicated incidents would surely displease $npcName:11001716$, who has an aversion to humans. After giving only a brief report, he doesn't look satisfied.

quest.name: Tinchai's Call
quest.desc: $npc:11000012$ relays a message from $npc:11001707$. $npc:11001707$ says she has something to tell you, so let's go meet her in $map:52000041$.

quest.name: A Special Warehouse
quest.desc: According to $npc:11001707$ who investigated with an informant, Black Star, which operates $map:02000216$, has a special secret warehouse where they show and sell items exclusively to special clients. Since a big spender has been visiting lately and Black Star's security is lax, we might be able to find clues related to Guidance's divine artifact there... Let's head to $map:02000216$ and meet $npc:11001730$.

quest.name: Infiltration Investigation
quest.desc: $npc:11001730$, who was monitoring Black Star's $map:52000042$, says the last remaining guard has been locked in the bathroom, making this the perfect chance to investigate $map:52000042$. The entrance to $map:52000042$ is on the first floor of the white building with a black roof next to the water tank where $npc:11001730$ is.
quest.manual: Enter $map:52000042$ on the first floor of the white building with a black roof next to $npc:11001730$'s water tank and search for clues

quest.name: Seeds of Suspicion
quest.desc: What was found is $item:30000562$. After reading it aloud for $npc:11001730$ who can't read, a place called Beyond Link, known as a humanoid engineering research institute, seems suspicious. It somehow feels familiar... Let's head to $map:52000041$ and discuss with the senior disciples.

quest.name: Tinchai's Summons
quest.desc: $npc:11000012$ relays a message from $npc:11001707$. $npc:11001707$ says she has something to tell you, so let's go meet her in $map:52000041$.

quest.name: A Suspicious Research Institute
quest.desc: $npc:11001707$ says two things from the $item:30000562$ contents and logistics investigation are particularly suspicious: Chairman Goldus, who is secretly diverting purchased relics somewhere, and Beyond Link, which claims to be an engineering research institute yet keeps buying relics. $npc:11001707$ says she'll handle the investigation on $npc:11000252$, so I should investigate Beyond Link. Let's go to $map:03000145$ and meet $npc:11001731$.

quest.name: What's Hidden There
quest.desc: $npc:11001731$, who was observing a Beyond Link building in $map:03000145$, says there's one place left that hasn't been investigated and asks you to check it out. Let's enter $map:52000039$.

quest.name: Secret File
quest.desc: $map:52000040$, reached through $map:52000039$. Operating $npc:11001692$ there revealed access to a secret file. Let's check the contents.

quest.name: Lost Child
quest.desc: 'Lost Child'... After defeating the black shadows that attacked, I felt dizzy... and when I came to, I was in $map:52000017$, a place I'd been to before. $npc:11001723$ stands before me... I try asking about several words pieced together from the secret file and faint memories, but instead of clear answers, all I get is to forget everything. What is $npc:11001723$'s true nature, and when will the hazy memories of the past fully return?

quest.name: Another Misunderstanding
quest.desc: Meeting $npc:11001724$ and their group for the second time in a delicate moment. They demand either a satisfactory explanation or information of equal value. With no telling what might happen if we stall... I quickly shared what I could about Beyond Link to clear the misunderstanding. Let's hurry back to $map:52000041$ and meet the senior disciples.
quest.manual: Speak with $npc:11001724$ in $map:52000040$ to clear the accumulated misunderstandings and escape

quest.name: Cautious Disciples
quest.desc: After sharing the contents of the secret file accessed at Beyond Link, $npc:11001707$ sinks into deep thought, saying she'll organize the clues and find a conclusion. It's uncomfortable not being able to tell the senior disciples everything, but it's best to hide these feelings. Let's speak with $npcName:11001716$, who seems to have something to say.

quest.name: Tinchai's Discovery
quest.desc: $npc:11000012$ relays a message from $npc:11001707$. $npc:11001707$ says she has something to tell you, so let's go meet her in $map:52000041$.

quest.name: The Words I Wanted to Hear
quest.desc: Before departing to find the sacred space in $map:02000039$, $npcName:11001716$ confirms that Beyond Link is an organization controlled by Kandura. $npcName:11001716$ asks if anything else has been discovered or remembered. After much deliberation, I avoided answering. Let's prepare and head to $map:02000039$ to find the entrance to the sacred space.
quest.manual: Find and enter the entrance to the sacred space in $map:02000039$

quest.name: The Snow-Dusted Grounds
quest.desc: $map:52000043$ feels strangely nostalgic, resembling $map:63000025$. $npc:11001707$ says we'll surely find something here. Let's search $map:52000043$ as she suggests.
quest.manual: Search every corner of $map:52000043$ for the sacred being
quest.complete: Show what you found to Tinchai in $map:52000043$

quest.name: Shadow Assault
