quest.desc: $npc:11001707$ explains that the Master once called this incense burner the 'Light of Munakra,' saying it wasn't a divine artifact but served as a guide to finding the light. Now that the Master is gone, $npc:11001707$ says the one who inherited the Master's Animar should be able to ignite the Light of Munakra by channeling Animar's power into it. Let's try to light the Light of Munakra as she says.
quest.manual: Activate the sacred incense burner, Light of Munakra, in $map:52000043$|Defeat all enemies that appear in $map:52000043$

quest.name: The Chief Disciple's Fury
quest.desc: $npc:11001707$ says $npcName:11001716$ seems a bit sensitive but we should understand, and suggests taking the Light of Munakra back to their quarters to talk calmly. But the incense burner was already gone. $npcName:11001716$ erupts in anger, demanding to know why we hid the information about the connection to Beyond Link and $npc:23000081$. Harshly telling us to get out of sight... Let's step outside to calm down, then return to $map:52000041$ to meet the senior disciples.
quest.manual: Speak with the senior disciples in $map:52000043$

quest.name: A Guard in Danger
quest.desc: $npc:11001838$, terrified, calls for help. He asks you to defeat the fearsome creatures blocking the path... Looking at his desperate eyes, he truly seems frightened. As a good deed, let's grant his request.

quest.name: Jody's Gift
quest.desc: $npc:11001838$ is extremely grateful and hands you a gift. Having failed at the training academy and unable to become an official guard, let's cheer him on as he takes on what may be his last chance—escorting the Amherst transport ship.

quest.name: How to Get to Tria
quest.desc: $npc:11001838$ asks if there's anything he can help with. When asked how to get to $map:02000001$, he says small boats can't make the trip due to recent storms, so it would be best to take the ship of the $map:63000001$ audience celebration delegation. Let's meet $npcTitle:11000052$ $npcName:11000052$ to find out how to board the ship.

quest.name: Amherst's Pride
quest.desc: When asked for a ride on the ship, $npc:11000052$ says with a reluctant face that the celebration delegation has a mission to promote $map:63000001$ in $map:02000001$, and he's been preparing hard. Since there may not be enough room on the prepared ship, he suggests speaking with boatman $npcName:11000016$...

quest.name: The Village Chief's Wish
quest.desc: When asked if there's room on the ship, $npc:11000016$ hints that the village chief probably wants something, and fulfilling his request could make things easier. Let's go to the chief and offer to help.

quest.name: A Beautiful Egg
quest.desc: $npc:11000052$ wants to introduce the eggs of the rare Pecky Bird as a $map:63000001$ specialty. But the Pecky Bird is extremely hard to find... He asks you to find the eggs too, with the spirit of a treasure hunt, and promises to definitely give you a spot on the ship if you succeed. Let's go to the dock and meet $npc:11000021$, a local who knows a bit about Pecky Birds.

quest.name: Rumors About the Pecky Bird
quest.desc: $npc:11000021$ warns that the Pecky Bird is extremely hard to find, then shares a story passed down in the village. The Pecky Bird is said to live in high places with clear water. Let's follow the path behind $map:63000003$ and climb up to the waterfall in the back mountain.
quest.complete: Speak with $npc:11001839$ searching for Pecky Bird traces in a high place of $map:63000001$

quest.name: Searching for the Egg
quest.desc: $npc:11001838$ says he saw a strange bird appear on the cliff, do something, then fly high away. But he's too afraid of heights to climb any further... Let's climb up the wall and see what's there.
quest.manual: Search the Pecky Bird's nest on the cliff for an egg

quest.name: The Delegation Departs
quest.desc: $npc:11001838$ is overjoyed and says to bring $item:30000598$ to $npc:11000052$. He says he'll go down first since he's scared... Let's head back to $map:63000003$ and meet $npc:11000052$.

quest.name: A New Departure
quest.desc: $npc:11000096$, met right after getting off the ship, says $npc:11001839$ left a message to come to $map:02000068$ and ran up the stairs. But he doesn't know where $map:02000068$ is... Let's talk to $npc:11000022$, who appears to be a local.

quest.name: The Broken Path
quest.desc: $npc:11000022$ is glad to hear $npcName:11001839$'s name. Turns out they've been friends since childhood. He says $npcName:11001839$, who is timid but always hardworking, needs to get to $map:02000001$ safely, but it won't be easy. He suggests going to $map:02000068$ to hear the details. Let's meet $npc:11000019$ in $map:02000068$.

quest.name: Terry's Suggestion
quest.desc: Many people have come to $map:02000062$ to get to $map:02000001$ ahead of the audience ceremony. But an earthquake has broken Royal Road, leaving many stranded... Let's talk to the troubled $npc:11000019$ to find a way.

quest.name: A Shortcut to Tria
quest.desc: The mountain path to the northwest of $map:02000062$ connects to $map:02000001$, but strange poisonous plants and sleep-inducing pollen have started appearing recently, so it was closed for safety reasons. But it's undeniably the only option to reach $map:02000001$ in time for the audience ceremony... Let's meet $npc:11000024$ who's guarding the $map:63000041$ entrance northwest of $map:02000062$.
quest.complete: Speak with $npc:11000024$ guarding the $map:63000041$ entrance northwest of $map:02000062$

quest.name: What We Met on That Path
quest.desc: $npc:11000024$, standing guard northwest of $map:02000062$ at $map:63000041$, says $npcName:11001838$ is already waiting inside with the group from $map:63000001$. Let's enter $map:63000041$ and head toward $map:02000001$ where the audience ceremony will be held, together with $npcName:11001838$.
quest.manual: Enter $map:63000041$ northwest of $map:02000062$ as $npc:11000024$ directed, and travel to $map:02000001$ with $npc:11001838$

quest.name: Incident Report
quest.desc: $npcName:11001841$ lies in bed groaning. Having collapsed right after meeting $npcName:11001851$, he doesn't seem to remember much about her. But he's gathered information that many such attacks have been occurring near $map:02000001$... To report the incident in detail, let's go meet $npc:11000119$ on behalf of the patient $npcName:11001841$.
quest.complete: Report the attack incident to $npc:11000119$ in $map:02000001$

quest.name: The Guard Captain's Silence
quest.desc: After receiving the report, $npc:11000119$ warns with an authoritative attitude not to get recklessly involved in this matter. He also seems dismissive about $npcName:11001841$'s official enlistment... Let's go back to $npc:11001841$ and share the results.

quest.name: Suspicious Incidents
quest.desc: $npcName:11001841$ says while hospitalized, he heard strange conversations from people around him and finds many things suspicious. $npc:11001842$, $npcName:11001841$'s training academy classmate from $map:63000041$, also has stories to share... Let's meet $npc:11001842$ in $map:63000042$.

quest.name: Memories of That Day
quest.desc: $npc:11001843$ says $npc:11000119$ acted differently after the incident, ordering the guards to keep quiet. He says military orders must be followed even if unconvincing, and strangely, his memories of that day seem to be fading quickly. Let's go back to the worried $npc:11001841$ and share the conversation.

quest.name: Following the Rumors
quest.desc: Someone is trying to cover up the truth. Since the guards are bound by military orders and can't investigate freely, we need to start looking into things ourselves. Let's begin by finding someone well-informed about the Royal Guard and the royal family to discover the real reason the audience ceremony was canceled. Let's visit $npc:11000169$, who $npcName:11001841$ says 'hears a lot of passing information.'

quest.name: Deepening Worries
quest.desc: $npc:11000169$ seems to have something on her mind. Let's meet $npc:11000169$ in $map:02000001$.

quest.name: The Sacred Rock Spirit
quest.desc: $npc:11000119$ has received reports that evil dark shamans are trying to corrupt the sacred rock spirit in $map:02000055$, and requests a scouting mission there on behalf of the Royal Guard, who lacks the resources.
quest.manual: Assess and deal with the situation in $map:02000055$

quest.name: Request from the Darkwind Commander
quest.desc: $npc:11000601$ says someone from the Darkwind forces among the garrison stationed in $map:02000146$ has requested help, and suggests meeting $npc:11000266$.

quest.name: The Fugitive of Sunset Tower
quest.desc: $npc:11000266$ says there's been a report of a robot resembling $npc:23100055$, which was previously developed as a weapon of war, appearing in $map:02000099$. He asks you to check on the situation there.
quest.manual: Assess and deal with the situation in $map:02000099$

quest.name: Dark Shadow of the Watchtower
quest.desc: $npc:11000601$ says farmers are suffering from a massive horde of pigs that invaded near $map:02000091$, and asks you to help $map:02000076$ $npc:11000015$ who is conducting extermination operations there.
quest.manual: Hold off the pig horde attack in $map:02000334$ until the end

quest.name: The Guard Captain's Request
quest.desc: $npc:11000119$ has been looking for you, saying he has a message. Let's meet him in $map:02000001$.

quest.name: Horus's Nest
quest.desc: $npc:11000119$ reports that the leader of the sacred Griffin race, $npc:23100021$, has lost its senses and is setting the surrounding mountains ablaze, even attacking the Pigming tribe people who are trying to calm it down. He says he doesn't want to add to the worries of the troubled $npc:11000075$, and requests you to check on the situation in $map:02000316$.

quest.name: The Guard Captain's Summons
quest.desc: $npc:11000119$ has been looking for you, saying he has a message. Let's meet him in $map:02000001$.

quest.name: Source of the Flames
quest.desc: Fires of unknown origin are breaking out across Victoria Island. The suspected source is a place called $map:02000079$, the Spring of Lava. $npc:11000119$ says he wants to entrust this investigation to someone with good instincts for finding clues and strong combat abilities. Let's go investigate $map:02000079$ as he wishes.
quest.manual: Investigate $map:02000079$, the suspected source of the fires, thoroughly

quest.name: A Journalist with Conviction
quest.desc: $npc:11000566$ wants to expose the human rights issues in $map:02000100$. Having heard that Maple TV's $npc:11001191$ is a PD with strong convictions, she asks you to tell her that there's a story to cover if she meets the protesters in front of $map:02000100$ City Hall, since she can't step forward openly herself.

quest.name: A Request for Survival
quest.desc: $npc:11001191$ has been transferred to the entertainment division due to conflicts with the culture department head. The actor who was supposed to appear on her new program is unreachable, leaving her in quite a bind. In her distress, she asks if you'd like to do a part-time acting job for pay... Let's head to the filming location, $map:02000380$.

quest.name: Imperial Planning
quest.desc: Empress $npcName:11001969$ has sent for you. Meet her at $map:52000087$.

quest.name: Insights from the Sea
quest.desc:
$npc:11001969$ is concerned that so little is known about the enemy. You've suggested checking with the sailors of the Adventurer's Guild to see if they've heard anything in their travels.
Go to the $map:02000068$ in $map:02000062$ and see what you can learn.

quest.name: The Great Explorer
quest.desc: $npcName:11000019$ doesn't know anything useful, but the famous explorer But since the famous explorer $npcName:11003080$ is staying in the $map:52000095$. Ask if he's seen anything unusual in his travels.

quest.name: An Ominous Warning
quest.desc:
$npcName:11003080$ was injured in a pirate attack and is bedridden. While he hasn't seen the forces of darkness himself, he did hear a prophecy from the siren $npcName:24003002$ about a great disaster. You've decided to travel to $map:02000391$ and hear the rumor for yourself, but you'll need a ship and a good navigator to get there.
Go to $map:02000182$ and meet with $npcName:11003082$.

quest.name: Chorrie's Bad Day
quest.desc: $npcName:11003082$ is the only navigator who can get you to the sirens. He's also being attacked by pirates in his cabin. Perhaps you should lend him a hand.

quest.name: Green-eyed Monsters
quest.desc:
$npc:23000015$ targeted $npcName:11003080$ out of jealousy. It seems the pirate captain has a thing for $npcName:24003002$...
$npcName:11003082$ doesn't want anything to do with this business, but he's agreed to help you get to $map:02000391$ out of respect for $npcName:11003080$.

quest.name: In Search of Sirens
quest.desc:
$npcName:11003082$ is ready to set sail. Go to $map:02000391$ and meet with $npcName:24003002$.
Use the Enter Dungeon button to travel to the dungeon regardless of your item level.
quest.manual: Use Enter Dungeon button to go to $dungeonTitle:21022001$ and calm $npcName:24003001$ |Calm $npcName:24003002$
quest.complete: Return to $map:52000096$ in $map:02000182$ and meet with $npcName:11003082$

quest.name: A Meeting with Alvanos
quest.desc:
The sirens intend to hijack the pirates' ship. Join $npcName:24003001$ in the attack, and then meet with $npcName:24002931$.
Use the Enter Dungeon button to travel to the dungeon regardless of your item level.
quest.manual: Use Enter Dungeon button to go to $dungeonTitle:21023001$ and calm $npcName:24002931$

quest.name: Guardian of the Seas
quest.desc:
$npcName:24002931$ is calming. Use $npcName:24003002$'s power to drive away the mists and have a conversation with $npcName:24002931$.
Use the Enter Dungeon button to travel to the dungeon regardless of your item level.

quest.name: The Explorer and the Sea
quest.desc: Your meeting with $npcName:24002931$ was short, but it gave you plenty to think about. Meet with $npcName:11003080$ and tell him what the sirens are up to.

quest.name: A Tale Untellable
quest.desc: $npcName:11003080$ is giddy that you met $npcName:24002931$, but you can't possibly tell him about the vision you saw. Return to the $map:52000087$ in $map:02000001$ and report to Empress $npcName:11001969$.

quest.name: Captain's Calling
quest.desc: $npc:11000076$ is on a mission deep in the frozen wastes and has requested your help. Meet him at the $map:52000080$ in $map:02000261$.

quest.name: Unknown Enemy
quest.desc: $npcName:11000076$ was scouting the ice cave in $map:02000260$ when he encountered the forces of darkness. A $npcName:11003062$ appeared during the fight and left the captain with his injured. Head to the $map:52000081$ and look for clues.

quest.name: The Swordsman in the Cold
quest.desc:
You were trapped and surrounded in the $map:52000081$, but the $npcName:11003062$ appeared and gave you a chance to escape. Before he vanished into the blizzard, he warned you to go no further if you value your life.
Return to the $map:52000080$ and report this to $npc:11000076$.

quest.name: The Frozen Path
quest.desc: $npc:11003054$ has heard tales of $map:52000082$ and its $npcName:11003064$. He suggests you ask $npcName:11003060$, who was a citizen of the snow kingdom that used to be here, if there's a way through the frozen path.

quest.name: The Recluse Herbalist
quest.desc: $npcName:11003060$ knows of a potion that can make you resistant to the cold of the blizzard in $map:52000082$. Another yeti, $npcName:11003063$, knows how to make it. Find him at $map:02000263$.

quest.name: Burning Breath
quest.desc:
$npcName:11003063$ is not exactly happy with his former queen. You barely managed to convince him to make you the potion.
Of course, now you have to gather the ingredients for him.

quest.name: The Wavering Queen
quest.desc:
$npcName:11003063$ made you a bottle of $item:20000451$ that will let you pass through $map:52000082$. The potion's effects are temporarily, so be sure to use it just before you enter! Once you enter the $map:52000083$, continue your investigation.
If you need more $item:20000451$, go to $npcName:11003063$ in $map:02000263$.
quest.manual: Drink $item:20000451$ and search $map:52000083$ at the end of $map:52000082$

quest.name: The Queen's Knight
quest.desc: Long ago, $npcName:11003060$ was the palace gatekeeper for the kingdom of snow. $npcName:11003065$ needs his help to get to the $map:52000085$, where $npc:11003069$ is. Since $npcName:11003065$ is injured, deliver her message to $npcName:11003060$ and go to the $map:52000085$ in her place.

quest.name: The Raging Snowstorm
quest.desc:
$npc:11003060$ says that the $map:52000085$ guards the path to the $map:52000086$, where the snow kingdom's secret treasure was kept. He's worried that the specter who appeared to $npcName:11003069$ is connected to the darkness and is using her to get the treasure.
Enter the hidden cave door in $map:02000260$ to join $npcName:11003060$ at the $map:52000084$, then investigate the $map:52000085$.
quest.manual: Enter $map:52000084$ through the hidden path in $map:02000260$ and investigate $map:52000085$

quest.name: To the Temple
quest.desc: $npc:11003069$ opened the path to the temple, but the vault to the Frozen Crystal is still locked. It seems likely that the forces of darkness are manipulating events here. Get ready to leave for the $map:52000086$ with $npcName:11003060$.

quest.name: Frost and Shadow
quest.desc: Meet $npcName:11003060$ at the $map:52000086$. You can get there through the passageway on the tallest, steepest part of $map:02000263$.
quest.complete: Return to $map:52000080$ in $map:02000261$ and report to $npc:11000076$

quest.name: The Captain's Concern
quest.desc:
$npcName:11000076$ is sorry that he was too busy to help with the investigation. He's also concerned that the enemy seems to preparing for something, and he has no idea what it is.
He's received recall orders back to $map:02000001$. Speak with $npcName:11003060$ in the $map:52000080$.

quest.name: Those Who Remain
quest.desc:
$npcName:11003069$ has resealed the path to the $map:02000383$ and sends you her thanks. $npcName:11003060$ will return to his business in $map:02000001$, but he'll be sure to keep an eye on things back at his old home.
Return to $map:52000087$ in $map:02000001$ and report to Empress $npcName:11001969$.

quest.name: Dilemma
quest.desc: $npc:11000119$ and $npc:11000074$ can't agree on what to do about the attack on $map:02000076$. Perhaps you can provide $npc:11000075$ with an alternative solution.

quest.name: Crisis in Henesys
quest.desc:
You volunteered to provide reinforcements for $map:02000076$, which is under attack from the forces of darkness. Help $npcName:11000001$ and $npcName:11000015$ defeat the invaders.
Talk to $npcName:11000075$ in $map:52000033$ to join the battle.
quest.manual: Defend $map:52000120$ (Speak with $npcName:11000075$ in the $map:52000033$ to begin)

quest.name: Elder's Request
quest.desc: $npcName:11000015$ thanks you for defending $map:02000076$. However, the town has sustained some damage, and they need help getting back on their feet. Speak with $npc:11000001$.

quest.name: An Immature Son
quest.desc: $npcName:11000001$ wants you to bring his son $npcName:11000502$ home. As one of the Seven Heroes, it seems the elder holds his son to extremely high expectations, and now he's worried the boy will do something rash. $npcName:11000502$ may be at $map:02000027$.

quest.name: In Search of Armano
quest.desc: $npc:11000273$ claims that $npcName:11000502$ hasn't been in to see him all day. $npcName:11000961$ is supposedly $npcName:11000502$'s childhood friend. You may as well deliver the doctor's $item:30000767$ to her in $map:02000076$ when you go to question her.
quest.manual: Search the cabinet in $map:02000027$ and take $item:30000767$

quest.name: The Hero's Son
quest.desc: $npcName:11000961$ is surprised that you're looking for $npcName:11000502$. She knows he has a bad reputation, but it's because he tries so hard to live up to his father's legacy. She hasn't seen him since he fought with his father at the hospital, but she's certain he's still in $map:02000076$ somewhere.

quest.name: Henesys at a Glance
quest.desc:
$npcName:11000478$ lives at the top of the hill in $map:02000076$. He says it's easy to see what's going on in town if you look through a telescope.
If you still can't find $npcName:11000502$ after using the telescope, try asking $npcName:11000189$ if he's been by her cornfield.

quest.name: A Corny Greeting
quest.desc: $npcName:11000189$ has a mischievous streak. She'll tell you where to find what you're after... but only if you give her corn stalks a pep talk! You can greet by typing /greet in the chat window or pressing the F1 key.
quest.manual: Greet $npcName:11000189$'s corn in $map:02000076$ by pressing the F1 key or typing /greet in the chat window.

quest.name: A Helpful Fellow
quest.desc:
$npcName:11000189$ always keeps her promises, no matter how strange they are. She tells you that $npcName:11000502$ ran off to get reinforcements from Dark Wind. While he may think that's a great idea, you know that $map:02000100$ is still recovering from the attack, and Dark Wind is in no position to help out.
It seems that $npcName:11000189$'s contact is a gaudily dressed man in $map:02000083$. See if you can find him.

quest.name: Den of Thieves
quest.desc:
$npcName:11000101$ is trying to pretend he doesn't know $npcName:11000502$. Luckily for you, he's also a complete idiot. It was easy to get the information you needed from him.
It sounds like $npcName:11000502$ is being held in $map:02000243$. You'll have to go through $map:02000241$ to get there.

quest.name: The Dupe
quest.desc: $npcName:11000173$ confesses to trying to kidnap $npcName:11000502$. However, the elder's son slipped away in the chaos and escaped to $map:02000134$.

quest.name: Never Empty-handed
quest.desc: $npcName:11000502$ went into the $map:02000224$ in $map:02000134$. He refuses to go home until you get the $itemPlural:20000050$ from the monsters there.

quest.name: Another Crisis
quest.desc:
$npcName:11000502$ finally agreed to go home, but only if you remembered the fact that he was the real hero today. You were about to agree when $npcName:11000961$ suddenly appeared. It seems $npcName:11000001$ has gone to face the remaining forces of darkness himself.
$npcName:11000502$ has a worrying fire burning in his eyes. Hurry to $map:02000054$.

quest.name: A Father's Heart
quest.desc: You reached $map:02000054$, where $npcName:11000961$'s sister-in-arms $npcName:11000786$ is wounded. $npcName:11000001$ and $npcName:11000015$ are outgunned in $map:52000121$. Hurry to their side!

quest.name: A Late Regret
quest.desc: $npcName:11000001$ was injured protecting his son. $npcName:11000502$ wanted to seek revenge, but $npcName:11000015$ and $npcName:11000119$ stopped him. While he's off sulking, you should find out what $npcName:11001838$ is doing here.

quest.name: The Next Plan
quest.desc: $npcName:11001838$ is thrilled that he's one step closer to being a real guard, but he's not any closer to reaching $npc:11000119$'s standards. Speak with $npcName:11000119$ about your next moves.

quest.name: Farewell for Now
quest.desc:
$npcName:11001838$ is surprised that you volunteered to go to the $map:02000146$. He promises that he'll become a great guard someday.
Hurry to the $map:02000146$ and meet $npc:11000076$.

quest.name: Shadow Research
quest.desc:
The work at the $map:02000146$ isn't going very well. You can help by getting $npcName:11000264$ some materials for his research.
Gather $itemPlural:20000047$ from the monsters at the center of the $map:02000146$, then bring them to $npcName:11000264$.

quest.name: The Research Resumes
quest.desc: $npcName:11000264$ is impressed that you collected the $itemPlural:20000047$ so quickly. As you were discussing the situation, $npcName:11000032$ of $map:02000023$ appeared. See what he wants.

quest.name: A Dark Threat
quest.desc: The $map:02000146$ used to be the Door of Light. $npcName:11000032$'s research is about finding a way to fight the darkness that is threatening the world. Now that $npcName:11000264$ is done analyzing the $itemPlural:20000047$, see what he's learned.

quest.name: A Blue Light in the Darkness
quest.desc: It seems that an unknown glowing substance is either a byproduct or component of $item:20000047$. $npcName:11000264$ has never seen anything like it, but when he questioned $npcName:11000032$ on the matter, $npcName:11000032$ merely asked him if the $itemPlural:20000016$ were ready.

quest.name: The Most Dangerous Garden
quest.desc:
$itemPlural:20000016$ are made from the $itemPlural:20000045$ that thrive in this place. They're usually hard to farm, but $npcName:11000032$ managed to make a patch of magical soil that they grow in. The $itemPlural:20000045$ would be a piece of cake to harvest... if it weren't for the monsters crowding the garden in front of the $map:02000026$.
Go pick some $itemPlural:20000045$ for $npcName:11000264$.
quest.manual: Pick $itemPlural:20000045$ in garden of the $map:02000026$ at the $map:02000146$

quest.name: The Amazing Invention
quest.desc: $npcName:11000264$ claims that his new medicine formula is super effective and easy to make. Put the $itemPlural:20000045$ in the mixer and try making the $itemPlural:20000016$ yourself.

quest.name: An Unknown Substance
quest.desc: $npcName:11000032$ is returning to $map:02000023$ to confer with the headmaster, $npc:11000031$. Speak with him to come along.
quest.complete: Speak with $npcName:11000031$ in $map:52000134$ (If you leave by mistake, talk to $npc:11000033$ again to return.)

quest.name: Fruits of Research
quest.desc:
$npc:11000031$, the headmaster of $map:52000133$, welcomes you to the campus. Listen in as $npcName:11000032$'s delivers his report.
If you leave by mistake, talk to $npc:11000033$ in $map:02000023$ to return.
quest.complete: Speak with $npcName:11003282$ in $map:52000134$ (If you leave by mistake, talk to $npc:11000033$ again to return.)

quest.name: Einos's Hypothesis
quest.desc: $npcName:11000032$ believes that the substance coming from the $item:20000045$ is the means by which the power of darkness spreads, and he thinks he can prove it. Go to $map:52000135$ and observe his experiment.
quest.complete: Speak with $npcName:11003250$ in $map:52000135$ (If you leave by mistake, talk to $npc:11000033$ again to return.)

quest.name: The Excellent Student
quest.desc:
The forces of darkness have attacked $map:02000023$, but $npc:11000031$ managed to keep $map:02000023$ safe with a magical shield. His strength is waning, so you need to hurry.
At $npcName:11000031$'s request, work with the academy's star citizen in $map:52000101$.
If you leave by mistake, talk to $npc:11000033$ in $map:02000023$ again to return.
quest.complete: Meet the academy's star student at $map:52000133$ (If you leave by mistake, talk to $npc:11000033$ to return.)

quest.name: A Fresh Start
quest.desc:
$npcName:11003146$, star student of $map:52000101$, insists that you purify your body in the spring since you've picked up all kinds of minor curses while fighting the darkness. Take a nice, relaxing soak.
If you leave by mistake, talk to $npc:11000033$ in $map:02000023$ again to return.
quest.complete: Speak with $npcName:11003146$ in $map:52000133$ (If you leave by mistake, talk to $npc:11000033$ again to return.)

quest.name: Totem Repair Duty
quest.desc:
The barrier around the academy is reinforced by magic totems. These totems are especially fragile, so the students of Ellinel often have to repair them. $npcName:11003146$ sent $npcName:11000284$ to $map:02000006$ to do some totem repairs, but she hasn't come back. Check in with her close underclassman, $npcName:11000029$, in $map:02000023$.
If you leave by mistake, talk to $npc:11000033$ in $map:02000023$ again to return.

quest.name: Cheer Up, Arwen
quest.desc: $npcName:11000029$ admits that $npcName:11000284$ can be slow sometimes, but it's only because she wants to do a good job. It's possible she's still in $map:02000006$. Take the $item:30000768$ and travel to $map:02000006$ to meet $npcName:11000284$.

quest.name: Unexpected Difficulties
quest.desc:
$npcName:11000284$ visited one of the locals, $npcName:11000304$, for help. Unfortunately, $npcName:11000304$ doesn't seem to want any visitors. If you defeat the $npcPlural:33000006$ that are roaming the area, it might prove your good intentions to her.
Once you're done with the monsters, find $npcName:11000304$ in the $map:02000073$.

quest.name: The Witch's Riddle
quest.desc:
$npcName:11000304$ ridiculed $npcName:11000284$ for failing to solve the riddle. Now it's your turn:
"Two divine creatures lost their hearts when darkness fell. End their pain and redeem the forsaken soul"
What does this riddle mean? Return to $npcName:11000284$ and find the answer together.

quest.name: The Wrong Answer
quest.desc: $npcName:11000284$ thought she had the answer, but she failed. Her answer makes some sense to you, so you've left to investigate. Search the $map:02000074$.

quest.name: The Forsaken
quest.desc:
You bumped into $npcName:11003146$ in the $map:02000074$, and she figured out the answer to the riddle in a snap.
Go to $map:02000089$ and defeat $npcName:22000038$. Once that's done, meet with $npcName:11000285$.

quest.name: A Turtle's Tears
quest.desc: $npcName:11000285$ is heartbroken. The day the darkness fell, monsters trampled over the precious flowers that mark the memory of his true love. Save the dying flowers on his behalf.

quest.name: The Soul Key
quest.desc:
$npcName:11000285$ remembers a mage who dealt in forbidden magic to be with the one he loved. Even when the world called him a villain, he wanted his power to make the world a better place. His power is still hidden in the place where he fell...
Could this power be the thing that's hiding in the $map:02000074$? Return to the $map:02000074$ in $map:02000006$.

quest.name: Box of Magic
quest.desc: $npcName:11003146$ is gone, but she's left a note behind, as well as some sort of magical box. She also writes that the riddle was easy for her because she's great, and not because $npcName:11000284$ is lacking in any way. For now, check out the box in the $map:02000074$ in $map:02000006$ and then meet $npcName:11000284$ in $map:02000006$.
quest.manual: Check the magic box in the $map:02000074$ in $map:02000006$.

quest.name: The Aid of the Light
quest.desc: The magic box you found is now a totem supporting the headmaster's magic barrier. $npcName:11000284$ is relieved that the situation is finally resolved. Head back to $map:02000023$ and report to $npcName:11000033$.

quest.name: Attack from Within
quest.desc: $npcName:11000033$ says that something has started attacking the barrier from within. He suspects the disturbance is coming from $map:02000312$, an old dark fairy temple. He sent one of his students, $npcName:11000876$, to $map:02000024$ to check it out.

quest.name: Sweet Tooth
quest.desc: $npcName:11000876$ asked $npcName:11000293$, the eldest of the creatures here, for clues, but $npcName:11000293$ simply smiled. $npcName:11000876$ is certain that some sweets will jog the creature's memory. Defeat the monsters in $map:02000024$ and gather $itemPlural:20000052$ from the nearby boxes.

quest.name: The Seed of Darkness
quest.desc: $npcName:11000293$ feels good after eating the $itemPlural:20000052$. He recalls seeing the entrance to $map:02000312$ behind the waterfall at the center of this place. Complete your investigation, then return to $npcName:11000033$ in $map:02000023$.

quest.name: Ellinel Express
quest.desc: You need to report your findings to $npc:11000031$. To get back to Ellinel, you need to take the Ellinel Express from $map:02000023$. Apparently, you'll need to find the littlest mage in $map:02000023$ to depart.

quest.name: The Mages of Ellinel
quest.desc:
The littlest mage in $map:02000023$ is $npcName:11003257$, a pretty kitty on a red cushion. After traveling via the Ellinel Express, you met $npcName:11003146$ in $map:52000101$. She tried to drop more work in your lap, but $npcName:11000032$ appeared and asked her to get a report from you.
$npcName:11003146$ is fuming. Go ahead and talk to her.

quest.name: The Missing Child
quest.desc:
One of the elementary students, $npcName:11001165$, got into the lab storage room and stole an experimental potion. He left behind a note claiming that he'll be a great hero someday... but $npcName:11000032$ is worried that the stolen potion is actually a shadow reagent that could take the child's life.
Meet with $npcName:11001167$, who is looking for his younger brother in $map:02000101$.

quest.name: Dang Kids
quest.desc: $npcName:11001166$'s older brother, $npcName:11001167$, is worried because his attempts to frighten his little brother straight only made the kid more bold. He'll search to the north while you search to the south of $map:02000101$.

quest.name: Think of the Children
quest.desc: $npcName:11001166$ and his friends went into the forest to investigate some shadows he saw, but they got separated. He made it out, but his friends are still in there. Enter $map:02000331$ and help $npcName:11001166$ save his fellow kids.

quest.name: A Child's Request
quest.desc:
$npcName:11003253$ confesses that she drank the potion $npcName:11001166$ brought, thinking it was a mana potion. She also wants to know what kind of snacks $npcName:11003257$ likes...
Speak with $npcName:11003257$ to return to Ellinel.

quest.name: Ellinel in Shadow
quest.desc:
$npcName:11003257$ says that a huge cloud of dark magic is covering Ellinel, blinding her to whatever is happening in the campus. Her attempt to teleport you directly to $npcName:11000032$ failed, though she thinks she can get you to $npcName:11003146$.
If you leave by mistake, talk to $npc:11003257$ in $map:02000023$ to return.
quest.complete: Speak with $npcName:11003146$ in $map:52000100$ (If you leave by mistake, talk to $npc:11003257$ in $map:02000023$ to return.)

quest.name: Two Faces of Einos
quest.desc:
Darkness has engulfed $map:52000136$ and driven $npcName:11000032$ into a feral rage. $npcName:11003146$ is still in shock and doesn't know what to do with herself. Shadow magic flows from $map:52000137$, where only $npcName:11000031$ and $npcName:11000032$ remain. It's time for you to see this for yourself.
If you leave by mistake, talk to $npc:11003257$ in $map:02000023$ to return.
quest.manual: Fight the dark creature in $map:52000137$ (If you leave by mistake, talk to $npc:11003257$ in $map:02000023$ to return.)

quest.name: Whereabouts Unknown
quest.desc:
The scholars of Ellinel believe $npcName:11000032$'s transformation is related to his research. Based on her research as $map:02000001$'s head librarian, $npcName:11000005$ suspects that a shadow seed may have been involved. The mere suggestion seems to have upset $npcName:11003146$...
Finish your conversation with $npcName:11000005$.

quest.name: What's Left Behind
quest.desc: $npcName:11000005$ is convinced that a mage of $npcName:11000032$'s caliber would have noticed the changes he was undergoing. It's impossible to return to Ellinel, but he did maintain an off-site workspace in $map:02000109$. Search for any records or notes while $npcName:11000033$ and $npcName:11000005$ work on restoring the Ellinel Express.

quest.name: The Source of Darkness
quest.desc: You found $npcName:11003265$ in a hidden compartment. According to these notes, the strange blue light found on many of the objects and substances around the $map:02000146$ is actually a contagious form of darkness. This power is focused and spreading from the $map:02000326$. Hurry there and cut off the supply of darkness before it spreads further.
quest.manual: Search the space behind the waterfall

quest.name: Spreading Danger
quest.desc:
While reading $npcName:11000032$'s notes, you found evidence that someone else had already been there—including a lost $item:30000769$. You'll have to be sure to give it back to $npcName:11003146$ when you see her again.
Hurry to the $map:02000146$ and warn $npcName:11000076$ of the danger.

quest.name: A Critical Moment
quest.desc: You arrived at the $map:02000146$, but $npc:11000076$ was already on a mission to the $map:02000213$ to investigate. Hurry there and defeat whoever is behind this spreading darkness.
quest.manual: Defeat the source of darkness at the $dungeonTitle:20006001$

quest.name: The Flow of Darkness
quest.desc:
$npc:11000076$ has brought you up to speed on the happenings around the $map:02000146$. The monster attacks are growing more vicious, and a new disease is spreading alongside the shadow poisons. Thus far, only $npcName:11000264$ and his research associates have managed to slow the infection.
Speak with $npcName:11000264$.

quest.name: A Bright New Crisis
quest.desc:
$npcName:11000264$ is shocked after hearing about what happened in $map:02000023$.
$npc:11000076$ wants to talk strategy.

quest.name: A Regret Too Late
quest.desc: Return to the $map:02000146$ and tell $npc:11000076$ about the loss of another one of the Seven Heroes.

quest.name: The Guard Captain's Request
quest.desc: $npc:11000119$ has requested your help in $map:02000001$. What's so urgent that the captain of the guard needs your help?

quest.name: Capital Crisis
quest.desc: Go to $map:02000001$ and meet with $npc:11000119$.

quest.name: Under the Palace
quest.desc: $npcName:11000057$ and her minions have kidnapped $npc:11000074$ and vanished into the $map:02000252$. While the guard prepare their assault, go to the $map:02000252$ and keep an eye on $npcName:11000057$'s forces.

quest.name: A Meeting with the Minister
quest.desc: $npcName:11000119$ says that $npc:11000074$ wants to thank you, and suggests that you go meet him. Go to the $map:02000065$ in $map:02000001$ and meet with $npcName:11000074$.

quest.name: The Minister's Choice
quest.desc: $npcName:11000057$ is $npcName:11000074$'s daughter. While he is a loyalist to the throne, she seeks to spread chaos and uproot the empire. He asks you not to tell anyone else that $npcName:11000057$ was here, but you can't shake the feeling that there's something he's not telling you...

quest.name: Royal Magics
quest.desc: $npcName:11003432$ has come to $npcName:11000074$'s office to borrow the Scroll of $map:02000001$, a manuscript kept by the royal mages. He had it hidden in $map:02000218$ to keep it safe from thieves. Go fetch it while $npcName:11003432$ and $npcName:11000074$ discuss another important matter.

quest.name: Mind of a Minister
quest.desc: $npcName:11000530$ gave you the $item:30000870$, and asked you to give the minister his regards. Return to $npcName:11003432$ in the $map:02000065$.
quest.complete: Return to $map:02000065$ in $map:02000001$ and speak with $npcName:11003432$

quest.name: Happy News
quest.desc:
$npcName:11003432$ has invited you to go with her to see $npcName:11000032$, who's suddenly returned.
If you leave by mistake, use the $npcName:11003497$ next to $npcName:11003257$ in $map:02000023$ to return.
quest.complete: Speak with $npcName:11003433$ in $map:52000102$ <font color="#909090">If you leave by mistake, use the $npcName:11003497$ next to $npcName:11003257$ in $map:02000023$ to return</font>

quest.name: The Return of Einos
quest.desc:
$npcName:11000032$ is recovering in the $map:52000149$ and still hasn't woken up. Go see how he's doing.
If you leave by mistake, use the $npcName:11003497$ next to $npcName:11003257$ in $map:02000023$ to return.
quest.complete: Speak with $npcName:11003438$ inside the $map:52000149$ <font color="#909090">If you leave by mistake, use the $npcName:11003497$ next to $npcName:11003257$ in $map:02000023$ to return</font>

quest.name: The Unspeakable Truth
quest.desc:
According to $npcName:11003433$'s research, a great divine being placed an emissary in every dimension to guide and direct that world. These so-called "Innocents" possess the capability for both good and evil, and at some point must choose which of the two they will follow.
He thinks that $npcName:11000032$ is one of these Innocents, and that exposure to the Land of Darkness caused his evil side to temporarily awaken. He's asked you to keep this a secret for now, in order to prevent panic from spreading through $map:02000023$.
If you leave by mistake, use the $npcName:11003497$ next to $npcName:11003257$ in $map:02000023$ to return.
quest.complete: Speak with $npcName:11003433$ in the $map:52000149$ <font color="#909090">If you leave by mistake, use the $npcName:11003497$ next to $npcName:11003257$ in $map:02000023$ to return</font>

quest.name: Life Magic: Study 1
quest.desc:
$npcName:11003433$ is researching life magic in hopes of finding a way to cure $npcName:11000032$. First, he needs $item:30000179$. Find some for him while he reviews the book $npcName:11003432$ borrowed on his behalf.
If you leave by mistake, use the $npcName:11003497$ next to $npcName:11003257$ in $map:02000023$ to return.

quest.name: Life Magic: Study 2
quest.desc: $npcName:11000033$ needs $itemPlural:30000871$ from the $map:02000012$ in the $map:02000128$.

quest.name: Life Magic: Study 3
quest.desc: The last item $npcName:11000033$ needs for his treatment is $item:30000190$. Get it from $npcName:23100025$ in the $map:02000206$.

quest.name: A Twisted Road
quest.desc:
$npcName:11003442$ attempted to teleport you to $npcName:11000033$ for the healing ritual, but some sort of interference caused you to appear in the $map:52000150$, instead.
If you leave by mistake, use the $npcName:11003497$ next to $npcName:11003257$ in $map:02000023$ to return.
quest.complete: Speak with $npcName:11000033$ in $map:52000150$ <font color="#909090">If you leave by mistake, use the $npcName:11003497$ next to $npcName:11003257$ in $map:02000023$ to return</font>

quest.name: Seed of Uncertainty
quest.desc:
While $npcName:11003438$ was moving $npcName:11000032$ to the $map:02000179$, his teleportation spell was blocked and he had to take a detour through the $map:52000150$. Hold off the attacking monsters while he keeps $npcName:11000032$ safe.
If you leave by mistake, use the $npcName:11003497$ next to $npcName:11003257$ in $map:02000023$ to return.
quest.complete: Speak with $npcName:11003440$ in $map:52000150$ <font color="#909090">If you leave by mistake, use the $npcName:11003497$ next to $npcName:11003257$ in $map:02000023$ to return</font>

quest.name: Defend the Forest
quest.desc:
$npcName:11000068$ is trying to enter the $map:02000179$ through the $map:02000066$. If he succeeds, all of $map:02000023$ will be in danger!
If you leave by mistake, use the $npcName:11003497$ next to $npcName:11003257$ in $map:02000023$ to return.
quest.complete: Speak with $npcName:11000033$ in $map:02000179$ <font color="#909090">If you leave by mistake, use the $npcName:11003497$ next to $npcName:11003257$ in $map:02000023$ to return</font>

quest.name: Shrouded in Mystery
quest.desc:
$npcName:11003439$ needs a book called the "Dimensional Dictionary" to cross-reference his research on the Innocents. Unfortunately, the book's owner doesn't seem keen to lend it out. See if you can convince $npcName:11000282$ of the $map:02000019$ in $map:02000215$ to part ways with it.
If you leave by mistake, use the $npcName:11003497$ next to $npcName:11003257$ in $map:02000023$ to return.

quest.name: The Librarian's Game
quest.desc: $npcName:11000282$ thinks you're no better than a thief for somehow knowing what books he has without asking first. However, if you can find the Dimensional Dictionary on your own, he may be willing to talk. Search inside the $map:02000019$.

quest.name: The Magic of Reading
quest.desc:
Someone has put a book in the wrong bookcase, and the $npcName:11000670$ is quite perturbed about the whole matter. Take the $item:30000082$ from the bookcase and return it to its proper location.
You'll need to get the key to the bookcase from a $npcName:21000216$.

quest.name: The Hidden Room
quest.desc: The Dimensional Dictionary has been enchanted so that nobody can read it. Even $npcName:11000282$, the book's owner, has no idea what it says. If you can come up with a way to dispel the enchantment, maybe you could convince him to lend it to you...

quest.name: Clash of Wills
quest.desc: $npcName:11000705$ of the $map:02000129$ knows how to remove the enchantment on the Dimensional Dictionary, but she's refused to help $npcName:11000282$ do it. Perhaps you can convince her to help you, instead.

quest.name: The Lost Ladle
quest.desc: Mischievous monsters have stolen $npcName:11000705$'s cooking utensil and hid it near $map:02000129$'s waterfall. Find $item:30000204$ on her behalf.
quest.manual: Find $item:30000204$ in the grass near $map:02000129$'s waterfall

quest.name: A Word to the Wise
quest.desc:
According to $npcName:11000705$, you need $npc:22000007$'s $item:30000186$ in order to read the Dimensional Dictionary. She's also insistent that you be the one to open the book when you get it...
Head to $map:02000180$ and get the $item:30000186$.

quest.name: The Livid Librarian
quest.desc: $npcName:11000282$ has agreed to let you read the Dimensional Dictionary with him in the $map:02000219$. Remember, you are supposed to open the book first.

quest.name: The Librarian's Defeat
quest.desc: $npcName:11003444$ is frustrated because he still can't read the book. He's agreed to lend it to you under the condition that you return with a transcription. It's time to return to $map:02000023$ and meet with $npcName:11000033$.

quest.name: Deciphering the Meaning
quest.desc:
Not even $npcName:11000033$ could read the book! There's a chance that $npcName:11000032$ is immune to the effects of the enchantment. Show him the Dimensional Dictionary.
If you leave by mistake, you can talk to $npc:11000033$ in $map:02000023$ to return.
quest.complete: Meet with $npc:11003445$ in $map:02000179$ <font color="#909090">If you leave by mistake, you can talk to $npcName:11000033$ in $map:02000023$ to return.</font>

quest.name: Dark Forces: A Study
quest.desc: $npcName:11003445$ has received reports that many of the divine creatures of Maple World have fallen under the influence of dark magic. Meet with $npcName:11000033$ in $map:02000023$ and come up with a plan to confirm this report.

quest.name: Dark Forces: Study 1
quest.desc: $npcName:11000033$ has heard that two of the ancient creatures of the forest have been acting up, and he'd like to begin by looking into $npcName:23100041$. Travel to $map:02000079$ and find out if the report is true.
quest.manual: Defeat $npc:23100041$, the ancient divine creature, in $dungeonTitle:20013001$

quest.name: Dark Forces: Study 2
quest.desc: Next, you need to check on $npcName:23100021$, who has been indiscriminately attacking passersby. Go to $map:02000316$ and see what you can learn.
quest.manual: Check on $npc:23000021$, who became wild in $dungeonTitle:20003001$

quest.name: Dark Forces: A Revelation
quest.desc:
$npcName:11000032$ needs to speak with you. Meet him in the $map:02000179$.
If you leave by mistake, talk to $npc:11000033$ in $map:02000023$ to return.
quest.complete: Meet with $npc:11003445$ in $map:02000179$ <font color="#909090">If you leave by mistake, you can talk to $npcName:11000033$ in $map:02000023$ to return.</font>

quest.name: Crystal Clarity
quest.desc:
While studying the Dimensional Dictionary, $npcName:11003445$ learned of a kind of magic crystal that can reveal answers to the questions that wear on the user's mind. He made such a crystal, so take a look.
If you leave by mistake, use the $npcName:11003497$ next to $npcName:11003257$ in $map:02000023$ to return.
quest.manual: Look into the crystal <font color="#909090">If you leave by mistake, you can either talk to $npcName:11000033$ or use the $npcName:11003497$ next to $npcName:11003257$ in $map:02000023$</font>

quest.name: Tracking the Truth
quest.desc:
$npcName:11003445$'s crystal showed you $npcName:11000044$, who seems to be looking for $npcName:11000526$. You need to find out how he's connected to the forces of darkness... and if Dark Wind is hiding something. Go to $map:02000157$ and speak to $npc:11000065$.
If you leave by mistake, use the $npcName:11003497$ next to $npcName:11003257$ in $map:02000023$ to return.

quest.name: A Personal Request
quest.desc:
According to $npcName:11000361$, $npc:11000065$ won't see anybody without an appointment, and he's not accepting any new appointments at the moment. If you want to get to the mayor, you'll have to curry favor with $npcName:11000361$ first...
Go to $map:02000008$ and check on her younger sister, $npcName:11000868$.

quest.name: Dashed Dreams
quest.desc: $npcName:11000868$ didn't expect her job to involve so many monsters. Her boss wants a report on the monsters' physical composition, but she can't stand to go near them. Defeat them and gather $itemPlural:30000872$ for her.

quest.name: The New Hire
quest.desc:
$npcName:11000868$ wants you to deliver her report to her boss, $npcName:11000869$. She also wants you to mention how she did a great job.
Find $npcName:11000869$ in $map:02000142$.

quest.name: The Clocktower's Secret
quest.desc: Time flows more slowly around the clock tower. If this effect spreads, the whole world could be thrown into chaos. Enter the $map:02000357$ and find out what's going on.

quest.name: Budget Wars
quest.desc: $npcName:11000869$ is annoyed that he can't continue his very important research with his current budget. $npc:11000065$ pledged to support his work, but has been silent for a while. Perhaps $npcName:11000361$ would help the situation if she knew how much it was hurting her sister's career...

quest.name: Ear of the Mayor
quest.desc: Thanks to the science of time travel, your appointment with $npc:11000065$ has finally arrived. Hurry up to the $map:02000154$.

quest.name: Dark Wind's Shadow
quest.desc:
$npc:11000065$ has nothing to say about Dark Wind. He did have some cryptic advice for you, however: not everything about a hero is great, and not everyone under a leader believes in the same values.
It looks like you have no choice but to go to $map:52000073$ and speak with $npcName:11000044$ in person.

quest.name: Weight of the World
quest.desc:
$npcName:11000044$ put on a big show about $npcName:11000526$ being beneath his concern. Any attempts to bring it up causes him to start talking about the hunt for $npcName:11000064$.
Maybe it's time you track $npcName:11000064$ down and have a nice, private chat about Dark Wind.
quest.complete: Talk to the $npcName:11003446$ who came to $map:02000152$

quest.name: The Boss's Fury
quest.desc: A $npcName:11003446$ is cowering in fear from $npcName:11000044$'s anger. It seems that he's been especially furious ever since $npcName:11000069$ disappeared.

quest.name: An Order from the Boss
quest.desc: $npcName:11000044$ says he needs everyone's help to find $npcName:11000069$. Go to $map:02000147$ and meet with $npcName:11000258$, who was standing guard when $npc:11000069$ disappeared.

quest.name: Zipped Lips
quest.desc: $npcName:11000258$ is convinced that $npcName:11000531$ is holding out on him due to some sort of grudge against Dark Wind. Since the bookseller doesn't know you, try asking him about $npcName:11000069$.

quest.name: A Tentative Lead
quest.desc: It doesn't seem like $npcName:11000531$ will have anything useful to say. Perhaps you can trace $npcName:11000069$'s steps to find out where she is.

quest.name: Dangerous Side Gig
quest.desc: Somebody hired $npcName:11000532$ to borrow and return the books. Who would do such a thing? Could they be connected to $npcName:11000069$'s disappearance?

quest.name: In Pursuit
quest.desc: $npcName:11000301$ didn't see anyone suspicious in the area, but he did mention an area under the $map:02000045$ that would make a perfect hiding spot. This seems like a good place to continue your search.

quest.name: Perion and Yamarcha
quest.desc:
The words "Yamarcha" and "$map:02000051$" are written on a wall under the $map:02000223$. What could Yamarcha mean?
This sounds like a question for $npcName:11000005$ of the $map:52000103$.

quest.name: Library Lookup
quest.desc: The Yamarcha were an ancient tribe from $map:02000051$ who sold their souls in exchange for power. $npcName:11000005$ is thrilled at your discovery at the $map:02000223$. Help her search the library for references on $map:02000051$.

quest.name: The Final Gift
quest.desc:
$npcName:11000005$ believes that the $map:02000229$ can be found in a place known to be tainted by darkness. Perhaps whatever $npcName:11000064$ was looking for had to do with this darkness.
Use the $item:30000076$ that $npcName:11000005$ gave you to release the soul of $npcName:21900090$, who is imprisoned by the darkness. The entrance to the ruins should be in $map:02000170$.
quest.manual: Defeat monsters at $map:02000229$ |Use $item:30000076$ to free $npcName:21900090$'s soul

quest.name: An Unexpected Discovery
quest.desc: You found a suspicious bag in the $map:02000229$. Could it be $npcName:11000069$'s?

quest.name: The Story They Shared
quest.desc: The $npcName:11003483$ tells you that $npcName:11000064$ and $npcName:11000069$ were supposed to meet here, but someone got to $npcName:11000069$ first and kidnapped her. The attacker left behind a green jewel; as soon as he saw it, $npcName:11000064$ ran off by himself. Go to the $map:02000208$ in $map:02000166$ and tell $npcName:11000529$ what happened.

quest.name: Unyielding Friendship
quest.desc:
According to $item:30000340$, he went to Katramus alone to save $npcName:11000069$. $npcName:11000529$ urges you to choose your next moves carefully.
It's up to you to decide what to tell $npc:11000044$. For now, go to $map:02000152$ in $map:02000100$ and meet with him.

quest.name: Run and Hide
quest.desc: $npcName:11000044$ wants you to go back into the streets and look for more clues. For now, meet with $npcName:11000005$ at the $map:02000031$.

quest.name: A Surprising Clue
quest.desc: $npcName:11000005$ wants to show you a letter from $npcName:11000032$, but she doesn't remember where she put it. Help her look.

quest.name: Humblis Hideout
quest.desc:
The item that $npcName:11000064$ found in the $map:02000306$ definitely belongs to $npcName:11000057$. In all likelihood, he's walking right into a trap.
This is no job for one person. Go to the $map:02000208$ and ask for help.

quest.name: Help from Humblis
quest.desc: By the time you got to his headquarters, $npcName:11000006$ was gone. Ask $npcName:11000566$ for his location.

quest.name: Real Friendship
quest.desc: $npcName:11000566$ says $npcName:11000529$ went to Katramus. If you want to join him, you'd better hurry!

quest.name: A Long Parting
quest.desc: Help $npcName:11000006$ free the slaves in $dungeonTitle:21017001$.

quest.name: Witness Protection
quest.desc: $npcName:11000529$ thanks you for your help in Katramus. Now there's a new mission to tackle: an anonymous informant claims to have critical information about $npc:11000044$'s plans. You must get to this informant before Dark Wind does.

quest.name: Cornered Witness
quest.desc: The request for help came from $map:02000279$. Meet with $npcName:11000565$ and find the informant.

quest.name: Power Struggle
quest.desc: The agents of Humblis are trying to search the station, but robots keep getting in their way. The $npcName:22000042$ is particularly bad, as it has the power to shut down all the electric doors. Get rid of this nuisance. It appears in $map:02000279$ now and then.

quest.name: No Stone Unturned
quest.desc: $npcName:11001021$ wants you to search the $map:02000307$. The entrance is right behind him.

quest.name: Raymon Lives
quest.desc: The informant was $npc:11000526$... who was thought long dead! He claims that the robbery of the armory and the death of $npcName:11000492$ were all $npcName:11000044$'s doing. The proof can be found behind the wall clock in the $map:02000226$.

quest.name: Cold Hard Proof
quest.desc: $npcName:11001022$ has hidden the evidence in his office at $map:02000225$. Go to the $map:02000226$ and look behind the clock.
quest.manual: Search the wall clock in $map:02000226$ at $map:02000139$

quest.name: The Arrest
quest.desc: With $npc:11000526$'s testimony and $item:30000075$, you have more than enough evidence to prove $npcName:11000044$'s guilt. Go to the $map:02000152$ and capture him.

quest.name: Into Thin Air
quest.desc:
By the time you got to the $map:02000153$, $npcName:11000044$ was long gone. It seems he'd already seen the writing on the wall...
Return to $map:02000208$ and tell $npcName:11000529$ the news.

quest.name: Trading Fortunes
quest.desc: Bring $item:30000075$ to $npc:11000119$ in $map:02000001$. There won't be a safe place in the entire empire for $npcName:11000044$ to hide when the guard hears about this.

quest.name: The Whole Truth
quest.desc: Report to $npcName:11000075$.

quest.name: An Ally in Prison
quest.desc: $npcName:11000012$ has an important letter to deliver, but he's too terrified to face the recipient—$npcName:11000526$, who is under arrest in connection to $npcName:11000492$'s murder. Deliver the letter to the $map:02000310$.

quest.name: Nelph's Keepsake
quest.desc: $npcName:11000526$ gave you $npcName:11000492$'s keepsake, a tape containing an audio message for $npc:11000492$'s blind mother. Since he can't deliver the tape from behind bars, he's asked you to bring it to $npcName:11000178$ in $map:02000076$.

quest.name: Broken Promises
quest.desc: $npcName:11000178$ has asked you to play $item:30000342$ for her. The tape player is next to the bed in $map:02000198$.

quest.name: The New Ally
quest.desc: You haven't checked on the $map:02000146$ in a while. Seek out $npc:11000076$ at $map:02000228$.

quest.name: Lennon the Hero
quest.desc: $npcName:11000064$ has joined in the defense of Maple World! Meet him at $map:02000228$.

quest.name: The Underground
quest.desc: $npcName:11000064$ suspects that $npcName:11000044$ will use a tunnel at the $map:02000146$ to sneak into the Land of Darkness. Search the $map:02000308$.

quest.name: Facing the Darkness
quest.desc: $npcName:11000064$ is hot on $npcName:11000044$'s tail. Follow them into the $map:52000003$.

quest.name: Survivor's Duty
quest.desc: $npcName:11000064$ wants you to warn the guard that $npcName:11000044$ escaped... and that he's certain to return with more power than ever.

quest.name: Fight Another Day
quest.desc: Now that $npcName:11000044$ is beyond your reach, it's time to report to $npc:11000075$.

quest.name: The Waves' Wrath
quest.desc:
Your first mission for the Frontier Foundation is to investigate the unexplained ocean disturbances plaguing Maple World, and making the seas more treacherous.
According to $npcName:11003885$, the famed explorer $npcName:11003080$ may know something about what's going on, having himself recently survived the loss of his ship to unprecedented weather conditions.

quest.name: Secrets From the Deep
quest.desc:
It seems that the lapenshards may not be directly responsible for the ocean disturbances plaguing Maple World, but instead unidentified dark energies may be the culprits.
According to $npcName:11003885$, your best shot at uncovering the truth may lie in asking the famed explorer $npcName:11003080$ what he saw the day his ship was lost.

quest.name: The Great Explorer
quest.desc:
You arrived in $map:02000068$ and spoke with $npc:11000019$. Still recovering from his ordeal, it seems $npc:11003080$ requested not to be disturbed.
Considering the gravity of the situation, perhaps you can convince $npc:11000019$ to let you speak with $npc:11003080$ about what he saw.

quest.name: The Beast Below
quest.desc:
According to $npc:11003080$, he was shipwrecked by the guardian of the seas himself, $npc:11003086$. It seems the once peaceful divine beast is not the whale he used to be.
$npc:11003080$ said that the siren sisters $npc:11003888$ and $npc:11003889$ may be able to aid you in finding $npc:11003086$. The only problem is, he doesn't know where to find them.
Fortunately, he knows someone who does, a former pirate named $npc:11003082$. Travel to $map:02000182$ and speak with $npc:11003082$.

quest.name: Chorrie's Bad Day
quest.desc: After arriving in $map:02000182$, you located the $map:52000096$ where $npc:11003082$ lives. When you stepped inside, you found yourself in the middle of a messy situation.

quest.name: Dead Men Tell No Tales
quest.desc:
You rescued $npc:11003082$ from his angry former crewmen, but it seems he wants something more in exchange for the location of the siren sisters.
He wants you to erase any trace he was ever a pirate, so he can begin his life anew. It seems you have no other choice than to help him.

quest.name: In Search of Sirens
quest.desc:
$npc:11003082$ told you that the siren sisters live in the $map:52100002$ on $map:52100001$. However, reaching them may not be easy.
It appears the younger sister $npc:29000212$ has caught the attention of the pirate captain $npc:29000213$, who is dead-set on kidnapping the mer-lass.
Head to $map:52100001$ and ensure he does not succeed.

quest.name: A Seaside Chat
quest.desc: After defeating Captain $npc:29000213$ and clearing up a violent misunderstanding with the siren sisters, it is time you finally learned about $npc:11003086$ and his whereabouts.

quest.name: An Audience with Alvanos
quest.desc:
Rumor has it, something has driven $npc:11003086$ berserk, and his rampage has made oceans worldwide a danger to sail. You resolved to meet with $npc:11003086$ firsthand to resolve the situation.
Reaching $npc:11003086$ on such treacherous seas would be no easy feat, but according to $npc:11003082$, one vessel is up for the task! All you need to do is steal $npc:29000213$'s ship, $map:52100012$.
* You can enter $map:52100011$ through the portal on the dock in front of $map:52000096$ located in the south of $map:02000182$.
quest.manual: Subdue $npc:11003086$ <font color="#909090">* You can enter $map:52100011$ through the portal on the dock located in the south of $map:02000182$.</font>

quest.name: Guardian of the Seas
quest.desc:
After subduing $npc:11003086$, you learned about what set off his rampage in the first place.
It all started when $npc:11003795$ crashed into the ocean, the dark energies leeching from his body corrupting the lapenshards which had sprouted deep in the ocean.
Before the corruption might have destroyed his home, $npc:11003086$ summoned the power of the ocean to purge the seas of their corruption. However, in his weakened state, he himself became susceptible to the corrupting power of darkness...
You should hurry back to $map:52010068$ and report what you've learned.

quest.name: Between Crises
quest.desc: Your first assignment for the Frontier Foundation was a success, and Terrun Calibre was quite impressed. However your recent experiences raise many questions that must be answered...

quest.name: Shadow Seed
quest.desc: The raging seas have been quieted, but elsewhere, some of the Seven Commanders gather in the $map:52000185$ at $npc:11003894$'s behest. At the same time, $npc:11000057$ arrives to discuss a request from $npc:11003894$'s...

quest.name: Out in the Cold
quest.desc:
Considering what you learned during your undersea adventure, it seems likely the extreme weather in El Nath is tied to the lapenshard. Beatrice has tasked you with traveling there alongside $npcName:11003060$ to join up with the investigation that's already underway....
Surnuny's thinks the unnatural blizzard in the region was conjured by Erda, queen of a fallen kingdom in El Nath. He is quite concerned as to whether Queen Erda and the Frozen Crystal she watches after are both safe.

quest.name: A Frosty Encounter
quest.desc: Beatrice has tasked you with joining the ongoing investigation into the unusual weather in El Nath. Head to the $map:52000080$

quest.name: Resuming the Search
quest.desc: $npcName:11003949$ of Guidance was scouting the ice cave in $map:02000260$ when he encountered the forces of darkness. A $npcName:11003062$ appeared during the fight and left $npcName:11003949$ and his fellow expedition members injured. Head to the $map:52000081$ and look for clues.

quest.name: The Swordsman in the Snow
quest.desc:
Surrounded by monsters in the $map:52000081$, who should come to your aid but a $npcName:11003062$? Before vanishing into the blizzard, he cautioned you not to go any further if you value your life.
Return to the $map:52000080$ and catch $npc:11003949$ up on what happened.

quest.name: The Recluse Herbalist
quest.desc: $npcName:11003060$ knows of a potion that will allow you to resist the cold of the blizzard raging in $map:52000082$. Another yeti, $npcName:11003063$, knows how to make it. Find him at $map:02000263$.

quest.name: Burning Breath
quest.desc:
$npcName:11003063$ is not exactly happy with his former queen. With great difficulty, you managed to convince him to make you the potion.
Of course, now you have to gather the ingredients for him.

quest.name: A Chilling Development
quest.desc:
$npcName:11003063$ made you a bottle of $item:20000451$ that will let you pass through $map:52000082$. The potion's effects are temporary, so be sure to use it just before you enter! Once you enter the $map:52000083$, continue your investigation.
If you need another bottle of $item:20000451$, go to $npcName:11003063$ in $map:02000263$.
quest.manual: Drink the $item:20000451$ and investigate $map:52000083$ at the end of $map:52000082$

quest.name: Hand of the Queen
quest.desc: Long ago, $npcName:11003060$ was the palace gatekeeper for the kingdom of snow. $npcName:11003065$ needs his help to get to the $map:52000085$, where $npc:11003069$ is. Since $npcName:11003065$ is injured, deliver her message to $npcName:11003060$ and go to the $map:52000085$ in her place.

quest.name: Secrets in the Snow
quest.desc:
$npc:11003060$ says that $map:52000085$ guards the path to the $map:52000086$, where the snow kingdom's secret treasure was kept. He's worried that the specter who appeared to $npcName:11003069$ is connected to the darkness and is using her to get the treasure.
Enter the hidden cave door in $map:02000260$ to join $npcName:11003060$ at the $map:52000084$, then investigate the $map:52000085$.
quest.manual: Enter $map:52000084$ through the hidden path in $map:02000260$ and investigate $map:52000085$
quest.complete: Return to $map:52000080$ in $map:02000261$ and speak with $npc:11003060$

quest.name: To the Temple
quest.desc: $npc:11003069$ opened the path to the temple, but the vault to the Frozen Crystal is still locked. It seems likely that the forces of darkness are manipulating events here. Get ready to leave for the $map:52000086$ with $npcName:11003060$.

quest.name: Frost and Shadow
quest.desc: Meet $npcName:11003060$ at the $map:52000086$. You can get there through the passageway on the tallest, steepest part of $map:02000263$.

quest.name: Thawing the Ice
quest.desc: The cause of the extreme weather in El Nath was revealed with help from the snowfolk, and a world-ending ice age was averted. However, $npc:11004045$ seems forlorn after losing her beloved $npcName:11004024$ once more. Speak with $npcName:11004045$.

quest.name: Those Left Behind
quest.desc: Report to $npc:11004020$.

quest.name: After the Storm
quest.desc: Your investigation in El Nath has reached its conclusion. Report your findings to $npc:11003883$.

quest.name: Dragon Magic
quest.desc:
$npcName:11004032$'s analysis of the blackshard revealed it to be a lapenshard corrupted using powerful dragon magic. She believes it is possible to use the crystal to track the magic used to create it, but that she's the wrong person for the job.
There is someone who can help, but $npcName:11004032$ is reluctant to call for her aid...

quest.name: Eccentric Interests
quest.desc:
$npcName:11000042$, the master wizard, has concocted a spell that can track the lumarigon magic used to create the blackshard. Her expertise is vital in the mission at hand, but she's stubbornly refusing to do any field work.
Perhaps her mind can be changed?

quest.name: Where Ice Meets Fire
quest.desc: $npcName:11000042$ was persuaded into helping you. Meet her at $map:52000088$ to begin your search.

quest.name: Traces of Dragon Magic
quest.desc: $npcName:11000042$ senses lumarigon magic coming from the rune stones in $map:52000088$. Take a closer look at these stones.

quest.name: Bathed in Fire
quest.desc: $npcName:11000042$ is sure that the dragon you're tracking is in fact lumarigon—or at least related to the lumarigon in some way. Based on what you found, you should search for more evidence in $map:52000089$ at $map:02000268$.

quest.name: The Wounded Dragon
quest.desc: $npcName:11000042$ says you can learn a lot about a dragon from its scales. Examine the scales in $map:52000089$.

quest.name: Teleportation Tag-along
quest.desc:
The dragon scales in $map:52000089$ were tainted with dark magic. $npcName:11000042$'s tracking spell is now pointing her towards the Land of Darkness, but first she needs to visit the $map:02000146$ to get a more precise reading.
Speak with $npcName:11003089$ at the $map:02000146$.

quest.name: Oozing Darkness
quest.desc:
After arriving at $map:02000146$, $npcName:11000042$'s tracking spell picked up significant amounts of lumarigon magic in $map:52000090$. She needs you to hurry there, and gather samples of darkness from the area for her to analyze.
Defeat $npcNamePlural:29000164$ in $map:52000090$, which can be found at $map:03000043$ in the Land of Darkness.

quest.name: Warped Space
quest.desc:
$npcName:11000042$ has pinpointed the last known location of the lumarigon spellcaster, which was surprisingly close.
Meet her at the $map:52000092$ beneath the $map:02000146$.

quest.name: De-Obfuscation
quest.desc:
$npcName:11000042$ discovered a large stretch of distorted space where it seems something is being hidden by magic. She is preparing a counterspell to remove the cloak, but she needs your help to gather reagents.
Gather $item:30000726$ in $map:52000093$.

quest.name: Essence of Darkness
quest.desc: To continue the plan to reveal whatever is hidden here, gather $item:30000727$ in $map:52000094$.

quest.name: Lifting the Veil
quest.desc: To complete the counterspell, place rune stones on the edges of the magic seal. You can get rune stones in the $map:52000092$.
quest.manual: Place rune stones on the magic seal in $map:52000092$

quest.name: Finally, Suddenly
quest.desc: The counterspell is ready! Overload the phase distortion with $npc:11000042$.

quest.name: Vanguard Assault
quest.desc: The shadow of the phase has been lifted, and there stood none other than the massive castle of $npcName:11001698$. To make matters worse, $npcName:11001698$'s army is also closing in. We must hold back their advance before they break through and invade the surrounding area, and request reinforcements from the Maple Alliance! Let's fight alongside $npcName:11003089$ to hold back $npcName:11001698$'s vanguard with everything we've got.

quest.name: Turn Back the Dark
quest.desc:
With $npcName:11004033$'s aid, you discovered a fortress built by Madria hidden at the former site of the spatial distortion.
Together, you faced an endless horde of $npcName:11001698$'s minions. Luckily, $npcName:11004032$ had grown concerned during your absence and organized a rescue party who arrived just in time to assist you.
Alongside $npcName:11004052$ and $npcName:11004033$, you crushed Madria's forces.

quest.name: Lumiknights on the Scene
quest.desc: Thanks to $npcName:11004034$'s mass-teleportation spell, Captain Allon and his Lumiknights arrived just in time to help you take down the enemy army.

quest.name: The Rear Guard
quest.desc: $npcName:11003094$ and his Dark Wind agents are dominating the battlefield, thanks to their teleportation-enabled surprise attack.

quest.name: Cutting off the Escape
quest.desc: $npcName:11001585$ and her Green Hoods cut off the retreat of $npcName:11001698$'s army, sealing the alliance's victory.

quest.name: Revealed Stronghold
quest.desc:
After all this time, you finally stand before $npcName:11001698$'s stronghold. It was hidden in a pocket dimension outside the Shadow Gate this whole time!
With $npcName:11001698$'s forces routed, the Alliance plans to push its advantage and go on the offensive. Speak with $npcName:11003089$ about your next steps.

quest.name: The Siege of Madrakan
quest.desc: The Alliance's assault against $npcName:11001698$'s stronghold "Madrakan" is about to begin. The fortress is sure to crumble under the combined might of the Maple Alliance. Ride to the front line and prepare for the battle ahead.

quest.name: The Seal and the Spire
quest.desc:
The Alliance has finally started striking back at the forces of darkness. Madrakan is on the brink of falling, but one obstacle stands in the way.
A powerful seal surrounds the last holdout, $map:52100042$, Captain $npcName:11003679$ has tasked you with returning to the Frontier Foundation to speak with an expert about undoing the seal.

quest.name: The Girl's Past
quest.desc: After telling $npcName:11003883$ about the seal on $map:52100042$ and everything else that had happened, she told you about Madria's past.

quest.name: A Grudge from Long Ago
quest.desc: It seems that the seal's power source lies in a grudge from Madria's past.. $npcName:11004035$ and $npcName:11004034$ devise a plan to break the seal, but they need your help.

quest.name: Raze the Spire
quest.desc: After traveling to the $map:52100041$ and destroying the source of its power, the seal blocking entry to $map:52100042$ collapsed. Speak with $npcName:11003569$ in $map:02000402$ to determine your next steps.

quest.name: The Final Battle for Madrakan
quest.desc: It's time to conquer Madrakan once and for all. Travel to $map:52100042$ and deal a critical blow to the forces of darkness.
quest.manual: |Conquer $map:52100042$ <font color="#909090">(If you leave by mistake, talk to $npc:11003096$ in $map:52000091$ to return.)</font>

quest.name: Return to Ground Zero
quest.desc: After regaining consciousness several days after the dark crystal's explosion, you travel to the $map:52010068$ to speak with $npc:11003883$. $npc:11003883$ feels responsible for the disappearance of the leaders of Terrun Calibre, and wants to turbo-charge the search effort by mobilizing the full resources of the Frontier Foundation.

quest.name: Search and Rescue
quest.desc: $npcName:11004106$ summons you to the $map:02000496$ to investigate the site of the dark crystal's explosion and assist in the search effort for the missing Runeblades.

quest.name: The Giant Lapenshard
quest.desc: After traveling to help out the Foundation at the $map:02000496$, $npcName:11004108$ requested your help researching the anomaly at the center of the blast site.

quest.name: Through the Looking Glass
quest.desc: $npcName:11004108$ asked you to investigate the powerful anomaly surrounding the large lapenshard at the center of the crater. Upon arriving there you heard a familiar voice, before suddenly finding yourself inside the anomaly. While exploring your newfound surroundings, you encountered the missing Runeblades. However, they seemed different than you remembered…

quest.name: Critical Mass
quest.desc: You were flung out of the abyss from $map:02000496$ and reported to $npcName:11004106$ on what you experienced in ground zero. $npcName:11004106$ said their objective would not change even if the Runeblades have changed. You said you will enter the abyss of $map:02000496$ once more but $npcName:11004108$ blocked you.

quest.name: The Mysterious Bladesman Returns
quest.desc: After $npcName:11004108$'s warning that the new dark crystal that has formed in the $map:02000496$ is building towards an apocalyptic explosion, you resolve to re-enter the anomaly in the hopes of finding a solution. Once inside, you encounter an unexpected face…

quest.name: An Unlikely Partnership
quest.desc: You were surprised to encounter the $npcName:11004112$ within the anomaly. Arguing that your goals were aligned, he convinced you that the two of you should work together to rescue the missing Runeblades.

quest.name: Emerald Dreams
quest.desc:
Using the power of rune magic, the $npcName:11004112$ managed to track down the missing Runeblades. It turns out they're right here—albeit in a parallel region of spacetime. Using his powers and the unique properties of his blade, the $npcName:11004112$ carved a rift leading to the first of four such pocket dimensions where he believed the Runeblades dwelled. Enter the rift and rescue the lost Runeblades!
This solo dungeon can only be entered when you have the related quest. Either click the [Enter Alone] button or go through the entrance created in $map:52010069$.

quest.name: Corrupted Runeblades
quest.desc: After battling with a twisted version of $npcName:11004130$ within the pocket dimension, you told the $npcName:11004112$ everything that happened. The $npcName:11004112$ believes that $npcName:11004130$'s true self has been suppressed by the dark crystal, and that the only way to save the Runeblades is by dispersing the energy within the dark crystal.

quest.name: Altered Space
quest.desc:
$npcName:11004112$ opened a rift to the next dimensional pocket and urged you to step inside. Your mission is clear.
This solo dungeon can only be entered when you have the related quest. Either click the [Enter Alone] button or go through the entrance created in $map:52010069$.

quest.name: The Rune's Toll
quest.desc: After confronting $npcName:11004129$ in his altered state, you emerged from the pocket dimension to find the $npcName:11004112$ looking exhausted. Nevertheless, he carved open a rift to the next realm and urged you to investigate.

quest.name: Twisted Time
quest.desc:
The repeated opening of dimensional rifts seems to have taken a serious toll on the $npcName:11004112$'s body, yet he urges you to keep going. After demanding you promise to find a way to save the missing Runeblades, he reluctantly agrees to seek treatment—but not before opening a rift to $npcName:11004128$'s domain.
This solo dungeon can only be entered when you have the related quest. Either click the [Enter Alone] button or go through the entrance created in $map:52010069$.

quest.name: Save Terrun Calibre, Save the World
quest.desc: You defeated $npc:11004128$ in his corrupted state, and he fled, just like the others. After returning from your expedition, you find $npcName:11004112$ at the Foundation base camp. He has some ideas about how to save the leaders of Terrun Calibre and prevent the end of the world, but he says you'll need help to do it. Thankfully, $npcName:11004108$ is uniquely qualified in the subject of lapenshards.

quest.name: All In
quest.desc:
$npcName:11004108$ says that the only way to stop the new dark crystal from exploding is to extract the corrupted Runeblades from the anomaly. She also said that fighting them will burn off the power accumulated by the crystal, restoring the Runeblades to their former selves, and eliminating the threat posed by the blackshard. For the sake of your friends, and all of Maple World, it's time to enter the $map:02020130$.
This solo dungeon can only be entered when you have the related quest. Either click the [Enter Alone] button or go through the entrance created in $map:02000496$.

quest.name: The Runeblades Return
quest.desc: The leaders of Terrun Calibre have been rescued, and you survived the ordeal relatively unscathed—yet the Runeblades have failed to awaken despite their apparent healthy state.
