The $npcName:11004112$ hypothesized that residual blackshard energy within their bodies was preventing them from awakening. Thankfully, $npcName:11004108$ has devised a plan to help them.

quest.name: A Venomous Truth
quest.desc:
With the Runeblades' awakening came a joyful reunion which proved short-lived when the $npcName:11004112$ was identified as $npcName:11004115$, an alleged traitor to Terrun Calibre. But according to $npcName:11004115$, it was not he who was the traitor, but their former master Arazaad. $npcName:11004115$ says that Master Arazaad intended to hand Terrun Calibre over to the $npcName:11003894$ in the interest of self-preservation in the sight of the approaching tide of darkness.
$npcName:11004115$ claims that when he tried to convince Arazaad of the error of his ways, his master attacked him, and he was forced to end Arazaad's life. While you are having a difficult time swallowing such an outlandish tale, Ishura doesn't seem so certain...

quest.name: An End to the Blackshard Threat
quest.desc:
$npcName:11004128$ is reluctant to accept the visions of the future he witnessed within the anomaly—but he is not quite ready to dismiss them either. In the end, he decided to let $npcName:11004115$ leave of his own volition.
The future may be uncertain, but one thing is not: thanks to your actions, the leaders of Terrun Calibre are safe, and the threat of the blackshards seems to be ended. You return to the Frontier Foundation to celebrate a job well done, and officially conclude your investigation into the lapenshard crises.
With catastrophe averted, Terrun Calibre and Guidance, and the visiting alliance leaders all make their way home to their respective bases of operation. For now, Maple World is a calmer place. And as for you, it seems the best course of action is to ensure that whenever the next dark threat rears its ugly head, you're ready for it.

quest.name: Convening the World Security Council
quest.desc: Empress $npcName:11004390$ has called you to an emergency meeting. Go to $map:52020037$ and discover what's happened.

quest.name: An Uncharted Continent
quest.desc: An unidentified continent has appeared in the skies of Maple World from parts unknown. According to Captain $npcName:11004312$, Sky Fortress's instruments detected the presence of lapenshards. $npcName:11004316$ believes they may have arrived there as a result of the dark crystal's latest detonation. $npcName:11004312$ suggested Sky Fortress investigate the mysterious new land immediately, and the Empress gave her approval.

quest.name: First Contact
quest.desc: You arrived in $map:02020029$ by way of one of Sky Fortress's dropships, where you detected a nearby lifeform. If it is intelligent, it might provide you with some useful information.
quest.complete: Ask $npcName:11004387$ for information about this new land

quest.name: Survival of the Fittest
quest.desc:
While investigating $map:02020029$, you encountered an individual named $npcName:11004387$—the alliance's first contact with a denizen of this strange new continent. $npcName:11004387$ agrees to tell you what he knows about the missile fired against Sky Fortress in exchange for your aid. He wants you to harvest a substance called "aetherine" from the nearby fauna to power his rifle.
Time to go hunting.

quest.name: Mysterious Assailants
quest.desc: As thanks for your help, $npcName:11004387$ told you that the missile targeting Sky Fortress was fired from a base in the north operated by an unknown and hostile force he believes originated in Maple World. The unidentified foe landed on the unidentified continent several days ago and have been terrorizing the "Kidel" region in search of something. You decide to travel into enemy territory to track down the missile's launch site.
quest.manual: Defeat $npcNamePlural:25020001$ on the hill to the north.

quest.name: The Woman in the Rubble
quest.desc: You discover an unidentified woman in the rubble of the Dark Army's camp to the north of $map:02020029$. She appears to be disoriented and hungry. You decide to harvest fruit from the nearby trees for her.

quest.name: The Enemy of Your Enemy
quest.desc: After learning that the Daemon Army's airship landed somewhere in the outskirts of $map:02020029$, you returned to the forest in search of clues.
quest.complete: Explore the east end of the $map:02020029$

quest.name: A New Assignment
quest.desc: $npcName:11004393$ said that the rest of his squad was captured by the Dark Army. After pursuing them to their camp, he witnessed a terrible scene and had no choice but to flee.

quest.name: The Kindness of Strangers
quest.desc: $npcName:11004393$ says he needs the medicinal herbs which grow in aetherine-infused soil nearby to get his comrades well enough to travel. You decide to help him.

quest.name: Onward to Richmonde
quest.desc: $npcName:11004393$ told you about the history of Humanitas and their conflict with Tairen. On the subject of your own investigation into the Dark Army's search for an unknown woman, he suggested you visit Humanitas's headquarters in $map:02020030$ and ask around.
quest.manual: Travel to the Humanitas base in $map:02020030$

quest.name: A Bloody Gesture
quest.desc: $map:02020030$ finds itself under siege by soldiers of the Dark Army—or the Daemon Army, as they are known by Kritians. Hoping to endear yourself to Humanitas's leader, you decide to follow $npcName:11004388$'s advice and engage the Daemon Army soldiers.

quest.name: New Acquaintances
quest.desc:
You met with $npcName:11004395$, leader of Humanitas, and learned that Kritias's arrival in Maple World was as much a surprise to its denizens as to you.
With the arrival of the Daemon Army in Kritias, Humanitas—who were already under regular siege from Tairen—are now waging a war on two fronts. Despite having a shared foe, $npcName:11004395$ had no interest in working together, as she blamed the Maple Alliance for the Daemon Army's invasion of Kritias. She then issued an ultimatum: Sky Fortress must withdraw from Kritias within ten days, or be fired upon.
The woman you met at the missile site advocated on your behalf to little success. When you asked $npcName:11004395$ what the woman was doing in here office, she kicked you out. If $npcName:11004395$ isn't willing to listen to reason, perhaps her adjutant will be?

quest.name: Behind Enemy Lines
quest.desc:
You spoke with $npc:11004395$'s adjutant $npcName:11004396$, who thanked you for helping his brother and apologized for his superiors curtness.
$npcName:11004396$ revealed that Humanitas were once citizens of Tairen who revolted against the AI who governed them when she began exiling people to bring her "utopia" to fruition.
During his explanation, $npcName:11004396$ receives an urgent call for reinforcements. It seems that Daemon Army soldiers are on the verge of overrunning the guard post in the west. Luckily for them, you have volunteered to aid them.

quest.name: Proof of Death
quest.desc:
$npc:11004397$ thanks you for coming to his aid. He tells you that one of his soldiers was separated from the group during the fighting, and requests that you search for him.
Find the missing soldier. If he is alive, escort him back to $map:02020030$ for medical attention. If he is dead, collect his identification tag and deliver it to $npcName:11004395$.

quest.name: The Child of Vanheim
quest.desc:
$npcName:11004395$ revealed that the identification tag belonged to the first exile she had rescued after founding Humanitas. In light of your actions to aid Humanitas, she seems more receptive to discussion.
Through your dialogue, you both come to realize the exile standing before you is $npcName:11004400$, the daughter of Maple World's sage $npcName:11004431[gender:0]$ and the individual responsible for sealing Kritias away so many years ago.
It was then that $npcName:11004430$ and his minions arrived.

quest.name: Transmission Troubles
quest.desc:
$npcName:11004400$, the woman whose power sealed Kritias away, has been captured by $npcName:11004430$. If the forces of darkness were to use her power for evil, the results would be devastating.
Thankfully, it seems Humanitas placed a tracker on $npcName:11004400$ as a precautionary measure. There's one small catch however—$map:02020030$'s signal repeater was damaged by the Daemon Army's recent attacks. In order to repair it and locate $npcName:11004400$, you'll have to harvest the necessary part from one of the mechanical soldiers on the floating islands nearby.

quest.name: Can't Stop the Signal
quest.desc:
Using the technical manual $npcName:11004396$ gave you and the part you harvested, you managed to repair $map:02020030$'s signal repeater.
$npcName:11004395$'s tracking device should be online now. Go find out.

quest.name: A Desperate Search
quest.desc:
$npcName:11004395$'s tracking device placed $npcName:11004400$ within the vicinity of $map:02020031$, a Tairen resource extraction operation.
$npcName:11004395$ suggested you speak with the Humanitas agent on site in the hopes they saw where $npcName:11004400$ was taken.

quest.name: Forging a Path
quest.desc:
You arrived at the Tairen resource extracting operation in $map:02020031$, and spoke with $npcName:11004398$, a Humanitas agent. $npcName:11004398$ recounted what he witnessed, including $npcName:11004430$'s takeover of $map:02020031$ wherein he somehow took control of the numerous mechanized soldiers nearby.
If you want to break into the fusion reactor where $npcName:11004400[gender:1]$ is allegedly being held, you're going to have to carve a path through enemy lines.

quest.name: These Blasted Doors
quest.desc:
According to $npcName:11004399$, the room where $npcName:11004400$ is being held has been sealed off by the facility's blast doors, which do not seem to budge.
Try to break through the blast door inside the $map:52100105$.
quest.manual: Attempt to open the blast door

quest.name: Extreme Measures
quest.desc:
With time short and entry into the reactor blocked, $npcName:11004395$ suggests a variety of well-meaning but dangerous ideas to break inside. Formulating a plan based on the intel you received from a Humanitas agent, you call Sky Fortress to request they fire on the spire that feeds aetherine into the reactor facility.
If what you've been told is true, destroying the spire will cause all of the reactor's blast doors to open. After much persuading, $npcName:11004312$ agreed to your plan. You travel back to the $map:52100104$ in the hopes the operation was a success.

quest.name: The Daring Rescue
quest.desc:
You arrived at the $map:52100105$ and spoke with the Humanitas agent on site. It seems the plan was a success: the spire is destroyed, and the blast door is open.
Now comes the moment of truth. Enter the $map:52100105$ and rescue $npcName:11004400[gender:1]$.

quest.name: The Power Within
quest.desc: In an unexpected turn of events, $npcName:11004400$ utilized $npcName:11004430$'s plan to extract the Blue Lapenta from her body to instead awaken its power inside her. Summoning the lapenta's power, she attacked $npcName:11004430$, who had no other choice but to retreat from the $map:52100105$.

quest.name: A Link Between Worlds
quest.desc:
$npcName:11004430$ may have retreated for now, but he'll be back with another plan to capture $npcName:11004400$ and steal her power. $npcName:11004400$ however seems unconcerned about this, and has left on a mission of her own.
You should travel to $map:02020041$ and formulate a new course of action.

quest.name: Balrog's Blood
quest.desc: You defeated the so-called immortal $npcName:23090005$ and caught a drop of his $item:30000419$. It hums with evil, and yet you can sense a great power within it. Perhaps $npcName:11000144$ can tell you more about it.

quest.name: Scholar of Life
quest.desc: $npcName:11000144$ isn't equipped to analyze the blood of an immortal monster. He recommends you seek out $npcName:11001210$ in $map:02000023$, who is a renowned scholar of life magic.
quest.complete: Talk to $npcName:11001210$ in $map:02000023$ and ask about $item:30000419$

quest.name: True Nature
quest.desc: $npcName:11001210$ is in a state of shock after discovering that the $item:30000419$ seemingly defies the laws of mortality. It is surely a source of great power... but it's useless to you if its evil can't be exorcised. Ask $npcName:11001210$ if he can purify it.

quest.name: Blacksmith of Nerman
quest.desc: $npcName:11001210$ purified the $item:30000419$, leaving only $item:30000420$ behind. He suggests you seek out Harcha the blacksmith in $map:02000203$, who may be able to forge it into a mighty weapon.

quest.name: Infinite Essence
quest.desc:
$npcName:11001211$'s great-grandfather, Harcha, passed down a technique to craft weapons the like of which Maple World has never seen. However, he needs $itemPlural:30000421$ and $itemPlural:30000420$ to do it.
You might be able to get $itemPlural:30000421$ from the Allicari in $map:2000064$.

quest.name: Treasury of Knowledge
quest.desc: Master $npc:11001246$ tried to gain the cooperation of the $map:2000001$ royal family, but couldn't even meet $npc:11000075$ or any high-ranking officials. What $npc:11001231$ seeks is the legacy of the ancestors called the Wisdom of Baz. Master $npc:11001246$ says that by searching for the Wisdom of Baz, we may eventually meet $npc:11001231$. Could the information about the Wisdom of Baz be found in the historically renowned $map:2000031$? Let's go to $map:2000031$ and meet $npc:11000005$.
quest.complete: Go to $map:2000031$ and gather information about the Wisdom of Baz

quest.name: The Relic Restoration Expert
quest.desc: According to $npc:11000005$, similar content to the Wisdom of Baz was found in old documents, but she can't say for certain whether it truly is the Wisdom of Baz. To make matters worse, most of the documents are damaged. $npc:11000005$ says $npc:11001261$ could restore the documents. $npc:11001261$ is said to have headed to $map:52000019$ located in $map:2000014$ to find special materials. Let's meet $npc:11001261$ and request the document restoration.

quest.name: Pop Goes the Wriggler Pit
quest.desc: $npc:11001261$, gathering special materials only found in the habitat of $map:52000019$, asks for assistance with the work. $npc:29000068$ inhabit various parts of $map:52000019$, so let's help $npc:11001261$ finish gathering materials safely.
quest.manual: Stay by $npc:11001277$'s side and help until the work is safely completed

quest.name: The Guest in Room 215
quest.desc: According to innkeeper $npc:11000390$, Master $npc:11001246$ is staying at $map:52000018$. Let's hurry and meet Master $npc:11001246$.

quest.name: Repaying the Help
quest.desc: $npc:11001261$ has promised to restore the documents in return for helping with the work. Although it will take a long time, we've obtained the first lead on the Wisdom of Baz. Let's return to $map:52000018$ and inform Master $npc:11001246$ of this.

quest.name: The Barota Guild's Second Trade Item
quest.desc: Master $npc:11001246$ suggests seeking the cooperation of the Barota Guild, the largest peddler organization on Victoria Island, to gather information about the Wisdom of Baz and Holschtat. As the Master says, let's first meet $npc:11000484$ in $map:2000033$ and ask about the Barota Guild.

quest.name: Information Request
quest.desc: $npc:11000484$ says they manage quality information at $map:52000020$ located in $map:2000139$ and provide it to interested clients. Visiting $npc:11001262$ at $map:52000020$ should provide whatever information is needed, so let's meet $npc:11001262$ first.
quest.complete: Go to $map:52000020$ located in $map:2000139$ and request information

quest.name: A Mysterious Ambush
quest.desc: While speaking with $npc:11001262$, he says he heard suspicious sounds near the entrance. According to $npc:11001262$, people who have been interfering with the Barota Guild's operations have appeared recently, and he's worried it might be them. Let's investigate the area near the entrance of $map:52000020$ to put his worries to rest.

quest.name: The Force Behind the Guild
quest.desc: $npc:11001262$ says this incident was caused by a force that has been consistently interfering with the Barota Guild. Judging by $npcName:11001262$'s expression, he seems to have suspects in mind... but he's clamped his mouth shut. In any case, we've secured $npcName:11001262$'s cooperation, so let's return to $map:52000018$ and report the situation to Master $npc:11001246$.

quest.name: Chasing the Defector
quest.desc: According to information from $npc:11001262$, $map:52000021$ has been discovered in $map:2000082$. Master $npc:11001246$ says we must act quickly and to meet at $map:52000021$. This is the first trace of $npc:11001231$ found since arriving on Victoria Island. Let's hurry to $map:52000021$.

quest.name: What Happened in the Prison
quest.desc: $npc:11001264$ tracked $npc:11001231$'s whereabouts from $map:2000062$ in southern Victoria Island, and obtained information that a man matching $npc:11001231$'s description headed toward $map:2000124$. However, there are some things left unverified while chasing $npc:11001231$ that are weighing on the mind. To verify the rumors $npc:11001264$ mentioned, let's go to $map:2000124$ and investigate by meeting $npcTitle:11000514$ or talking to the prisoners. $map:2000124$ can be reached by ship from $npc:11000585$ in $map:2000062$.
quest.manual: Meet $npcTitle:11000514$ in $map:2000124$|Gather information from prisoners in $map:2000124$|Gather information from prisoners in $map:2000124$|Gather information from prisoners in $map:2000124$

quest.name: Unknown Movements
quest.desc: Piecing together what $npc:11000649$ said, it seems some sort of plan is being carried out in $map:2000146$ under the direction of someone suspected to be $npc:11001231$. Is the person $npc:11000649$ mentioned really $npc:11001231$? Nothing can be said for certain. For now, let's inform Master $npc:11001246$ of this.

quest.name: The Restored Document
quest.desc: $npc:11000005$ says the document restoration commissioned to $npc:11001261$ has been completed. However, an unexpected problem has arisen—all the content recorded in the documents is written in cryptic verses that are difficult to decipher. Let's go to Master $npc:11001246$ and inform him of this.

quest.name: Traces of the Defector
quest.desc: $npc:11001262$ reports that $npc:11001231$'s traces have been found at $map:52000022$ located in $map:3000014$. However, $npc:11001231$ has already been confirmed to have moved elsewhere. Master $npc:11001246$ says $npc:11001231$'s actions are full of mysteries, between the information from $map:2000124$ and everything else, and decides to investigate personally. Since we're to meet at $map:52000022$ in the Dark Land $map:3000014$, we should hurry. There's a gate to the Dark Land in $map:2000146$, so going through there should get us to $map:3000014$.

quest.name: A New Mission
quest.desc: $npc:11001268$ says $npc:11001265$ is still not fully recovered from what happened at $map:52000021$. As Master $npc:11001246$ instructed, let's go to $map:2000361$ in $map:2000076$ and meet $npc:11001265$ first.

quest.name: Searching for the First Baz Ruin
quest.desc: $npc:11001265$ says the interpretation of the first verse recorded in $item:30000442$ has been completed. According to $npc:11001265$'s interpretation, $map:2000363$, where the knowledge left by the ancient ancestors sleeps, should be in $map:2000058$. Let's hurry and find $map:2000363$ in $map:2000058$.
quest.manual: Enter $map:2000363$ located in $map:2000058$ and investigate the ruins

quest.name: Searching for the Second Baz Ruin
quest.desc: $npc:11001265$ says the interpretation of the second verse recorded in $item:30000442$ has been completed. According to $npc:11001265$'s interpretation, $map:2000364$, where the knowledge left by the ancient ancestors sleeps, should be in $map:2000090$. Let's hurry and find $map:2000364$ in $map:2000090$.
quest.manual: Enter $map:2000364$ located in $map:2000090$ and investigate the ruins

quest.name: Searching for the Third Baz Ruin
quest.desc: $npc:11001265$ says the interpretation of the second verse recorded in $item:30000442$ has been completed. According to $npc:11001265$'s interpretation, $map:2000366$, where the knowledge left by the ancient ancestors sleeps, should be in $map:2000067$. Let's hurry and find $map:2000366$ in $map:2000067$.
quest.manual: Enter $map:2000366$ located in $map:2000067$ and investigate the ruins

quest.name: News from the Master
quest.desc: $npc:11001265$ says a letter has been received from Master $npc:11001246$, who had departed to the Dark Land to track $npc:11001231$'s whereabouts. This is news from Master $npc:11001246$, who had been unreachable. Let's quickly check what the message says.

quest.name: Duty of the Practitioner
quest.desc: Master $npc:11001246$ once said that training to become stronger is not just about honing the body. It's been a long time since receiving guidance from Master $npc:11001246$ since the training on Karrib Island. Let's listen attentively to what teachings will be given.

quest.name: The Path of Learning
quest.desc: Master $npc:11001246$ checked whether the previous teachings have been neglected. Let's listen to Master $npc:11001246$'s teachings attentively so as not to disappoint.

quest.name: Bomar Rides the Airship
quest.desc:
$npcName:11001275$ says the airship Dungdungi developed by Makan has successfully completed testing. They also mention that Bomar has boarded Dungdungi headed for Lizab Rock Island on Karkar Island.
$npc:11001275$ says $npcName:11001403$ should be preparing the return settings for Dungdungi to come back to Barbosa Coast, and asks you to deliver the airship operation manual so he doesn't make any mistakes. First, let's ride Dungdungi to $map:02010043$ and meet $npcName:11001403$.
quest.complete: Board Dungdungi and travel to $map:02010043$ to deliver $item:30000486$ to $npcName:11001403$

quest.name: The Woman of the Desert
quest.desc: According to $npcName:11001403$, $npcName:11001405$ left for $map:02010084$ to meet a woman named $npcName:11001404$. Meeting $npcName:11001404$ at $map:02010084$ should give us a clue about $npcName:11001405$'s whereabouts.
quest.complete: Meet $npcName:11001404$ at $map:02010084$ and ask about $npcName:11001405$'s whereabouts

quest.name: To Ludeli City
quest.desc: $npcName:11001404$ says $npcName:11001405$ did come to $map:02010084$ looking for her, but had to rush off to $map:02010002$ due to urgent business. According to $npcName:11001404$, it hasn't been long since he left, so this time we should be able to find $npcName:11001405$ if we go to $map:02010002$.

quest.name: A Disease of Strange Rumors
quest.desc: $npc:11001443$ says patients with a strange disease that recently appeared in the village have been gathered and quarantined in $map:02010005$. According to $npcName:11001443$'s diagnosis, there's no particular suspicion of contagion, but it doesn't seem like an ordinary disease—there's an unsettling feeling reminiscent of magic or sorcery. Perhaps because of this, some villagers who claim the illness is a curse have been openly harassing $map:02010005$... Let's go to $map:02010005$ to check on the patients' condition and see if there's anything we can help with.

quest.name: The Girls' Promise
quest.desc: $npcName:11001392$ says she was scared because the villagers pointed fingers at everyone in $map:02010005$, calling them cursed. Because of that, everyone avoided the patients—except for $npcName:11001396$, who was different. $npcName:11001396$, known as $npcTitle:11001396$ for her brilliance, promised with a pinky swear to find a cure. But days have passed with no word, and $npcName:11001392$ worries that even $npcName:11001396$ may have abandoned them... According to $npcName:11001392$, $npcName:11001396$'s parent $npc:11001390$ is in $map:02010063$, so let's ask about $npcName:11001396$.

quest.name: Finding Navilla
quest.desc: $npcName:11001390$ says that $npcName:11001396$ left for $map:02010023$. $npcName:11001390$, who had always thought $npcName:11001396$ left home just to pursue her hobby of observing and researching ruins, was quite surprised to hear about the promise between her daughter and $npcName:11001392$. Though she never causes trouble, $npcName:11001390$ says she's always on edge because of her daughter's headstrong personality, and is worried that she has set out to cure a disease that even $npcName:11001443$, the village doctor, couldn't treat. On top of that, she worries whether her only daughter is even eating properly... Let's deliver the lunchbox filled with $npcName:11001390$'s love for her daughter to $npcName:11001396$.

quest.name: A Clue from the Ruins
quest.desc: $npcName:11001396$ says that after steadily observing the vast ruins spread across $map:02010023$, she noticed that $npc:21000674$ appearing near the ruins were carrying suspicious stone tablet fragments. She suspects that the strange disease plaguing the village might be their doing... and if she could obtain those tablet fragments, she could figure out the details and organize her hypothesis. Let's obtain the mysterious stone tablet fragments from $npc:21000674$ in $map:02010023$.
quest.manual: Obtain mysterious stone tablet fragments from $npcName:21000674$

quest.name: A Clue Begets a Miracle
quest.desc: $npcName:11001396$ says she needs to ask a Moropapa tribe member named $npcName:11001397$ to interpret the tablet. According to $npcName:11001396$, she already told $npcName:11001397$ about the promise with $npcName:11001392$, and $npcName:11001397$ also said he would conduct his own research on the disease afflicting $npcName:11001392$. Let's find $npcName:11001397$, who is said to be somewhere near $map:02010023$, and ask him to interpret the tablet.
quest.manual: Receive the stone tablet fragment from $npcName:11001396$|Meet $npcName:11001397$ and ask for interpretation of the stone tablet fragment
quest.complete: Deliver the Elixir of Akamoro to $npcName:11001396$

quest.name: A Day for Miracles
quest.desc: $npcName:11001396$ is overjoyed, saying that with $item:30000504$, she can surely keep her promise with $npcName:11001392$. $npcName:11001396$ says she needs time to organize her records about the ruins, so please hurry and deliver this good news and the elixir to $npcName:11001392$. Let's hurry back to $map:02010005$ in $map:02010063$ and deliver $item:30000504$ to $npcName:11001392$.
quest.complete: Deliver the Elixir of Akamoro to $npcName:11001392$

quest.name: A Promise Shattered
quest.desc: $npcName:11001391$, the older brother of $npcName:11001392$, says that promises made by people are all lies. Their parents ran away, the villagers pointed fingers and called them cursed, and now even the person his sister trusted has broken their promise, which infuriated him greatly. It's unfortunate, but it seems we need to deliver this news to $npcName:11001396$.

quest.name: Endless Practice
quest.desc:
$npc:11001320$ in $map:02000001$ advises that you can't become a good musician without consistent practice. If you don't have the instruments or sheet music needed for performing, you can purchase them from $npc:11001320$'s shop. (Hopefully this isn't just $npc:11001320$ trying to make a sale...)
Level 25 Performance Guide: Complete the [Performance Guide: Beginner] chapter quest to receive free instruments and sheet music needed for performing.
quest.manual: Play a complete song from sheet music in $map:02000001$

quest.name: Talent Donation
quest.desc: $npc:11001320$ in $map:02000001$ praises your excellent performance skills and tells you to play your beautiful music for more people.

quest.name: Pursuing Profit
quest.desc: $npc:11000781$ in $map:02000002$ asks for help mining $item:33000001$ from the ore veins behind the fishing spot in $map:02000002$.
quest.manual: Try mining $item:33000001$ from the ore veins behind the fishing spot in $map:02000002$

quest.name: Fishing with Music
quest.desc: $npc:11000781$ asks for a wonderful performance so beautiful that fish will gather to the melody.
quest.manual: Play a complete song from sheet music in $map:02000002$

quest.name: Dancing Fish
quest.desc:
$npc:11000781$ says that more fish seem to be gathering thanks to the beautiful melody, and suggests you cast a line and enjoy some leisure time.
Level 20 Fishing Guide: Complete the [Fishing Guide: Beginner] chapter quest to receive a free fishing rod needed for fishing.

quest.name: End of Rest
quest.desc: $npc:11000781$ in $map:02000002$ tells you to stop by sometimes to play music and go fishing.

quest.name: A Thunderous Roar
quest.desc: An angry cry from $npcTitle:11000003$ echoes throughout $map:02000001$. What could be the matter?

quest.name: New Bait
quest.desc:
$npc:11000003$ in $map:02000001$ says he needs $item:33000026$ dropped by the chickens raised at home.
Go back to your house, adopt a chicken, and try harvesting $item:33000026$.
quest.manual: Try harvesting $item:33000026$ from the chicken raised at your house

quest.name: Taking the Bait
quest.desc:
$npc:11000003$ tosses you his usual bait and taunts you, saying he'd be a cat, not a tiger, if you managed to catch any fish in $map:02000001$. Let's show off our fishing skills in $map:02000001$.
If your fishing proficiency is too low to fish in $map:02000001$, try raising it by fishing in nearby $map:02000002$.
Roarr's Secret Know-How: "Complete the Level 32 Fishing Guide [Fishing Guide: Advanced] chapter quest to quickly raise your fishing proficiency to Beginner Level 2!"

quest.name: A Grumpy Friendship
quest.desc: The proud $npc:11000003$ calms down after you promise not to spread word about losing the bet, and suggests you try placing the $item:50200010$ he gave you as a gift in your house. Even if it doesn't quite match your house's style, it's probably better to just place it and soothe the hot-tempered $npcTitle:11000003$ rather than watch him get worked up and start yelling again.

quest.name: Opening the Festival
quest.desc: $npc:11000059$ in $map:02000001$ excitedly shares the news that a festival will be held soon at $map:02000064$.

quest.name: The Value of Sweat
quest.desc:
$npc:11000711$ in $map:02000064$ has asked for help gathering materials needed to build the festival performance stage.
If your mining proficiency is too low, try raising it by mining $item:33000001$ in $map:02000002$.

quest.name: Mint, If It's You...
quest.desc:
$npc:11000711$ in $map:02000064$ asks if you can craft $item:33000064$ for the Bunny Bunny Performance Troupe.
Open the crafting menu from the [Life Skills] menu at the bottom right, then go to [Life Skills > Crafting > Smithing] to try crafting. If your crafting proficiency is too low, keep crafting items at your current level to raise it.

quest.name: Melody in My Heart
quest.desc: As thanks for crafting $item:33000064$, $npc:11000711$ says the Bunny Bunny Performance Troupe members will lend you one of their practice instruments for a few days to try out.
quest.manual: Play a complete song from sheet music

quest.name: I'm in the Band Too
quest.desc: $npc:11000711$ in $map:02000064$ says music is a wonderful way to connect people's hearts, and suggests you gather with friends to play together.
quest.manual: Gather two or more people and try an ensemble performance

quest.name: The Royal Rumble
quest.desc: $npcName:11004285$, queen of the Pink Beans, has descended upon Maple World! This mysterious monarch is hosting the Queen Bean Rumble, a massive tournament with a huge cash prize. Speak with $npc:11004287$ in $map:83000001$ for details. You can get there by pressing the 'Queen Bean Rumble' dungeon's 'Lobby' button in the Challenge Map.

quest.name: For the Queen's Joy!
quest.desc: You asked $npcName:11004287$ about $npcName:11004285$, which naturally prompted him to call you a dirty peasant who grew up in a cave. Still, this queen of beans is hosting the Queen Bean Rumble, which comes with a sizable reward.

quest.name: The Caravan
quest.desc: You met a guardsman, $npcName:11003180$, in $map:02000062$. He says you should go into the $map:52000116$ to sign up as a caravan guard.

quest.name: A Natural Hero
quest.desc: You're all signed up to escort the caravan to Tria! According to $npcName:11003163$, they're waiting on one last guard. Who could it be?

quest.name: A Simple Job
quest.desc: $npcName:11003164$ is probably the weakest guard you've ever met. This is supposed to be an easy job, but the fact that your partner on the caravan escort isn't strong enough to defeat a small puppy doesn't fill you with confidence...
quest.manual: Escort the caravan through the $map:63000041$, northwest of $map:02000062$|Make your report at $map:02000001$

quest.name: An Imperial Audience
quest.desc: After the disastrous caravan attack, you woke up in Tria with $npc:11003165$ watching over you. He's asked you to come to the $map:52000033$. Her Imperial Highness wants to see you.

quest.name: The Investigation
quest.desc: At $npc:11003165$'s request, you are investigating the attack on the caravan. Begin by seeking the advice of $npc:11003163$, who had intimate knowledge of the caravan schedule and route.

quest.name: The Masked Figure
quest.desc:
$npcName:11003166$ encountered a $npcName:11003167$ at $map:52000118$. Instead of taking the suspicious character in for questioning, he let them go. Now you have no suspects and no leads.
Little matter! Take $npcName:11003166$'s special brand of incompetence in stride and follow the $npcName:11003167$, who seems to be headed for $map:02000092$!

quest.name: Chasing the Mask
quest.desc: $npcName:11000170$ spotted the $npcName:11003167$ heading northeast of $map:02000092$. That road leads to $map:02000083$.

quest.name: A Mess of Masks
quest.desc: Your pursuit of the $npcName:11003167[gender:0]$ has led you to the $map:02000083$, where you met $npcName:11000394$. According to her, there is a whole mess of masked figures making a ruckus in the $map:02000121$…

quest.name: Joddy in Distress
quest.desc:
While you were investigating the masked thugs attacking the $map:02000121$, their allies nabbed $npcName:11003166$. If you want to save him, you'll have to lock horns with $npcName:11003334$, the kingpin of $map:02000083$.
You should do this even if you don't want to save $npcName:11003166$.

quest.name: Informative Ivan
quest.desc: You saved $npcName:11003247$ from $npcName:11003334$'s sleazy clutches. Now that you've roughed up $npcName:11003334$'s henchmen, he's eager to give you all the information he has on the mysterious figure you're chasing.

quest.name: An Unreasonable Refusal
quest.desc: $npcName:11003194$'s man $npcName:11000396$ doesn't seem keen to talk to you. Maybe $npcName:11000171$ can tell you what's going on.

quest.name: Ralph's Wrongdoings
quest.desc:
It seems like $npcName:11000396$ has been left out in the cold since he crossed $npcName:11000173$. $npcName:11000171$ believes that the poor man will talk to you if you help him—and the best way to help is by doing his old job for $npcName:11000171$.
You don't quite grasp $npcName:11000171$'s raccoon logic, but he's a king, so he probably knows what he's talking about.

quest.name: For Ivan
quest.desc: You are busy completing menial labor for $npcName:11000171$ in the hopes that it will get $npcName:11000396$ to talk.
quest.manual: Collect Scrap Iron in $map:2000084$ |Defeat $npcName:11000173$'s men in $map:2000084$

quest.name: Job Well Done
quest.desc: In exchange for your help, $npcName:11000171$ put in a good word for you with $npcName:11000396$. Maybe he'll be willing to speak with you now.

quest.name: A Dead End
quest.desc: $npcName:11000396$ is finally talking, but it turns out he hasn't seen the $npcName:11003167$. Was $npcName:11003194$ giving you the runaround this whole time? It's time to return to $map:52000119$ and let $npcName:11003194$ know how you feel about being played for a fool.

quest.name: Ralph's Lead
quest.desc:
$npcName:11000173$ tried to double-cross you. It didn't end well for him.
However, now he claims that he knows where $npcName:11003163$ is...

quest.name: The End of Nelph
quest.desc: You found $npcName:11003163$ in $map:52000037$, but you were too late. Somebody else got here first and ended his life.

quest.name: Ralph's Last Go
quest.desc: The $npcName:11003167$ may have slipped through your fingers, but not before dropping a $item:30000023$. This seems like the sort of thing $npcName:11003334$ would know a lot about.

quest.name: Barrota Port
quest.desc:
After a final attempt to defeat you, $npcName:11000173$ has finally given up. He promises to do everything he can to help your investigation—and he's started by identifying the $npcName:11003167$'s notepad as belonging to the Barrota Trading Company.
Head to $map:02000139$ and see what you can find out.
quest.complete: Talk to a member of the Barrota Trading Company in $map:02000139$

quest.name: A Card in the Chaos
quest.desc: In $map:02000139$, you met a trader named $npcName:11000117$. He says that the crest on the notebook belongs to the president of the Barrota Trading Company. Take the elevator from the $map:02000225$ to reach $map:02000226$ and speak with the Barrota chief face-to-face.

quest.name: Ripert
quest.desc: The $map:02000226$ is in a state of disarray and the Barrota chief is missing. The only clue you could find is $item:30000773$. Apparently this $npcName:11003193$ person is an information broker based out of $map:02000139$. Find him at the $map:52000020$.

quest.name: The Cost of Information
quest.desc: You saved $npcName:11001262$ from Blackstar thugs, and he's thanking you by calling you names and generally being unpleasant. It seems this information broker will keep his lips sealed unless you can guarantee his safety from the mob.

quest.name: Dark Wind
quest.desc: Even though you saved his life twice, $npcName:11001262$ won't just give you the answers you want. While he refuses to tell you anything about the $npcName:11003167$, he's happy to refer you to someone who might. Seek out help at the $map:02000153$ in $map:02000100$.
quest.complete: Speak with a Dark Wind agent in the $map:02000153$ in $map:02000100$

quest.name: To Meet the Boss
quest.desc: You're in $map:02000153$ to dig up clues on the $npcName:11003167$, but Dark Wind's boss is out. A particularly helpful agent named $npcName:11000215$ thinks you can find him in $map:52000124$.
quest.complete: Meet the Dark Wind boss at $map:52000124$ in $map:02000147$

quest.name: Behind the Mask
quest.desc: $npcName:11000044$ already knows about the caravan ambush and why you came to see him. But there are still some things even he does not know, so meet him in the $map:52000073$ to discuss things in detail.

quest.name: The Great Winn Stilton
quest.desc: The captain of Dark Wind was the great hero, Winn Stilton. However, you've arrived in Kerning City to find a man named $npcName:11000044$ in charge. Find out what became of the previous captain.
quest.manual: Learn about the leader of Dark Wind

quest.name: A Welcome Friend
quest.desc:
$npcName:11000044$ is convinced that $npcName:11000064$ is the $npcName:11003167$ you've been after this whole time. He promises to put Dark Wind's considerable resources behind your investigation.
But wait—who's that cowering against the wall?

quest.name: Missing Person's Person
quest.desc: Your trusty ally $npcName:11003202$ has come to the $map:52000055$ to deliver bad news. When he went to $map:52000037$ to look for more clues, $npcName:11003163$'s body was no longer there. Return to $map:52000037$ with $npcName:11003202$ and check it out.

quest.name: Cherry Blossom Forest
quest.desc:
While investigating $map:52000037$, a frantic sprite appeared and begged for your help. This sprite, $npcName:11003204$, claims that monsters are threatening his people's kingdom. Investigating the caravan attack is important, but helping fairfolk is important, too.
Head to $map:02000290$ and see what you can do.

quest.name: A Semi-clue
quest.desc: After saving the $map:02000290$ from destruction, $npcName:11003204$ mentioned an encounter with a powerful blond human. Could it be $npcName:11003216$? If $npcName:11003204$ is right, then he's headed back to $map:52000073$ to finish what he started!

quest.name: Homebody
quest.desc: You have pressing information for your investigation, but $npcName:11000044$ isn't at the $map:2000153$. Maybe he went back to $map:52000124$.
quest.complete: Go to $map:52000124$ in $map:02000147$ and talk to $npcName:11000044$

quest.name: Katvan's Wrath
quest.desc:
$npcName:11000044$ isn't at $map:52000124$ this time. $npcName:11000069$ took the opportunity to warn you against trusting $npcName:11000044$ too quickly, but a couple of suspicious men interrupted the conversation.
That's pretty rude. You should rough them up. (Also, they're trying to kill $npcName:11000069$.)

quest.name: Hard Heart
quest.desc: $npcName:11000044$ is in a rage after $npcPlural:11003304$ tried to ambush $npcName:11000069$. Once he calms his nerves, meet him at $map:02000153$.

quest.name: A Tempting Lead
quest.desc: $npcName:11000215$ interrupted your conversation with $npcName:11000044$. It seems someone in $map:02000167$ reported spotting a person matching $npcName:11000064$'s description. Go question $npcName:11001116$, the witness.

quest.name: Masked Motives
quest.desc:
$npcName:11001116$ was keeping an eye on the pollution spreading through $map:02000167$'s garden when she spotted a masked man go inside. Thinking it was the infamous $npcName:11001111$, she reported him to Dark Wind.
You may still be able to catch him if you enter the $map:02000328$ right away.

quest.name: A Trip in Vain
quest.desc: The $map:02000328$ was a bust, but $npcName:11001116$ heard a rumor that might interest you. It seems $npcName:11000543$ over in $map:02000148$ saw someone awfully suspicious.

quest.name: A Report from the Wastes
quest.desc: $npcName:11000543$ says that he actually heard the rumor about $npcName:11001108$ from $npcName:11000533$. Head to the center of $map:02000148$ and pay this $npcName:11000533$ a visit.

quest.name: Exchange of Labor
quest.desc: $npcName:11000533$ says he saw someone matching $npcName:11001111$'s description, but he won't say anything else—not without getting something in return, at least. You'd better do what he says.
quest.manual: Defeat monsters in $map:02000148$ |Clean rusty pipes in $map:02000148$

quest.name: In Your Grasp
quest.desc: $npcName:11000533$ says he spotted $npcName:11001111$ head towards $map:02000139$. If you hurry, you may be able to catch him.

quest.name: After That Blond
quest.desc:
You ran through the streets of $map:02000139$ in pursuit of $npcName:11001111$. Luckily, your dear old treacherous friend $npcName:11000173$ was there to point you in the right direction.
$npcName:11003207$ in $map:02000138$ says he spotted a blond guy head into the $map:52000125$.

quest.name: A Lie of Omission
quest.desc: The blond guy in the warehouse was actually $npcName:11003206$, $npcName:11000211$'s little brother. It seems you were tricked into saving $npcName:11003206$ from a gang of muggers.

quest.name: A Reliable Witness
quest.desc: $npcName:11003206$ claims that he really did see a blond man matching Lennon's description. Since you saved $npcName:11003206$'s brother, it's his turn to help you. Seek out $npcName:11000867$ in $map:02000138$.

quest.name: Memory Trade
quest.desc: $npcName:11000867$ insists that nothing happens in $map:02000138$ without him knowing it, and yet he can't recall where the blond man went. You may have to do something to jog his memory.

quest.name: Merchant's Sighting
quest.desc: $npcName:11000867$ conveniently remembered where the blond man went after you helped him. Head to $map:52000126$.

quest.name: Lennon Lost
quest.desc: The blond man in $map:52000126$ wasn't $npcName:11001111$, but an $npcName:11000213$. The man doesn't seem to have his wits about him. Just as you are about to give up on him, some thugs in familiar masks ambush you...

quest.name: The Awaited Meeting
quest.desc: $npcName:11000211$ and $npcName:11003206$ tracked down the blond man in order to thank you. Your search takes you to the $map:52000046$.

quest.name: Glimpse of the Truth
quest.desc: $npcName:11003215$ claims that he didn't kill $npcName:11003219$. Whatever the case, you need to bring $npcName:11003215$ in for questioning.

quest.name: Hidden Truth
quest.desc:
You've woken up in Kerning City's finest hospital. This is not your day.
Head back to the command office at $map:02000153$ and bring the others up to date.

quest.name: Regroup
quest.desc: $npcName:11000044$ is very understanding of your failure to capture $npcName:11003215$. Now it's time to regroup and come up with a new plan. Head down to the $map:52000055$ ground floor.

quest.name: Black Mushroom
quest.desc: The radars are picking up something strange. Monsters are invading $map:02000100$! $npc:11000044$ is initiating the Black Mushroom... whatever that is.

quest.name: End of the Investigation
quest.desc: $npcName:11000044$ thanks you for saving $map:02000100$, but he won't be able to offer you any more help until the city is back on its feet. It's time to return to $map:02000001$ and let them know everything that's happened.

quest.name: Shock after Shock
quest.desc:
The empress is shocked by the death of $npcName:11003219$, who was one of the Seven Heroes.
Your conversation was interrupted by a guard reporting in to $npc:11001666$. What is this about?

quest.name: Donald's Invitation
quest.desc: $npcName:11003870$ has summoned you to $map:02000424$. Speak with $npcName:11000454$ in $map:02000069$ to get there.

quest.name: Stories of the Sea
quest.desc: Just when you thought $npcName:11000454$ was going to bore you to death with his endless stories, he told you that $npcName:11000981$ knows the route to $map:02000424$.

quest.name: To Berg Island
quest.desc: Since you're friends with $npcName:11000454$, $npcName:11000981$ has agreed to take you to $map:02000424$.

quest.name: Donald's Demand
quest.desc: $npcName:11003870$ of $map:02000424$ has a favor to ask of you. Deliver $item:30001128$ to the miners—but don't let them know who it's from!

quest.name: Always More Work
quest.desc: Just as you're about to return to $npcName:11003870$, $npc:11003871$ pulls you aside with another job.

quest.name: Always Welcome
quest.desc: $npcName:11003872$ thanks you and says to visit $map:02000424$ more often.

quest.name: Alkimi's Invitation
quest.desc: $npcName:11000005$ of the Alkimi Guild (a guild that—you guessed it—focuses on alchemy) has invited you to visit $map:02000425$. Meet with $npcName:11003876$ in $map:02000069$ to arrange your travel.

quest.name: Loana the Sailor
quest.desc: $npcName:11003876$ says that $map:02000425$ is a beautiful place.

quest.name: To Alkimi Island
quest.desc: $npcName:11003877$ opened the sea route to $map:02000425$.

quest.name: Lunch Delivery
quest.desc: $npcName:11003878$ forgot to send lunch to the caretaker of $map:02000425$. Deliver it on her behalf.

quest.name: Pulling Weeds
quest.desc: You need to get the lunch box back from $npcName:11003879$. $npcName:11003879$ asks you to pull weeds while he eats lunch.

quest.name: Thanks for the Meal
quest.desc: $npcName:11003879$ was able to have lunch in peace, thanks to you. Take the empty lunch box from $npcName:11003879$ and return it to $npcName:11003878$.

quest.name: Open the Box of Luck!
quest.desc: $item:20300133$, which can be obtained daily upon login, can be opened with $item:30000512$. $npc:11001484$ hinted that if you're short on $item:30000512$, you should try defeating elite monsters that appear in fields. Not only that, she has also prepared a special gift for anyone who opens $item:20300133$ 50 times. So let's hurry and open some boxes.

quest.name: Delicious Chocolate
quest.desc: In celebration of Valentine's Day, $npc:11000508$ has prepared some sweet chocolate. Let's go visit $npc:11000508$.

quest.name: Open the Five-Color Pouch
quest.desc: Collect and use 30 Five-Color Pouches. You can receive 3 per day upon login, and additional ones can be earned through quests during the Lunar New Year holiday.

quest.name: New Year's Greetings
quest.desc: For the Lunar New Year holiday, let's visit $npc:11000001$ and pay our respects.

quest.name: Find the Essence of Spring!
quest.desc: Evil beings envious of warm spring are stealing $item:30000525$. Defeat the elite monsters appearing throughout the fields, collect 10 $item:30000525$, and bring them to $npc:11001484$.

quest.name: The Kind Hero
quest.desc: $npc:11001484$ has prepared a gift for kind heroes with beautiful hearts, like a warm spring breeze. To prove you're a kind hero, collect 6 $item:30000526$ and bring them to $npcName:11001484$. $item:30000526$ can be obtained by helping other adventurers who are struggling with Challenge/Chaos mode dungeons and clearing them together.

quest.name: Please Take Care of the Puppy
quest.desc: The Queen's Animal Love Association is running an animal love campaign to prevent animal abandonment and encourage adoption of shelter dogs, so that animals and people can become precious friends to each other. In particular, they're holding an event to give out cute pets to adventurers who cherish and love animals... Let's visit $npc:11001002$ at $map:02000064$.

quest.name: Walking the Puppy
quest.desc: Dogs are energetic animals that love walks. Good stamina is essential for having fun walks together! As $npc:11001002$ says, let's breathe in nature and run joyfully.

quest.name: Swimming with the Puppy
quest.desc: Dogs are good swimmers, but they can be afraid of water when young. If the owner shows them how to swim confidently, the puppy can learn to swim easily... As $npc:11001002$ says, let's get in the water and swim.

quest.name: Bouncing with the Puppy
quest.desc: $npc:11001002$ says that the best way to show off a puppy's cute pink paw pads is to bounce and jump together. As she suggests, let's jump with a fresh heart.

quest.name: How to Bond with Animals
quest.desc: If you're not sure how to get close to animals, meeting a well-trained animal that's friendly with people would help. Visit Callie the cat living in a $item:50400004$ placed at your house or someone else's, and bond together through play.

quest.name: How to Have Fun with Animals
quest.desc: If you're not sure how to play with animals, meeting one that's having fun with people would help. Bond with the monkey skillfully playing on a $item:50400118$ placed at your house or someone else's by riding the seesaw together.
quest.manual: Ride the seesaw with the monkey at $item:50400118$

quest.name: Adaptation Training in Crowded Places
quest.desc: Dogs can have trouble adapting to crowded places. When that happens, you need to help them get used to it slowly... MC $npc:11000787$'s event venues gather lots of people, which would be great for adaptation training. However, some say it might be too much for a young puppy. Visit one of $map:61000001$, $map:61000002$, $map:61000007$, $map:61000006$, $map:61000004$, $map:61000003$, or $map:61000008$ to check if it's suitable for the young puppy's adaptation training.
quest.manual: Participate in an event hosted by MC $npcName:11000168$

quest.name: Puppies Love the Sea
quest.desc: Puppies seem to really love $map:51000003$ these days. But no one knows why... Let's visit in person and solve $npc:11001002$'s curiosity.

quest.name: Puppies Love the Farm
quest.desc: Puppies seem to really love $map:51000001$ these days. But no one knows why... Let's visit in person and solve $npc:11001002$'s curiosity.

quest.name: Fishing Is Better Together
quest.desc: People at the Queen's Animal Love Association enjoy fishing with their dogs. Not only can they spend time together, but they can also provide food for other animals at the shelter... Since it's for a good cause, let's participate. Let's go fishing.

quest.name: A Healing Melody for Animals
quest.desc: Just like people, animals also love music. Perhaps because music has the power to transcend language and heal all living things in the world? Let's play beautiful music for the animals.

quest.name: The Grand Battle
quest.desc: An emergency alert has been issued for $map:02000146$. Monsters are rushing in more rapidly from the Dark Land, riding the forces of darkness... Let's defeat the monsters in $map:02000146$!

quest.name: Fairy Paradise
quest.desc: A beautiful garden once called the paradise of $map:02000023$ fairies... You've received word from $npcName:11000033$ requesting help with something unusual happening there. Let's head to $map:02000180$.

quest.name: Whirlwind Vortex
quest.desc: $npc:22000007$, the one behind the whirlwind vortexes sweeping through $map:02000180$!! Let's defeat it and calm the gusts!

quest.name: Path of Return
quest.desc: Word has come that $npc:11000119$ is urgently looking for you at $map:02000001$. What could it be? Let's head back to $map:02000001$.

quest.name: Distress Signal
quest.desc: Phew... I'm swamped right now... An emergency distress signal came from $map:02000231$... Go find out what's going on and take care of it.

quest.name: Fantasy Rampage
quest.desc: A band is having trouble with monsters rampaging near the stage ahead of their promised performance for the audience! Let's defeat the monsters in $map:02000231$ so the audience can safely enjoy the show!

quest.name: Mission Complete
quest.desc: Word has come from $map:02000153$ to return immediately. Let's go back to $map:02000153$ and meet $npc:11000215$.

quest.name: Disappearing Time
quest.desc: Reports have come in that there are creatures eating time in $map:02000262$. Let's go to $map:02000262$ and find out what's happening.

quest.name: Slurp Time
quest.desc: $npcName:11000783$ in $map:02000262$ says that the monsters living here have been eating time, causing him and his girlfriend Corin to be stuck as children, unable to grow up. He asks you to defeat the monsters so that their frozen time can flow again.

quest.name: Time to Return
quest.desc: Let's return to $map:02000076$ and report the situation in $map:02000262$ to $npc:11000015$.

quest.name: Running Healthily
quest.desc: The 'I Want to Go There' event with Barbie! Let's excitedly run through Maple World.

quest.name: Bouncing Along
quest.desc: The 'I Want to Go There' event with Barbie! Let's jump and bounce until we reach the skies of Maple World.

quest.name: Flying Like Light
quest.desc: The 'I Want to Go There' event with Barbie! Hop on a mount and explore every corner of Maple World.

quest.name: Approaching Carefully
quest.desc: The 'I Want to Go There' event with Barbie! For a unique experience, try carefully crawling around.

quest.name: Swimming Along
quest.desc: The 'I Want to Go There' event with Barbie! Show off your swimming skills and explore Maple World.

quest.name: Climbing Up Step by Step
quest.desc: The 'I Want to Go There' event with Barbie! Climb a ladder and enjoy the view of Maple World.
quest.manual: Hang on a ladder for 120 seconds

quest.name: Hanging On Persistently
quest.desc: The 'I Want to Go There' event with Barbie! Hang on a rope and enjoy the view of Maple World.
quest.manual: Hang on a rope for 120 seconds

quest.name: Finding Miss Valentine
quest.desc: After reading Maple Daily's 1st anniversary special feature on notable people of Maple World, $npc:11001002$ suggests going out to meet people while reminiscing about the past year. $npc:22000022$, the ruler of $map:02000117$, was voted the woman adventurers most want to receive chocolate from. Let's go check if this gentle woman with hidden beast instincts is rampaging.

quest.name: Finding Mister White
quest.desc: After reading Maple Daily's 1st anniversary special feature on notable people of Maple World, $npc:11001002$ suggests going out to meet people while reminiscing about the past year. Let's go to $map:02000118$ and meet $npc:11000617$, a man with an attractive poker face who was once voted the man adventurers most want to receive candy from.

quest.name: Looking Sharp, Sir
quest.desc: After reading Maple Daily's 1st anniversary special feature on notable people of Maple World, $npc:11001002$ suggests going out to meet people while reminiscing about the past year. Let's meet $npc:11000076$, a handsome man carrying out orders from Empress $npcName:11000075$ in $map:02000146$, and pass along $npc:11001002$'s greetings.

quest.name: The Quiet City Man
quest.desc: After reading Maple Daily's 1st anniversary special feature on notable people of Maple World, $npc:11001002$ suggests going out to meet people while reminiscing about the past year. Let's go to $map:02010016$ to meet $npc:11001374$, a cold city man with a neat appearance.

quest.name: Burning Charisma
quest.desc: After reading Maple Daily's 1st anniversary special feature on notable people of Maple World, $npc:11001002$ suggests going out to meet people while reminiscing about the past year. Let's go to $map:02000124$ to meet $npc:11000514$, the charismatic ruler of $map:02000124$.

quest.name: The Fatally Charming Lady
quest.desc: After reading Maple Daily's 1st anniversary special feature on notable people of Maple World, $npc:11001002$ suggests going out to meet people while reminiscing about the past year. $npc:11000515$, who flaunts her elegant beauty in $map:02000216$, is rumored to have ties to the Black Stars. Let's go to $map:02000216$ to meet her.

quest.name: Mascot of the Bunny Bunny Troupe
quest.desc: After reading Maple Daily's 1st anniversary special feature on notable people of Maple World, $npc:11001002$ suggests going out to meet people while reminiscing about the past year. Let's go to $map:02000064$ to meet $npc:11000711$, the self-proclaimed mascot of the Bunny Bunny Troupe with a bright and energetic smile.

quest.name: Spiritual Pillar of the Vigilantes
quest.desc: After reading Maple Daily's 1st anniversary special feature on notable people of Maple World, $npc:11001002$ suggests going out to meet people while reminiscing about the past year. Let's meet $npc:11000015$, the leader of the vigilantes who protect peaceful $map:02000076$, and ask about her beauty secrets.

quest.name: The Beautiful Idol
quest.desc: After reading Maple Daily's 1st anniversary special feature on notable people of Maple World, $npc:11001002$ suggests going out to meet people while reminiscing about the past year. A fan meeting for $npc:11000406$, said to be the most popular man on Victoria Island, is being held at $map:02000137$. Let's go attend.

quest.name: The Square-Headed Man
quest.desc: After reading Maple Daily's 1st anniversary special feature on notable people of Maple World, $npc:11001002$ suggests going out to meet people while reminiscing about the past year. Rumor has it that $npc:11000119$, a valiant man who guards $map:02000001$, has such a flat head that you could place a kettle on it. Let's go see if the rumor is true.

quest.name: The Man with the Hymn
quest.desc: After reading Maple Daily's 1st anniversary special feature on notable people of Maple World, $npc:11001002$ suggests going out to meet people while reminiscing about the past year. At $map:02000158$, atop the towering building in the center of $map:02000100$, there's a rumor that $npc:11000252$ makes job applicants sing a hymn with his name during interviews... Let's go find out the truth.

quest.name: The Boy from the Stars
quest.desc: After reading Maple Daily's 1st anniversary special feature on notable people of Maple World, $npc:11001002$ suggests going out to meet people while reminiscing about the past year. Let's go to $map:02010047$ to meet $npc:11001430$, a mysterious beautiful boy with a kind face but cold way of speaking.

quest.name: Finding the True Big Spender
quest.desc: After reading Maple Daily's 1st anniversary special feature on notable people of Maple World, $npc:11001002$ suggests going out to meet people while reminiscing about the past year. Let's visit $npc:11000185$, the lady of the house at $map:02000001$'s $map:02000123$, and hear about how to become wealthy.

quest.name: The Elder with Memories of That Day
quest.desc: After reading Maple Daily's 1st anniversary special feature on notable people of Maple World, $npc:11001002$ suggests going out to meet people while reminiscing about the past year. Let's go to $map:02000111$ to hear the story from $npc:11000874$, an old man who vividly remembers the tale of a giant turtle and the adventurers from long ago.

quest.name: Chunbae's Past
quest.desc: After reading Maple Daily's 1st anniversary special feature on notable people of Maple World, $npc:11001002$ suggests going out to meet people while reminiscing about the past year. If you're curious about the story behind GM Chunbae's name, you should visit someone called $npc:11000456$... Let's go to $map:02000070$ in $map:02000062$ and hear what happened.

quest.name: Announcers Are Love
quest.desc: After reading Maple Daily's 1st anniversary special feature on notable people of Maple World, $npc:11001002$ suggests going out to meet people while reminiscing about the past year. $npc:11001002$'s dream is to become a smart and pretty person like the announcer lady you can see when you turn on $item:50400002$. Let's turn on $item:50400002$ and see her.

quest.name: Let's Have a Meal
quest.desc: After reading Maple Daily's 1st anniversary special feature on notable people of Maple World, $npc:11001002$ suggests going out to meet people while reminiscing about the past year. Great news for those who feel lonely eating alone! If you place a furnishing called $item:50400125$ at home, you can always eat with a friend named Nana. Let's go meet this amazing furnishing and the friend who guards it, Nana.

quest.name: Meeting Refreshed
quest.desc: After reading Maple Daily's 1st anniversary special feature on notable people of Maple World, $npc:11001002$ suggests going out to meet people while reminiscing about the past year. $npc:11001002$ thinks the most important thing when meeting people is to wash up clean and meet them refreshed. Let's use $item:50400053$ to get clean and feel refreshed.

quest.name: Meeting Strong
quest.desc: After reading Maple Daily's 1st anniversary special feature on notable people of Maple World, $npc:11001002$ suggests going out to meet people while reminiscing about the past year. $npc:11001002$ wanted to ride a bicycle when meeting people but lacked the skill, so she bought $item:50400098$ from home shopping to practice. But her brother $npc:11001003$ says she can't practice cycling on indoor exercise equipment, making her sulk. Let's try riding $item:50400098$ and give her a review on whether it can be used for cycling practice.

quest.name: Meeting Light
quest.desc: After reading Maple Daily's 1st anniversary special feature on notable people of Maple World, $npc:11001002$ suggests going out to meet people while reminiscing about the past year. $npc:11001002$ thinks you need a light body and mind to focus on the person in front of you. She says $item:50400054$ is the perfect partner in that regard... Let's try using $item:50400054$ to see if she's right.

quest.name: Where Is That Person?
quest.desc: After reading Maple Daily's 1st anniversary special feature on notable people of Maple World, $npc:11001002$ suggests going out to meet people while reminiscing about the past year. $npc:11001002$ says there's nothing like a telescope for checking the location of someone far away. Let's try using a telescope as she suggests.

quest.name: I Miss You, Treasure Chest
quest.desc: After reading Maple Daily's 1st anniversary special feature on notable people of Maple World, $npc:11001002$ suggests going out to meet people while reminiscing about the past year. Some people are even happier to stumble upon golden treasure chests than meeting other people. Let's find hidden golden treasure chests and join in the fun.

quest.name: The Hero's Kindness Continues
quest.desc: Help other adventurers struggling with Challenge/Chaos mode dungeons to clear them, and you can earn $item:30000558$. They say there's a gift for heroes who collect 4 $item:30000558$, so let's try it.

quest.name: The Hero's Challenge Continues
quest.desc: Help other adventurers struggling with Challenge/Chaos mode dungeons to clear them, and you can earn $item:30000558$. They say there's a gift for heroes who collect 4 $item:30000558$, so let's try it.

quest.name: The Arikaari Merchant's Gift
quest.desc: Answer the Arikaari Merchant's quiz correctly, and you can earn the special gift they've prepared. They say it's very useful for monster hunting, so let's give it a try!

quest.name: The Maple Rice Cakes Are in Danger
quest.desc: Defeat $npcName:21090187$, $npcName:21090188$, and $npcName:21090189$ who are carrying $item:20000335$ in $map:02000280$, and collect $item:20000335$.

quest.desc: $npcName:11001003$'s recommended way to enjoy Chuseok! Bounce bounce! Let's enjoy the traditional wooden seesaw with friends!

quest.desc: $npcName:11001003$'s recommended way to enjoy Chuseok! Today, let's pound the mortar like the rabbit on the moon!

quest.name: Shall We Serve Delicious Food?
quest.desc: $npcName:11001003$'s recommended way to enjoy Chuseok! Let's cook a delicious meal for our guests on the Standard Gas Range!

quest.name: Chuseok Means Fighting Games!
quest.desc: $npcName:11001003$'s recommended way to enjoy Chuseok! Let's have a blast on the fighting game arcade machine!

quest.name: Jump Jump Until We Reach the Moon!
quest.desc: $npcName:11001003$'s recommended Chuseok exercise! Let's jump high until we reach the moon!

quest.name: I Run Even on Chuseok
quest.desc: $npcName:11001003$'s recommended Chuseok exercise! Let's run excitedly with friends!

quest.name: We're All the Best!
quest.desc: $npcName:11001003$'s recommended way to enjoy Chuseok! Let's use the Best Firework high into the sky!

quest.name: The Arikaari Merchant's Gift Is Always Right!
quest.desc:
Answer the Arikaari Merchant's quiz correctly, and you can obtain $item:20300508$.
A chance to get a powerful weapon again! Don't forget to try!

quest.desc:

quest.desc: Another way to enjoy the Maple Autumn Festival! Swim through the waters as blue as the sky above!

quest.desc:
Investigate the playfully grinning Halloween pumpkins found throughout Maple World!
Once you complete the investigation, you can receive a Halloween gift prepared by $npc:11001002$.

quest.name: Finding Miss Valentine
quest.desc: After reading the Maple Daily's Number One Festival special article about famous people of Maple World, $npc:11001002$ suggests meeting people to become Maple World's number one adventurer. Voted by adventurers as the woman they most want to receive chocolate from, the ruler of $map:02000117$, $npc:22000022$. A soft woman who hides a beast's instincts — let's go check if she's rampaging again.

quest.name: Finding Mr. White
quest.desc: After reading the Maple Daily's Number One Festival special article about famous people of Maple World, $npc:11001002$ suggests meeting people to become Maple World's number one adventurer. Once voted as the man adventurers most want to give candy to, go to $map:02000118$ to meet the charming poker-faced man, $npc:11000617$.

quest.name: How Cool, Sir
quest.desc: After reading the Maple Daily's Number One Festival special article about famous people of Maple World, $npc:11001002$ suggests meeting people to become Maple World's number one adventurer. Meet the handsome man $npc:11000076$ who is carrying out the orders of Empress $npcName:11000075$ at $map:02000146$, and deliver $npc:11001002$'s greetings.

quest.name: The Quiet City Man
quest.desc: After reading the Maple Daily's Number One Festival special article about famous people of Maple World, $npc:11001002$ suggests meeting people to become Maple World's number one adventurer. Go to $map:02010016$ to meet the cool city man with neat attire, $npc:11001374$.

quest.name: Blazing Charisma
quest.desc: After reading the Maple Daily's Number One Festival special article about famous people of Maple World, $npc:11001002$ suggests meeting people to become Maple World's number one adventurer. Go to $map:02000124$ to meet the charismatic ruler of $map:02000124$, $npc:11000514$.

quest.name: Her Lethal Charm
quest.desc: After reading the Maple Daily's Number One Festival special article about famous people of Maple World, $npc:11001002$ suggests meeting people to become Maple World's number one adventurer. $npc:11000515$, who flaunts her proud beauty at $map:02000216$, is rumored to have connections with the Dark Star organization. Let's go to $map:02000216$ to meet her.

quest.name: Mascot of the Bunny Bunny Gang
quest.desc: After reading the Maple Daily's Number One Festival special article about famous people of Maple World, $npc:11001002$ suggests meeting people to become Maple World's number one adventurer. Let's go to $map:02000064$ to meet $npc:11000711$, the self-proclaimed mascot of the Bunny Bunny Gang, who has a beautiful bright and cheerful smile.

quest.name: Spiritual Pillar of the Vigilantes
quest.desc: After reading the Maple Daily's Number One Festival special article about famous people of Maple World, $npc:11001002$ suggests meeting people to become Maple World's number one adventurer. Meet the leader of the vigilantes who protects peaceful $map:02000076$, $npc:11000015$, and ask about the secret to their beauty.

quest.name: A Beautiful Idol
quest.desc: After reading the Maple Daily's Number One Festival special article about famous people of Maple World, $npc:11001002$ suggests meeting people to become Maple World's number one adventurer. Victoria Island's most popular man $npc:11000406$ is holding a fan meeting at $map:02000137$. Let's go attend it.

quest.name: The Square-Headed Man
quest.desc: After reading the Maple Daily's Number One Festival special article about famous people of Maple World, $npc:11001002$ suggests meeting people to become Maple World's number one adventurer. There's a rumor that the gallant man $npc:11000119$ who guards $map:02000001$ has a head so flat you could put a kettle on it. Let's go find out if the rumor is true.

quest.name: The Man with a Hymn
quest.desc: After reading the Maple Daily's Number One Festival special article about famous people of Maple World, $npc:11001002$ suggests meeting people to become Maple World's number one adventurer. At the top of the building towering in the center of $map:02000100$, in $map:02000158$, there's a rumor that $npc:11000252$ makes job interview applicants sing a hymn with his name in it... Let's go find out the truth.

quest.name: A Beautiful Boy from the Stars
quest.desc: After reading the Maple Daily's Number One Festival special article about famous people of Maple World, $npc:11001002$ suggests meeting people to become Maple World's number one adventurer. Let's go to $map:02010047$ to meet the mysterious beautiful boy $npc:11001430$, who has a kind face but cold manner of speaking.

quest.name: Finding a True Big Spender
quest.desc: After reading the Maple Daily's Number One Festival special article about famous people of Maple World, $npc:11001002$ suggests meeting people to become Maple World's number one adventurer. Visit $npc:11000185$, the lady of $map:02000001$ $map:02000123$, and hear about how to become rich.

quest.name: The Old Man with Memories of That Day
quest.desc: After reading the Maple Daily's Number One Festival special article about famous people of Maple World, $npc:11001002$ suggests meeting people to become Maple World's number one adventurer. Go to $map:02000111$ to hear the story from $npc:11000874$, an elder who vividly remembers the tale between a giant turtle and adventurers from long ago.

quest.name: Chunbae's Past
quest.desc: After reading the Maple Daily's Number One Festival special article about famous people of Maple World, $npc:11001002$ suggests meeting people to become Maple World's number one adventurer. If you're curious about the story behind GM Chunbae's name, you should go to someone named $npc:11000456$... Let's go to $map:02000070$ in $map:02000062$ and hear what happened.

quest.name: The Announcer Is Love
quest.desc: After reading the Maple Daily's Number One Festival special article about famous people of Maple World, $npc:11001002$ suggests meeting people to become Maple World's number one adventurer. $npc:11001002$'s dream is to become a smart and pretty person like the announcer you can see when you turn on $item:50400002$. Turn on $item:50400002$ to see her.

quest.name: Let's Have a Meal
quest.desc: After reading the Maple Daily's Number One Festival special article about famous people of Maple World, $npc:11001002$ suggests meeting people to become Maple World's number one adventurer. Good news for people who feel lonely eating alone! If you place a piece of furniture called $item:50400125$ in your home, you can eat with a friend named Nana anytime. Let's go meet this amazing furniture and the friend guarding it, Nana.

quest.name: Let's Meet Refreshed
quest.desc: After reading the Maple Daily's Number One Festival special article about famous people of Maple World, $npc:11001002$ suggests meeting people to become Maple World's number one adventurer. $npc:11001002$ believes the most important thing when meeting people is to wash up clean and greet them refreshed. Let's clean up in $item:50400053$ and feel refreshed.

quest.name: Let's Meet Fit and Strong
quest.desc: After reading the Maple Daily's Number One Festival special article about famous people of Maple World, $npc:11001002$ suggests meeting people to become Maple World's number one adventurer. $npc:11001002$ wanted to ride a bicycle when meeting people but lacked the skill, so she bought $item:50400098$ from home shopping to practice. However, she looks dejected after her brother $npc:11001003$ said you can't practice cycling on an indoor exercise machine. Try riding $item:50400098$ and share your review on whether it can be used for bicycle practice.

quest.name: Let's Meet Light and Easy
quest.desc: After reading the Maple Daily's Number One Festival special article about famous people of Maple World, $npc:11001002$ suggests meeting people to become Maple World's number one adventurer. $npc:11001002$ believes you need a light body and mind to focus on the person in front of you. She says $item:50400054$ is the best partner for that purpose... Let's try using $item:50400054$ to see if she's right.

quest.name: Where Is That Person?
quest.desc: After reading the Maple Daily's Number One Festival special article about famous people of Maple World, $npc:11001002$ suggests meeting people to become Maple World's number one adventurer. $npc:11001002$ says there's nothing like a telescope for checking the location of someone far away. quest.name: Let's Find the Zakum Balloons
quest.desc:
Find and investigate Zakum balloons scattered throughout Maple World! Complete 10 investigations per day to receive 5 $item:20000691$ from $npc:11003722$.

quest.name: Mason's Special Someone
quest.desc:
Holy Knight Mason is preparing for the Sky Fortress fleet's deployment to protect Maple World! There's a cute and adorable Human Meret that melted his heart in an instant... Share his unique taste and form a special bond.
* $item:30001051$ can be obtained 1 per day as a reward from [Mason's Personal Taste] daily quest given by $npc:11001002$ at $map:02000064$ during the event period. * Event Period: January 25, 2018 - February 8, 2018

quest.name: Mason's Personal Taste
quest.desc:
Holy Knight Mason is preparing for the Sky Fortress fleet's deployment to protect Maple World! Find and pet the cute and adorable Human Merets that captured the heart of this handsome, intelligent, and cool-headed knight throughout Maple World!
* Human Merets appear across all fields every 10 minutes and last for 5 minutes.

quest.name: Love Rides on Chocolate
quest.desc:
A special Valentine's Day event is being held across all of Maple World. Find Chocoball balloons throughout the fields, collect $item:30001088$, and send them to the NPC you want to give a gift to.
* Chocoball balloons appear across all fields every 10 minutes and last for 5 minutes. * Each time you complete the quest, you'll achieve the [Choco Choco Gift] emblem and receive emblem rewards.

quest.name: Collect the Letters of 'Spring Has Come'!
quest.desc:
Spring has arrived in Maple World! Defeat the field bosses listed below or win in mini-games to obtain letters that complete the Maple Spring Preparation. Collect all 7 letters and deliver them to $npc:11003139$ to receive a special gift!

$npc:11004101$, the mysterious magpie who gathers love, promised to give you a large amount of $item:30001182$ if you complete special missions.
This week's weekly mission is performance! Play instruments freely so the energy of love flowing through the Milky Way Garden can flow even more actively.
quest.manual: Play an instrument in $map:63000062$|Perform as an ensemble with party members in $map:63000062$

quest.desc: The Island of Love has finally opened! $npc:11004102$, the mysterious raven living there, says they prepared a special gift for the one who caused the miracle of love. While they prepare the gift, join the Love Dance Party and return.
quest.manual: Participate in the Dance Party of Love in $map:63000062$
