quest.desc: If you are having trouble with leftover '$item:20301928$' after making '$item:20301927$', consider $npc:11003882$'s offer.
It has already been one year since you began making memories in MapleStory 2. Remember the memories of the past year and exchange congratulations with $npc:11001002$.
quest.manual: It has already been one year since you began making memories in MapleStory 2. Remember the memories of the past year and exchange congratulations with $npc:11001002$.

quest.desc: The Moon Bunny Mill was spending its busiest days making mooncakes for Chuseok. One day, more and more moon bunnies suddenly left the worksite, making it impossible to run the mill properly. $npc:11004248$, the bedridden work supervisor's daughter, came down to Maple World and is fiercely thinking of a way to supply mooncakes for adventurers... $npc:11003139$ says that if you refine $item:30001201$, which appears when investigating flower balloons scattered throughout Maple World, it may give off a scent similar to the Moon Bunny Mill's mugwort mooncakes. Nothing to lose! For the discouraged moon bunnies of the Moon Bunny Mill, collect 10 $item:30001201$ and bring them to $npc:11004248$ in $map:02000064$.

$npc:11001002$ says the moon bunnies who suddenly left the mill are appearing throughout Maple World, stained by a strange energy, and that this strange energy seems to be coming from a secret space behind the full moon. What connection is there between the moon bunnies' change and that suspicious space? Use $item:20301895$ to enter $map:80000016$, observe what is happening there, and tell $npc:11004248$ in $map:02000064$.
quest.manual: Enter $map:80000016$ and see what is happening

quest.desc:
$npc:11004248$ says she heard about the strange large rabbits appearing throughout Maple World, and that they seem to be the companions who left the Full Moon Mill. According to a moon bunny tribe legend her mother once told her, long ago some moon bunnies were stained by a strange energy and wrecked the mill. Only after they were subdued and the energy was drained did some moon bunnies regain their senses. $npc:11004248$ is saddened, but wants to give her companions peace even if it must be done that way. In her place, suppress $npc:27000034$, which appears in $map:02000043$, and tell $npc:11004248$ the result.
$npc:27000034$ appears in $map:02000043$ at 19:30, 20:30, 21:30, and 22:30.

Install an advertising balloon in one of $map:02000001$, $map:02000100$, $map:02000076$, $map:02000023$, $map:02000062$, or $map:02000064$, and leave a message celebrating MapleStory 2's first anniversary.

For the Halloween season when ghosts run wild, $npc:11001002$ asks you to show courage that will not lose to the evil spirit energy filling the dungeons. They say they will give a gift for Halloween heroes if you receive $item:20301427$, so clear dungeons until you have earned weekly rewards 30 times, receive $item:20301427$, and get the gift prepared by $npc:11001002$.
quest.manual: Clear dungeons until you have obtained weekly rewards 30 times, then receive $item:20301427$

quest.desc: Try placing $item:50400309$ in your house! You can find $item:50400309$ by opening the 'Start Building' menu and selecting the 'Pumpkin Demon Pumpky' tab on the left. If it is already installed, remove it and install it again.

The turkeys, tired of ending up on adventurers' tables every Thanksgiving, could endure it no longer and attacked Maple World to ruin Thanksgiving! Defeat $npc:27000051$ in $map:02000092$ and protect the residents of Maple World!

Rumor says that if you cook $npc:27000051$, it becomes a delicacy so excellent it cannot even be compared to ordinary turkey. $npc:11001002$ wants to serve a dish made with $npc:27000051$ to entertain guests during Thanksgiving. If you catch and bring $npc:27000051$ to $npc:11001002$ for ten days, it should be enough to serve many guests.

The power of darkness is running wild in Chaos Dungeons. Clear Chaos Dungeons <font color="#00a2ed">12 times</font> to stabilize them.
Dungeons to Clear: $dungeonTitle:23021003$, $dungeonTitle:23022003$, $dungeonTitle:23023003$

Too much energy has built up in the Eye of Lapenta dungeons. If even more energy condenses, it may explode again. Clear Eye of Lapenta dungeons <font color="#00a2ed">12 times</font> to prevent the explosion!
Dungeons to Clear: $dungeonTitle:27000001$, $dungeonTitle:27001001$, $dungeonTitle:27002001$
quest.manual: Clear Eye of Lapenta Dungeons 12 times

quest.desc: $npcName:11001002$ says they prepared a gift along with New Year's greetings. You cannot receive it after today, so hurry to $map:02000064$.

2019 is the Year of the Pig! Excited for the Year of the Pig, which comes once every 12 years, baby lucky pigs ran out into Maple World, thrilled at the thought of having a party. But the places where these naive baby lucky pigs appeared are full of monsters...! To help the frightened baby lucky pigs welcome the new year safely, untie their feet from the ground and let them fly freely!

$npc:11001002$ says they will give you a gift if you conquer the power of darkness that came to Kritias and return.
Dungeons to Clear: $dungeonTitle:23037002$ or $dungeonTitle:23038002$

quest.desc:
An April Fools' surprise event, available only until April 2, 2019!
It's April Fools' Day! That urge to trick or prank someone? $npcName:11001002$ totally gets it~!
Eat the $item:20000674$ received in the mail and give your friends a big surprise. Adventurers who complete the quest will receive a gift perfectly suited for April Fools'!
quest.name: I'm Going to Trick You!

quest.desc:
If you defeat $npcName:60000103$, the third-round opponent in Queenwin Rumble, three times, you can receive a gift from $npcName:11001002$.
The gift can only be received from May 22, 2019 until before the June 14 maintenance, so hurry and join Queenwin Rumble!
quest.name: Defeat Mint!
quest.manual: Face $npcName:60000103$ in Queen Bean Rumble and win

$npc:11001003$ tells you about a special dungeon open during the event and explains that you can level up quickly through it. Clear $dungeonTitle:29007001$ and $dungeonTitle:29007002$ a combined 30 times in one week to receive items for rapid growth. Note that the daily/weekly reward limit for both dungeons is shared at the account level.

A rift in time has opened a gateway to a dimension from another world. It all traces back to $map:02000420$... If the rift persists for long, who knows what dangers may arise. Head to $dungeonTitle:29006001$ and face $npc:23000077$.
quest.name: Time Monster's Mischief

quest.desc: The other-dimensional space created by the time rift has become wildly popular among adventurers. Now $npc:23000077$ plans to create even more dimensional spaces... If the rift lasts too long and grows larger, unforeseen dangers may follow. Head to $dungeonTitle:29006001$ and face $npc:23000077$.
quest.name: Time Monster's Plan

quest.desc: Apparently, $npc:23000077$'s true plan is to trap adventurers inside the other-dimensional space created by the time rift. Before adventurers fall into danger, head to $dungeonTitle:29006001$ and face $npc:23000077$.
quest.name: Time Monster's Conspiracy

quest.desc:
$npcName:11000119$ the Captain says that feeling lonely is a sign of a weak spirit, and recommends you join the Royal Guard's special training. I'm not quite sure why I should do this, but since there are rewards on offer, let's take part. First, defeat one of the various Field Bosses in Maple World, then find $npc:11000158$ in $map:02000118$.
Field Bosses in Maple World: '$npcName:23000013$', '$npcName:23000018$', '$npcName:23000001$', '$npcName:23000019$', '$npcName:23000054$', '$npcName:23000020$', '$npcName:23000035$', '$npcName:23000099$', '$npcName:23000017$', '$npcName:23000047$', '$npcName:23000024$', '$npcName:23000034$', '$npcName:23000045$', '$npcName:23000057$', '$npcName:23000026$', '$npcName:23000012$', '$npcName:23000009$', '$npcName:23000029$'

quest.name: Looking Good, Even to Myself
quest.desc: $npc:11000158$ says that the second training exercise is to run on $item:50400096$ and clear your mind. I'm not sure what the point of this is, but since there are rewards on offer, I might as well follow along. Use $item:50400096$ in your home or someone else's home, then find $npc:11000157$ in $map:02000118$.
quest.manual: Use $item:50400096$ at your house or someone else's house

quest.desc: $npc:11000157$ says that true romance means enjoying solitude and exploring yourself, and asks you to play a song with any sheet music. Apparently, immersing yourself in a world where only music and you exist is the third training exercise... I have no idea what that means, but since it's the third one, I might as well keep going. Play any sheet music, then find $npc:11000617$ in $map:02000118$.

$npc:11000617$ says that eating $item:20001693$ is the final training exercise, and even explained its significance. Since there's a gift waiting after this last exercise, I might as well just go ahead and do as I'm told. Eat the $item:20001693$ received as training rewards, then claim your souvenir. (If you don't have any $item:20001693$, speak to $npc:11000617$ to receive some again.)

If you stay logged in for at least 80 minutes on both December 31, 2019 and January 1, 2020, you'll receive 10 $item:30001467$ by mail each day. Collect 20 $item:30001467$ over the two days and bring them to $npcName:11001002$.
quest.name: Lucky Cupcake Delivery

quest.desc: $npc:11001002$ tells you that a very special dance party has been prepared this winter, and invites you to join in. Participate in $map:61000022$ 3 times a week and receive the surprise gift that $npc:11001002$ has prepared.

quest.name: Pet Mania
quest.desc: Capture various pets around Maple World and become a true pet master! Capture 15 pets to get a $item:60000032$ from $npc:11001003$.

quest.name: Conquer Dark Descent
quest.desc:
$dungeonTitle:25008001$ Entrance: $map:2000048$
Enter the darkness to unravel the true nature of $map:02000350$ and satiate $npcName:11001003$'s curiosity. Speak with $npc:11001003$ after completing round 15 to get a gift.

quest.name: Star Pop Party
quest.desc:
Search for star balloons scattered around Maple World. Pop 10 of them each day to get a tasty $item:20001034$ from $npcName:11001002$. After you collect 30 $itemPlural:20001034$, you will automatically unlock "Star Pop Party" in the Events category of the Trophy window and can collect $item:11850109$ as a reward.
* Star balloons appear in all non-instanced, non-town areas every 10 minutes and remain for 5 minutes.

quest.name: Raising Pumky!
quest.desc: Raise the adorable pumpkin devil Pumky and get some neat gifts!

quest.name: A Nest for Pumky
quest.desc: Place the $item:50400309$ in your home. You can find it in the Pumpkin Devil Pumky tab of the furnishings menu. If you've already placed one, remove it and place it again.

quest.name: Mason's Biggest Fan
quest.desc:
Mason is one of the leaders preparing to mobilize the Sky Fortress. Ruby has a unique opportunity for you to get "closer" to him, which could work to your advantage if you're stragetic about it.
* You'll get 1 $item:30001051$ per day for completing the daily quest "Mason's Little Secret," given by $npc:11001002$ in $map:02000064$ during the event.
* Event Period: 11/17/18 to the maintenance on 12/6/18

quest.name: Mason's Little Secret
quest.desc:
Mason is one of the leaders preparing to mobilize the Sky Fortress. Ruby has a unique opportunity for you to get ""closer"" to him, which could work to your advantage if you're stragetic about it. She says the way to earn his trust is to... find and pat the Meret-Men scattered around Maple World. Really? Who IS this guy?!
* Meret-Men spawn in almost all non-instanced, non-town areas every 10 minutes and remain for 5 minutes.

quest.name: Turkey Terror
quest.desc: Every Thanksgiving, people eat turkey. This year, they're fighting back! Normally, it wouldn't be a threat, but somehow, some huuuuge and dangerous $npcNamePlural:27000051$ have appeared at the $map:02000092$! They must be stopped!

quest.name: Turkey Dinner
quest.desc: People are saying that the taste of $npcName:27000051$ is incomparable. $npcName:11001002$ wants to serve a feast of $npcName:27000051$ for Thanksgiving and needs you to take care of the $npcNamePlural:27000051$ to make it happen.

quest.name: When Pigs Fly
quest.desc: 2019 is the Year of the Pig! The Lucky Piglets set out across Maple World to celebrate, but it seems many have lost their way! In this world of ever-present danger, it's up to you to rescue the perturbed piglets and send them on their way!
quest.manual: Rescue the Lucky Piglets trembling in fear all over Maple World

quest.name: Decadent Delivery
quest.desc: This Valentine's Day is the perfect time to confess your love with custom-made chocolates! Mendel, the famous confectioner is making world-class chocolate for the lovelorn, and they can be yours if you only gather the necessary ingredients. Collect 5 $itemPlural:20000452$, 2 $itemPlural:30000729$, and 1 $item:30000730$! Collecting Ingredients • $item:20000452$: Obtained by squeezing the choco-chicky balloons found all over the non-town maps. • $item:30000729$: Obtained by defeating world bosses. • $item:30000730$: Obtained by defeating dungeon bosses.

The Fool's Quiz
quest.desc:
Celebrate April Fools' Day until 4/2/2019!
Why don't you join in MC Kay's twisted April Fools OX Quiz event?

quest.name: A Big Surprise
quest.desc:
Surprise your friends with a giant-sized prank during the April Fools' Day event, running until 4/2/2019!
Complete the "$quest:80020121$" quest to get some Growth Pills, then use them to play a trick for a great reward.

quest.name: Give Me a P! I! N!
Give Me a K! B! E!
Give Me an A! N! Question mark!
My Friend, Pink Bean
quest.desc: You feel as though your friendship with Pink Bean has really taken off since you started collecting $item:20001330$. If you keep collecting more letters for $npc:11001002$ in exchange for candy, maybe Pink Bean will become your best friend!

quest.name: Luck On Your Side
quest.desc:
It's time to get lucky! Collect $itemPlural:20302745$ and open them using $itemPlural:30001420$, you will be rewarded for your efforts. If you open 200 $itemPlural:20302745$, you'll get a special gift from $npc:11001002$!
* How to Obtain $itemPlural:20302745$ - Collect via mail after logging in during the event. - Receive for Day 5, 9, 13, and 17 of the Summer Rewards Event. - Chance to receive after winning MC Kay mini-games. - Chance to receive after clearing Cathy Mart Part-Time Job. - Chance to receive from fishing and performing. - Chance to receive from Turka's Cache and Turka's Rare Cache.
* How to Obtain $itemPlural:30001420$ - Collect via mail after logging in during the event. - Chance to receive after defeating Elite monsters level 10 or higher. - Chance to receive from wooden and golden treasure chests.

quest.name: Birthday Candle Festival
quest.desc: Happy birthday to us! Happy birthday to us! Light the birthday candles all over Maple World to celebrate MapleStory 2's first anniversary.
quest.manual: Light birthday candles all over Maple World

quest.name: Fresh Start for Another Year
quest.desc: It's already MapleStory 2's first anniversary. You have been busy keeping the peace in Maple World, but wicked monsters run amok even today.
quest.manual: Defeat monsters all over Maple World

quest.name: Adventurous Celebration
quest.desc: It's already MapleStory 2's first anniversary. The real adventure starts now! Celebrate with fun dungeon runs!
quest.manual: Clear Normal/Hard Adventure Dungeon or Chaos Raid

quest.name: Anniversary Invitation Insanity
quest.desc: It's already MapleStory 2's first anniversary. Wicked monsters stole all of the party invitations for the anniversary gala. Defeat elite monsters all over Maple World and retrieve the $itemPlural:30001429$.

quest.name: Anniversary Gift Box Gaff
quest.desc: It's already MapleStory 2's first anniversary. Wicked monsters stole all of the gifts for the party-goers. Defeat world bosses all over Maple World and retrieve the $itemPlural:30001430$.

quest.name: Anniversary Splashing
quest.desc: You can't let MapleStory 2's first anniversary pass by without doing anything! Why don't you celebrate by swimming a lap or two?

quest.name: Anniversary Gaming

quest.desc: You can't let MapleStory 2's first anniversary pass by without doing anything! Why don't you celebrate by doing... nothing?

quest.name: Witch's Gift
quest.desc: A witch gave you your very own $npc:50400341$! It's probably safe to keep as a pet, right? ...Right?!

quest.name: A Terrible Fight
quest.desc: Place a $item:50400341$ in your home! You can find it in the Wampus tab of the furnishings menu. If you've already placed one, remove it and place it again.

quest.name: Finding Moon Bunnies
quest.desc: Runaway moon bunnies are showing up all over Maple World. Join in the $map:80000016$ and see what's going on. You can get $itemPlural:20301895$ in the Special Offers tab in the Meret Market.

quest.name: Bad Moon Bunnies
quest.desc:
The big strange bunnies appearing all over Maple World are runaway moon bunnies! The only way to return these bunnies to their senses is defeating them in combat. Go to $map:02000043$ and defeat the $npc:27000034$.
The $npc:27000034$ appears in $map:02000043$ at 19:30, 20:30, 21:30, and 22:30 UTC.

quest.name: Holiday Magic
quest.desc:
Strange holiday magic has settled over Maple World, resulting in the appearance of $itemPlural:30001465$! Gather $itemPlural:30001465$ and take them to $npc:11001003$.
[How to Obtain $itemPlural:30001465$] • Received from the daily quest "$quest:80020171$." • Chance to receive for fishing and performing in event map $map:63000093$ • Chance to receive for defeating any enemy • Received for winning MC Kay's mini-games (PvP excluded) • Received for clearing Lv. 70 hard adventure dungeons • Received for completing Kritias exploration goals • Received for using the binoculars scattered throughout Kritias (once per pair of binoculars)

quest.name: Dancing in the Snow

quest.name: New Year's Wishes
quest.desc: As a new year dawns on Maple World, people write their hopes on Sunshine Fragments and release them into the sky within balloons. To augment their yearly census and better determine the will of the people, the royal court of Tria is collecting the balloons in the new year. Find the New Year's balloons scattered across Maple World, collect the $itemPlural:30001466$ inside, and take them to $npc:11001003$.
quest.manual: Find the New Year's balloons and retrieve $itemPlural:30001466$

quest.name: A New Path
quest.desc: The large door behind $npcName:11000160$ in $map:02000001$'s leads to the $map:02000188$. You should find someone who has already walked the path of the you pursue to assist you with the job advancement.
quest.manual: Travel to the $map:02000188$ in $map:02000001$, and complete a job advancement.

quest.name: Welcome to $map:02000499$!
quest.desc: You've ventured to $map:02000499$, the biggest amusement park in Maple World. If you're going to succeed in Mushking Royale, you'd better start warming up. Go and take down the $npcName:29000403$!

quest.name: Onward to $map:02000499$
quest.desc: A gift is ready for you at $map:02000499$, the biggest amusement park in Maple World.

quest.name: Blowing Off Some Steam
quest.desc: Throw a bomb in $map:02000499$. It'll help relieve any stress you might have.
quest.manual: Speak with $npcName:11004210$|Throw a bomb from the training area

quest.name: Style Change!
quest.desc: You heard about $map:02000107$ from part-time flyer distributor $npc:11000373$ at $map:02000001$. Let's go to $map:02000107$ and meet $npc:11000462$ to learn more about how to change your style.

quest.name: The Spoiled Young Lady
quest.desc: $npc:11000154$ at $map:02000107$ is unhappy with the hairstyle she just got at the beauty shop and wants to redo it. She asked you to tell her brother $npc:11000331$ to come to $map:52000008$ with money. She seems quite impatient, telling you to take a taxi to $map:02000001$... Shall we call a taxi and go as she says?

quest.name: Keep Precious Things in the Vault
quest.desc: As $npc:11000325$ requested, let's go ask $npc:11000011$ if they're keeping $npcName:11000325$'s ring safe! $npc:11000011$ is at $map:02000034$.

quest.name: Aftermath of a Massive Earthquake
quest.desc: The aftermath of the earthquake seems truly massive. Let's look through the telescope next to $npc:11000112$ to see how deep the ground has split.
quest.complete: Look through the telescope at $map:02000115$ and talk to $npc:11000112$

quest.name: Ingredients for Food
quest.desc: The chicken that was going to be used as an ingredient for the audience ceremony feast reportedly fell off a cliff. Let's climb down and bring back $item:20000063$. Using the $skill:20000011$ skill when climbing up and down the cliff should make it much easier.
quest.manual: Find $item:20000063$ on the elevated ground behind $npc:11000159$

quest.name: Maple Apartment Move-In Event
quest.desc: Goldus Construction and $map:02000123$ have prepared a promotion to celebrate their partnership. Goldus Construction, which pursues only the finest quality, is building a new 'Maple Apartment' and giving out free move-in passes to celebrate its opening! You can't miss a golden opportunity like this! Let's hurry to $map:02000123$ at $map:02000001$ and meet $npc:11000600$!

quest.desc: The trail here has become dangerous because of $npc:99000041$. Let's help $npc:11000409$ defeat $npc:99000041$.

quest.name: Safe Passage
quest.desc: $npc:11000409$ is worried about $npc:11000410$ being alone. Take the portal to $map:63000010$ and find where $npc:11000410$ is.

quest.name: Gotta Stop the Pigs
quest.desc: $npc:11000410$ is working hard to keep the trail safe. Help $npc:11000410$ defeat $npc:99000042$. Using skills should make them much easier to defeat!

quest.desc: As $npc:11000324$ instructed, press the Dynamic Action button next to the chat input field and click any emote you want.

quest.name: Shackles of Debt
quest.desc: $npc:11000609$ was Raymond's errand runner, secretly trading $item:20000046$ with the Black Star Society. Then one day, Raymond vanished without a trace without paying the Black Star Society for the $item:20000046$, leaving all the debt behind. $npcName:11000609$, being chased by the Black Star Society, wants to explain the situation to $npc:11000610$, a Black Star Society member they know well, and ask to delay payment until Raymond is found. But if $npcName:11000609$ goes down to the Dark Lands directly, they'll be dragged away before they can explain. I'll go to the Dark Lands instead and meet $npcName:11000610$ to explain the situation.
quest.complete: Go to $map:03000014$ in the Dark Lands and meet $npc:11000610$

quest.name: Dangerous Labor
quest.desc: $npc:11000610$ flatly refuses, saying the Black Star Society shows no mercy. On top of that, they say they'll chase $npc:11000609$ to the ends of the earth and drag them back. They really are no ordinary villains. I should try to obtain $item:20000102$ on behalf of poor $npc:11000609$.
quest.manual: Pick $item:20000102$ from the Paduran poison plants at $map:03000014$

quest.name: Wandering Spirits
quest.desc: $npc:11000610$ says this isn't enough to forgive the debt and demands something harder. Defeat the monsters lurking in the darkness of $map:03000014$ with gleaming eyes and find $item:30000331$! There seems to be no choice if we want to clear $npc:11000609$'s debt. Let's defeat the monsters at $map:03000014$ and find $item:30000331$!

quest.name: Breaking Free from the Shackles
quest.desc: $npc:11000610$ has finally forgiven $npc:11000609$'s debt! Let's hurry and tell $npcName:11000609$ the good news.

quest.name: Confession of Conscience
quest.desc: $npc:11000511$ at $map:02000203$ says they're looking for someone who lost a large amount of $item:40100023$.

quest.name: The Dreaming Maid
quest.desc: $npc:11000160$ at $map:02000001$ suggested visiting $npc:11000700$, who is providing information about maids as a Dreamnaze recruitment promotion event. It seems like a great opportunity to learn more about maids.

quest.name: The Legacy of the Ancients
quest.manual: Enter the $map:52000016$|Investigate the situation at the $map:52000016$

quest.name: The Faithful Disciple
quest.desc:
$npcName:11001257$ told you that $npcName:11001229$ has departed for a place called $map:2000001$ in Victoria Island, and asked be patient while he prepares to teleport you there.
$map:2000001$... $npcName:11001229$ said that someone important was there... Who could he be talking about? Utilize the power of rune magic to teleport there, and find $npcName:11001229$.
quest.manual: Speak to $npcName:11001257$ at the $map:63000013$'s and teleport to $npcName:11001229$

quest.name: In the Blink of an Eye
The Way of the Underworld
quest.desc:
$npc:11001618$, the godfather of the criminal underworld and boss of Blackstar, will grant you one request... provided you manage to best the champion of $map:63000020$ in combat.
The person who will direct you to $map:63000020$ is waiting just outside the corridor. Leave $map:63000015$ and speak with them.

quest.name: Into the Underground Passage
quest.desc:
You're supposed to meet someone named $npc:11001545$ in the underground passage to get you set up for your fight with the champion of $map:63000020$.
Find $npc:11001545$ in $map:63000017$.

quest.name: Sewer Sanitation Service
quest.desc:
$npc:11001545$ was supposed to take you to $map:63000020$, but he's run into a problem with the $npcPlural:29000098$ that've come up from the sewers.
He wants you to retrieve the $itemPlural:30000553$ that the $npcPlural:29000098$ have gobbled up.

quest.name: Fighter Registration
quest.desc:
$npc:11001545$ says he's too busy to take you where you're supposed to go and tells you to go on alone.
Find $npc:11001545$'s associate $npc:11001546$ in the $map:63000018$.

quest.name: Sting Like a Bee
quest.desc:
Still skeptical you are who you say, $npc:11001546$ tells you to warm up for your fight with the champion of $map:63000020$'s, $npc:11001547$ who is said to be extremely strong.
Humor him and warm up with a punching bag in the $map:63000018$.

quest.name: The Proof is in the Punching
quest.desc: $npc:11001546$ thinks you're taking this $map:63000020$ business way too lightly. Show him you know exactly what your doing by using $skill:11000001$ in front of him.

quest.name: Serious Chops
quest.desc:
Despite his apparent surprise, $npc:11001546$ tells you that your $skill:11000001$ is rookie stuff, and that you'll need a lot more to take down the Champ.
Perhaps you should show him your $skill:11000011$ technique?

quest.name: Meeting with the Boss
quest.desc:
While you're eager get all this over with, $npc:11001546$ says you match in $map:63000020$ won't start until $npc:11001623$ wants it to.
Looks like it's time to visit $npc:11001623$ in the $map:63000019$.

quest.name: A Toast Between Friends
quest.desc:
Before your fight against the champion, $npc:11001623$ proposes a toast. You can't help but be skeptical, but in the end you decide to be a good guest.
See the $npc:11001624$ in $map:63000019$ and get your drink.
quest.manual: Order a drink from the $npc:11001624$ in $map:63000019$
quest.complete: Receive a drink from the $npc:11001624$ in $map:63000019$

quest.name: A Lesson in Trust
quest.desc:
After passing out in the middle of your fight, you learned the hard way that accepting drinks from suspicious characters like the crime boss $npc:11001629$ might not always be such a good idea.
Return to the $map:63000019$ and confront $npc:11001629$.

quest.name: Fair is Fair
quest.desc:
Exactly how things shook out this way is unclear, but you find yourself working for your worst enemy, $npc:11001629$. He's got a job for you, and it involves the Empress and $map:02000001$.
For the specifics of the job, speak with your handlers at the $map:63000023$.
quest.complete: Speak with your handlers at the $map:63000023$

quest.name: Lith Harbor
quest.desc:
It turns out your new handlers are $npc:11001545$ and $npc:11001546$ who you met inside Blackstar's headquarters.
According to $npcName:11001631$, the organization is planning to sell wares at the Empress's upcoming event for a boatload of cash, and it's your job to defend the shipment.
You don't like helping criminals, but right now it's hard to see another option. Get in the car and travel to $map:02000062$.

quest.name: Juice or Something
quest.desc: Well, you drank the beverage you got from the $npc:11001624$. You should check in with $npc:11001623$.
quest.manual: Tell $npc:11001629$ how you liked your drink
quest.complete: Tell $npc:11001629$ how you liked your drink

quest.name: Mystical Jewel
quest.manual: Take the training equipment from the showcase

quest.name: A Strict Disciple's Guidance
quest.manual: Go on top the pillar and train your sense of balance

quest.name: The Practice of Animus, Standard Version
quest.complete: Receive evaluation about your achievement of $skill:11100011$ from Brother $npcName:11001557$

quest.name: Rapid Cohesion and Emission
quest.complete: Receive evaluation about your achievement of $skill:11100041$ from Brother $npcName:11001557$

quest.name: The Climb Down
quest.desc: The Guidance party, in pursuit of their Master's revelation, decided on the track to $map:02000001$ for their future plans after leaving behind a burnt Halo Mountain. Before the dark shadows devour $map:63000030$ as well, hurry and head for $map:02000001$.

quest.name: Shining Crystal
quest.desc: $npcName:11001674$ says you need to become stronger to move beyond $map:02000100$ and be active on a bigger stage. It seems the boss also wasn't satisfied with the Gray Wolf's skills, and gave instructions to teach you how to become stronger.

quest.name: How Can the Strong Become Stronger?
quest.desc: The boss still doesn't seem satisfied with the Gray Wolf's skills. Instructions have come down to teach you how to become even stronger.

quest.name: Shining Crystal
quest.desc: $npc:11001716$ constantly emphasizes that even after coming down from Neoulbit Mountain, you must not neglect your training. $npcName:11001707$ says something terrible might happen if you don't listen to your senior, and offers to teach you how to become stronger.

quest.name: How Can the Strong Become Stronger?
quest.desc: $npc:11001716$ apparently told $npc:11001707$ that you need to become stronger to better search for information, complete tasks, and find more clues to recover your memories. $npc:11001707$ is calling for you, saying they will teach you how to become even stronger.

quest.name: Cast Your Line
quest.desc: $npc:11001861$, a fishing goods salesman on $map:52000058$, kindly gifts you a worn-down fishing pole and suggests that you give fishing a go while taking in the sites and smells of the island.

quest.name: The Lure's Temptation
quest.desc:
$npc:11001861$, who sells fishing supplies at $map:52000058$, generously hands over $item:20000342$ bait and suggests trying to catch a Star Candy Crab.
Star Candy Crabs can only be caught when using $item:20000342$ bait. Additional $item:20000342$ bait can be purchased from $npc:11001861$.
quest.manual: Use $item:20000342$ bait|Catch a Star Candy Crab using $item:20000342$ bait at $map:63000044$

quest.name: The Angler's Path
quest.desc: $npc:11001861$, who sells fishing supplies at $map:52000058$, says the fish are biting well and recommends fishing before the tide passes.

quest.name: The Art of Fishing
quest.desc: $npc:11001861$, who sells fishing supplies at $map:52000058$, generously hands over a $item:32000020$ and suggests experiencing its superior performance that a normal fishing rod can't match.

quest.name: A Fisherman's Curiosity...
quest.desc: $map:52000058$ has become murky from an unknown source of pollution! $npc:11001861$ says they want to get a look at the bizarre fish that have never been seen before, and suggests trying to catch them together.
quest.manual: Catch bizarre fish in the polluted $map:52000058$

quest.name: Mystery of the Sea of Fire
quest.desc: A volcano that erupted in an instant... The true nature of $map:52000058$ was a volcano that had been bubbling up from deep beneath the sea. And... mysterious creatures are leaping out from the boiling lava...
quest.manual: Catch bizarre fish at $map:52000059$ where lava is boiling

quest.name: Music to My Ears
quest.desc:
You stumbled across the $map:52000060$ by following an entrancing melody. Everyone within is hard at work practicing for the upcoming Moonlight Ensemble.
$npcName:11001866$ was kind enough to lend you an instrument and music score to practice with. Pick up the instrument and try playing it.
quest.manual: Use the Music Score and play the Piano in the $map:52000060$

quest.name: Melody at Your Fingertips
quest.desc: $npc:11001866$ at $map:52000060$ suggests trying to play a new instrument.
quest.manual: Practice playing guitar by reading sheet music at $map:52000060$

quest.name: A Fantastic Performance
quest.desc: $npc:11001866$ was standing at $map:52000061$ with a panicked expression, not knowing what to do! It's the day of the ensemble concert, but the pianist—practically the star of the show—hasn't shown up or made contact... It seems we can't just let the performance be delayed any longer. Take a deep breath and step onto the stage.
quest.manual: Perform at the Moonlight Ensemble at $map:52000061$

quest.name: Homespun Fashion
quest.desc: $npcName:11001176$ is the most prestigious designer in Maple World, and she's convinced she has got the perfect fashion for you. But can she really come up with an outfit that fits with your style?
quest.manual: Use a template to design your own outfit

quest.name: A Perfect Fit
quest.desc: $npcName:11001176$ of $map:52000062$ won't acknowledge your talent for design until you model your new outfit for her.

quest.name: Smile!
quest.desc: $npcName:11001176$ of $map:52000062$ begrudgingly admits that you may have an eye for fashion. Speak to her for an introduction to the League of Fashionistas.

quest.name: Handicraft 101
quest.desc: $npc:11001867$ possesses a special talent when it comes to making charming Handicraft accessories! She welcomes you into the workshop, and offers you a free lesson in the art of Handicraft. Using the [Life Skill] menu on the bottom right of the screen, navigate to the [Life Skill > Craft > Handicraft] window and try crafting something.

quest.name: Arts and Handicrafts
quest.desc: You run into $npcName:11001867$ at the $map:63000046$, where she asks you to help her collect important materials to fulfill a special accessory order.

quest.name: Girls, Interrupted
quest.desc:
$npc:11001867$ was just about to head off to entrust her sister $npcName:11001871$ with an enchantment, when suddenly $npcName:11001871$ stormed in requesting an urgent Handicraft project.
$npcName:11001871$ is not satisfied to merely wait around while her sister works, and offers to enchant an item for you in the mean time.
quest.manual: Entrust $npcName:11001871$ with an item to enchant

quest.name: No Such Thing as a Free Enchant
quest.desc: $npc:11001871$, who you met in the $map:52000057$, says she's ready and eager to enchant more items.

quest.name: Forest and Sea
quest.desc: Due to the unique geological structure of $map:63000046$, you can mine $item:33000024$ from the forest and $item:33000025$ from the beach, which are hard to find at $map:02000076$.
quest.manual: Gather $item:33000024$ by mining at $map:63000046$|Gather $item:33000025$ by mining at $map:63000046$

quest.name: The Never-Ending Request
quest.desc: $npc:11001867$ at $map:63000046$ says they accepted too many jewelry orders at once and are woefully short on materials, asking for help.

quest.name: Mining Mastery
quest.desc: $npc:11001867$ says that at this rate, it will be hard to finish crafting by the promised delivery date, and laments that having $item:20000343$ would allow them to work much faster.

quest.name: Swishing Tail Hair
quest.desc: $npc:11001870$, who was working at the barn, says the $item:20000343$ are all sold out, but it should be possible to make one.

quest.name: Transformation of Tail Hair
quest.desc: $npc:11001870$ says to try crafting $item:20000343$ from $item:33000041$ yourself.

quest.name: Lightning-Fast Mining
quest.desc: $npc:11001867$ says another guild member happened to drop off some spare $item:20000343$, and asks you to use the crafted $item:20000343$ to help finish gathering the jewelry materials.

quest.name: High Octane
quest.desc:
You happened upon the $map:52000063$, where $npcName:11001873$ the inventor approached you with a request: test out his newest invention, a super-engine!
Since you've agreed to enter the race, you might as well win while you're at it, right?
quest.manual: Race along the $map:52000063$ track to the specified location.

quest.name: Getting High for Science
quest.desc:
You ran into $npcName:11001873$ the inventor in $map:52000064$. According to him, he's put his super-engine research on hold to research aviation technology, and presents you with a $item:40400001$. Can you really entrust your life to a bunch of balloons?
Surely $npcName:11001873$ wouldn't ask you to test it if it weren't safe. Besides, you're an adventurer! Grab those balloon-strings tight, and don't let go! Soar through the sky to that building across the way.
quest.manual: Follow the rainbow in $map:52000064$ and fly to the building on the other side

quest.name: Furnishing Fundamentals
quest.desc: $npcName:11000185$ has dispatched one of her associates to help bring a little flare to your empty house! Click the House icon on the bottom right of the screen, or press the shortcut key ([T] by default) to travel to your house. While inside your house, press the Furnishing shortcut key ([B] by default) to enter Furnishing Mode, then search for $item:50200094$ in the furniture list.

quest.name: A Lesson in Product Placement
quest.desc: $npc:11001876$ suggests that you purchase furnishings you find aesthetically pleasing, and place them in your humble abode. While inside your house, press the Furnishing mode shortcut key (B by default), then search for [$item:50200108$] from among the furnishings to proceed with the quest.

quest.name: The Importance of Aesthetics
quest.desc: $npc:11001876$ gifts you one $item:50200299$ and suggest that you try placing it inside your house. While inside your house, press the Furnishing mode shortcut key (B by default), then search for and place the $item:50200299$ in your home.

quest.name: Classing Up the Joint
quest.desc: $npc:11001876$ tells you your home looks gloomy, and suggests you liven the place up with the latest trends. While inside your home, press the shortcut key (B by default) to enter Furnishing Mode, then search for and place both the $item:50200300$ and $item:50200080$ in your home.

quest.name: Feathered Friends
quest.desc: $npcName:11001877$, who runs a livestock farm in the vicinity of $map:02000076$ says he will give you a free $item:50400159$ if you are willing to try your hand at raising some friendly fowl. While inside your house, press the Furnishing mode shortcut key (B by default), then search for $item:50400159$ in the Ranching section to proceed with the quest.

quest.name: Growing Up Fast
quest.desc:
$npc:11001877$ says the critters inside the $item:50400159$ seem hungry and tells you to feed them.
Go near the [$item:50400159$] with the green cube and press the action key to give them feed.
quest.manual: Feed the $item:50400159$ installed at your house

quest.name: A Foul Harvest
quest.desc:
$npcName:11001877$ tells you to groom the chickens from your $itemPlural:50400159$ and pluck any loose feathers.
Go near a [$item:50400159$] with a green hexagon and press the action key to harvest its byproducts.
quest.manual: Attempt to harvest $itemPlural:33000026$ from the $item:50400159$ placed in your house

quest.name: Flapping Chickens
quest.desc:
$npc:11001877$ says the feathers from the chickens in the $item:50400159$ are useful materials for making fabric, and that you need practice plucking them without damaging them.
Go near the [$item:50400159$] with the green cube and press the action key to harvest products. Press shortcut [B] to switch to build mode and install additional [$item:50400159$] to harvest products faster.
quest.manual: Harvest $item:33000026$ from the $item:50400159$ installed at your house

quest.name: A New Family Member
quest.desc:
$npc:11001877$ asks if you'd like to try raising other livestock too, and gives you a $item:50400160$.
At your house, press shortcut [B] to switch to build mode, then search for [$item:50400160$] among the livestock furnishing items to proceed with the quest.

quest.name: The World of Ranching
quest.desc:
$npc:11001877$ suggests making $item:20000350$ to make harvesting much easier, and hands you $item:33000001$ as the material.
Open the [Life Skills > Crafting > Smithing] window from the [Life] menu at the bottom right and try crafting.
If you don't have enough materials, go to $map:02000002$ and mine copper veins yourself.

quest.name: New Ranching Technology
quest.desc:
$npc:11001877$ tells you to try out the effects of $item:20000350$. Use $item:20000350$ to harvest $item:33000027$.
Go near the [$item:50400160$] with the green cube and press the action key to harvest products.
quest.manual: Use $item:20000350$|Harvest $item:33000027$ from the $item:50400160$ installed at your house

quest.name: Go for the Guild
quest.desc:
The Guild Registry is an organization that supports the many guilds of Maple World and the adventurers who fill their ranks!
$npc:11003079$ urges you to join a guild to socialize with other adventurers and take advantage of the various benefits guilds have to offer.
On the bottom right side of the screen, open the Community menu (click the icon with the blue smiling face), open the Guild window, and search for guilds. You can apply to existing guilds or create your own!
If you've already applied to a guild, consider waiting for your application to be reviewed. If you're not the patient type, resubmit your application!
quest.manual: Apply to a guild or create your own

quest.name: Grade A Herb
quest.desc: You meet a man named $npcName:11003140$ in the $map:63000052$ who cultivates ancient and endangered species of herbs. He suggests that you harvest some $itemPlural:33000166$ on your own and sample its unique scent.

quest.name: A New Fragrance
quest.desc: $npc:11003140$ at $map:63000052$ says they found dried roots of a plant thought to be extinct and successfully cultivated them, and asks for help gathering $item:33000167$ and $item:33000168$.
quest.manual: Gather $item:33000167$ by foraging at $map:63000052$|Gather $item:33000168$ by foraging at $map:63000052$

quest.name: The Alchemist's Order
quest.desc: A mysterious $npc:11003143$ suddenly appears at $map:63000052$! They place a large order for $item:33000166$ to make medicine for the injured guardians at $map:02000146$, then vanish like the wind. Leave identifying the stranger to $npcName:11003140$, and help the fairies gather $item:33000166$ at $map:63000052$.

quest.name: The Garden Chef
quest.desc: $npc:11003140$ at $map:63000052$ asks you to bring $item:33000169$ to $npcName:11003141$, who is cooking for the fairies on the garden hill, and pass along the request to make $item:20000444$.

quest.name: Passing Down the Secret Recipe
quest.desc: $npcTitle:11003141$, who cooks for the fairies on the hill at $map:63000052$, says they'll teach you the recipe so you can make the $item:20000444$ that $npc:11003140$ requested yourself.

quest.name: Chewy Dried Persimmons
quest.desc:
$npc:11003140$ at $map:63000052$ tells you to eat $item:20000444$ and then try gathering $item:33000166$.
If you're short on the cooking ingredient $item:33000169$, you can get more from the persimmon trees at $map:63000052$. You can craft additional $item:20000444$ through the [Life Skills] menu at the bottom right.

quest.name: A Gift from the Stars
quest.desc: $npcName:11003142$, a mystical boy unexpectedly appears at your house! He says he wants to be your friend, and presents you with a gift.

quest.name: A Caring Touch
quest.desc: One day, a mysterious blond boy named $npcName:11003142$ shows up at your house without warning! He asks you to fertilize the $item:50400191$ he gave you as a gift of friendship.
quest.manual: Fertilize the $item:50400191$ installed at your house

quest.name: A Joyful Harvest
quest.desc: $npcName:11003142$, a mystical boy from beyond the stars unexpectedly appears at your house. He asks to harvest $item:33000118$ from the $item:50400191$ which he gifted you as an overture to friendship.
quest.manual: Attempt to harvest $itemPlural:33000118$ from the $item:50400191$ placed in your house

quest.name: A Time of Abundance
quest.desc: One day, a mysterious blond boy named $npcName:11003142$ shows up at your house without warning! He tells you to harvest $item:33000118$ from the $item:50400191$ he gave you as a gift of friendship.
quest.manual: Harvest $item:33000118$ from the $item:50400191$ installed at your house

quest.name: A Vine Rolls In
quest.desc: The mysterious blond boy $npcName:11003142$ has returned as a friend! This time he gives you a $item:50400192$ as a gift of friendship and tells you to try growing it.

quest.name: The Alchemist's Elixir
quest.desc:
A stranger who followed $npcName:11003142$ to your house. Introducing themselves as $npc:11003143$, they teach you an alchemy recipe for making a potion that helps with cultivation.
The alchemy ingredient $item:33000099$ for $item:20000445$ can be obtained through foraging activities.
quest.manual: Craft $item:20000445$ using $item:33000099$ as an alchemy ingredient

quest.name: Pumpkin Feast
quest.desc:
$npc:11003143$ tells you to eat $item:20000445$ and harvest $item:33000120$ from your house while the nutrient effect lasts.
The alchemy ingredient $item:33000099$ for $item:20000445$ can be obtained through foraging activities.

quest.name: Monster Taming 101
quest.desc: $npc:11003505$ tells you to speak with $npc:11003507$ to learn about monster taming.

quest.name: Monstrous Dietary Restrictions
quest.desc: $npc:11003507$ says you need a special item to tame monsters: $item:63000000$. Luckily, she's already placed an order for some with $npc:11003508$. If you pick up her $item:30000882$ shipment for her, she'll share some with you.

quest.name: Taming on an Empty Stomach
quest.desc:
$npc:11003503$ says that you can tame hungry monsters by feeding them $itemPlural:63000000$, and suggests you give it a whirl.
You can find hungry $itemPlural:61000002$ in $map:63000056$,. as well as other locations. You can check the Pet Album to see where the monster can be found.

quest.name: The Way of the Monster Tamer
quest.desc: $npc:11003503$ tells you that monsters can be pacified for capture using $itemPlural:63100000$. For now, you should try crafting some.

quest.name: Forced Adoption
quest.desc:
$npc:11003503$ tells you to pacify the monster by feeding it $itemPlural:63000000$, and then use the $item:63100000$ to capture it.
In addition to $map:63000056$, you can find $itemPlural:61000002$ at the habitats listed on the monster's Pet Album page.

quest.name: Empowering Your Pet
quest.desc: $npc:11003510$ says that if you have several of the same pet, you can fuse them together to raise their experience. Try it by fusing $item:61000002$!
quest.manual: Raise the $item:61000002$'s experience through pet fusion

quest.desc: To obtain the burning ember sealed in the soul of the Shadowmancer Devorak, you must defeat Devorak.
quest.complete: Talk to Beauty at the Reverse Gate

quest.desc: Defeat Captain Mook, who stole the burning ember, and take it back.
quest.complete: Talk to Beauty at the Reverse Gate

quest.desc: Barkant, visitor from another world. Is the burning ember he holds truly different from the others? Defeat Barkant and find out.
quest.complete: Talk to Beauty at the Reverse Gate

quest.desc: A burning ember rumored to have been made by Balrog. Whether that is true is unknown. What is certain is that you can only obtain the burning ember by defeating Balrog.
quest.complete: Talk to Beauty at the Reverse Gate

quest.name: After the Attack on Tria
quest.desc: $npcName:11000006$ has requested your help with an urgent matter. Speak with him in $map:02000153$ to find out what it is.

quest.name: Project Aegis
quest.desc:
$npcName:11000006$ tells you about 'Sky Fortress,' a secret project undertaken by the Dark Wind under Katvan's direction. The flying aircraft carrier is to become the headquarters of the Maple Alliance, which was formed after the attack on Tria.
Apparently, there's one thing missing before Sky Fortress is operational. Speak with $npcName:11000006$ to learn more!

quest.name: Defender of the Alliance
quest.desc: According to $npcName:11000006$, you are the missing ingredient for the Sky Fortress operation. He's asked you to serve as a liaison between the factions of the Maple Alliance. Once you've given the offer some thought, speak with $npcName:11000006$.

quest.name: A Fortress in the Skies
quest.desc: You agreed to join the Maple Alliance's defensive task force, and followed $npcName:11000006$ and the other leaders to a secret hangar where the Sky Fortress was docked. Speak with $npcName:11000119$ when you arrive.

quest.name: The New Commander
quest.desc: It turns out the Sky Fortress was being stored in a secret base under $map:02000092$. There you met Captain Veliche the new captain of Sky Fortress... You tried to introduce yourself, but it seems she has better things to do. In the mean time, you might as well listen to tactical officer Nairin's briefing.

quest.name: The Tactical Officer's Briefing
quest.desc: $npcName:11003585$ is the tactical officer and representative of the Green Hoods. She attempted to brief everyone on the operation, but it seems $npcName:11000006$ had already covered the basics. Speak with $npcName:11003585$ again.

quest.name: Shadows in the Wind
quest.desc: Due to Guard Captain $npcName:11000119$'s ardent interest, $npcName:11003585$ has excitedly resumed her briefing. As this might take a while, $npcName:11000006$ has suggested that you take this time to meet the other faction representatives. Start with the officer from Dark Wind, behind the cargo container.

quest.name: The Imperial Vanguard
quest.desc: You should speak with Imperial Vanguard officer $npcName:11003583$ next.

quest.name: The Order of the Eclipse
quest.desc: The representative of the Order of the Eclipse is on the central gangway admiring the airship. You should go and introduce yourself.

quest.name: Captain of the Skies
quest.desc: Finish off your introduction tour by speaking with Captain $npcName:11003582$ on the right side of the hangar.

quest.name: This Is Not a Test
quest.desc: Numerous unidentified radar contacts appeared during $npcName:11003536$'s demonstration of the system. Given the secret nature of the base, that can only mean one thing... Speak with $npcName:11003536$.

quest.name: Securing the $map:02000011$
quest.desc: After many twists and turns, Sky Fortress's launch was a success. However, before the alliance trusts with any serious tasks, you'll undergo an assessment. Your first mission is to secure the $map:02000011$. Follow $npcName:11003536$'s instructions and carry out the mission.
quest.descFameUI: Pyrros Fard dwells within the Lava Crest. If he is disturbed, it would place the surrounding areas in danger.

quest.name: The First Assignment
quest.desc: Officer $npcName:11003584$ of Dark Wind has sent you on a field mission. Follow her orders, and get the job done!
quest.complete: Speak with Dark Wind officer Schatten on Sky Fortress

quest.name: Emergency Launch
quest.desc: The Rooks have launched a surprise attack on the hangar. No doubt, their objective is to hijack the Sky Fortress. Keep them at bay until the ship is ready to launch!
quest.complete: Speak with Alliance Captain Veliche aboard Sky Fortress

quest.name: Provisions for the Proven
quest.desc: $npcName:11003583$ told you about the unique items carried by faction-exclusive shops. The higher your reputation with the faction, the more items you'll be able to buy.

quest.name: Setting Sail for the Skies
quest.desc: The Sky Fortress's mission has finally commenced. Follow Captain $npcName:11003582$'s orders and serve as the winged guardian of Maple World!

quest.name: Rampaging Robots
quest.desc: The $npcName:21000135$ is a combat drone created at the $map:02000187$, which has gone rogue and started attacking people. Destroy the $npcNamePlural:21000135$ so they can't hurt anyone else.

quest.name: A New Mission
quest.desc: Captain $npcName:11003533$ of the Sky Fortress has ordered an officer's meeting to discuss an important matter. Speak with $npcName:11003533$ to learn more.

quest.name: The Lost Air Vendors
quest.desc: Flying merchant ships, once the crowning achievement of Maple World, have resumed operation since the Sky Fortress became active. However, it seemse some have begun disappearing. Speak with $npcName:11003533$ to learn more.

quest.name: The Alliance Investigates
quest.desc: Captain $npcName:11003533$ gave an assignment to each representative of the Maple Alliance. Yours is to assist them in their investigations.

quest.name: Whispers from Lith Harbor
quest.desc: Tasked with digging up information about the missing airships, Vanguard Captain $npcName:11003534$ has asked you to talk to the people of $map:02000062$. Go and see what you can learn!
quest.manual: Gather intel from $npcName:11000024$|Gather intel from $npcName:11000025$|Gather intel from $npcName:11000106$

quest.name: Whispers from Tria
quest.desc: $npcName:11003534$'s informant gave him a tip about unsettling rumors circulating in $map:02000001$. Go to there and speak with the citizenry to see what you can learn.
quest.manual: Ask $npcName:11000160$ about the rumors|Ask $npcName:11000003$ about the rumors|Ask $npcName:11000373$ about the rumors

quest.name: Whispers from the Royal Court
quest.desc: Surely the royal court knows more about the rumors circulating $map:02000001$ than the public. $npcName:11003534$ has asked you to speak with them and see what they know.
quest.manual: Ask $npcName:11000119$ about the rumors|Ask $npcName:11000601$ about the rumors|Ask $npcName:11000074$ about the rumors

quest.name: Hacking $map:02000145$
quest.desc: Dark Wind was tasked with tracking down the routes of the missing airships, but Barrota's refusing to hand over their records. According to $npcName:11003535$, the only choice left is to hack in and steal the data. Go to $map:02000145$ and hack into the communication relay's data cache.
quest.manual: Activate the generators at $map:02000145$|Hack the communications array

quest.name: Hacking $map:02000162$
quest.desc: It turns out Barrota's split the data delivery pertaining to their airship routes across multiple communications relays. Go to $map:02000162$, to hack the next one, and defeat any $npcNamePlural:21000134$ interfering with the signal.
quest.manual: Activate the generators at $map:02000162$|Hack the communications array|Defeat $npcNamePlural:21000134$

quest.name: Hacking $map:02000277$
quest.desc: It turns out Barrota's split the data delivery pertaining to their airship routes across multiple communications relays. Hurry to $map:02000277$ and secure the next data cache.
quest.manual: Hack the communications array nodes at $map:02000277$

quest.name: Hacking $map:02000269$
quest.desc: It turns out Barrota's split the data delivery pertaining to their airship routes across multiple communications relays. Go to $map:02000269$ and hack the final data cache.
quest.manual: Hack the Comms Control Terminal in $map:02000269$| Defeat $npcNamePlural:21000121$ or $npcNamePlural:21000122$

quest.name: A Mysterious President
quest.desc: The Green Hoods were tasked with identifying the cargo of Barrota's merchant airships. $npcName:11003536$ says an asset within the company is willing to provide you with the secret ledger. Go to $map:02000139$ and meet the informant.

quest.name: Unsealing the Secret Ledger
quest.desc: You secured Barrota's secret ledger, but some kind of protective charm is keeping you from opening it. $npcName:11003536$ asks if you know any high ranking wizards that might be able to help. Sounds like a good time to take a trip to $map:02000023$ and speak with $npcName:11000033$.

quest.name: Ellinel's Class President
quest.desc: $npcName:11000033$ is no expert in protective magics, fortunately he's pointed you in the direction of someone who is. Speak with your old acquaintance in $map:02000023$.

quest.name: The Waters of Recollection
quest.desc: $npcName:11003146$ agreed to help you unseal the ledger, but she'll need a few things first. Start by collecting $itemPlural:30001033$ from $map:02000090$.

quest.name: Unvanishing Ink
quest.desc: $npcName:11003146$ says the second thing she'll need to unseal the ledger is $item:30001034$ from $map:02000019$. Time to visit the library!

quest.name: One More Thing
quest.desc: $npcName:11003146$ says there's one last thing she needs before she can help you: $itemPlural:30000232$. Gather some and bring them back to her.

quest.name: The Ledger's Secrets
quest.desc: $npcName:11003146$ has finally managed to remove the protective charm keeping the ledger locked tight. Hurry and bring it back to the Sky Fortress.

quest.name: Securing the Crash Site
quest.desc: The Lumiknights have been tasked with investigating the $map:52010053$, and $npcName:11003537$ wants you to accompany him. Travel to the crash site and search for anomalies.
quest.manual: Defeat monsters at the crash site

quest.name: Traces of Darkness
quest.desc: $npcName:11003537$ says the crash site has been tainted with darkness. He's asked you to bring him debris that might be affected by the darkness so he can analyze it.

quest.name: Investigating the Darkness
quest.desc: $npcName:11003537$ said the airship debris contained traces of a terrible darkness. What was the source of this evil energy? Listen to $npcName:11003537$'s explanation.

quest.name: Officers' Briefing
quest.desc: Captain $npcName:11003533$ has convened an officers' meeting of commanders to review the results of everyones' investigations. Meet her in the $map:52010052$.

quest.name: The Secret of the Black Box
quest.desc: Sky Fortress's team of analysts have finished repairing the black box of the crashed trading airship. Speak with $npcName:11003533$ to learn what the device recorded.

quest.name: The Big Reveal
quest.desc: After seeing the winged creatures recorded by the black box, the information everyone has gathered is beginning to make a lot more sense.

quest.name: Tracking the Enemy
quest.desc: Using all the clues everyone has gathered, $npcName:11003533$the is programming the scanners to determine where the enemy will go next. Speak to $npcName:11003533$ and $npcName:11003536$ to learn more.

quest.name: Perion in Peril
quest.desc: Hundreds of radar contacts have been detected near the $map:02000049$ in $map:02000051$. It must be the Crimson Balrogs! Hurry and defend Perion.

quest.name: An Unexpected Ally
quest.desc: Someone named $npcName:11003790$ arrived in Perion just as the invasion was thwarted. He seems to be an acquaintance of $npcName:11003534$. Perhaps he knows something about what's going on? Speak with him back on the Sky Fortress.

quest.name: Know Thine Enemy
quest.desc: $npcName:11003789$ provided some much-needed context regarding the Crimson Balrogs' raid on the $map:02000049$. There's still a great deal more to discuss.

quest.name: The Darkness Gathers
quest.desc: A top priority mission has been delivered to Sky Fortress, and Captain Veliche has called an officers' meeting. Elsewhere, dark forces conspire against the alliance.

quest.name: Looming Catastrophe
quest.desc: A dark deal is being brokered between Balrog and the Black Mage. This can only mean bad news for Maple World.

quest.name: A Dark Alliance
quest.desc: Balrog and the Black Mage have reached an accord. Only time will tell what terrible consequences this dark alliance will reap.

quest.name: Defending Perion
quest.desc: The Crimson Balrogs have launched devastating assault on the $map:52020036$. Fight along side $npcName:11003778$ and $npcName:11003779$ to protect the people of Perion by defeating $npcNamePlural:29000366$, $npcNamePlural:29000367$, and $npcNamePlural:29000368$.

quest.name: Aiding the Injured
quest.desc: Many were injured in the Crimson Balrogs' attack. Take them to $npcName:11003780$ for treatment.

quest.name: Air Support
quest.desc: A horde of Crimson Balrog troops are approaching. Use the crossbow delivered by Nairin to defeat them.

quest.name: An Urgent Summons
quest.desc: Captain $npc:11003533$ has issued an urgent summons. Speak with her in the $map:52010052$.

quest.name: An Immortal Threat
quest.desc: $npc:11000144$, the man you met at the $map:52010052$ and sworn enemy of Balrog, says he has felt an unusual aura that could only mean the return of the immortal demon lord, $npc:11003795$. What does this mean for Maple World?

quest.name: The Immortal Awakens
quest.desc: The crew of the Sky Fortress was shocked to learn of $npc:11003795$'s return. But $npc:11000144$ says things are not as bad as they seem... What is going on?

quest.name: Into the Balrog's Den
quest.desc: $npc:11000144$ went to $map:52010056$ to protect $npc:11003818$ from the Crimson Balrogs, and prevent $npc:11003795$'s revival.
quest.complete: Listen to $npcName:11000144$'s tale of what happened in $map:52010056$

quest.name: Whatever Works
quest.desc: In an effort to prevent Infernog's revival, $npc:11000144$ set out to secure $npc:11003818$. Cornered and with no other choice, he consumed it. The consequences of this decision remain to be seen.
quest.manual: Listen to $npcName:11000144$'s tale of what happened in $map:52010056$

quest.name: The Opportunity of the Millennia
quest.desc: So long as half of $npc:11003795$'s blood remains in $npc:11000144$'s possession, the demon lord is only at half strength. In theory, this changes everything...

quest.name: A Clear and Present Danger
quest.desc: $npc:11000144$ says that in his vulnerable state, $npc:11003795$ can be slain. $npc:11000144$ is ecstatic at the opportunity to bring his family's ancient duty to completion, and urges Captain Veliche to order an attack on the demon lord immediately.

quest.name: Caution and Impulse
quest.desc: Unlike $npc:11000144$, $npc:11003533$ is cautious and calculating. Seeing the threat to her crew in rushing blindly into battle, she advocates a more measured approach.

quest.name: A Change in Behavior
quest.desc: Frustrated with the Alliance's plan to deal with Infernog, $npc:11000144$ stormed off on his own. Is there something more at work behind his growing impatience?

quest.name: The Green Hoods' Ingenuity
quest.desc: With Tristan's whereabouts unknown, the best course of action is to track the $npcPlural:11003781$. Start by investigating the $map:52010060$.

quest.name: Hot Logic
quest.desc: A message carved in a cave wall hints at the site of $npc:11003795$'s return. But more work will be needed to narrow down the precise location.

quest.name: The Hottest Gossip
quest.desc:
$npc:11003534$ suggests you speak with two guards near $map:02000001$ who might have heard something about the place you're looking for.
Go there and speak with $npc:11000157$ and $npcName:11000158$.
quest.manual: Speak with $npc:11000157$ in $map:02000118$|Speak with $npc:11000158$ in $map:02000118$|Speak with $npc:11000005$ in $map:02000031$

quest.name: Extreme Survival Training
quest.desc:
Given the latest information, $npc:11003534$ is eager to travel to Orbis in the hopes of confronting Infernog. However, $npc:11003535$ believes you need to undergo special training in order to beat the heat of the fiery ruins of Orbis.
Go to $map:02000268$ and defeat monsters without succumbing to the heat.
quest.manual: Defeat monsters while enduring the heat of $map:02000268$

quest.name: Every Little Bit Helps
quest.desc: Judging from his persistent staring, $npc:11003537$ has something to discuss with you before you depart for Orbis. Head over and speak with him.

quest.name: Finding Tristan
quest.desc:
After traveling to Orbis in a souped-up escape pod, you found $npc:11000144$ in peril. It seems $npc:11003795$ is trying to absorb the blood that was stolen from him. You can't let that happen.
Defeat all of $npc:11003795$'s minions in $map:52010063$ and rescue $npc:11000144$ from harm. (If you leave by mistake, speak with $npc:11003533$ in $map:02000422$ to return.)

quest.name: Boiling Blood
quest.desc:
$npc:11000144$ apologizes for his behavior under the influence of $npc:11003818$. Now, he seems completely defeated. Are things really as gloomy as they appear?
(If you leave by mistake, talk to $npc:11003533$ in $map:52010052$ to return.)

quest.name: A Place Beyond Hope
quest.desc:
$npc:11000144$ reveals that $npc:11003795$ has recovered the rest of his blood, and therefore his power and immortality. He blames himself for all of this, and fears for the future in the face of this undying foe.
(If you leave the area by mistake, talk to $npc:11003533$ in $map:52010052$ to return.)

quest.name: The Big Gun
quest.desc:
After your safe return from Orbis with $npc:11000144$, plans are hatch to address the threat of the immortal demon lord.
Perhaps he is not so unstoppable as everyone once feared. Speak with the officers of the Sky Fortress.

quest.name: Completing the Weapon
quest.desc:
An urgent frenzy has begun to complete the Alliance's last best hope of dealing with Infernog: the Ultra-High-Density Magitron Accelerator Cannon. Surely if everyone gives their all, it will be completed in time.
While $npc:11003536$ researches how to process $itemPlural:30001056$, travel to $map:02000104$ and collect several loads.

quest.name: Technical Difficulties
quest.desc: $npc:11003535$ is having a hard time following Nairin's instructions to process the magical ore. If this cannon is ever to be ready on time, it seems like the job falls to you. Process the ore in $npc:11003535$'s place.

quest.name: Put Your Back Into It
quest.desc: $npc:11003534$'s only task in assembling the Big Gun is transporting cargo from one place to the next. The problem is, he seems to have injured himself. Nevertheless, those crates aren't going to move themselves. Move the cargo to the loading platform.
quest.manual: Move the cargo to the loading platform in $map:52010036$

quest.name: Uncorking the Darkness
quest.desc:
According to $npc:11003537$, the Big Gun is powered by stones full of dark magic, which can only be unsealed by a high-ranking member of the Lumiknights such as himself.
If his word is to be believed, you may have to take drastic measures to avert a horrible accident.

quest.name: Some Assembly Required
quest.desc: The weapon is finally complete, but a new crisis has arisen. Sky Fortress is under assault by the $npcPlural:11003781$. Defend the carrier at all costs!

quest.name: 15 Minutes to Midnight
quest.desc:
Just as a new plan was being hatched to dispatch the immortal demon lord Infernog, $npc:11000144$ set off alone again in a small vessel. Here we go again...
Speak with $npc:11003533$.
quest.manual: Review the footage of $npc:11000144$ setting out on the $map:52010064$

quest.name: Battle for the Skies
quest.desc:
$dungeonTitle:24090004$ This is a solo dungeon. It can only be entered by pressing the [Enter Alone] button while you have the related quest.
Your mission is to engage the immortal demon lord $npc:11003795$ and keep him distracted long enough for Sky Fortress's secret weapon to charge up and blast him into space.

quest.name: Battle for the Skies
quest.desc:
$dungeonTitle:24090004$ This is a solo dungeon. It can only be entered by pressing the [Enter Alone] button while you have the related quest.
Your mission is to engage the immortal demon lord $npc:11003795$ and keep him distracted long enough for Sky Fortress's secret weapon to charge up and blast him into space.

$dungeonTitle:24090004$ A solo dungeon accessible only while the quest is active. Entry is only possible via the [Enter Dungeon Alone] button.
You've been deployed on a mission to draw attention and push back $npc:11003795$ while the ultra-high-density particle accelerator is stabilized. Hold the defensive line with a sense of weighty responsibility.
quest.name: Securing the Skies, but...
The Shape of Things to Come
quest.desc: $npc:11000144$ expressed his deep gratitude for everyone's aid in banishing $npc:11003795$, but warns that there may be other threats on the horizon...

quest.name: The Looming Darkness
quest.desc: While the demon $npc:11003792$ licks his wounds in the $map:52010065$, he is visited by the great and powerful $npc:11001811$, who comes to collect his due. What grim tidings does this meeting foretell?

quest.name: They Are Legion
quest.desc: Now that the Alliance has a foothold in Kritias, there is much work to be done. $npcName:11004312$ has tasked you with finding the Daemon Army, gauging their forces, and combating them in any way possible. Humanitas has reported possible Daemon Army activity in $map:02020029$. Go there and investigate.
quest.descFameUI: Veliche has a special mission with your name written on it.

quest.name: They Are Legion
quest.desc: You arrived in $map:02020029$ but have yet to pick up the Daemon Army's trail. Perhaps if you make a lot of noise, the Daemon Army will find you?
quest.descFameUI: Make a scene in the hopes of drawing the Daemon Army's attention.

quest.name: They Are Legion
quest.desc: You caused a scene in hopes of drawing the Daemon Army's attention, but to no avail. Luckily, $npcName:11004312$ notified you that enemy movement had been detected near $map:02020030$. Go there and investigate.
quest.descFameUI: Troop movements have been detected near $map:02020030$. It could be the Daemon Army! Go and find out.

quest.name: They Are Legion
quest.desc: You arrived in $map:02020030$ and verified the presence of Daemon Army soldiers. If you drive them out, perhaps they'll lead you to their stronghold? Defeat $npcNamePlural:25020104$ and $npcNamePlural:25020105$ in the area.
quest.descFameUI: Daemon Army soldiers attacking $map:02020030$? Not on your watch!

quest.name: They Are Legion
quest.desc:
The Daemon Army is amassing a large number of troops for an attack at two different strategic locations. Deliver a preemptive strike at either location in the hopes of reducing their numbers in one fell swoop.
<font color="#00aaef">★ Completing this quest requires that you win one Legion Battle. While exploring the Kritias continent, invitations to participate in Legion Battles will appear as periodic pop-up notifications warning that a region is under siege. When minimized, this notification displays as a red radar screen.
(In order to participate in a legion battle, you must unlock Tier 1 of the $achieve:22200490$ trophy.)</font>
quest.descFameUI: The Daemon Army is amassing for an attack. Defeat them in a Legion Battle to deal a serious blow against their forces.

quest.name: They Are Legion
quest.desc: Your preemptive attack against the amassed troops of the Daemon Army has dealt a solid blow against their ranks. Report back to $npcName:11004312$ in $map:02020041$ to discuss the battle.
quest.descFameUI: Your preemptive attack against the troops of the Daemon Army has dealt a solid blow to their ranks. Report back to $npcName:11004312$.

quest.name: The Supply Run
quest.desc: $npcName:11004312$ says Humanitas has requested help with a mission. What could it be? Go to $map:02020030$ and speak with $npcName:11004401$.
quest.descFameUI: Humanitas has requested the aid of the Maple Alliance. Speak with their leader and see what she needs.

quest.name: The Supply Run
quest.desc:
According to $npcName:11004395$, Humanitas has made efforts to seize the nearby Tairen base of $map:02020004$ for the resources stockpiled there. However, they had no choice but to retreat when Tairen reinforcements arrived. $npcName:11004395$ wants you to secure the base on their behalf, and has offered to share any liberated supplies.
Aid your allies by traveling to $map:02020004$ and carrying out your mission.
quest.descFameUI: Help Humanitas take a nearby Tairen base to liberate the much-needed supplies inside.

quest.name: The Supply Run
quest.desc:
You arrived in $map:02020004$ and were greeted by a horde of mechanical Tairen soldiers. They must be dismantled before Humanitas can claim their much needed supplies.
Defeat $npcNamePlural:25020401$ and $npcNamePlural:25020402$.
quest.descFameUI: Capture the Tairen warehouse in $map:02020004$ by defeating the mechanized soldiers guarding the area.

quest.name: The Supply Run
quest.desc: While you were speaking with $npcName:11004395$ in $map:02020004$, the Tairen were regrouping to counter your assault. Defeat them and secure your victory.
quest.descFameUI: You defeated a group of Tairen mechanized soldiers in your efforts to capture the enemy's supplies, but they are regrouping. Deal with the enemy reinforcements.

quest.name: The Supply Run
quest.desc: In your efforts to capture the Tairen supply warehouse, you seem to have poked the bear. Now the commander on site is out for your blood. Defeat the $npcName:25020405$ and show the enemy that the Alliance doesn't retreat.
quest.descFameUI: An enemy commander has arrived. Crush them, and secure the area for Humanitas.

quest.name: The Supply Run
quest.desc:
You defeated the mechanized Tairen soldiers and the commander stationed in $map:02020041$ and secured some much-needed supplies for Humanitas.
Return to $map:02020041$ and report in.
quest.descFameUI: You defeated the mechanized Tairen soldiers and the commander stationed in $map:02020041$. Now it's time to report in.

quest.name: Bal-Busting
quest.desc:
$npcName:11004314$ told you about a worrisome rumor she confirmed to be true. However, rather than just tell you what the rumor was, she wants you to see for yourself.
Play along and go to $map:02020013$.
quest.descFameUI: A troublesome rumor is circulating among Sky Fortress's crew. This warrants an investigation.

quest.name: Bal-Busting
quest.desc: According to $npcName:11004314$, the rumors that $npcName:23090006$ has come to Kritias are true. It's up to you to find out why. Search $map:02020013$ and for traces Balrog or his lackeys.
quest.descFameUI: What is $npcName:23090006$ doing in Kritias? It's up to you to find out.

quest.name: Bal-Busting
quest.desc:
It seems $npcName:23090006$ has come to Kritias, and he brought the $npcNamePlural:25020906$ with him. $npcName:11004315$ ran a sensor sweep and tracked him to $map:02020017$. $npcName:11004312$ orders you to track down $npcName:23090006$ and deal with him while she warns Humanitas.
Go to $map:02020017$ in search of $npcName:23090006$.
quest.descFameUI: $npcName:23090006$ is in Kritias. The Alliance has pinpointed his location, and now it's up to you to track him down.

quest.name: Bal-Busting
quest.desc: $npcName:23090006$ came to Kritias seeking new power in the form of aetherine and lapenshards. If this were allowed to happen, $npcName:23090006$ would become a great threat to the Alliance and Kritias alike. Travel to $dungeonTitle:23038002$ and defeat $npcName:23090006$!
quest.descFameUI: The time has come to confront an old foe. Will you finally be able to end this battle once and for all?

quest.name: Bal-Busting
quest.desc:
If $npcName:23090006$ obtains the power he seeks, he could become a greater threat than Tairen or the Daemon Army combined. He must be stopped.
Travel to $map:02020097$, enter the $dungeonTitle:23038002$, and defeat $npcName:23090006$!
quest.descFameUI: Play time is over! It's time to truly crush $npcName:23090006$!

quest.name: Bal-Busting
quest.desc: You tried to contact the Captain to tell her that $npcName:23090006$ had been defeated, but there's something wrong with your radio. Go to $map:02020041$ and deliver the news in person.
quest.descFameUI: $npcName:23090006$ has finally been defeated. Return to base and deliver the good news..

quest.name: Nothing Is Forever
quest.desc:
$npcName:11004555$ was summoned to $map:02020041$ to investigate the possibility that $npcName:23000150$ had come to Kritias. He suspected this was true, though he found himself unable to pick out $npcName:23000150$'s aura from the energies of this alien land.
Speak with your allies and formulate a plan to locate $npcName:23000150$.
quest.descFameUI: Has $npcName:23000150$ the immortal demon lord come to Kritias? You should probably find out.

quest.name: Nothing Is Forever
quest.desc: $npcName:11004555$ rambled on about a book passed down by his family which seemed to evidence the sage $npcName:11004431$'s arrival in Maple World. Perhaps eventually he'll loop around to the matter you were originally discussing—$npcName:23000150$'s presence in Kritias.
quest.descFameUI: What began as an effort to track down Infernog has ended in $npcName:11004555$'s predictable rambling.

quest.name: Nothing Is Forever
quest.desc:
$npcName:11004555$ is fairly sure $npcName:23000150$ has come to Kritias, but needs catch the demon lord's trail. In the mean time, $npcName:11004315$ has developed a detector that just might be able to track him down.
Follow the detector's signal to $map:02020003$.
quest.descFameUI: Take your handy new detector device and pick up $npcName:23000150$'s trail.

quest.name: Nothing Is Forever
quest.desc: $npcName:11004315$ says the aetherine signatures of the nearby $npcNamePlural:25021504$, $npcNamePlural:25021505$, and $npcNamePlural:25021502$ are confusing her detector. Purge $map:02020003$ of these foes so she can recalibrate her device.
quest.descFameUI: The aetherine signatures of nearby foes are interfering with your search for Infernog. Eliminate the source of the problem.

quest.name: Nothing Is Forever
quest.desc:
After locating $npcName:23000150$, you were contacted by $npcName:11004555$ who said he had discovered a way to end the demon lord for good using the power of aetherine. If his hypothesis proves true, you can bring this immortal villains story to its ultimate conclusion.
(Defeat $npcName:23000150$ in the chaos raid $dungeonTitle:23043003$ or $dungeonTitle:23042003$.)
quest.manual: Defeat $npcName:23000150$ in the chaos raid $dungeonTitle:23043003$ or $dungeonTitle:23042003$.
quest.descFameUI: Harness the power of a new land to put an end to an immortal threat.

quest.name: Nothing Is Forever
quest.desc: At long last, $npcName:23000150$ is defeated! Return to $map:02020041$ and tell $npcName:11004312$ everything.
quest.descFameUI: Your battle against $npcName:23000150$ is finally over. It's time to spread the word.

quest.name: The Counter-Offensive
quest.desc:
The threat posed by $npcName:23090006$ and $npcName:23000150$ is finally ended, but other threats to the exploration of Kritias remain—such as the presence of hostile Tairen and Kharon forces.
To begin to address the matter, $npcName:11004312$ has asked you to lead a joint mission on behalf of Humanitas and the Maple Alliance. Go to $map:02020009$ and carry out your orders.
quest.descFameUI: Obstacles remain which inhibit the further exploration of Kritias. It's up to you to deal with them.

quest.name: The Counter-Offensive
quest.desc:
