quest.desc: The Sky Fortress crew and officers take routine tests to ensure they're still fit for service. Do what $npcName:11003536$ asks and prove you have what it takes.
quest.descFameUI: Everyone aboard the Sky Fortress must undergo routine testing to ensure they're still fit for service, including all members of the Green Hoods.

quest.name: Gigantica's Rampage
quest.desc:
The earthquakes caused by $npcName:23001006$ are even damaging Sky Fortress. We cannot leave this unchecked.
Go to $map:02020051$ and defeat $npcName:23001006$.
quest.descFameUI: $npcName:23001006$ is causing earthquakes at the waste landfill, and injured members are reportedly increasing. Let's subdue it before the damage gets worse.

quest.name: Perkau Plains Expedition
quest.desc: The magic and technology of Kritias is most prominent in $map:02020003$. This region offers untold possibilities for exploration, but the local monsters will complicate those efforts. Thin the monsters out to help the expedition proceed.
quest.descFameUI: Take out the monsters interfering with the expedition $map:02020003$.

quest.name: Why Would You Eat That?!
quest.desc: A new medicine is being developed to treat those affected by $npcName:23001006$'s poison. We need samples of the poison to work with, but the $npcNamePlural:25021102$ eat it for... some reason. If we're going to get these samples, the $npcNamePlural:25021102$ have to go.
quest.descFameUI: There's a plan to gather samples of $npcName:23001006$'s poison and create an antidote, but $npcNamePlural:25021102$ are gobbling it up. Find and stop them in $map:02020051$ so the research can progress.

quest.name: Collecting Gigantica's Combat Data
quest.desc:
Green Hood is researching what purpose and activities $npcName:23001006$ has in Kritias. Combat data is needed for this.
To collect combat data, let's battle $npcName:23001006$ at $map:02020051$.
quest.descFameUI: We need to collect $npcName:23001006$'s combat data to determine its purpose and activity patterns here.

quest.name: Preservation Efforts
quest.desc: The $npcNamePlural:25021202$ break everything they touch, placing the priceless documents stored within the $map:02020017$ in grave danger. Defeat the $npcNamePlural:25021202$ before they destroy an irreplaceable body of knowledge about Kritias's history.
quest.descFameUI: Records of ancient Kritias are stored in the $map:02020017$. They are priceless sources of knowledge, so please protect them by stopping the $npcNamePlural:25021202$.

quest.name: Precious Bodily Fluids
quest.desc: We've discovered that $npcName:25021403$'s $item:30001252$ is an enzyme that can neutralize $npcName:23001006$'s poison. More enzyme samples are necessary to complete development of a cure. Defeat $npcNamePlural:25021403$ and collect $itemPlural:30001252$.
quest.descFameUI: $npcName:25021403$ bodily fluids contain an enzyme that can neutralize $npcName:23001006$'s poison. Do what you have to do to get $item:30001252$.

quest.name: Perkau Melody
quest.desc: The odd device in $map:02020003$ plays a unique melody. Matching the melody from the device is said to open a special treasure chest. Discover the melody, and find the treasure.
quest.manual: Play the melody and open the golden chest
quest.descFameUI: The expedition members discovered the source of the unfamiliar melody in $map:02020003$. Go there and learn the melody.

quest.name: Stripped for Parts
quest.desc: $npcNamePlural:25021503$ in $map:02020003$ have been stripping our equipment for parts. Seems Maple World tech has some value out here. Teach those $npcNamePlural:25021503$ that they need to keep their hands to themselves.
quest.descFameUI: $npcNamePlural:25021503$ in $map:02020003$ are stealing Sky Fortress parts. Rough them up so they think twice before stealing again.

quest.name: The Last Stand of Mannstad
quest.desc: $npcName:25021303$ is destroying the stronghold in $map:02020033$. If we want to maintain our hold on the area, you'll need to defeat the $npcNamePlural:25021303$.
quest.descFameUI: The second Humanitas base, $map:02020033$, is under attack by $npcNamePlural:25021303$. Push them back and defend the fortress.

quest.name: Log Recovery
quest.desc: Important research is at risk because $npcNamePlural:25021203$ have stolen the $itemPlural:30001253$. Such a huge setback cannot be allowed. Find them, and bring back the $itemPlural:30001253$.
quest.descFameUI: $npcNamePlural:25021203$ have stolen our $itemPlural:30001253$. Find them, catch them, and bring back those logs.

quest.name: Assault on Mannstad Fortress
quest.desc: The $npcNamePlural:25021307$ have invaded $map:02020033$. Drive them out and restore control of $map:02020033$.
quest.descFameUI: The $npcNamePlural:25021307$ of Tairen are attacking the Humanitas base, $map:02020033$.

quest.name: Probe-tection
quest.desc: The $npcNamePlural:25021103$ in $map:02020051$ are using surface-to-air missiles to attack the probe. Take them down before they take the probe down.
quest.descFameUI: $npcNamePlural:25021103$ have been trying to shoot down our probe in $map:02020051$. Better put a stop to that.

quest.name: Routine Testing: The Green Hoods
quest.desc: The Sky Fortress crew and officers take routine tests to ensure they're still fit for service. Do what $npcName:11003536$ asks and prove you have what it takes.
quest.descFameUI: Everyone aboard the Sky Fortress must undergo routine testing to ensure they're still fit for service, including all members of the Green Hoods.

quest.name: Identifying Gigantica's Attack Patterns
quest.desc:
New attack patterns of $npcName:23001006$ have been discovered. $npcName:23001006$ seems to evolve its own attack patterns. It appears far more complex technology has been applied to $npcName:23001006$ than we initially thought.
To collect more data, let's defeat $npcName:23001006$ at $map:02020051$.
quest.descFameUI: We must identify $npcName:23001006$'s new attack patterns to predict its next attack. Combat data must be collected through battle with $npcName:23001006$.

quest.name: Routine Testing: The Green Hoods
quest.desc: The Sky Fortress crew and officers take routine tests to ensure they're still fit for service. Do what $npcName:11003536$ asks and prove you have what it takes.
quest.descFameUI: Everyone aboard the Sky Fortress must undergo routine testing to ensure they're still fit for service, including all members of the Green Hoods.

quest.name: Security Clearance
quest.desc: $map:02020035$ has been occupied by the Daemon Army, and they intend on using it to produce more mechanical warriors for their army. Assault the factory and clear out the robots!
quest.manual: Clear out the security force in $map:02020035$
quest.descFameUI: $map:02020035$ has been occupied by the Daemon Army, and they're producing more mechanical warriors. Weaken the security forces to prepare for an assault on the factory.

quest.name: Hunters of Leshy Forest
quest.desc: $map:02020008$ is filled with plants that take in aetherine. It's an important region for research, but the monsters there are very aggressive towards intruders. Aid the researchers by thinning out the predator population.
quest.manual: Clear out the hostile monsters in $map:02020008$
quest.descFameUI: Clear out the hostile monsters in $map:02020008$ to protect the Green Hoods aetherine operations.

quest.name: Tairen's Military Secrets
quest.desc: The Shadow Walkers found $npcName:25021804$ delivering $item:30001254$, which could expose the Alliance's weaknesses. Defeat $npcName:25021804$ and return with the $item:30001254$.
quest.descFameUI: The Tairen Kingdom is delivering a secret military document via $npcName:25021804$. Take them down and recover the $item:30001254$.

quest.name: Analyzing Gigantica's AI Patterns
quest.desc:
We are trying to analyze and hack $npcName:23001006$'s AI patterns to find vulnerabilities. This requires engaging in battle with $npcName:23001006$.
Go to $map:02020051$ and battle $npcName:23001006$.
quest.descFameUI: The research team is analyzing and hacking $npcName:23001006$'s AI patterns to find vulnerabilities. Combat data from $npcName:23001006$ must be collected for the research to progress.

quest.name: Courting Danger
quest.desc: Your allies have advanced to $map:02020037$, the gateway to the heart of Kritias. Because of the strategic value of this area, the enemy has stationed their elite forces there. Defeat $npcNamePlural:25022103$ to clear the way for the allied forces to establish a foothold in the region.
quest.descFameUI: The Alliance has reached $map:02020037$, the gateway to Tairen's territory. Deal with the $npcNamePlural:25022103$ who defend it to secure entry.

quest.name: Analyzing Gigantica's Exoskeleton
quest.desc:
If we can analyze the metal that forms $npcName:23001006$'s exoskeleton, we may be able to cause fractures using Sky Fortress's sonic vibration cannon.
Let's collect data to determine the molecular properties of the exoskeleton. Real combat is the best way to collect data.
Go to $map:02020051$ and battle $npcName:23001006$.
quest.descFameUI: If we can find a sound wave that can vibrate $npcName:23001006$'s exoskeleton molecular structure, we may be able to cause fractures. To do so, let's first collect information about the exoskeleton through combat.

quest.name: Chips Ahoy
quest.desc: The allied forces need data to analyze the tactical programming of the robots manufactured in the $map:02020035$. A thorough dumping of the $npcName:25021903$ memory chips could yield the key to turning these foes into allies. It's up to you to send the $npcNamePlural:25021903$ to the junk heap and collect their $itemPlural:30001255$.
quest.descFameUI: A thorough analysis of the memory chips from the robots in the $map:02020035$, may reveal vulnerabilities that could be used to turn them into allies. You need to take out $npcNamePlural:25021903$ and collect their memory chips.

quest.name: A is for Antidote
quest.desc: The soldiers of the alliance have run into an unforeseen setback, becoming poisoned by the powder scattered about by the wings of the $npcNamePlural:25021803$ in $map:02020008$. Exterminate $npcNamePlural:25021803$ to help the exploration of the region continue without further incident.
quest.descFameUI: The explorers have been taken ill, suffering the effects of the poison powder spread by the flapping of the $npcNamePlural:25021803$' wings. Take them out to make the area safe for traversal again.

quest.name: Death by Daemon
quest.desc: The Daemon Army forces in Kritias are growing by the day, the few have been as violent and destructive as the $npcNamePlural:25022005$. Defeat $npcNamePlural:25022005$ in $map:02020036$ to prevent them from causing any further damage.
quest.descFameUI: The team sent to investigate the dark energy at $map:02020036$ have suffered great losses at the hands of the $npcNamePlural:25022005$. Take them out so the investigation can resume.

quest.name: From Sample to Complex
quest.desc: The $npcNamePlural:25021604$ broke in and stole the $item:30001256$ for $npcName:23001006$'s poison that was discovered at the $map:02020009$. Find $npcNamePlural:25021604$ at the $map:02020009$, defeat them, and take back the $item:30001256$.
quest.descFameUI: The $npcName:25021604$ launched a surprise raid on the research team and seized the antidote sample made to counteract $npcName:23001006$ contaminant. Defeat them and retrieve the sample.

quest.name: The Aetherine Factor
quest.desc: An expedition was sent to $map:02020018$ to carry out aetherine research, but attacks from $npcNamePlural:25021703$ have threatened the viability of the entire expedition. Defeat $npcNamePlural:25021703$ in $map:02020018$ and make the area safe for research.
quest.descFameUI: The expedition members researching aetherine crystals in $map:02020018$ were taken off-guard by sudden attacks by $npcNamePlural:25021703$. Deal with these foes to make the area safe for research.

quest.name: Every Dog Has its Day
quest.desc: Scouting is necessary in preparation for the attack on $map:02020036$, but frequent attacks by $npcNamePlural:25022004$ have made reconaissance difficult. Defeat $npcNamePlural:25022004$ so that the scouts can complete their mission safely.
quest.descFameUI: An assault against the occupied territories of the Daemon Army is being planned, but the gathering of intelligence will prove vital. Cull the $npcNamePlural:25022004$ patrolling the area to ensure the scouts' safety.

quest.name: $map:02020030$ in Crisis
quest.desc: Humanitas's base of $map:02020030$ is under threat from constant monster attack. Come to their aid by defeating $npcNamePlural:25020004$ in $map:02020029$ and $npcNamePlural:25020104$ in $map:02020030$.
quest.descFameUI: $map:02020030$ is surrounded by monsters. Come to Humanitas's aid.

quest.name: Securing the Supply Line
quest.desc: $map:02020004$ and $map:02020006$ sit on key supply lines for $map:02020041$, but they're being overwhelmed by monsters. Defeat $npcNamePlural:25020305$ in $map:02020006$ and $npcNamePlural:25020403$ in $map:02020004$.
quest.descFameUI: The monsters in $map:02020004$ and $map:02020006$ are attacking Sky Fortress's supply lines.

quest.name: Holding the Line
quest.desc: The $map:02020032$ is under constant attack from the Daemon Army. If $map:02020041$ is ever to be a city in its own right, then these enemies must be turned back. Defeat $npcNamePlural:25020701$, $npcNamePlural:25020702$, $npcNamePlural:25020703$, $npcNamePlural:25020704$, $npcNamePlural:25020705$, $npcNamePlural:25020706$, and $npcNamePlural:25020707$ in $map:02020032$.
quest.descFameUI: The outpost must be secured. Defeat monsters in $map:02020032$.

quest.name: Nature in Technology
quest.desc: In spite of its technological advancement, natural scenery can be found throughout Kritias. Unfortunately, monsters are threatening that beauty in $map:02020014$.
quest.descFameUI: Technology and nature are in balance in Kritias. The beauty of this place must be protected.

quest.name: Monstrous Interference
quest.desc: The further you venture into Kritias, the more fierce the monster resistance becomes. Clear a path for Sky Fortress's scouts.
quest.descFameUI: Monsters are interfering with Sky Fortress's exploration of Kritias.

quest.name: Jamming the Jammers
quest.desc: $npcNamePlural:25020102$ are emitting a signal that interferes with Sky Fortress's radio systems. Go to $map:02020030$ and defeat them.
quest.descFameUI: $npcNamePlural:25020102$ are jamming the radio signals of scouts in $map:02020030$.

quest.name: Attack on $map:02020004$
quest.desc: The nearest town to $map:02020041$, $map:02020004$, is occupied by Tairen. Head there and defeat $npcNamePlural:25020405$.
quest.descFameUI: The nearest town to $map:02020041$, $map:02020004$, is occupied by Tairen. Head there and defeat $npcNamePlural:25020405$.

quest.name: Endangered Research
quest.desc: Ecological research in $map:02020034$ and $map:02020013$ has come to a stop due to monster attacks. Defeat $npcNamePlural:25020804$ in $map:02020034$ and $npcNamePlural:25020904$ in $map:02020013$.
quest.descFameUI: Ecological research in $map:02020034$ and $map:02020013$ has come to a stop due to monster attacks.

quest.name: Tairen Raid
quest.desc: Sky Fortress is preparing an offensive against Tairen forces in $map:02020017$ and $map:02020033$. Your part in this attack is to defeat $npcNamePlural:25021205$ in $map:02020017$ and $npcNamePlural:25021305$ in $map:02020033$.
quest.descFameUI: Sky Fortress is planning a raid on $map:02020017$ and $map:02020033$.

quest.name: Act of Stewardship
quest.desc: The monsters in $map:02020035$ and $map:02020037$ are suddenly attacking Sky Fortress agents. Defeat $npcNamePlural:25021904$ and $npcNamePlural:25022104$.
quest.descFameUI: The monsters in $map:02020035$ and $map:02020037$ are suddenly attacking Sky Fortress agents.

quest.name: Aetherine Endangered
quest.desc: Sky Fortress's access to aetherine is endangered by the $npcNamePlural:25020102$ near $map:02020030$. If this goes on, research into aetherine will come grinding to a halt.
quest.descFameUI: Sky Fortress's access to aetherine is endangered by the $npcNamePlural:25020102$ near $map:02020030$. If this goes on, research into aetherine will come grinding to a halt.

quest.name: The Research Must Go On
quest.desc: Monsters are interfering with research in $map:02020001$ and $map:02020004$ is growing as the days go by. Defeat $npcNamePlural:25020505$ in $map:02020001$ and $npcNamePlural:25020402$ in $map:02020004$.
quest.descFameUI: Defeat the monsters interfering with aetherine research in $map:02020001$ and $map:02020004$.

quest.name: Scratching the Ruin Surface
quest.desc: Excavation of $map:02020016$ has been delayed by the many robots and Kharon forces in the area. Because the ruins seem to have a lot of aetherine in them, someone needs to get rid of the monsters to make room for the excavation team.
quest.descFameUI: Excavation in $map:02020016$ hasn't started because of monster interference. Remove this interference.

quest.name: Records of Ancient Kritias
quest.desc: $map:02020017$ is a valuable repository of writings on ancient Kritias. Enemy forces are destroying these writings and must be stopped.
quest.descFameUI: $map:02020017$ is a valuable repository of writings on ancient Kritias. Enemy forces are destroying these writings and must be stopped.

quest.name: Research Interference
quest.desc: Research in $map:02020009$ and $map:02020018$ is endangered by frequent monster attacks. Defeat $npcNamePlural:25021605$ in $map:02020009$ and $npcNamePlural:25021704$ in $map:02020018$.
quest.descFameUI: Defeat $npcNamePlural:25021605$ in $map:02020009$ and $npcNamePlural:25021704$ in $map:02020018$ to keep them from attacking researchers.

quest.name: Unidentified Flying Object
quest.desc: An unidentified flying object has been sighted following the Sky Fortress. To determine what it is, and whether it's a threat to the ship, $npcName:11003536$ has asked you to investigate. Head to the deck as soon as the object arrives!
quest.descFameUI: An unidentified flying object has been trailing Sky Fortress. It's up to you to analyze it!

quest.desc:
An unidentified aircraft is hovering near the Sky Fortress.
$npcName:11003536$ seems determined to analyze it. In this situation, there's only one thing $npcName:11003536$ needs!
That is the help of $MyPCName$.
quest.descFameUI: An unidentified aircraft is hovering near the Sky Fortress. To analyze it, get in there and face it head-on!
quest.name: Unidentified Flying Object

quest.desc:
<font color="#00a2ed">Fortress Rumble Mission</font> Become Captain Blieze's sparring partner and rise to the top.
In Fortress Rumble, you can spar with Captain Blieze at [Sky Fortress Bridge Upper Deck].
quest.descFameUI: <font color="#00a2ed">Fortress Rumble Mission</font> Become Captain Blieze's sparring partner and rise to the top.
quest.manual: Fortress Rumble, [Sky Fortress Bridge Upper Deck] Clear

Sparring in the Skies
quest.desc: <font color="#00a2ed">Fortress Rumble Mission</font> Spar with Captain Veliche atop Sky Fortress! You can face her in the "Duel on the Deck" Fortress Rumble.
quest.manual: Clear the "Duel on the Deck" Fortress Rumble
quest.descFameUI: <font color="#00a2ed">Fortress Rumble Mission</font> Spar with Captain Veliche atop Sky Fortress!

quest.desc:
<font color="#00a2ed">Fortress Rumble Mission</font> Schaten's special tutoring is training that feels just like the real thing.
In Fortress Rumble, you can spar with $npcName:11003584$ at [Shadow Wind Secret Training Facility].

quest.manual: Clear Fortress Rumble, [Shadow Wind Secret Training Facility]

quest.name: One-on-One with Schatten
quest.desc: <font color="#00a2ed">Fortress Rumble Mission</font> $npcName:11003584$ wants some special one-on-one time with you. You can face her in the "Close Quarters" Fortress Rumble.
quest.descFameUI: <font color="#00a2ed">Fortress Rumble Mission</font> Schatten is itching for some one-on-one time with you.

quest.name: A Potential Destiny
quest.desc: <font color="#00a2ed">Fortress Rumble Mission</font> $npcName:11003537$ wishes to learn the truth about your destiny by dueling against you. You can face him in the "Trial by Ordeal" Fortress Rumble.
quest.manual: Clear the "Trial by Ordeal" Fortress Rumble
quest.descFameUI: <font color="#00a2ed">Fortress Rumble Mission</font> Mason seeks to help you reach destiny by violence.
<font color="#00a2ed">Fortress Rumble Mission</font> A duel with Mason to seize your destiny. The possibilities are in motion.
quest.desc:
<font color="#00a2ed">Fortress Rumble Mission</font> A duel with Mason to seize your destiny. The possibilities are in motion.
In Fortress Rumble, you can spar with $npcName:11003537$ at [Knights' High Command Reception Area].
quest.name: Destiny of Possibility
quest.manual: Clear Fortress Rumble, [Knights Order High Command Reception Area]

quest.desc:
<font color="#00a2ed">Fortress Rumble Mission</font> For the perfect combat simulation, your battle data is required.
In Fortress Rumble, you can participate in $npcName:11003585$'s virtual combat training at [Nairin's Combat Simulator].
quest.descFameUI: <font color="#00a2ed">Fortress Rumble Mission</font> For the perfect combat simulation, your battle data is required.
quest.name: For the Perfect Simulation!
In the Name of Perfection!
quest.desc: <font color="#00a2ed">Fortress Rumble Mission</font> To perfect Nairin's Combat Simulator, you have to battle against it. You can face it in the "Nairin's Combat Simulator" Fortress Rumble.
quest.manual: Clear the "Nairin's Combat Simulator" Fortress Rumble
quest.descFameUI: <font color="#00a2ed">Fortress Rumble Mission</font> To perfect Nairin's Combat Simulator, you have to battle against it.

quest.name: Royal Guard Workout
quest.desc: <font color="#00a2ed">Fortress Rumble Mission</font> Spar with $npcName:11003583$ to improve your skills and possibly even your social standing.
quest.manual: Clear the "Training Yard Tussle" Fortress Rumble
quest.descFameUI: <font color="#00a2ed">Fortress Rumble Mission</font> Spar with Condor to improve your skills and possibly even your social standing.

quest.desc:
<font color="#00a2ed">Fortress Rumble Mission</font> Royal Guard-style fitness training! Feel your combat skills grow and experience the camaraderie of military life.
In Fortress Rumble, you can spar with $npcName:11003583$ at [Royal Guard Training Grounds].
quest.descFameUI: <font color="#00a2ed">Fortress Rumble Mission</font> Royal Guard-style fitness training! Feel your combat skills grow and experience the camaraderie of military life.
quest.manual: Clear Fortress Rumble, [Royal Guard Training Ground]

quest.name: [Special] Gigantica Rampage
quest.desc:
$npcName:23001006$ is on a rampage in $map:02020051$. It must be defeated before it does more damage.
(Once you accept this mission, you cannot begin any other weekly [Special] Gigantica missions until the weekly reset.)
quest.descFameUI: <font color="#00a2ed">$npcName:23001006$ Mission</font> $npcName:23001006$ is on a rampage in $map:02020051$. It must be defeated before it does more damage.

quest.name: [Special] Gigantica Contained
quest.desc:
Sky Fortress's medics can't keep up with the soldiers injured fighting $npcName:23001006$ in $map:02020051$. Defeat the monster so that the medics can catch up.
(Once you accept this mission, you cannot begin any other weekly [Special] Gigantica missions until the weekly reset.)
quest.descFameUI: <font color="#00a2ed">$npcName:23001006$ Mission</font> Medics can't keep up with those ijured fighting $npcName:23001006$ in $map:02020051$. Defeat the mechanoid monster!

quest.name: [Special] Gigantica's Tactics
quest.desc:
$npcName:23001006$ in $map:02020051$ is unlike any enemy Sky Fortress has ever encountered. Collect combat data on this strange monster by fighting it.
(Once you accept this mission, you cannot begin any other weekly [Special] Gigantica missions until the weekly reset.)
quest.descFameUI: <font color="#00a2ed">$npcName:23001006$ Mission</font> Study $npcName:23001006$'s tactics and strategies.

quest.name: [Special] Daemon Army Invasion 1
quest.desc:
$npcName:11001813$'s fingerprints are all over the disasters taking place in Kritias. Uncover his plot.
(Once you accept this mission, you cannot begin any other weekly [Special] First Legion missions until the weekly reset.)
quest.manual: Clear a legion battle in $map:02020061$ or $map:02020065$
quest.descFameUI: <font color="#00a2ed">First Legion Mission</font> $npcName:11001813$'s fingerprints are all over the disasters taking place in Kritias. Uncover his plot.

quest.name: [Special] Spreading Darkness 1
quest.desc:
$npcName:11001813$ taints everything he touches. Track down his corruption to its source.
(Once you accept this mission, you cannot begin any other weekly [Special] First Legion missions until the weekly reset.)
quest.manual: Clear a legion battle in $map:02020061$ or $map:02020065$
quest.descFameUI: <font color="#00a2ed">First Legion Mission</font> $npcName:11001813$ taints everything he touches. Track down his corruption to its source.

quest.name: [Special] Daemon Army Counterattack 1
quest.desc: The Daemon Army has practically occupied Kidel. If Sky Fortress is too defeat them, then they'll need more intelligence on the enemy forces. (Once you accept this mission, you cannot begin any other weekly [Special] First Legion missions until the weekly reset.)
quest.manual: Clear a legion battle in $map:02020061$ or $map:02020065$
quest.descFameUI: <font color="#00a2ed">First Legion Mission</font> Daemon forces have occupied much of Kidel. If the Alliance is to defeat them, they'll need more intelligence on the enemy.

quest.name: [Special] Daemon Army Invasion 2
quest.desc:
The Daemon Army is on the move again, and this time their eyes are set on all of Kritias. Cut them off before they threaten Sky Fortress and its allies.
(Once you accept this mission, you cannot begin any other weekly [Special] Second Legion missions until the weekly reset.)
quest.manual: Clear a legion battle in $map:02020062$ or $map:02020063$
quest.descFameUI: <font color="#00a2ed">Second Legion Mission</font> Daemon forces are on the move. Cut them off before they threaten Sky Fortress and its allies.

quest.name: [Special] Spreading Darkness 2
quest.desc:
Darkness surges through the land as $npcName:11001813$'s Daemon Army marches. This cannot be allowed!
(Once you accept this mission, you cannot begin any other weekly [Special] Second Legion missions until the weekly reset.)
quest.manual: Clear a legion battle in $map:02020062$ or $map:02020063$
quest.descFameUI: <font color="#00a2ed">Second Legion Mission</font> Darkness surges through the land as $npcName:11001813$'s Daemon Army marches. This cannot be allowed!

quest.name: [Special] Daemon Army Counterattack 2
quest.desc: After all this time, you still know almost nothing about $npcName:11001813$. The Green Hoods have decided to study him by investigating his Daemon Army. (Once you accept this mission, you cannot begin any other weekly [Special] Second Legion missions until the weekly reset.)
quest.manual: Clear a legion battle in $map:02020062$ or $map:02020063$
quest.descFameUI: <font color="#00a2ed">Second Legion Mission</font> Darkness surges through the land as $npcName:11001813$'s Daemon Army marches. This cannot be allowed!

quest.name: No Other Option
quest.desc: $npcName:11004430$ keeps turning monsters to the side of evil. Curtail his vile efforts by defeating $npcNamePlural:25020001$ in $map:02020029$, $npcNamePlural:25020205$ in $map:02020031$, and $npcNamePlural:25020106$ in $map:02020030$.
quest.descFameUI: Evil is spreading through the land. Defeat the monsters that are most affected.

quest.name: Combat Aid
quest.desc: There are too many monsters for Sky Fortress's soldiers to handle. Help out by defeating $npcNamePlural:25020002$ in $map:02020029$ and $npcNamePlural:25020206$ in $map:02020031$.
quest.descFameUI: The enemy forces seem to have no end. It's only a matter of time before Sky Fortress is overwhelmed.

quest.name: Imminent Threat
quest.desc: Humanitas is in dire need of reinforcements. Defeat $npcNamePlural:25020306$ in $map:02020006$, $npcNamePlural:25020406$ in $map:02020004$, and $npcNamePlural:25020506$ in $map:02020001$.
quest.descFameUI: Humanitas is being overwhelmed by waves of enemies. Help them fight back.

quest.name: For Humanitas
quest.desc: Humanitas is having a hard time holding back enemy attacks from $map:02020004$ and $map:02020001$. Help Humanitas by defeating $npcNamePlural:25020403$ in $map:02020004$ and $npcNamePlural:25020507$ in $map:02020001$.
quest.descFameUI: Help Humanitas defend from attacks in multiple directions.

quest.name: Strange Swords
quest.desc: $npcName:11004312$ is interested in the fencing techniques of Kritias. Study them by defeating $npcNamePlural:25020602$ in $map:02020010$, $npcNamePlural:25020802$ in $map:02020034$, and $npcNamePlural:25021004$ in $map:02020016$.
quest.descFameUI: $npcName:11004312$ wants to understand the fencing of Kritias. Experience this fencing for yourself.

quest.name: Brutal Bullets
quest.desc: $npcName:11004312$ prefers swordplay, but still wants to learn about the gunplay of Kritias. Study $npcNamePlural:25020604$ in $map:02020010$ and $npcNamePlural:25021005$ in $map:02020016$.
quest.descFameUI: Study how the enemy uses their guns to better prepare the crew of Sky Fortress for field engagements.

quest.name: Rookies in Danger
quest.desc: Due to a mix-up, rookie soldiers were accidentally sent into areas with heavy fighting. Protect them by defeating $npcNamePlural:25021106$ in $map:02020051$, $npcNamePlural:25021202$ in $map:02020017$, and $npcNamePlural:25021502$ in $map:02020003$.
quest.descFameUI: Protect some new recruits who have waded a little too far into the deep end.

quest.name: Heavy Foes
quest.desc: Heavily armored enemies have been spotted by Sky Fortress's advance scouts. Defeat $npcNamePlural:25021205$ in $map:02020017$ and $npcNamePlural:25021406$ in $map:02020014$.
quest.descFameUI: Heavily armored enemies have been spotted. Defeat these enemies before they interfere with research and scouting operations.

quest.name: Tairen Interference
quest.desc: The road to innermost Kritias goes through $map:02020018$, $map:02020037$, and $map:02020035$, but Tairen has fortified all of these positions. Defeat $npcNamePlural:25021703$ in $map:02020018$, $npcNamePlural:25022105$ in $map:02020037$, and $npcNamePlural:25021905$ in $map:02020035$.
quest.descFameUI: Tairen is holding several key routes through Kritias. Defeat them to secure the routes.

quest.name: Breaking Through
quest.desc: $map:02020018$ and $map:02020037$ appear to be gateways to the furthest reaches of Kritias. Help Sky Fortress's agents break through by defeating $npcNamePlural:25021702$ in $map:02020018$ and $npcNamePlural:25022102$ in $map:02020037$.
quest.descFameUI: Make way to the furthest reaches of Kritias by defeating $npcNamePlural:25021702$ in $map:02020018$ and $npcNamePlural:25022102$ in $map:02020037$.

quest.name: Research Focus: $item:61000154$
quest.desc: $npcName:11004315$ needs to study inert monsters to better understand how to fight them. Capture a $item:61000154$ from $map:02020031$.
quest.descFameUI: Capture $item:61000154$ in $map:02020031$ to help expand Sky Fortress's research efforts.

quest.name: Research Focus: $item:61000155$
quest.desc: Sky Fortress continues its research on pacified monsters. Capture a $item:61000155$ in $map:02020006$.
quest.descFameUI: Capture $item:61000155$ in $map:02020006$ to help expand Sky Fortress's research efforts.

quest.name: Research Focus: $item:61000159$
quest.desc: The monsters in $map:02020001$ look similar to the monsters of Maple World. Go to $map:02020001$ and capture a $item:61000159$.
quest.descFameUI: Go to $map:02020001$ and capture a $item:61000159$.

quest.name: Research Focus: $item:61000161$
quest.desc: The researchers of Sky Fortress need yet another monster to prove their new hypothesis. This time they need a $item:61000161$ from $map:02020034$.
quest.descFameUI: The researchers of Sky Fortress need yet another monster to prove their new hypothesis. This time they need a $item:61000161$ from $map:02020034$.

quest.name: Secrets of the Leshies
quest.desc: Unlike the other monsters of Kritias, leshies don't have much aetherine in their bodies. Instead, they wear aetherine pendants that they use for power. Could humans learn how to use this power? Collect $itemPlural:30001303$ from $npcNamePlural:25020901$ and $npcNamePlural:25020902$ in $map:02020013$.
quest.descFameUI: Leshies get power from the $itemPlural:30001303$ around their necks. Collect some for research.

quest.name: Research Focus: $item:61000164$
quest.desc: Sky Fortress is turning its efforts on researching unusual monsters. Help the research by capturing $itemPlural:61000164$ in $map:02020051$.
quest.descFameUI: Sky Fortress is researching unique monsters. Help the research by capturing $itemPlural:61000164$ in $map:02020051$.

quest.name: Research Focus: $item:61000165$
quest.desc: $npcName:11004312$ asked you to capture a $item:61000165$ from $map:02020033$.
quest.descFameUI: Capture a $item:61000165$ from $map:02020033$ for the Sky Fortress research team.

quest.name: Research Focus: $item:61000170$
quest.desc: The Sky Fortress research team needs a $item:61000170$ from $map:02020033$ for their experiments.
quest.descFameUI: Sky Fortress is continuing its research on the monsters of Kritias. Go to $map:02020033$ and capture a $item:61000170$ to help with their research.

quest.name: Research Focus: $item:61000166$
quest.desc: There is still a little more work to be done in the research on Kritias's monsters. Capture a $item:61000166$ in $map:02020018$ for the research team.
quest.descFameUI: There is still a little more work to be done in the research on Kritias's monsters. Capture a $item:61000166$ in $map:02020018$ for the research team.

quest.name: Research Focus: $item:61000169$
quest.desc: $npcName:11004312$ needs you to capture a $item:61000169$ in $map:02020037$.
quest.descFameUI: Help the research team by capturing a $item:61000169$ in $map:02020037$.

quest.name: Research Focus: $item:61000163$
quest.desc: One of the researchers accidentally let one of their monster specimens escape. Capture a replacement $item:61000163$ in $map:02020009$.
quest.descFameUI: One of the researchers accidentally let one of their monster specimens escape. Capture a replacement $item:61000163$ in $map:02020009$.

quest.name: Research Focus: $item:61000168$
quest.desc: Capture a $item:61000168$ in $map:02020008$. Don't worry; it's gentle.
quest.descFameUI: Capture a $item:61000168$ in $map:02020008$ for Sky Fortress's research team.

quest.name: Aetherine Source
quest.desc: A strange pit was discovered in $map:02020029$. $npcName:11004312$ believes that the monsters of $map:02020029$ get power from that pit. Enter $map:52100111$ in $map:02020029$ and search for a source of aetherine.
quest.manual: Search $map:52100111$ in $map:02020029$ for a source of aetherine
quest.descFameUI: Enter $map:52100111$ in $map:02020029$ and search for a source of aetherine.

quest.name: Seeking the $map:52100113$
quest.desc: $npcNamePlural:25020302$ are overwhelming $map:02020006$. $npcName:11004312$ wants to cut them off at their source. Enter the $map:52100113$ near the bridge in $map:02020006$ and get rid of their eggs.
quest.manual: Enter the $map:52100113$ in $map:02020006$ and destroy leecher eggs
quest.descFameUI: Enter the $map:52100113$ near the bridge in $map:02020006$ and get rid of their eggs.

quest.name: $map:02020033$'s Cannons
quest.desc: Humanitas is requesting help at $map:02020033$. Their cannons have suddenly stopped working; head out and provide emergency repairs.
quest.descFameUI: The Humanitas cannons in $map:02020033$ have failed. They need a dashing hero to come fix them.

quest.name: An Unusual Darkness
quest.desc: $npcName:11004316$ senses a dark aura that must be taken care of. Defeat the $npcNamePlural:25020005$ in $map:02020029$, $npcNamePlural:25020104$ in $map:02020030$, and $npcNamePlural:25020202$ in $map:02020031$.
quest.descFameUI: Battle the darkness by defeating $npcNamePlural:25020005$ in $map:02020029$, $npcNamePlural:25020104$ in $map:02020030$, and $npcNamePlural:25020202$ in $map:02020031$.

quest.name: Make Haste
quest.desc: $npcName:11004316$ met with the oracle last night. You must defeat $npcNamePlural:25020105$ in $map:02020030$ and $npcNamePlural:25020004$ in $map:02020029$.
quest.descFameUI: Avert disaster by defeating $npcNamePlural:25020105$ in $map:02020030$ and $npcNamePlural:25020004$ in $map:02020029$.

quest.name: Laid to Rest
quest.desc: $npcName:11004316$ has a duty to lay the souls of the corrupted to rest. Fulfill this duty on his behalf by defeating $npcNamePlural:25020306$ in $map:02020006$, $npcNamePlural:25020402$ in $map:02020004$, and $npcNamePlural:25020503$ in $map:02020001$.
quest.descFameUI: Lay the $npcNamePlural:25020306$ in $map:02020006$, $npcNamePlural:25020402$ in $map:02020004$, and $npcNamePlural:25020503$ in $map:02020001$ to rest.

quest.name: Knowledge from Violence
quest.desc: $npcName:11004316$ has received strange reports of the monsters in $map:02020006$. Go to $map:02020006$ and carefully observe $npcNamePlural:25020307$ and $npcNamePlural:25020305$.
quest.descFameUI: $npcName:11004316$ is interested in $map:02020006$. Go to $map:02020006$ and carefully observe $npcNamePlural:25020307$ and $npcNamePlural:25020305$.

quest.name: It Has to Be You
quest.desc: $npcName:11004316$ seeks to put a swift end to the enemies' resistance. He's sure that their forces will collapse if you defeat $npcNamePlural:25020606$ in $map:02020010$, $npcNamePlural:25020806$ in $map:02020034$, and $npcNamePlural:25021006$ in $map:02020016$.
quest.descFameUI: Defeat $npcNamePlural:25020606$ in $map:02020010$, $npcNamePlural:25020806$ in $map:02020034$, and $npcNamePlural:25021006$ in $map:02020016$.

quest.name: Kharon's Plot
quest.desc: Kharon and the Daemon Army have been spotted exchanging information. Curb their cultural exchange by defeating $npcNamePlural:25020603$ in $map:02020032$ and $npcNamePlural:25020703$ in $map:02020010$.
quest.descFameUI: Keep Kharon in check by defeating $npcNamePlural:25020603$ in $map:02020032$ and $npcNamePlural:25020703$ in $map:02020010$.

quest.name: Secret of the Blue Light
quest.desc: Sky Fortress's researchers believe that monsters with a blue glow have aetherine in their bodies. $npcName:11004316$ wants you to look into this. Vivisect $npcNamePlural:25021101$ in $map:02020051$, $npcNamePlural:25021204$ in $map:02020017$, and $npcNamePlural:25021501$ in $map:02020003$.
quest.descFameUI: Conduct research on $npcNamePlural:25021101$ in $map:02020051$, $npcNamePlural:25021204$ in $map:02020017$, and $npcNamePlural:25021501$ in $map:02020003$.

quest.name: Inelegant Weapons
quest.desc: $npcName:11004316$ thinks that swords are better than guns. Even so, he wants to know more about the gunslingers of Kritias, so defeat $npcNamePlural:25021103$ in $map:02020051$ and $npcNamePlural:25021407$ in $map:02020014$.
quest.descFameUI: Swords are better than guns. Also, defeat $npcNamePlural:25021103$ in $map:02020051$ and $npcNamePlural:25021407$ in $map:02020014$.

quest.name: Cutting the Line
quest.desc: Despite your best efforts, the alliance between Kharon and the Daemon Army goes strong. Cut the lines between them by defeating $npcNamePlural:25021904$ in $map:02020035$, $npcNamePlural:25022005$ in $map:02020036$, and $npcNamePlural:25021602$ in $map:02020009$.
quest.descFameUI: Defeat $npcNamePlural:25021904$ in $map:02020035$, $npcNamePlural:25022005$ in $map:02020036$, and $npcNamePlural:25021602$ in $map:02020009$.

quest.name: A Simple Conclusion
quest.desc: $npcName:11004316$ has identified the Deamon Army as the greatest threat in Kritias. Defeat $npcNamePlural:25021903$ in $map:02020035$ and $npcNamePlural:25022001$ in $map:02020036$.
quest.descFameUI: Weaken the Daemon Army by defeating $npcNamePlural:25021903$ in $map:02020035$ and $npcNamePlural:25022001$ in $map:02020036$.

quest.name: Robot Bug Collections
quest.desc: The Lumiknights are exploring the many ways that Kritias differs from Maple World. They've grown interested with the strange robotic insects in $map:02020029$. Collect some insects from there.
quest.descFameUI: Collect robotic insects in $map:02020029$.

quest.name: Secret of the Dark Crystals
quest.desc: $npcNamePlural:25020104$ constantly appear in $map:02020030$ and $npcName:11004316$ doesn't know why. Go to $map:02020030$, investigate the dark crystals scattered all over the place, and collect some samples.
quest.descFameUI: Collect $itemPlural:30001297$ in $map:02020030$.

quest.name: Humanitas-ian Aid
quest.desc: The transmission tower in $map:02020030$ is being attacked by monsters. Repair the fence around the tower to prevent Humanitas from losing it.
quest.manual: Repair the fence near the tower in $map:02020030$
quest.descFameUI: Repair the fence near the transmission tower in $map:02020030$ to prevent monsters from approaching it.

quest.name: A Helping Hand
quest.desc: Sky Fortress's research team is overwhelmed, so $npcName:11004316$ has graciously offered your help. Examine the strange ore in $map:02020031$.
quest.descFameUI: Help the Sky Fortress research team by examining the strange ore in $map:02020031$.

quest.name: Waters of $map:02020001$
quest.desc: $npcName:11004316$ is impressed by the diversity of life in Kritias. He placed some devices disguised as plants in $map:02020001$ and needs you to see if they've gathered any new data.
quest.descFameUI: Find out if the monitoring devices in $map:02020001$ have gathered any data.

quest.name: Ship's Maintenance
quest.desc: The ship has been anchored in $map:02020041$ for a long time. $npcName:11004316$ says that it's your turn to do regular maintenance.
quest.descFameUI: Perform repairs on the Sky Fortress while it's anchored in $map:02020041$.

quest.name: $itemPlural:30000232$ for Research
quest.desc: $itemPlural:30000232$ grow in Kritias, too. $npcName:11004316$ is curious how it came to be there. Collect some for him for his "research."
quest.descFameUI: Collect $itemPlural:30000232$ for $npcName:11004316$'s research.

quest.name: Local Remedies
quest.desc: In this war, there is never a shortage of injured soldiers. Because supply lines are stretched thin between Kritias and Maple World, you need to gather a local herb called $item:30001299$ to use for medicine. You can harvest it from $npcName:25020705$ in $map:02020032$.
quest.descFameUI: Go to $map:02020032$, examine $npcName:25020705$, and harvest $item:30001299$.

quest.name: $map:52100112$
quest.desc: The Sky Fortress team managed to hack some enemy robots, but the robots are finicky and difficult to control. Go to the $map:52100112$ in $map:02020041$ and get an update from $npcName:11004522$.
quest.descFameUI: Go to the $map:52100112$ in $map:02020041$ and get an update from $npcName:11004522$.

quest.name: Poings of Rage
quest.desc: The rafflesia of $map:02020013$ emit a constant fog of poison, and it's making the $npcNamePlural:11004342$ very, very angry. Go to $map:02020013$ and pacify them.
quest.descFameUI: Go to $map:02020013$ and take care of the angry poings there.

quest.name: Cherry Blossoms for Someone
quest.desc: $npcName:11004316$ has asked you to collect $item:30001300$ for him. It's not clear why he needs these blossoms, but you can find them in $map:02020014$.
quest.descFameUI: Get $itemPlural:30001300$ in $map:02020014$.

quest.name: Silent Research
quest.desc: Understanding $map:02020014$ is critical to understanding Kritias, but Sky Fortress has lost contact with its researchers there. Head out and make sure they're safe.
quest.descFameUI: Go to $map:02020014$ and make sure the researchers are safe.

quest.name: What's in a Waspling
quest.desc: Even though they live throughout Kritias, wasplings aren't yet well understood by the Sky Fortress team. A researcher spotted would appears to be a brood of baby wasplings in the north of the $map:02020017$. Go back there and examine the baby bugs.
quest.descFameUI: Go to the north of the $map:02020017$ and examine baby wasplings.

quest.name: $map:02020018$'s Dew
quest.desc: $map:02020018$ may be the highest region in all of Kritias and appears to be untouched by the technology that covers the rest of the continent. It is here that $item:30001301$ beads on the local plant life. Search these plants for this miraculous dew.
quest.descFameUI: Gather $item:30001301$ from the plants in $map:02020018$.

quest.name: Aetherine Botany
quest.desc: The plants of $map:02020037$ seem to have an unusually high level of aetherine. Head there and gather $itemPlural:30001302$ for $npcName:11004316$.
quest.manual: Examine the red plants in $map:02020037$ and collect $itemPlural:30001302$
quest.descFameUI: Examine the red plants in $map:02020037$ and gather $itemPlural:30001302$.

quest.name: Willing Investigator
quest.desc:
$npcName:11004315$ feels overwhelmed by her research on Kritias. Help her by gathering information on the $npcNamePlural:25020003$ in $map:02020029$, $npcNamePlural:25020103$ in $map:02020030$, and $npcNamePlural:25020203$ in $map:02020031$.
In this case, "gathering information" means "defeating," of course.
quest.descFameUI: Gather information on the $npcNamePlural:25020003$ in $map:02020029$, $npcNamePlural:25020103$ in $map:02020030$, and $npcNamePlural:25020203$ in $map:02020031$.

quest.name: Peculiar Foes
quest.desc: $npcName:11004315$ never has enough data on the villains of Kritias! You volunteered to investigate the $npcNamePlural:25020101$ in $map:02020030$ and $npcNamePlural:25020201$ in $map:02020031$ to help Sky Fortress. Fight them and figure out what makes them unique.
quest.descFameUI: Fight $npcNamePlural:25020101$ in $map:02020030$ and $npcNamePlural:25020201$ in $map:02020031$ to learn what makes them special.

quest.name: No Time to Waste
quest.desc: $npcName:11004315$ is worried about the frequent injuries to the agents sent to $map:02020004$, $map:02020001$, and $map:02020006$. Help $npcName:11004315$ by defeating $npcNamePlural:25020405$ in $map:02020004$, $npcNamePlural:25020502$ in $map:02020001$, and $npcNamePlural:25020303$ in $map:02020006$ who are giving her people trouble.
quest.descFameUI: Defeat $npcNamePlural:25020405$ in $map:02020004$, $npcNamePlural:25020502$ in $map:02020001$, and $npcNamePlural:25020303$ in $map:02020006$ to protect Sky Fortress's people.

quest.name: Her Hypothesis
quest.desc: It bothers $npcName:11004315$ that $npcName:11004316$ has been snooping on her research since arriving in Kritias. Now she wants help proving her hypothesis about blue monsters before her rival can swoop in. Study the $npcNamePlural:25020302$ in $map:02020006$ and $npcNamePlural:25020505$ in $map:02020001$.
quest.descFameUI: Prove $npcName:11004315$'s hypothesis by investigating $npcNamePlural:25020302$ in $map:02020006$ and $npcNamePlural:25020505$ in $map:02020001$.

quest.name: Systematic Investigation
quest.desc: $npcName:11004315$ wants to bring some order to Sky Fortress's research strategy. Start by studying mechanical monsters with unique shapes. You can do this by fighting $npcNamePlural:25020605$ in $map:02020010$, $npcNamePlural:25020807$ in $map:02020034$, and $npcNamePlural:25021001$ in $map:02020016$.
quest.descFameUI: Gather data by fighting $npcNamePlural:25020605$ in $map:02020010$, $npcNamePlural:25020807$ in $map:02020034$, and $npcNamePlural:25021001$ in $map:02020016$.

quest.name: Poings Everywhere
quest.desc: $npcName:11004315$ is in awe of the variety of monsters who call Kritias their home. She's particularly interested in $npcNamePlural:11004342$. Research them by hunting $npcNamePlural:25020704$ in $map:02020032$ and $npcNamePlural:25020905$ in $map:02020013$.
quest.descFameUI: Research $npcNamePlural:25020704$ in $map:02020032$ and $npcNamePlural:25020905$ in $map:02020013$.

quest.name: Not Enough Data
quest.desc: $npcName:11004315$ rolodex of monsters is missing critical details for certain species. Help fill in the gaps by fighting $npcNamePlural:25021102$ in $map:02020051$, $npcNamePlural:25021203$ in $map:02020017$, and $npcNamePlural:25021401$ in $map:02020014$.
quest.descFameUI: Gather data on $npcNamePlural:25021102$ in $map:02020051$, $npcNamePlural:25021203$ in $map:02020017$, and $npcNamePlural:25021401$ in $map:02020014$.

quest.name: Perfection
quest.desc: $npcName:11004315$ rolodex of monsters is missing critical details for certain species. Help fill in the gaps by fighting $npcNamePlural:25021104$ in $map:02020051$ and $npcNamePlural:25021201$ in $map:02020017$.
quest.descFameUI: Gather information by defeating $npcNamePlural:25021104$ in $map:02020051$ and $npcNamePlural:25021201$ in $map:02020017$.

quest.name: Fearful Future
quest.desc: Sky Fortress is gathering data on the plant monsters of Kritias. It seems that Kharon and Tairen is plotting to use these monsters in their armies. Disrupt their plan by defeating $npcNamePlural:25021801$ in $map:02020008$, $npcNamePlural:25021603$ in $map:02020009$, and $npcNamePlural:25022101$ in $map:02020037$.
quest.descFameUI: Disrupt Tairen's plan by defeating $npcNamePlural:25021801$ in $map:02020008$, $npcNamePlural:25021603$ in $map:02020009$, and $npcNamePlural:25022101$ in $map:02020037$.

quest.name: Next Steps
quest.desc: $npcName:11004315$ has identified the Daemon Army as a major threat. Keep them in check by defeating $npcNamePlural:25021901$ in $map:02020035$ and $npcNamePlural:25022002$ in $map:02020036$.
quest.descFameUI: Keep the Daemon Army in check by defeating $npcNamePlural:25021901$ in $map:02020035$ and $npcNamePlural:25022002$ in $map:02020036$.

quest.name: Rumors of Treasure
quest.desc: $npcName:11004315$ wants you to look into a strange rumor. They say that whosoever can move the heart of the giant $npcName:11004342$ in $map:02020006$ will uncover a great treasure. Investigate this rumor.
quest.manual: Move the heart of the giant $npcName:11004342$ in $map:02020006$
quest.descFameUI: They say that whosoever who can move the heart of the giant $npcName:11004342$ in $map:02020006$ will uncover a great treasure.

quest.name: Checking In
quest.desc: Sky Fortress deployed a squadron on a difficult mission in $map:02020031$, but they've lost contact. Travel there and check in on them.
quest.descFameUI: Check on the Sky Fortress agents in $map:02020031$.

quest.name: $map:02020034$ Rumor: Rings
quest.desc: $npcName:11004315$ is researching the rumors of Kritias. They say that there's a machine in $map:02020034$ that summons a shiny ring in the sky. Head there and see if there's any truth to the rumor, then use a flying mount to go through the ring.
quest.manual: Use the mysterious device in $map:02020034$ and go through the shiny ring
quest.descFameUI: There's a rumor about a shiny ring and a strange machine in $map:02020034$.

quest.name: $map:02020016$ Rumor: Blossoms
quest.desc: $npcName:11004315$ heard a new rumor. Apparently there's a device in $map:02020016$ that makes flowers bloom! Head there and see if you can get the device to work.
quest.manual: Use the device in $map:02020016$ to make flowers bloom
quest.descFameUI: See if there's really a machine in $map:02020016$ that makes flowers bloom.

quest.name: $map:02020032$ Rumor: Treasure Run
quest.desc: At the $map:02020032$, soldiers are reporting that adventurers are loitering around the binoculars, than taking off at full speed. What could be going on over there?
quest.manual: Find out why people are running in $map:02020032$
quest.descFameUI: Adventurers have been spotted running at full speed around the $map:02020032$. What could they possibly be running for?

quest.name: $map:02020014$ Rumor: Sky Garden
quest.desc: $npcName:11004315$ heard a new rumor. It seems that there's a machine in $map:02020014$ that makes floating platforms appear. Head out and see if there's any truth to that.
quest.manual: Use the device in $map:02020014$ and climb the platforms
quest.descFameUI: There's a rumor about floating platforms in $map:02020014$.

quest.name: $map:02020017$ Rumor: Rings
quest.desc: $npcName:11004315$ is looking into rumors from Kritias. $map:02020017$ also has a device that summons shiny rings in the sky. You should check it out.
quest.manual: Use the mysterious device in $map:02020017$ and go through the shiny ring
quest.descFameUI: Go to $map:02020017$ and use the device to summon a shiny ring.

quest.name: $map:02020018$ Rumor: Sky Garden
quest.desc: $npcName:11004315$ heard a rumor about floating platforms in $map:02020018$. Are these the same platforms from that other rumor? There's only one way to find out.
quest.manual: Use the device in $map:02020018$ and climb the platforms
quest.descFameUI: Go to $map:02020018$, operate a weird machine, and jump on floating platforms.

quest.name: $map:02020035$ Rumor: Rings
quest.desc: A scout witnessed a shiny ring in the sky near $map:02020035$. Head out there and check it out.
quest.manual: Use the mysterious device in $map:02020035$ and go through the shiny ring
quest.descFameUI: Go to $map:02020035$, use the mysterious device, and check out the shiny ring.

quest.name: $map:02020009$ Rumor: Guardian
quest.desc: The Sky Fortress team encountered a stubbornly stationary $npcName:11004342$ some time ago, and now another has been spotted in $map:02020009$. $npcName:11004315$ doesn't know what it's guarding, but she wants to find out.
quest.manual: Find out what the $npcName:11004342$ in $map:02020009$ is guarding
quest.descFameUI: See what $npcName:11004342$ wants and give it freedom.

quest.name: $map:02020008$ Rumor: Blossoms
quest.desc: A familiar device has been spotted in $map:02020008$. According to rumors, it causes flowers to blossom on nearby trees. $npcName:11004315$ wants you to check it out.
quest.manual: Use the device in $map:02020008$ to make flowers bloom
quest.descFameUI: Go to $map:02020008$ and use the device to make the flowers bloom.

quest.name: $map:02020037$ Rumor: Blossoms
quest.desc: A familiar device has been spotted in $map:02020037$. According to rumors, it causes flowers to blossom on nearby trees. $npcName:11004315$ wants you to check it out.
quest.manual: Use the device in $map:02020037$ to make flowers bloom
quest.descFameUI: Go to $map:02020037$ and use the device to make the flowers bloom.

quest.name: $map:02020033$ Rumor: Treasure Run
quest.desc: $npcName:11004315$ has an idea why some adventurers have been spotted zipping about certain areas of Kritias. She claims that there's a machine that causes treasure chests to appear. She heard about just such a machine in $map:02020033$ and wants you to check it out.
quest.descFameUI: Use the device in $map:02020033$, find the treasure chest, and open it.

quest.name: $map:02020036$ Rumor: Treasure Run
quest.desc: Treasure runners have been witnessed in $map:02020036$. Give it a go and report your findings to $npcName:11004315$.
quest.descFameUI: Go to $map:02020036$, use the device, and run for the treasure chest.

quest.name: Unidentified Researcher
quest.desc: $npcName:11004485$ is a Sky Fortress researcher in $map:02020009$. The problem is... $npcName:11004315$ doesn't know who he is or what he's researching. As a responsible head of research, she wants you to find out for her.
quest.descFameUI: Go to $map:02020009$ and find out what $npc:11004485$ is doing.
Go to $map:02020066$, meet $npc:11004574$, and help the refugees in danger.
quest.desc:
The refugees in $map:02020066$ have been isolated after the Black Legion appeared and blocked the road... Now that the Maple Alliance has advanced into northern Kidel, $npcName:11004614$ wants to help the refugees.
Go to $map:02020066$, meet $npc:11004574$, and help the refugees endangered by the harsh environment.
You must receive and complete the '$quest:40002797$' mission from $npc:11004574$.
quest.manual: Go to $map:02020066$, meet $npc:11004574$, and help the refugees in danger

quest.desc:
Georg created a special forces unit to strengthen its regular army. The special forces carry out the most dangerous missions on the front line.
Take on the special forces mission from $npcName:11004614$ and try to surpass your limits.
quest.descFameUI: You will be deployed on a high-difficulty Georg special forces mission. Mission Theme: Georg

quest.desc:
$npcName:11004614$ seems extremely excited. After the Georg Intelligence Department's tireless efforts, they finally found one of Kerbes's bases.
$npcName:25022900$ is said to be staying there.
Go to $map:52100114$, which is connected to $map:02020067$, and defeat $npcName:25022900$.
quest.descFameUI: Go to $map:52100114$ in $map:02020067$ and defeat $npcName:25022900$.

quest.desc:
Information has arrived that Poings exposed to Ener are attacking the Morang, causing heavy damage. $npcName:11004614$ feels guilty about the Poings' mutation because Ener belongs to their civilization.
Before the damage grows worse, meet $npcName:11004620$ and help the Morang in danger.
You must receive and complete the '$quest:40002798$' mission from $npc:11004620$.
quest.descFameUI: Go to $map:02020069$, meet $npcName:11004620$, and help the Morang in danger.
quest.manual: Go to $map:02020069$, meet $npcName:11004620$, and help the Morang tribe in danger

quest.desc:
The Maple Alliance and Georg succeeded in pushing the Black Legion all the way to northern Kidel. However, $map:02020071$ remains impregnable.
Despite many sacrifices by Georg's regular army, they have been unable to break through the fortress entrance. $npcName:11004614$ worries that if there are any more losses, the operation will become impossible.
Now it is time to step in yourself.
Launch a surprise attack on $map:02020071$ and defeat $npcName:25022702$, $npcName:25022704$, and $npcName:25022701$.
quest.descFameUI: Go to $map:02020071$ and defeat $npcName:25022702$, $npcName:25022704$, and $npcName:25022701$.

quest.desc:
Georg created a special forces unit to strengthen its regular army. The special forces carry out the most dangerous missions on the front line.
Take on the special forces mission from $npcName:11004614$ and try to surpass your limits.
quest.descFameUI: You will be deployed on a high-difficulty Georg special forces mission. Mission Theme: Georg

quest.desc:
The places where $map:02020070$ and $map:02020071$ were built were originally farmlands operated by the Tyren Kingdom. The farms were closed when the land became barren, but for some reason, two Tyren guard robots that protected the farms are now attacking living creatures...
Because of this, the assault on $map:02020070$ and $map:02020071$ is struggling.
Destroy $npcName:25022800$ in $map:02020070$ and $npcName:25022810$ in $map:02020071$.
quest.descFameUI: Destroy $npcName:25022800$ in $map:02020070$ and $npcName:25022810$ in $map:02020071$.

quest.desc:
$npcName:11004614$ says the Tyren Kingdom has begun attacking $map:02020066$.
$npcName:11004614$ believes Tyren is acting this way to stop Georg from absorbing the refugees and growing stronger.
Go to $map:02020066$, meet $npc:11004574$, understand the situation, and help the refugees.
You must receive and complete the '$quest:40002799$' mission from $npc:11004574$.
quest.descFameUI: Go to $map:02020066$, meet $npc:11004574$, and help the refugees in danger.
quest.manual: Go to $map:02020066$, meet $npc:11004574$, and help the refugees in danger

quest.desc:
Kerbes is said to be kidnapping refugees who went to $map:02020067$ to find food. $npcName:11004614$ asks for help, saying they can no longer stand by and watch Kerbes torment the refugees.
Go to $map:02020066$, meet $npc:11004574$, understand the situation, and help the refugees.
You must receive and complete the '$quest:40002800$' mission from $npc:11004574$.
quest.descFameUI: Go to $map:02020066$, meet $npc:11004574$, and help the refugees in danger.
quest.manual: Go to $map:02020066$, meet $npc:11004574$, and help the refugees in danger
quest.name: Refugees Being Captured

quest.desc:
Georg created a special forces unit to strengthen its regular army. The special forces carry out the most dangerous missions on the front line.
Take on the special forces mission from $npcName:11004614$ and try to surpass your limits.
quest.descFameUI: You will be deployed on a high-difficulty Georg special forces mission. Mission Theme: Georg

quest.desc:
$npcName:11004614$ says they received information that the Black Legion is polluting the forest to steal the Morang's 'mysterious power.' $npcName:11004614$ says that if this power falls into the Black Legion's hands, it will become a major threat to Georg and the Maple Alliance.
Go to $map:02020069$, meet $npcName:11004620$, and stop the mysterious power from falling into the Black Legion's hands.
You must receive and complete the '$quest:40002801$' mission from $npc:11004620$.
quest.descFameUI: Go to $map:02020069$, meet $npcName:11004620$, and stop the mysterious power from falling into the Black Legion's hands.
quest.manual: Go to $map:02020069$, meet $npcName:11004620$, and stop the crisis facing the Morang tribe
quest.name: The Forest Turning Black

quest.desc:
According to the Georg search party, creatures consumed by black energy are heading toward $map:02020069$.
$npcName:11004614$ thinks the Black Legion is moving corrupted hosts to steal the 'mysterious power' passed down among the Morang.
Go to $map:02020069$, meet $npcName:11004620$, and stop the mysterious power from falling into the Black Legion's hands.
You must receive and complete the '$quest:40002802$' mission from $npc:11004620$.
quest.descFameUI: Go to $map:02020069$, meet $npcName:11004620$, and stop the mysterious power from falling into the Black Legion's hands.
quest.manual: Go to $map:02020069$, meet $npcName:11004620$, and stop the Morang tribe's crisis

quest.desc:
$npcName:11004614$ says $map:02020066$ and $map:02020067$ are being attacked by Kerbes at the same time.
This may be the beginning of Kerbes's full-scale offensive to capture $map:02020066$.
Go to $map:02020066$, meet $npc:11004574$, and help the refugees in danger.
You must receive and complete the '$quest:40002803$' mission from $npc:11004574$.
quest.descFameUI: Go to $map:02020066$, meet $npc:11004574$, and help the refugees in danger.
quest.manual: Go to $map:02020066$, meet $npc:11004574$, and help the refugees in danger

quest.desc:
$npcName:11004614$ says the units deployed to $map:02020070$ have suffered heavy losses and are being reorganized.
$map:02020070$ is the gateway to $map:02020071$, but its defenses are so strong that allied casualties only keep increasing.
Suppress the Black Legion forces in $map:02020070$ to ease $npcName:11004614$'s worries.
Go to $map:02020070$ and defeat $npcName:25022603$, $npcName:25022600$, and $npcName:25022605$.
quest.descFameUI: Go to $map:02020070$ and defeat $npcName:25022603$, $npcName:25022600$, and $npcName:25022605$.

quest.desc:
$npcName:11004614$ says hunting activity in $map:02020066$ has noticeably decreased.
Since hunting is the refugees' main food source, something must have happened in $map:02020066$.
Go to $map:02020066$, meet $npc:11004574$, and find out what happened.
You must receive and complete the '$quest:40002804$' mission from $npc:11004574$.
quest.descFameUI: Go to $map:02020066$, meet $npc:11004574$, and find out what happened.
quest.manual: Go to $map:02020066$, meet $npc:11004574$, and find out what happened

quest.desc:
Georg created a special forces unit to strengthen its regular army. The special forces carry out the most dangerous missions on the front line.
Take on the special forces mission from $npcName:11004614$ and try to surpass your limits.
quest.descFameUI: You will be deployed on a high-difficulty Georg special forces mission. Mission Theme: Georg

quest.desc:
$npcName:11004614$ says the search party suffered heavy losses from beasts released by the Black Legion.
The search party was hit especially hard in $map:02020067$ and $map:02020068$.
If there are more wounded, Georg's operation will be affected. You cannot just leave this alone.
Defeat $npcName:25022302$ in $map:02020067$ and $npcName:25022401$ in $map:02020068$.
quest.descFameUI: Defeat $npcName:25022302$ in $map:02020067$ and $npcName:25022401$ in $map:02020068$.

quest.desc:
$npcName:11004614$ says signs of division have recently appeared among the Morang.
According to the search party, the number of Morang moving in groups and committing violence has rapidly increased.
There is concern that $npc:11004620$, who protects peace, may have lost their leadership.
Go to $map:02020069$, meet $npc:11004620$, and assess the situation.
You must receive and complete the '$quest:40002805$' mission from $npc:11004620$.
quest.descFameUI: Go to $map:02020069$, meet $npc:11004620$, and help the Morang.
quest.manual: Go to $map:02020069$, meet $npc:11004620$, and help the Morang tribe

quest.desc:
Georg created a special forces unit to strengthen its regular army. The special forces carry out the most dangerous missions on the front line.
Take on the special forces mission from $npcName:11004614$ and try to surpass your limits.
quest.descFameUI: You will be deployed on a high-difficulty Georg special forces mission. Mission Theme: Georg

quest.desc:
Allied soldiers attacking $map:02020070$ and $map:02020071$ are said to be frightened.
$npcName:11004614$ says it is because of a terrifying Black Legion monster that vanishes without a trace after attacking.
Rumors that it is a ghost are spreading among the soldiers, lowering morale.
Before the damage grows worse, you need to suppress them.
Go to $map:02020070$ and defeat $npcName:25022601$, then go to $map:02020071$ and defeat $npcName:25022700$.
quest.descFameUI: Go to $map:02020070$ and defeat $npcName:25022601$, then go to $map:02020071$ and defeat $npcName:25022700$.
Go to $map:02020066$, meet $npc:11004574$, and find out why the number of drones has decreased.
quest.desc:
$npcName:11004614$ says the number of surveillance drones in $map:02020066$ has recently dropped noticeably.
If the number of drones decreases, defending $map:02020066$ will be difficult, so it is unclear why their active count was reduced.
Go directly to $map:02020066$, meet $npc:11004574$, and find out why the number of drones has decreased.
You must receive and complete the '$quest:40002806$' mission from $npc:11004574$.
quest.manual: Go to $map:02020066$, meet $npc:11004574$, and find out why the number of drones has decreased

quest.descFameUI: Go to $map:02020066$, meet $npc:11004574$, and help solve the refugees' difficulties.
quest.desc:
$npcName:11004614$ asks you to go to $map:02020066$ without giving many details. She says she is always worried about the refugees staying in that barren place.
To answer $npcName:11004614$'s compassion, you feel determined to help the refugees even more.
Go to $map:02020066$, meet $npc:11004574$, and solve whatever difficulties they have.
You must receive and complete the '$quest:40002807$' mission from $npc:11004574$.
quest.manual: Go to $map:02020066$, meet $npc:11004574$, and help solve the refugees' troubles

quest.descFameUI: Go to $map:02020066$, meet $npc:11004574$, and find out whether Kerbes has caused any damage.
quest.desc:
$npcName:11004614$ says Kerbes activity near $map:02020067$ has increased noticeably.
That place is where refugees hunt for their livelihood despite the risk of kidnapping.
Go to $map:02020066$, meet $npc:11004574$, and find out whether Kerbes has caused any damage.
You must receive and complete the '$quest:40002808$' mission from $npc:11004574$.
quest.manual: Go to $map:02020066$, meet $npc:11004574$, and check whether the refugees have suffered any harm

quest.desc:
During a search mission, $npc:11004393$ saw Kerbes forces tormenting refugees for fun.
You cannot let monsters like that get away with it.
Go to $map:02020066$, meet $npc:11004574$, and repel the Kerbes forces.
You must receive and complete the '$quest:40002809$' mission from $npc:11004574$.
quest.descFameUI: Go to $map:02020066$, meet $npc:11004574$, and repel the Kerbes forces.
quest.manual: Go to $map:02020066$, meet $npc:11004574$, then repel the Kerbes forces

quest.desc:
$npcName:11004614$ says the Black Legion's plot to steal the mysterious power is always on her mind.
It would be good to strengthen security in $map:02020069$, but the Morang do not allow Georg to station troops there.
Go to $map:02020069$, meet $npc:11004620$, and look for a solution.
You must receive and complete the '$quest:40002810$' mission from $npc:11004620$.
quest.descFameUI: Go to $map:02020069$, meet $npc:11004620$, and look for a solution.
quest.manual: Go to $map:02020069$, meet $npc:11004620$, and find a solution

quest.desc:
$npcName:11004614$ says she has not been able to sleep lately because of all kinds of worries. She asks you to get $item:30001356$, saying it helps with restful sleep.
You cannot just leave Georg's leader unable to sleep.
Go to $map:02020068$, subdue $npcName:25022407$, and bring back $item:30001356$.
quest.descFameUI: Go to $map:02020068$, subdue $npcName:25022407$, and bring back $item:30001356$.
Go to $map:02020069$, meet $npc:11004620$, and warn them of the crisis.
quest.desc:
$npcName:11004614$ says creatures living near $map:02020069$ have started surrounding the nest.
She says the Black Legion seems to be corrupting the creatures and controlling them.
If this continues, $map:02020069$ will be attacked by creatures controlled by the Black Legion.
Go to $map:02020069$, meet $npc:11004620$, warn them of the crisis, and look for a solution.
You must receive and complete the '$quest:40002811$' mission from $npc:11004620$.

According to $npcName:11004614$, information has arrived that the atmosphere in $map:02020069$ has become ominous.
$npcName:11004614$ says fewer Morang are doing business, and some Morang no longer come out of their homes at all.
She says that since the Black Legion's movements are no different from before, something else must be happening.
Go directly to $map:02020069$, meet $npc:11004620$, and assess the situation.
You must receive and complete the '$quest:40002812$' mission from $npc:11004620$.
quest.descFameUI: Go to $map:02020069$, meet $npc:11004620$, and find out why the atmosphere has become ominous.

quest.desc:
$npcName:11004614$ and the Georg Research Institute are working to determine the principle behind blackening.
Blackening is the dark power the Black Legion uses to turn the Tyren Kingdom's mechanical soldiers into its minions.
$npcName:11004614$ says the research could progress if you obtain parts from blackened mechanical soldiers.
Go to $map:02020071$, defeat $npcName:25022707$ and $npcName:25022708$, and recover $item:30001357$.
quest.descFameUI: Go to $map:02020071$, defeat $npcName:25022707$ and $npcName:25022708$, and recover $item:30001357$.

quest.desc:
$npcName:11004614$ says another offensive against $map:02020070$ failed because of the Black Legion's $npcName:25022601$.
They are said to watch soldiers from the air and attack at lightning speed.
The research team says if they can determine the principle behind that tremendous speed, they can reduce casualties among the soldiers.
$npcName:11004614$ asks you to obtain $item:30001358$ for this purpose.
Go to $map:02020070$, defeat $npcName:25022601$, and bring back $item:30001358$.
quest.descFameUI: Go to $map:02020070$, defeat $npcName:25022601$, and bring back $item:30001358$.

quest.desc:
$npcName:11004614$ says Georg's military hospital is overflowing with patients. They are all soldiers bitten by spider robots in $map:02020071$.
Being bitten by a spider robot supposedly paralyzes the entire body and leaves the victim unable to move.
$npcName:11004614$ says even more soldiers have to be deployed to evacuate the paralyzed soldiers.
You cannot allow any more damage.
Go to $map:02020071$ and defeat $npcName:25022705$.
quest.descFameUI: Go to $map:02020071$ and defeat $npcName:25022705$.

quest.desc:
$npcName:11004614$ says another surprise attack on $map:02020071$ failed because of the Black Legion's one-horned monster.
Its tactic of circling in the air and diving at lightning speed often scatters the soldiers' formation.
Hearing $npcName:11004614$'s story somehow stirs your competitive spirit.
Go to $map:02020071$ and face $npcName:25022700$.
quest.descFameUI: Go to $map:02020071$ and face $npcName:25022700$.

quest.desc:
$npcName:11004614$ says the long war with the Tyren Kingdom has disrupted Ener production in $map:02020030$.
The parts of the Ener fusion device have grown old and no longer perform properly.
She says there is an Ener generator installed by the Tyren Kingdom in $map:02020034$.
$npcName:11004614$ says if you remove the STX-17 part from the generator, the Ener fusion device in $map:02020030$ should be able to perform properly.
Go to $map:02020034$ and bring back the Ener generator part STX-17.
quest.descFameUI: Go to $map:02020034$ and bring back the Ener generator part STX-17.

quest.desc:
$npcName:11004614$ says the intelligence department found the Tyren Kingdom's $map:52100115$ in $map:02020013$.
She says the Tyren Kingdom seems to plan to connect $map:02020013$ through $map:02020010$ with a highway.
If construction is completed, $map:02020013$, a supply route, will be attacked by Tyren forces coming down the highway from $map:02020010$.
You cannot just watch Georg's supply route collapse.
Go to $map:52100115$, connected to $map:02020013$, and suppress $npcName:25023000$, $npcName:25023001$, and $npcName:25023002$, who are assigned to construction.
quest.descFameUI: Go to $map:52100115$, connected to $map:02020013$, and suppress $npcName:25023000$, $npcName:25023001$, and $npcName:25023002$.

quest.desc:
$npcName:11004614$ says the scout team discovered $map:52100116$ in $map:02020003$.
After analyzing the footage, they determined this place is a warehouse where Kerbes stores food produced by forcing refugees into labor.
$npcName:11004614$ says that if you raid $map:52100116$ and neutralize the guards, allied soldiers will be able to seize the food.
Go to $map:52100116$ in $map:02020003$ and suppress $npcName:25023100$ and $npcName:25023101$.
quest.descFameUI: Go to $map:52100116$ in $map:02020003$ and suppress $npcName:25023100$ and $npcName:25023101$.

quest.desc:
$npcName:11004614$ says the Tyren Kingdom planted a bomb in $map:02020014$.
$map:02020014$ is said to be a place Georg created to protect and study Kidel's flora and fauna.
Judging by the bomb's scale, she says it seems the Tyren Kingdom intends to blow up all of $map:02020014$.
You cannot just watch $map:02020014$ be destroyed.
Go to $map:02020014$ and disarm the MK42 bomb installed by the Tyren Kingdom.
quest.descFameUI: Go to $map:02020014$ and disarm the MK42 bomb installed by the Tyren Kingdom.
quest.manual: Go to $map:02020014$ and defuse the MK42 bombs of the Tyren Kingdom

quest.descFameUI: Go to $map:02020008$ and seize the supply crates before they fall into the hands of the Morang thugs.
quest.desc:
$npcName:11004614$ says Kerbes has begun distributing some of the supply crates it received from the Tyren Kingdom to Morang thugs.
They are supposedly trying to win over the Morang thugs and use them to kidnap refugees.
$npcName:11004614$ worries that if the Morang thugs are recruited, refugee kidnappings will accelerate.
Go to $map:02020008$ and seize the supply crates before they fall into the hands of the Morang thugs.
quest.manual: Go to $map:02020008$ and seize the supply boxes

quest.descFameUI: For the Georg research team, go to $map:02020018$ and secure a glowing blue relic.
quest.desc:
$npcName:11004614$ says $map:02020018$ is a Kritias temple built in ancient times.
It was built so long ago that no record remains of who built the temple or why.
$npcName:11004614$ says the research team is studying the blue-glowing relics in $map:02020018$.
She says they have not yet identified the nature of the blue light or the function of the relics, but they intend to continue researching without giving up.
For the research team, go to $map:02020018$ and secure a glowing blue relic.
quest.manual: Go to $map:02020018$ and secure the shining blue relic

quest.desc:
$npcName:11004614$ says the intelligence team finally discovered the secret hideout of the Morang thugs after long effort.
The place, called $map:52100117$, is said to exist somewhere hidden in $map:02020008$.
She says the Morang thugs are expanding their influence by using $map:52100117$ as a base to attack outsiders.
Raiding $map:52100117$ would deal a heavy blow to the Morang thugs.
Go to $map:52100117$ in $map:02020008$ and suppress $npcName:25023201$ and $npcName:25023202$.
quest.descFameUI: Go to $map:52100117$ in $map:02020008$ and suppress $npcName:25023201$ and $npcName:25023202$.

quest.desc:
$npcName:11004614$ says the Georg-Maple Alliance surprise attack on $map:02020037$ ended in failure.
The surprise attack was discovered after being detected by intrusion detection sensors installed in $map:02020037$.
$npcName:11004614$ is discouraged, saying surprise operations will remain impossible as long as high-performance intrusion detection sensors are installed in $map:02020037$.
Stealthily infiltrate $map:02020037$ and turn off the Tyren Kingdom's intrusion detection sensors.
quest.descFameUI: Infiltrate $map:02020037$ and turn off the Tyren Kingdom's intrusion detection sensors.

quest.desc:
$npcName:11004614$ says Kerbes's rage has reached its peak after their attack on $map:02020066$ was thwarted.
Furious Kerbes forces are throwing grenades indiscriminately into $map:02020066$.
If this continues, damage to the refugees will spiral out of control.
Go to $map:02020066$, meet $npc:11004574$, and repel the Kerbes forces.
You must receive and complete the '$quest:40002813$' mission from $npc:11004574$.
quest.descFameUI: Go to $map:02020066$, meet $npc:11004574$, and repel the Kerbes forces.
Go to $map:02020066$, defeat $npcName:25022202$, and secure $item:30001359$.
quest.desc:
$npcName:11004614$ asks what kind of person men in Maple World like. When you ask why she wants to know, she panics and says she was just asking.
Then $npcName:11004614$ abruptly asks you to get $item:30001359$ from $npcName:25022202$'s tail.
She says it is to analyze the ore and understand $npcName:25022202$'s structure, but something feels suspicious.
Still, go to $map:02020066$, defeat $npcName:25022202$, and secure $item:30001359$.

$npcName:11004614$ says the Black Legion forces stationed in $map:02020067$ have been reinforced.
They are not attacking the refugees right away, but you need to find out why their forces were reinforced.
Go to $map:02020066$, meet $npc:11004574$, and find out why the Black Legion increased its forces.
You must receive and complete the '$quest:40002814$' mission from $npc:11004574$.
quest.descFameUI: Go to $map:02020066$, meet $npc:11004574$, and find out why the Black Legion increased its forces.

quest.desc:
$npcName:11004614$ says the search party witnessed Kerbes kidnapping refugees.
She is frustrated that Kerbes loaded the refugees into a vehicle and left, so the search party could not rescue them.
Go to $map:02020066$, meet $npc:11004574$, and look for a way to rescue the refugees.
You must receive and complete the '$quest:40002815$' mission from $npc:11004574$.
quest.descFameUI: Go to $map:02020066$, meet $npc:11004574$, and look for a way to rescue the refugees.

quest.desc:
$npcName:11004614$ says rumors are spreading that $map:02020068$ has been gripped by fear.
