She says an unidentified creature is wandering the forest and attacking Morang.
If this continues, the number of Morang victims will keep increasing.
Go to $map:02020069$, meet $npc:11004620$, assess the situation, and look for a solution.
You must receive and complete the '$quest:40002816$' mission from $npc:11004620$.
quest.descFameUI: Go to $map:02020069$, meet $npc:11004620$, assess the situation, and look for a solution.

quest.desc:
$npcName:11004614$ says she has been so busy taking care of refugees lately that exchanges with the Morang seem to have grown distant.
She says that if you have many conversations with $npc:11004620$, you should be able to connect with the Morang.
You spoke with $npc:11004620$ not long ago, but it does not seem to be enough to satisfy $npcName:11004614$.
Go to $map:02020069$, meet $npc:11004620$, talk with them, and find out whether there is anything you can help with.
You must receive and complete the '$quest:40002817$' mission from $npc:11004620$.
quest.descFameUI: Go to $map:02020069$, meet $npc:11004620$, talk with them, and look for something to help with.
Go to $map:02020069$, meet $npc:11004620$, and investigate the incident.
quest.desc:
$npcName:11004614$ says the ecosystem near $map:02020069$ is being disrupted.
She says something like spores is scattering everywhere, and the forest animals are running wild because of it.
$npcName:11004614$ asks you to investigate the incident yourself.
Go to $map:02020069$, meet $npc:11004620$, and investigate the incident.
You must receive and complete the '$quest:40002818$' mission from $npc:11004620$.

$npcName:11004614$ says robot bugs have invaded $map:02020069$.
$npcName:25022505$ are attacking the Morang indiscriminately, throwing $map:02020069$ into chaos.
If this continues, $map:02020069$ will face a major crisis.
Go to $map:02020069$, meet $npc:11004620$, and look for a way to repel $npcName:25022505$.
You must receive and complete the '$quest:40002819$' mission from $npc:11004620$.
quest.descFameUI: Go to $map:02020069$, meet $npc:11004620$, and look for a way to repel $npcName:25022505$.

quest.desc:
$npcName:11004614$ says $npcName:25022602$, consumed by black energy in $map:02020070$, is releasing pollen.
She says $npcName:25022602$'s contaminated pollen is staining northern Kidel with black energy.
Before the contamination spreads, go to $map:02020070$ and defeat $npcName:25022602$, which has been consumed by black energy.
quest.descFameUI: Go to $map:02020070$ and defeat $npcName:25022602$, which has been consumed by black energy.

quest.desc:
$npcName:11004614$ says the Georg Research Institute is studying blackening.
Blackened mechanical soldiers turn black and then obey the Black Legion's control.
$npcName:11004614$ says the research will progress if you can obtain parts from $npcName:25022708$.
Go to $map:02020071$, defeat $npcName:25022708$, and secure $item:30001362$.
quest.descFameUI: Go to $map:02020071$, defeat $npcName:25022708$, and secure $item:30001362$.

quest.desc:
$npcName:11004614$ asks what kinds of gifts men in Maple World like.
When you jokingly answer that they like very hideous and fierce pets, she asks you to capture $npcName:25022706$.
You cannot take back what you already said.
Go to $map:02020071$ and capture $npcName:25022706$.
quest.descFameUI: Go to $map:02020071$ and capture $npcName:25022706$.

quest.desc:
$npcName:11004614$ says the special forces deployed to $map:02020071$ suffered heavy damage from $npcName:25022701$.
They had many wounded from its terrifying strength and sharp horn, and had no choice but to retreat.
Defeating Georg's elite unit... This is an opponent that stirs your competitive spirit.
Go directly to $map:02020071$ and suppress $npcName:25022701$.
quest.descFameUI: Go to $map:02020071$ and suppress $npcName:25022701$.

quest.desc:
$npcName:11004614$ says one platoon of Georg's regular army was captured by Tyren Kingdom forces.
It happened because the Tyren Kingdom intercepted operational communications between $map:02020030$ and $map:02020033$.
$npcName:11004614$ says the Tyren Kingdom is conducting the wiretapping from an interception receiver tower in $map:02020016$.
As long as the wiretapping continues, damage will keep occurring.
Go to $map:02020016$ and disable the interception receiver tower.
quest.descFameUI: Go to $map:02020016$ and disable the interception receiver tower.
Go to $map:02020010$ and intercept the boxes of gold bars before Kerbes receives them.
quest.desc:
$npcName:11004614$ says boxes of gold bars to be delivered to Kerbes are being loaded in $map:02020010$.
The boxes of gold bars are said to be provided by the Tyren Kingdom to Kerbes in exchange for information.
$npcName:11004614$ says Kerbes will soon arrive in $map:02020010$ to receive the boxes of gold bars.
Go to $map:02020010$ and intercept the boxes of gold bars before Kerbes receives them.
quest.name: The Price of Information
quest.manual: Intercept the gold bar boxes in $map:02020010$

quest.desc:
$npcName:11004614$ says she has thought of a way to put the Tyren Royal Guard in trouble.
The Royal Guard, made up of nobles, supposedly loves luxury goods boxes so they can live lavishly even on the battlefield.
She says luxury goods boxes airlifted from the Tyren Kingdom will soon arrive near $map:02020033$.
If you seize the items in the luxury goods boxes, the Tyren Royal Guard will fall into a panic.
Intercept the items from the luxury goods boxes near $map:02020033$.
quest.descFameUI: Intercept the items from the luxury goods boxes near $map:02020033$.
quest.manual: Intercept the goods from luxury item boxes near $map:02020033$

quest.descFameUI: Go to $map:52100118$ in $map:02020051$ and suppress $npcName:25023300$ and $npcName:25023301$.
quest.desc:
$npcName:11004614$ says they received information that abandoned robots in $map:02020051$ are making weapons.
They are supposedly manufacturing weapons from waste materials to sell to Kerbes.
According to the intelligence department, a weapons deal between Kerbes and the robots will take place today at $map:52100118$ in the landfill.
You cannot just watch the weapons deal succeed and strengthen Kerbes's forces.
Go to $map:52100118$ in $map:02020051$ and suppress $npcName:25023300$ and $npcName:25023301$.

$npcName:11004614$ says Kerbes is growing crops in $map:02020003$.
They are supposedly kidnapping refugees and forcing them to work in the farmland.
According to the search party, new seed stock recently arrived in $map:02020003$.
If you seize the seed stock, Kerbes's food supply will run into problems.
Go to $map:02020003$ and seize the seed stock.
quest.descFameUI: Go to $map:02020003$ and seize the seed stock.

quest.desc:
$npcName:11004614$ says they detected equipment in $map:02020035$ suspected to be a blackening conversion device.
She says it seems Tyren Kingdom mechanical soldiers are converted into Black Legion minions through this equipment.
Securing the conversion device's key component will help determine the principle behind blackening.
Go to $map:02020035$ and secure the conversion device's key component.
quest.descFameUI: Go to $map:02020035$ and secure the conversion device's key component.
Go to $map:02020009$ and turn off the high-frequency Ener emitter.
quest.desc:
$npcName:11004614$ says Kerbes installed a high-frequency Ener emitter in $map:02020009$.
She says Kerbes seems to be trying to use the high-frequency Ener emitter to make the abandoned robots in $map:02020009$ run wild.
$npcName:11004614$ says an allied search party carrying out an operation in $map:02020009$ recently suffered heavy damage from rampaging robots.
If the high-frequency Ener emitter is not shut down, the damage will continue to grow.
Go to $map:02020009$ and turn off the high-frequency Ener emitter.

$npcName:11004614$ says the Georg-Maple Alliance attack on $map:02020037$ ended in failure.
She says it failed because of the long-range artillery deployed by the Tyren Kingdom.
The long-range artillery called KG-42 is said to have excellent destructive power, rate of fire, and accuracy, causing the allied forces to suffer heavy damage and retreat.
For an attack on $map:02020037$ to succeed, the long-range artillery must be suppressed first.
Go to $map:02020037$ and destroy the long-range artillery.
quest.descFameUI: Go to $map:02020037$ and destroy the long-range artillery.

quest.desc:
$npcName:11004614$ says information has arrived that the atmosphere in Galan is unsettled.
More refugees are ignoring the order that has been maintained and acting however they please.
$npcName:11004614$ asks you to find out whether the cause is an external factor, or whether $npc:11004574$ has lost leadership.
Go to $map:02020066$, meet $npc:11004574$, and look for a way to restore order.
You must receive and complete the '$quest:40002820$' mission from $npc:11004574$.
quest.descFameUI: Go to $map:02020066$, meet $npc:11004574$, and look for a way to restore order.
Go to $map:02020066$, meet $npc:11004574$, and track down whatever harmed the refugees.
quest.desc:
$npcName:11004614$ says the search party transported unconscious refugees found near Galan to $map:02020030$.
According to the military doctor, the refugees' wounds were caused by something other than Kerbes weapons.
Go to $map:02020066$, meet $npc:11004574$, and track down whatever harmed the refugees.
You must receive and complete the '$quest:40002821$' mission from $npc:11004574$.

$npcName:11004614$ worries about the refugees, who must be suffering in the sweltering heat.
She is not making a specific request, but this is clearly silent pressure.
Go to $map:02020066$, meet $npc:11004574$, and look for a way to deal with the heat.
You must receive and complete the '$quest:40002822$' mission from $npc:11004574$.
quest.descFameUI: Go to $map:02020066$, meet $npc:11004574$, and look for a way to deal with the heat.

quest.desc:
$npcName:11004614$ says the Tyren Kingdom holds fireworks around this time every year. It is supposedly to wish happiness for loved ones.
She worries that the refugees of Galan may be very upset because they cannot have fireworks.
If you use Kerbes's thrown explosives, the refugees may be able to have fireworks.
Go to $map:02020067$, suppress $npcName:25022303$, and bring back the thrown explosives.
quest.descFameUI: Go to $map:02020067$, suppress $npcName:25022303$, and bring back $item:30001364$.

quest.desc:
$npcName:11004614$ says $map:02020068$ has recently been consumed by black energy at a rapid pace.
It is nothing new for the Black Legion to contaminate $map:02020068$, but the speed has suddenly increased.
If this continues, even $map:02020069$ may be stained by black energy.
Go to $map:02020069$, meet $npc:11004620$, and look for a way to stop the contamination.
You must receive and complete the '$quest:40002825$' mission from $npc:11004620$.
quest.descFameUI: Go to $map:02020069$, meet $npc:11004620$, and look for a way to stop the contamination.

quest.desc:
$npcName:11004614$ says the Morang in $map:02020069$ are suffering from food shortages.
Food shortages for Morang who lived abundantly thanks to plentiful tree fruit... Something must have happened.
Go to $map:02020069$, meet $npc:11004620$, and investigate the cause of the food shortage.
You must receive and complete the '$quest:40002826$' mission from $npc:11004620$.
quest.descFameUI: Go to $map:02020069$, meet $npc:11004620$, and investigate the cause of the food shortage.
Go to $map:02020069$, meet $npc:11004620$, and discuss ways to strengthen security.
quest.desc:
$npcName:11004614$ says the Black Legion has not stopped trying to steal the Morang's 'mysterious power.'
They are said to be constantly sending creatures consumed by black energy to $map:02020069$.
$npcName:11004614$ worries that the Morang's primitive weapons are not enough to stand against the Black Legion.
Go to $map:02020069$, meet $npc:11004620$, and discuss ways to strengthen security.
You must receive and complete the '$quest:40002823$' mission from $npc:11004620$.

$npcName:11004614$ says activity among the residents of $map:02020069$ has noticeably increased.
According to drone footage, it does not look like commercial activity. Morang are gathering and moving around a specific place.
It would be good if this is something positive... but if something bad has happened, you should help the Morang.
Go to $map:02020069$, meet $npc:11004620$, and find out what happened.
You must receive and complete the '$quest:40002824$' mission from $npc:11004620$.
quest.descFameUI: Go to $map:02020069$, meet $npc:11004620$, and find out what happened.
Go to $map:02020070$ and suppress $npcName:25022600$.
quest.desc:
$npcName:11004614$ says a full-scale offensive against $map:02020070$ has begun.
The regular army and special forces will attack $map:02020070$ together.
$map:02020070$ is heavily defended, so there will be many casualties.
If you suppress the main force, $npcName:25022600$, before the full offensive, you may be able to reduce the damage.
Go to $map:02020070$ and suppress $npcName:25022600$.

$npcName:11004614$ says the attack operation against $map:02020070$ has run into a major obstacle.
It is because the Black Legion blackened $npcName:25022604$ and deployed it in $map:02020070$.
She says $npcName:25022604$ is causing heavy damage to allied forces with its sharp poisonous stinger.
Before there are more casualties, go to $map:02020070$ and suppress $npcName:25022604$.
quest.descFameUI: Go to $map:02020070$ and suppress $npcName:25022604$.
Go to $map:02020071$, defeat $npcName:25022702$, and secure $item:30001367$.
quest.desc:
$npcName:11004614$ says some of the Black Legion forces deployed in $map:02020071$ have terrifying combat power.
In particular, $npcName:25022702$ is said to possess immense combat power that cannot be explained by its physical structure.
Citing the research team's opinion, $npcName:11004614$ says $item:30001367$ on $npcName:25022702$'s head is likely the source of its power.
For detailed research, go to $map:02020071$, defeat $npcName:25022702$, and secure $item:30001367$.
quest.name: Searching for the Source of Power

quest.desc:
$npcName:11004614$ says allied rifle bullets cannot pierce the shield of $npcName:25022704$ stationed in $map:02020071$.
She says that to attack $map:02020071$, they need to analyze the shield's composition and find a way to penetrate it.
Go to $map:02020071$, defeat $npcName:25022704$, and secure $item:30001368$.
quest.descFameUI: Go to $map:02020071$, defeat $npcName:25022704$, and secure $item:30001368$.

quest.desc:
$npcName:11004614$ says the outskirts of $map:02020032$ have been occupied by the Black Legion.
She says allied forces withdrew in a hurry and left behind medium-range cannon.
$npcName:11004614$ regrets that recovering even the parts would greatly help allied strength.
To strengthen Georg's forces, go to $map:02020032$ and recover medium-range cannon parts.
quest.descFameUI: Go to $map:02020032$ and recover medium-range cannon parts.

quest.desc:
$npcName:11004614$ says they identified the location of weapons crates the Tyren Kingdom provided to Kerbes.
These weapons crates are said to be what Kerbes received in exchange for providing information to the Tyren Kingdom.
$npcName:11004614$ says Kerbes received the weapons crates and transported them to $map:02020016$.
If you launch a surprise attack there, you should be able to find the weapons crates.
Go to $map:02020016$ and seize the weapons crates.
quest.descFameUI: Go to $map:02020016$ and seize the weapons crates.
quest.name: The Reward of Greed

quest.desc:
$npcName:11004614$ says the Poings in $map:02020013$ are obsessed with a certain fruit tree.
It is a fruit tree that bears blue fruit, and they attack fiercely whenever the scouting team even approaches it.
$npcName:11004614$ says she cannot help but wonder why the Poings are so obsessed with the fruit tree.
For $npcName:11004614$, go to $map:02020013$ and pick blue fruit.
quest.descFameUI: Go to $map:02020013$ and pick blue fruit.
Go to $map:02020033$ and destroy the long-range cannon.
quest.desc:
$npcName:11004614$ says the Tyren Kingdom's long-range cannon has been deployed on the outskirts of $map:02020033$.
The long-range cannon called KG-42 is said to be a weapon with terrifying destructive power.
She worries that if the long-range cannon begins shelling, $map:02020033$ will suffer heavy damage.
Before the shelling begins, go to $map:02020033$ and destroy the long-range cannon.

$npcName:11004614$ says $npc:11004618$ tried to contact allied forces through their adjutant, $npcName:11004619$.
$npc:11004619$ supposedly offered to arrange a meeting with $npcName:11004618$ if you come to $map:02020051$ to meet them.
If you secure $npcName:11004618$, you may gain important information that can bring down Kerbes.
Meet $npcName:11004619$ in $map:02020051$, determine $npc:11004618$'s location, and make contact with $npc:11004618$.
quest.descFameUI: Meet $npcName:11004619$ in $map:02020051$, determine $npc:11004618$'s location, and make contact with $npc:11004618$.

quest.desc:
$npcName:11004614$ says the Tyren Kingdom is testing a new mechanical soldier in $map:02020018$.
The test subject is said to be a latest model with blue paint, different from existing mechanical soldiers.
$npcName:11004614$ says the scouting team discovered a weapons data measuring device installed in $map:02020018$.
$npcName:11004614$ says it seems the new weapon's performance test is being conducted through the data measuring device in $map:02020018$.
To avoid losing the war against the Tyren Kingdom, you need to analyze data on the new weapon.
Go to $map:02020018$ and secure the test data from the data measuring device.
quest.descFameUI: Go to $map:02020018$ and secure the test data from the data measuring device.
quest.manual: Go to $map:02020018$ and obtain test data from the data measuring device

quest.desc:
$npcName:11004614$ says the research team is studying black energy, the source of the Black Legion's contamination.
She says they are trying to analyze black energy scientifically.
You said black energy is not a scientific phenomenon, but $npcName:11004614$ counters that there is nothing science cannot explain.
It seems it would be faster for her to experience it directly and understand.
Go to $map:02020036$ and collect black energy, then return.
quest.descFameUI: Go to $map:02020036$ and collect black energy.

quest.desc:
$npcName:11004614$ says $map:02020017$ is an ancient ruin of Kritias.
She says that now that northwestern Kidel has been secured, they plan to explore $map:02020017$ in earnest.
$npcName:11004614$ says the first step of the expedition is securing an ancient relic of the Blue Hall.
Studying the relic may reveal the origin of the Blue Hall.
Go to $map:02020017$, secure an ancient relic of the Blue Hall, and return.
quest.descFameUI: Go to $map:02020017$ and secure an ancient relic of the Blue Hall.
quest.manual: Go to $map:02020017$ and secure the ancient relic of the Blue Temple

quest.desc:
$npcName:11004614$ says they found $map:52100114$, but are having trouble entering it.
She says it is because of $npcName:25022901$, who is guarding Tekin.
$npcName:11004614$ says soldiers suffered heavy damage from its sharp horns.
Since its body is covered in armor and it is extremely fast, it is not easy to suppress.
Before more soldiers get hurt, go to $map:52100114$ and suppress $npcName:25022901$.
quest.descFameUI: Go to $map:52100114$ and suppress $npcName:25022901$.

quest.desc:
$npcName:11004614$ says the special forces attacking $map:02020070$ suffered heavy damage from $npcName:25022607$ and $npcName:25022608$.
Black Legion Masters are said to have terrifying attack power unlike ordinary Black Legion groups.
$npcName:11004614$ says the soldiers now freeze just from seeing their black cloaks.
If the Black Legion Masters cannot be suppressed, the attack on $map:02020070$ will not succeed.
Go to $map:02020070$ and suppress $npcName:25022607$ and $npcName:25022608$.
quest.descFameUI: Go to $map:02020070$ and suppress $npcName:25022607$ and $npcName:25022608$.

quest.desc:
$npcName:11004614$ says allied soldiers attacking $map:02020070$ and $map:02020071$ suffered heavy damage from the Black Legion's beasts.
After slashing with sharp claws, they charge with the large horns on their backs, knocking even heavily armed special forces soldiers away in a single blow.
If these beasts cannot be suppressed, the attacks on $map:02020070$ and $map:02020071$ will not succeed.
Suppress $npcName:25022606$ and $npcName:25022609$ in $map:02020070$, and $npcName:25022703$ and $npcName:25022709$ in $map:02020071$.
quest.descFameUI: Suppress $npcName:25022606$ and $npcName:25022609$ in $map:02020070$, and $npcName:25022703$ and $npcName:25022709$ in $map:02020071$.

quest.desc:
$npcName:11004614$ says northern Kidel was secured through a joint operation with the Maple Alliance, but attacks by Tyren mechanical soldiers are causing heavy losses.
In particular, $npcName:25023003$, $npcName:25023004$, and $npcName:25023303$ are said to be causing severe damage to soldiers with their powerful combat ability.
$npcName:11004614$ says that if you suppress them, you may be able to gain the upper hand in the war against Tyren.
Defeat $npcName:25023003$ and $npcName:25023004$ in $map:52100115$, connected to $map:02020013$, and $npcName:25023303$ in $map:52100118$, connected to $map:02020051$.
quest.descFameUI: Defeat $npcName:25023003$ and $npcName:25023004$ in $map:52100115$, and $npcName:25023303$ in $map:52100118$.

quest.desc:
$npcName:11004614$ says the special forces will soon launch surprise attacks on Kerbes bases $map:52100114$ and $map:52100116$.
She says if they proceed with the surprise operation as-is, they will suffer heavy damage from $npcName:25022902$, $npcName:25022903$, and $npcName:25023102$.
That is because combat simulations concluded that the unit members are vulnerable to those Kerbes forces.
You need to eliminate the factors that could cause the surprise operation to fail.
Suppress $npcName:25022902$ and $npcName:25022903$ in $map:52100114$, connected to $map:02020067$, and $npcName:25023102$ in $map:52100116$, connected to $map:02020003$.
quest.descFameUI: Suppress $npcName:25022902$ and $npcName:25022903$ in $map:52100114$, and $npcName:25023102$ in $map:52100116$.

quest.name: Funky Cat
quest.desc:
Equip the entire Technokitty outfit to complete the quest.
* The Technokitty outfit consists of 6 items. The entire set must be equipped.
Male: $item:11850151$, $item:11150047$, $item:11304781$, $item:11710013$, $item:11604690$, $item:12200527$ Female: $item:11850152$, $item:11150048$, $item:11304782$, $item:11710014$, $item:11604691$, $item:12200528$

quest.name: An Adventurer's Dignity
quest.desc:
Equip the entire Dignified Armor outfit to complete the quest.
* The Dignified Armor outfit consists of 6 items. The entire set must be equipped.
Male: $item:11850149$, $item:11610007$, $item:11710011$, $item:11250094$, $item:11304779$, $item:12200521$ Female: $item:11850150$, $item:11610008$, $item:11710012$, $item:11250095$, $item:11304780$, $item:12200522$
quest.manual: Equip the entire Dignified Armor set

quest.name: Meow! Meow! Meow!
quest.desc:
Equip the entire Kitten Maid outfit.
The Kitten Maid outfit consists of 6 items. The entire set must be equipped.
Male: $item:11250103$, $item:11301071$, $item:11600989$, $item:11701066$, $item:11850157$, $item:12200490$ Female: $item:11250104$, $item:11301072$, $item:11600990$, $item:11701067$, $item:11850158$, $item:12200491$
quest.manual: Equip the entire Kitten Maid set

quest.name: Snow Bright
quest.desc:
Equip the entire Snow Tale outfit.
The Snow Tale outfit consists of 6 items. The entire set must be equipped.
Male: $item:11250109$, $item:11301244$, $item:11601144$, $item:11701225$, $item:11850163$, $item:12200539$ Female: $item:11250110$, $item:11301245$, $item:11601145$, $item:11701226$, $item:11850164$, $item:12200540$
quest.manual: Equip the entire Snow Tale set

quest.name: Luminaire Chic
quest.desc:
Equip the entire Luminaire outfit to complete the quest.
* The Luminaire outfit consists of 6 items. The entire set must be equipped.
Male: $item:11200097$, $item:11301279$, $item:11601164$, $item:11701259$, $item:11800124$, $item:12200557$ Female: $item:11200098$, $item:11301391$, $item:11601165$, $item:11701260$, $item:11800125$, $item:12200558$

quest.name: Items Worth Paying Attention To
quest.desc: Some outfits obtained from the $item:20301206$ contain hidden quests! Pay attention to the outfit icons and tooltips to find them!

quest.name: Items Worth Paying Attention To
quest.desc: Some outfits grant special rewards when you equip the full set, so pay attention when you see an explanation mark on an outfit's icon!
